article.articleHeadline: Brasil lidera coalizão G20 com foco no combate à dengue - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil leads G20 coalition focused on fighting dengue - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleSummary: Brazil leads the G20 Coalition for Local and Regional Production, Innovation and Equitable Access, with dengue as its first priority. The initiative aims to boost local production of vaccines, diagnostics and health technologies for equitable access in developing countries. Members include Brazil, South Africa, Germany, China, France, Indonesia, the UK, Russia, Türkiye, the EU and the African Union; Fiocruz is executive secretariat. In Rio, the first dengue proposal call was launched to boost production for vulnerable populations. Brazil signed a WuXi deal to scale the Butantan DV dengue vaccine to 30 million doses in H2 2026, and an LOI with the International Vaccine Institute under BRIGHT Fund to advance vaccines for Brazil and LMICs. Separately, tacrolimus will be domestically produced via an India tech transfer, benefiting about 120,000 SUS patients. A new RNA vaccine center at UFMG with R$65 million raises total federal investment to R$150 million to enable rapid pandemic response.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがデング熱対策に焦点を当てたG20連合を主導 - ブラジリア新聞
triage.triage_reason: デング熱関連の国際的な予防・生産支援イニシアティブであり、複数国が関与する政策・技術移転の枠組みが報じられている。ただし、急性的な感染症アウトブレイク拡大の報告ではなく、長期的なキャパシティビルディング中心のため、現段階では情報不足で経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は現在のデング熱アウトブレイク対応というより、G20主導の多国間協力枠組み（ワクチン生産、技術移転、研究開発投資）の発表である。acute outbreak situationではなく、長期的な公衆衛生キャパシティ構築が中心。デング熱は既知の流行易い感染症であり、長期的な曝露リスクはあるが、新規の急性シグナルの特性は限定的。続報でアウトブレイク状況の急速な悪化や新規流行地への拡大が報じられれば再評価を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Campak Nasional Naik, Dinkes Tana Tidung Andalkan Rekam Medis Elektronik - Tribunkaltim.co
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Measles Cases Rise, Tana Tidung Regency Health Office Relies on Electronic Medical Records
article.articleSummary: Nationwide measles cases are rising in several regions of Indonesia, but Tana Tidung Regency Health Office reports the area remains under control and without measles in years. Health Director Mohammad Sarif said there have been no measles cases in Tana Tidung for years, aided by electronic medical records that enable real-time monitoring of community health. A digital early-warning system allows rapid detection and early interventions to prevent outbreaks. In response to increases elsewhere, Tana Tidung authorities have intensified preventive education, disseminating a government circular to heighten alertness and producing short educational videos for the public. These measures reflect a broader national emphasis on surveillance, data-driven decision making, and community outreach to manage measles risk as of March 24, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 全国麻疹患者数が増加、タナ・ティドゥン県保健局が電子医療記録に依存
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア全域での麻疹患者増加は異常・予想外の兆候だが、記事の主焦点はタナ・ティドゥン県の防御体制であり、具体的な患者数、重症度、死亡情報が不明。国際的拡大リスクも明記されていない。
triage.notes: インドネシア全域での麻疹患者増加が報告されており、スクリーニング基準は複数該当（異常性、流行しやすさ）。ただし、患者数、重症度、死亡の有無、国際的拡大リスクなど重要な情報が不足している。タナ・ティドゥン県では数年間患者がないとの報告であり、具体的な患者数データが記事に含まれていない。続報により詳細が明らかになる可能性がため、経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: SSM plans tongue-swab screening to detect tuberculosis in seniors | MACAU DAILY TIMES 澳門每日時報
article.articleSummary: Macau's Health Bureau TB Prevention and Control Center will roll out tongue-swab screening in the second half of 2026 to detect tuberculosis infections or latent TB among seniors and others unable to provide sputum. The initiative targets high‑risk groups and aims for earlier identification to curb transmission. World Tuberculosis Day was observed as Macau reported 258 TB cases in 2025, or 37.5 per 100,000 people, still far from the WHO 2035 target of fewer than 10 per 100,000. Dr. Chou Kwok Hei emphasized raising awareness and promoting early testing and treatment among citizens and healthcare workers. Tuberculosis is airborne; symptoms prompting testing include a persistent cough longer than two weeks, sputum or blood in cough, unexplained weight loss, and night sweats. Current diagnostics include tuberculin skin tests, blood or sputum tests, and chest X-rays.

triage.headline_ja: SSM、シニア向けの舌スワブスクリーニングで結核検出を計画 | マカオ日報
triage.triage_reason: 結核は公衆衛生上の懸念であり、マカオの罹患率がWHO目標値を大きく上回る（37.5対100,000）が、記事は既知の結核対策の新しいスクリーニング方法の導入について述べており、新規アウトブレイクやシグナルの要素は明確ではない。継続的な動向監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はマカオ（China に含める）での結核対策の新規スクリーニング導入について。258症例（2025年）が報告されており、WHO目標より罹患率は高いが、これは既知のエンデミック状況の継続と位置付けられる。シニア向けの新しい検査方法の導入は公衆衛生上のポジティブな対応と見なされるため、緊急性の高いシグナルではなくWATCHレベルが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Tackling TB, a seriously deadly matter
article.articleSummary: World Tuberculosis Day, observed March 24 since 1982, highlights that TB remains the world's leading infectious killer. The article notes TB infection affects about 25% of the global population. In 2023, 10.8 million people were infected and 1.25 million died; about 4,400 deaths annually and 30,000 infections are reported each year. An estimated 170 crore people have TB, with 79 million survivors since 2000. In India, TB-affected rate is 188 per 100,000 people. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis and spreads via airborne droplets; infection can occur from inhaling a few germs. Drug resistance is rising due to inappropriate prescriptions, poor drug quality, and interrupted treatment. India has expanded screening, faster diagnostics, and large-scale treatment, but incidence remains above elimination targets and drug-resistant TB requires longer regimens. WHO’s theme: "Yes! We can end TB: Led by countries, powered by people," urging leadership and investment toward a 2023 elimination target.

triage.headline_ja: 結核対策、極めて深刻な問題
triage.triage_reason: World Tuberculosis Day の啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや急性的な感染症危機を報告するものではない。既知の疾病負荷の現状説明が主題である。
triage.notes: 本記事はWorld Tuberculosis Day（3月24日）の啓発キャンペーン記事であり、新規なアウトブレイクイベントではなく、既知の結核の世界的な疾病負荷と対策の現状を述べている。シグナルトリアージの対象外として判定。

article.articleHeadline: 云南开展世界防治结核病日宣传活动
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yunnan Carries Out World TB Day Awareness Activities
article.articleSummary: On March 24—the 31st World Tuberculosis Day—Yunnan Province held its provincial-level main event at Yunnan Transportation Vocational College, under the theme “Comprehensive action, full commitment, broad participation to end TB.” The program featured expert free clinics, distribution of promotional materials, lantern riddles, interactive games, and prize Q&As to explain TB prevention policies and disseminate scientific control knowledge, engaging students and staff to strengthen on-campus health defenses. Tuberculosis remains a major infectious disease; in a three-year plan, Yunnan includes TB prevention and control within the “disease control” project, expanding screening, ensuring effective treatment, and standardizing management. The province maintains a governance model of party leadership, government-led coordination, inter-department collaboration, and social participation, contributing to progress in prevention and control. TB incidence is on a downward trend, with cure rates consistently above 90%.

triage.headline_ja: 雲南省が世界結核病予防デーの啓発活動を展開
triage.triage_reason: 結核の啓発イベント報道であり、新規の疾病クラスタや異常事象ではない。既知疾患の予防活動に関する情報提供記事である。
triage.notes: 本記事は3月24日の世界結核病予防デー（World TB Day）における雲南省での啓発活動の実施報告である。疾患の新規発生、クラスタ、異常な傾向を報告するものではなく、既知疾患の公衆衛生キャンペーン情報である。記事では結核発生率が下降傾向にあり、治癒率が90%以上であることが述べられており、対応可能な状況を示している。シグナル検出対象外の定常的な公衆衛生活動報道である。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura alerta para prevenção e tratamento da tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall warns about the prevention and treatment of tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: World Tuberculosis Day, March 24, 2026, prompts Porto Velho, Brazil, to reinforce TB prevention and treatment. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Koch bacillus) and is airborne, spreading mainly when an untreated person coughs, talks, or sneezes. Symptoms include a cough lasting three weeks or more, night-time fever, night sweats, weight loss, fatigue, chest pain, and coughing up blood. Diagnosis uses sputum testing or chest X-ray; Porto Velho uses the Rapid Molecular Test for Tuberculosis for detection. Individuals with persistent coughs should visit the nearest Basic Health Unit; sputum is collected there and sent to the Municipal Laboratory. Dr. Patrícia Guedes warns that interrupting treatment risks treatment failure and multidrug-resistant TB. Treatment is free through the SUS and typically lasts six to nine months. Jaime Gazola, Municipal Health Secretary, emphasizes March educational campaigns to raise awareness and promote adherence to care and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトベーロ市庁舎が結核の予防と治療について警告
triage.triage_reason: 世界結核デー（3月24日）に合わせた定期的な啓発キャンペーン記事。新規発生アラートではなく、既知疾患の予防・治療啓発であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準をいずれも満たさない。
triage.notes: 世界結核デーに関連する定期的な保健教育キャンペーンであり、新規の感染症イベント・シグナルではない。記事は既存のTB対策と治療方法の周知が主目的。フルRRA の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Porto Velho registra primeiro caso de coqueluche em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Velho records the first case of pertussis in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, the capital of Rondônia, Brazil, records the first pertussis (whooping cough) case of 2026. On March 24, 2026, authorities confirmed a three‑month‑old infant with pertussis who is hospitalized, stable, and receiving treatment through the state health network. Pertussis is a respiratory disease caused by Bordetella pertussis, highly contagious and transmitted person-to-person via droplets from coughing, sneezing, or talking. Key symptoms include intense, prolonged coughing spells, breathing difficulties, and sometimes vomiting after coughing. The report does not specify vaccination status or lab confirmation details. This case signals ongoing surveillance in Porto Velho as public health authorities monitor contacts and reinforce measures.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトベーリョが2026年最初のペルトゥーシス症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ペルトゥーシス（百日咳）の初期症例報告であり、乳幼児の重症化リスクと人-人感染の可能性が存在するが、現時点では単一症例の確認段階であり、IHR基準の複数該当やWPRO基準の明確な満たし方に至っていない。続報による流行拡大の有無を要経過観察。
triage.notes: 単一症例（3ヶ月児、安定状態、入院中）の報告。ペルトゥーシスは高い伝染性を持ち、乳幼児への重症化リスクが高い疾患であるが、現時点では流行を示す複数症例の報告や地域感染の拡大は記述されていない。ワクチン接種状況や検査確認の詳細が不明。ブラジルはWPRO地域内の対象国であり、今後の症例増加動向に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 肺结核的传播途径有哪些 飞沫传播需警惕
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What are the transmission routes of pulmonary tuberculosis? Be vigilant about droplet transmission.
article.articleSummary: Today marks the 31st World TB Day. Tuberculosis (TB), caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, comprises pulmonary TB and extrapulmonary TB. Pulmonary TB spreads via droplets from coughing or sneezing; about 5–10% of infected people develop active disease, and standard therapy achieves a cure rate over 90%. Extrapulmonary TB is less contagious; bacteria may reach the brain (tuberculous meningitis), lymph nodes (tuberculous lymphadenitis), or GI tract (intestinal TB or tuberculous peritonitis). Symptoms vary; chronic cough lasting more than two weeks with sputum (sometimes blood), weight loss, and fatigue should prompt specialist evaluation if antibiotics fail. Risk groups include diabetes, silicosis, immunosuppressants, stem cell transplant recipients, long-term steroids, and older age. BCG vaccine offers limited protection against severe TB and wanes with age; TB is not hereditary, though family immune status affects risk.

triage.headline_ja: 肺結核の伝播経路は何か 飛沫伝播に警戒する必要がある
triage.triage_reason: 世界結核デー（3月24日）に関連した教育的・啓発的な記事であり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクやイベントの報道ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は世界結核デーの機会に結核の伝播経路、症状、リスク要因、予防方法について一般向けに説明する教育的コンテンツである。新規のアウトブレイク、異常な患者数増加、または緊急対応の必要性は示唆されていない。シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 平阳三男子捕食竹鼠染病 肺部被细菌"啃"成蜂窝状 - 欧洲头条
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three men in Pingyang who hunted bamboo rats contracted an illness; bacteria gnawed their lungs into a honeycomb pattern - Europe Headlines
article.articleSummary: Three men in Pingyang, Zhejiang, China, hunted bamboo rats and developed a severe fungal pneumonia. Within days they had high fever and dyspnea; one progressed to respiratory failure. Bronchoalveolar lavage identified the causative fungus as 'Marniﬁ basket-shaped fungus,' linked to bamboo rats. A separate case from Fuding, Fujian, also tested positive after contact with wild rodents during tea picking. Clinicians describe the organism as a temperature‑dependent 'two‑faced killer': mold at 25–30°C in animal/soil, but yeast at 37°C in humans, rapidly invading lung tissue and disseminating, with mortality reportedly >90% when treatment is delayed. Carrier rates in common bamboo rat species, including the silver-spotted bamboo rat, can reach 96%. Transmission risks include barehand capture, handling, cooking bamboo rats, inhalation of contaminated dust, or eating undercooked meat. Patients stabilize with antifungal therapy but require long‑term treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 平阳の3人の男性がタケネズミを捕食して感染症に罹患、肺部が細菌に「かじられて」蜂窩状になる
triage.triage_reason: 未知の真菌性肺炎（Marniﬁ basket-shaped fungus）による重篤な感染症が複数の県にまたがって発生。高い死亡率（>90%）、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、国際的な公衆衛生への潜在的影響がある。
triage.notes: 記事は浙江省平陽と福建省福鼎での未知の真菌性肺炎の発生を報告。「Unknown Illness」分類だが、記事サマリーより「Marniﬁ basket-shaped fungus」と特定される真菌病原体による肺炎と判明。タケネズミとの接触が共通リンク。死亡率>90%、急速な進行、複数地域での症例報告、職業曝露（狩猟、調理）があり、リスクは高い。ただし現時点で国際的な拡大については情報不足。

article.articleHeadline: Centre's 100-day campaign against TB is a step in the right direction
article.articleSummary: TB remains a major burden in India, eight years after the aim to eliminate by 2025; the country now diagnoses more than 80% of estimated TB cases, but about 100,000 infections go undetected. The Centre's 100-day anti-TB drive, started 25 March 2026, targets intensified surveillance, with frontline workers to screen residents across 1.58 lakh villages and focus on high-risk groups such as people living with HIV, those with diabetes, and crowded urban areas. A Rs 1,000 nutrition stipend for TB patients is being expedited; earlier delays reduced the program’s impact, though timely cash transfers helped states like Chhattisgarh and Puducherry eliminate TB in over 4,000 gram panchayats between Dec 2024 and Mar 2025. The campaign aims to strengthen diagnostics, follow-ups, and community engagement to curb multidrug-resistant TB, where mismanagement fuels resistance as patients discontinue therapy.

triage.headline_ja: 結核対策の100日キャンペーンは正しい方向への一歩
triage.triage_reason: 結核とHIVの重大な公衆衛生課題であり、インドでの予防・対策キャンペーンが報道されている。しかし、このイベントは新規の疾病発生アウトブレイクではなく、既存の疾病負担に対する政策的対応の記事であるため、即座のフルRRAは不要だが、継続的な監視対象とすべき。
triage.notes: このイベントは新規アウトブレイク検知ではなく、既知の結核・HIV共感染の課題に対するインド政府の対策キャンペーンの報道である。約100,000件の未検出TB感染、多剤耐性結核の蔓延リスク、HIV患者など脆弱集団への影響がある。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスクや異常性の基準は満たさない。WATCHレベルでの継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 广州结核病报告发病率下降26.3%__南方+_南方plus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangzhou's reported tuberculosis incidence rate fell by 26.3% __ Southern+_ Southern Plus
article.articleSummary: Guangzhou, China observed World Tuberculosis Day (March 24) with a report on TB control progress. During the 14th Five-Year Plan, the city’s tuberculosis incidence rate dropped 26.3%, with a treatment success rate exceeding 94% and multidrug-resistant TB (MDR-TB) treatment success at 85%, positioning Guangzhou among domestic leaders. The Guangzhou TB Prevention and Control Institute noted over 30,000 pulmonary TB cases discovered and treated. Gains stem from early screening, improved care for difficult and drug-resistant TB, and emphasis on education. Most Mycobacterium tuberculosis infections remain latent; only a small fraction develop active TB. Guangzhou hosts more than 4.5 million students, including over 1.6 million university students, the largest in the country. Schools are central to prevention: routine morning checks, disease reporting, and sick-absence tracking. For symptoms, a persistent cough with sputum for two weeks or more warrants prompt testing and strict adherence to the early, combined, adequate, regular, full-course treatment to prevent resistance.

triage.headline_ja: 広州の結核報告罹患率が26.3%低下
triage.triage_reason: 結核罹患率の低下を報告する正常な公衆衛生進展に関する記事であり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の該当がない。異常事象や国際的拡大の懸念はない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核管理の成功を報告する通常の公衆衛生情報であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事象ではない。World TB Day 2026を機とした進展報告に過ぎず、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento de casos de "virose da mosca" sobrecarrega unidades de saúde em Sousa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in cases of "fly-borne viral infection" overwhelms health facilities in Sousa.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, Sousa, in the Sertão region of Paraíba, Brazil, reports a surge in a fly-borne viral infection. Emergency Care Unit (UPA) visits rose from about 180 to 300 daily; the Regional Hospital of Sousa saw daily attendances climb from roughly 80 to about 300, nearly quadrupling. Patients predominantly experience diarrhea, abdominal pain, vomiting, nausea, and fever, with rapid dehydration risk, especially among the elderly. Transmission is linked to contaminated food or water; authorities emphasize meticulous hand hygiene and safe food practices, plus seeking medical care if symptoms persist. No laboratory confirmation data are provided. The outbreak places strain on local health facilities, highlighting the need for sanitation measures to curb transmission in the Sousa region.

triage.headline_ja: 「ハエ媒介性ウイルス感染症」患者の増加がソウザの保健施設を圧倒
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の感染症（ハエ媒介性と推定）の集団発生で保健施設への負荷増加が報告されているが、ラボ確認データが欠落しており、病原体の正体が不確定。国際的拡大リスクや深刻度について情報不足のため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: ブラジル対象国。記事サマリーより、パライーバ州ソウザ地域でハエ媒介性ウイルス感染症の集団発生が報告されている。緊急治療室の患者数が180～300/日に急増し、地域病院の受診が80～300/日に増加している。主症状は下痢、腹痛、嘔吐、悪心、発熱で脱水リスクが高い。ただし、ラボ確認データが提供されていないため、原因病原体が未確定。食水汚染が関連している可能性が指摘されている。IHR基準では2つ以上該当（深刻な影響・異常性）し、WPRO基準では全て該当するが、ラボ確認と国際的拡大リスクの情報不足から WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 'Café com Notícias': Combate às arboviroses exige ação permanente e participação da população, diz especialista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Coffee with News': Fighting arboviral diseases requires ongoing action and public participation, says an expert.
article.articleSummary: Arboviral diseases in Maranhão require ongoing action and public participation. Dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya control relies on community engagement, with about 80% of Aedes aegypti breeding sites inside homes — plant pots, uncovered water tanks, gutters, and other water-collecting containers. Education is the main prevention tool; prevention must be daily, not only when illness appears. Oropouche fever cases are rising in Maranhão, with symptoms of high fever, body aches, retro-orbital pain, and fatigue; the third to fifth day is critical as fever may subside yet dehydration and organ involvement risk increase. A diarrheal illness called 'virose da mosca' linked to contaminated water/food also recurs in the rainy season. Vaccination efforts include Qdenga for adolescents 10-14, and the Butantan vaccine initially for primary-care professionals, with expansion planned up to 59 years. Municipal alerts include Loreto, Chapadinha, parts of Pinheiro, Zé Doca, Junco do Maranhão, and Governador Nunes Freire; the Health in School program aids community education and household prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 「コーヒーと一緒にニュース」：アルボウイルス感染症との戦いには継続的な対策と国民の参加が必要、と専門家は述べている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（マラニャン州）で複数のアルボウイルス感染症（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱、オロポーシェ熱）が同時に流行しており、異常性と継続的な曝露リスクが明確である。IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限のリスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準3項目（異常性、長期曝露、流行容易性）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはマラニャン州のアルボウイルス感染症（特にデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱、オロポーシェ熱）の流行に焦点を当てている。Loreto（ペルー領）が発生地域に含まれているが、記事の主題はブラジル（マラニャン州）であり、ペルーについて具体的な言及がないため、verified_locationsはブラジルのみとした。オロポーシェ熱の症例増加、雨季の水媒介性疾患の増加、ワクチン接種プログラムの展開など、持続的な対策が必要な状況が記述されている。

article.articleHeadline: 166 dog bites a day in Vasai-Virar; 9-yr-old's rabies death sparks alarm
article.articleSummary: Vasai-Virar region, Maharashtra, reports a dog-bite surge: 166 cases daily in Jan–Feb 2026 (10,120 total). In 2025, dog-bite cases reached 46,000, up from 36,000 in 2024. Nine-year-old Kashish Sahani of Nalasopara died of rabies after a dog bite, highlighting outbreak risk. Aggressive stray dogs reported across multiple areas, with attacks on children, pedestrians and two-wheeler riders, often in packs. The Vasai Virar City Municipal Corporation launches an intensified rabies vaccination and sterilisation drive starting Monday, aiming to surpass last year’s 15,741 dogs vaccinated, though no new target is specified. Medical officers confirm anti-rabies vaccine is available at all primary health centres and civic hospitals; residents are urged to seek immediate treatment for bites and complete the vaccination course, even for minor scratches."}

triage.headline_ja: ヴァサイ・ヴィラール地域で1日166件の犬かみ傷；9歳児の狂犬病死が警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: インドのマハラシュトラ州で狂犬病による死亡例が報告され、犬かみ傷が急増している。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常な発生状況が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ヴァサイ・ヴィラール地域（マハラシュトラ州）での犬かみ傷件数が2024年36,000件から2025年46,000件へ増加し、2026年初頭は1日166件に急増。狂犬病による死亡例が確認され、攻撃的な野良犬群による危険が高まっている。地方自治体は予防接種と不妊手術キャンペーンを実施予定。記事は公開日付が2026年3月25日となっているため、未来の日付である可能性があるが、内容は実際の公衆衛生上の脅威として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: Ca tay chân miệng ở TPHCM tăng gần gấp đôi, 2 trường hợp tử vong trong tuần
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease cases in Ho Chi Minh City nearly double, two deaths in the week.
article.articleSummary: HFMD cases in Ho Chi Minh City surged in week 11 (Mar 9–15, 2026) to 837, up 97.1% from the prior four weeks (424) and up 241.3% year over year, crossing the alert threshold. The city also received 138 HFMD patients from other provinces for treatment (20.6% of total). Eight severe cases were reported, with six patients transferred from outside the city. Two HFMD deaths occurred in the week, bringing 2026 cumulative fatalities to 3, three more than in the same period of 2025. Across 117 of 168 wards, outbreaks rose; 37 localities were at alarm levels. There were 30 school outbreaks and 49 community outbreaks in week 11, yielding a year-to-date total of 286 HFMD outbreaks. Authorities warn of pressure on tertiary hospitals due to interprovincial patient inflow and urge early detection and preventive measures among families with young children.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市の手足口病患者数がほぼ倍増、1週間で2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: EV71による手足口病の急激な増加（1週間で97.1%増、前年比241.3%増）と死亡例の報告により、IHR基準2つ以上に該当し、かつWPRO基準も複数該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: EV71(腸内ウイルス71型)による手足口病の季節流行が警報閾値を超える急速な増加を示しており、死亡例も含まれている。ホーチミン市内での複数地域での集団発生（30件の学校アウトブレイク、49件のコミュニティアウトブレイク）が報告されており、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。複数県からの患者流入による医療施設への負荷が指摘されている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 1,000 Birds Culled, 14,000 Eggs Destroyed After Bird Flu Detected In Govt Hatchery
article.articleSummary: Nagpur's Govt Central Hatchery at Seminary Hills culled ~1,000 poultry birds and destroyed ~14,000 eggs after confirmation of highly pathogenic H5N1 Avian Influenza. Lab confirmation by NIHSAD (Bhopal) and the Disease Investigation Section (Pune). Infection suspected to originate from migratory birds visiting Futala Lake this winter. Collector Vipin Itankar established a 1 km infected zone and a 9 km surveillance zone around the hatchery; a 21-day ban on purchase, sale, and transport of poultry, eggs, and feed within the infected area, and closure of poultry shops and markets in the surveillance zone. The hatchery serves as a mother unit supplying chicks to farmers, with breeds including Kaveri and Aseel. About 1,250 kg of feed discarded; culling conducted by rapid response teams. Health teams monitor workers; no respiratory issues reported yet. No activity for 21 days; hatchery closure for ~3 months, with restoration expected in 5–6 months after clearance."

triage.headline_ja: 政府孵化場で鳥インフルエンザ確認、1,000羽を殺処分、14,000個の卵を破棄
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性H5N1鳥インフルエンザの確定診断、農業チェーン全体への影響（孵化場から農家への供給中断）、多くの接触者の健康監視が必要であり、スクリーニング基準で重症度・流行性・管理可能性が該当。インドの重要な農業地域での発生。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ナグプール（マハラシュトラ州）の政府孵化場での高病原性H5N1確定診断、1,000羽の殺処分、14,000個卵の破棄が報告されている。対象国はインドのみ。農業への影響が大きく、孵化場は農家への雛供給の母体施設であることから、ポーランド・チェーン全体への影響が懸念される。渡航・貿易制限（21日間の家禽・卵・飼料の売買輸送禁止、家禽店舗・市場の閉鎖）が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Bilaspur Bird Flu News: छत्तीसगढ़ के इस जिले में मुर्गी-अंडे की बिक्री और डिलीवरी पर रोक, कलेक्टर ने जारी किया आदेश, जानें क्या है कारण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bilaspur Bird Flu News: Ban on sale and delivery of chicken eggs in this district of Chhattisgarh; the District Collector has issued an order—find out the reason.
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza detected in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, triggering a containment response. As of 25 March 2026, an infected zone within 1 km and a surveillance zone within 10 km around the confirmed outbreak have been declared, covering Ram Krishna Paramhans Nagar and Vidyasagar Nagar wards. All poultry activities are banned in both zones, including sale, transport, and storage of poultry products such as chicken and eggs; poultry shops are to be temporarily closed and door-to-door delivery halted. Checkpoints established to monitor movement of poultry inside and outside the zones. Health and animal husbandry departments activated; health screening for poultry farm workers ordered to prevent further spread. District control room set up with Dr. G.S. Tanvar in charge and Dr. Virender Pille as deputy. Public helplines: 88278 17931 and 94061 58769. Citizens urged to follow regulations and avoid rumors.

triage.headline_ja: Bilaspur Bird Flu News: チャッティスガル州のこの地区で鶏・卵の販売・配送禁止、地区コレクターが命令を発表—理由を知る
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの人間感染リスクを持つ検出事例。公衆衛生への影響が深刻（感染ゾーン設定、全家禽活動禁止）で、異常・予想外（新規検出）であり、拡大防止の積極的対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのチャッティスガル州ビラスプル地区でのH5N1検出を報道。感染ゾーン（1km以内）と監視ゾーン（10km以内）の設定、家禽販売・輸送・貯蔵の全面禁止、チェックポイント設置、保健・動物飼育部門の活性化など、当局による積極的な封じ込め対応が既に実施されている。人間感染の直接的な報告はないが、H5N1の人間感染リスクの高さとスクリーニング基準全項目該当から、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進展が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 国家卫健委：将基孔肯雅热和发热伴血小板减少综合征纳入乙类传染病进行管理
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Health Commission: Chikungunya fever and fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome to be managed as Category B infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 25 March 2026, China’s National Health Commission announced that chikungunya fever and severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) will be managed as Category B infectious diseases from 1 April 2026, with corresponding prevention and control measures. Chikungunya fever is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and presents with fever, rash, and joint/muscle pain. It originated in Africa and has spread to Southeast Asia, South Asia, Indian Ocean islands, and the Americas; in China, imported cases occurred in 2008, a locally transmitted outbreak in 2010, and 2025 saw provincial clusters linked to importations. SFTS is a tickborne illness caused by the SFTS virus, characterized by fever, thrombocytopenia, and leukopenia; it is mainly in Asia with regional clustering. China reported cases since 2009, concentrated in mountainous/hilly tick habitats; imported cases have appeared in the US and Europe. The policy emphasizes enhanced surveillance, health education, environmental management, and standardized diagnosis and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 国家卫健委：将基孔肯雅热和发热伴血小板减少综合征纳入乙类传染病进行管理
triage.triage_reason: 中国が2つの感染症（チクングニア熱とSFTS）を乙類感染症に格上げし、4月1日から強化された監視・対策を実施することを発表。これはIHR基準3つ以上（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（異常性、管理性）。対象国での重要な政策変更であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 中国の国家レベルの感染症分類政策変更。チクングニア熱は2025年に省レベルでの群発事例（輸入例に関連）を報告。SFTSは2009年以降の報告歴あり。米国・欧州への輸出事例も言及されており、国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu kills 4,400 chickens in Chhattisgarh's Bilaspur; surveillance intensified
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) outbreaks kill 4,400 chickens at a state-run poultry farm in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, India, with 5,037 birds housed at the Koni facility. Deaths occurred March 19–24; samples from dead birds were sent to labs in Bhopal and Pune, with Bhopal confirming avian influenza. Containment measures declare a 1 km infected zone around the farm and a 10 km surveillance zone. Within the infected zone, poultry, feed, and eggs will be culled and movement banned, with compensation to owners by the Animal Husbandry Department. The farm will be sealed after culling. Rapid Response Teams will conduct culling, disposal, surveillance, and sanitisation; signs installed; movement and sale of poultry strictly monitored. Health monitoring of farm workers is underway; any symptomatic individuals will be tested and given antivirals if needed. No human infections reported to date; authorities urge vigilance and cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティースガル州ビラスプールで鳥インフルエンザが4,400羽の鶏を殺す；監視が強化
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザのヒト感染リスク、複数州への地理的拡大、公式な確認例と管理措置の実施があり、IHR基準3つ（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は明確にインドの複数州（チャッティースガル、マディヤプラデシュ、マハーラシュトラ、ヒマチャルプラデシュ）でのH5N1鳥インフルエンザ流行を報告。ラボで確認された事例、積極的な封込措置、ヒト感染監視体制が構築されている。ヒト感染報告なしだが、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク及び国際的な貿易・渡航制限の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Avian Influenza Outbreak Hits Chhattisgarh Poultry Farm | Health
article.articleSummary: . As of 25 March 2026, an avian influenza outbreak at a state-run poultry farm in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, has killed around 4,400 chickens. Authorities have designated a 1-km infected zone and a 10-km surveillance zone around the farm and implemented containment measures including culling, safe disposal, and movement bans within these zones. Compensation is being arranged for poultry owners whose birds are culled. The administration urges public cooperation and cautions against rumor-mongering. There have been no human cases reported; health monitoring and antiviral provisions are in place for farm workers. The response focuses on stopping transmission, protecting livelihoods, and preventing further spread through strict zoning and culling at the affected site.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザの流行がチャッティスガル州の養鶏場を襲う
triage.triage_reason: インド国内での動物における鳥インフルエンザ流行事例だが、現時点で人間への感染報告がなく、IHR基準への該当が限定的。ただしヒト感染リスク評価のため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 現在のところ人間感染例はなく、動物のみの事例。しかし鳥インフルエンザは人獣共通感染症であり、農場労働者への継続的な健康監視とヒト感染への転化リスクを監視する必要がある。地域的な対応措置（1km感染区域、10km監視区域）は適切に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm phổi do nhiễm hai loại vi khuẩn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonia caused by infection with two types of bacteria.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam — An 87-year-old man with extensive cardiovascular disease (prior myocardial infarctions, reduced left-ventricular function, chronic atrial fibrillation, hypertension) and devices (pacemaker for complete heart block, prior CABG and abdominal aortic stent) developed pneumonia caused by co-infection with Staphylococcus aureus and Enterobacter cloacae. He presented with delirium and respiratory symptoms. Diagnosis confirmed pneumonia due to these bacteria; elderly, frail patients are at high risk of respiratory failure and multi-organ infection. Treatment integrated management of pneumonia, heart failure, atrial fibrillation, and electrolyte disturbances, with nutrition support via enteral tube and oral intake. After about two weeks, the infection resolved, heart failure improved, and he was discharged. Preventive measures include adequate nutrition (vitamins/minerals), personal/environmental hygiene, light activity, sufficient sleep, and vaccination against influenza, pneumococcus, shingles, and RSV. Early nonspecific infection symptoms (fatigue, confusion, dyspnea, tachycardia) should prompt medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 2種類の細菌感染による肺炎
triage.triage_reason: 単一の高齢患者における既知の病原体による肺炎の臨床症例報告であり、新規の流行や異常な集団発生を示す証拠がない。公衆衛生上の重大性、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクのいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一患者のケーススタディであり、集団発生（アウトブレイク）の証拠はない。Staphylococcus aureusおよびEnterobacter cloacaeはcommon opportunistic pathogensであり、特に高齢で複数の基礎疾患を有する患者では予期される臨床像である。記事は臨床管理と予防措置に関する教育的情報提供であり、新規の感染症シグナルを構成しない。

article.articleHeadline: HCM City records first three deaths from hand, foot, mouth disease
article.articleSummary: Three HFMD deaths have been recorded in Ho Chi Minh City since the start of 2026 as infections surge. In week 11 (Mar 9–15), 837 HFMD cases were reported, up 97.1% on the four‑week average and 241.3% year on year; cumulative citywide cases exceed 7,000 and approach 7,300. The city reported 138 cases from outside localities (20.6% of total) and eight severe cases, six of which were referred from other provinces (75% of severe). The center notes HM City as a major national treatment hub, pressuring tertiary hospitals. Pathogen surveillance shows six of 25 samples tested positive for Enterovirus 71 (EV71) this year. Authorities will boost surveillance, early detection, containment, and public communication, especially in nurseries and home care. Preventive measures include handwashing, disinfecting, monitoring 7–10 days, keeping infected children home, and seeking hospital for warning signs like startling, limb tremors, high fever, vomiting, rapid breathing, or lethargy.

triage.headline_ja: HCM市、手足口病による初の3人の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による手足口病で死亡例3件が確認され、感染数が急増（週次97.1%増、前年比241.3%増）している。ベトナムは対象国で、重症度と異常性の基準を満たしており、公衆衛生への重大な影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: Enterovirus 71は手足口病の重症化に関連する危険な病原体である。HCM市は国家的な治療ハブとして機能しており、他の地域からの患者流入も報告されている。保育施設での感染リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm não mô cầu có lây không và lây như thế nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is meningococcal meningitis contagious, and how is it transmitted?
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal meningitis, caused by Neisseria meningitidis, is a highly infectious, rapidly progressive disease with high mortality if untreated. It can spread in communities and trigger outbreaks in crowded settings; children and adolescents are at higher risk. A notable Vietnamese case: an 11-year-old girl from Phú Quốc tested positive for Neisseria meningitidis type B, with septicemia and meningitis, and survived after the ‘golden hour’ within 12 hours of onset due to urgent care at Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases, with recovery after 3 days of intensive therapy. Transmission is mainly via respiratory droplets and close contact, including kissing, sharing utensils, and crowded living or schooling environments. Early symptoms include sudden high fever, severe headache, vomiting, neck stiffness, altered consciousness, and a map-like hemorrhagic rash that may necrose. Vaccination (types A, C, Y, W-135, B) is key, alongside hygiene and prompt medical attention."

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は感染する、そしてどのように感染するのか？
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の確定症例（11歳女児、ベトナム南部フー・クォック島）が報告されており、IHR基準3つ以上該当。未治療時の高い死亡率、急速進行性、コミュニティ感染およびアウトブレイク発生可能性があり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の感染経路と臨床的特徴に関する教育的記事であるが、確定症例（11歳女児、フー・クォック島→ホーチミン市の熱帯病病院で治療）の具体的報告を含む。高い死亡率、急速進行性、飛沫感染およびヒト-ヒト感染、混雑した環境でのアウトブレイク潜在性が明記されている。発生地域はベトナム南部（キエン・ジャン省、ホーチミン市、フー・クォック）に限定されており、ベトナムが対象国リストに含まれているため PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: 近十年结核病报告发病率降至36%_YNET.com北青网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the past decade, the reported incidence rate of tuberculosis has fallen to 36%.
article.articleSummary: On World Tuberculosis Day (March 24), Beijing highlighted the theme 'Comprehensive action, full effort, broad participation to end TB.' Beijing runs 24 designated hospitals at city and district levels with testing for diagnosis and treatment; TB incidence has fallen 36% in the past decade. The event showcased a facilities map and prevention materials, with public engagement. WHO 2024 data show 10.7 million new TB cases worldwide (131 per 100,000) and about 1.23 million deaths. China reported 696,000 new TB cases in 2024, fourth after India, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Pulmonary TB accounts for >80% of cases; symptoms include a cough ≥2 weeks, sputum with blood, fever, night sweats, and weight loss. Extrapulmonary TB is non-infectious. Pulmonary TB requires a six-month or longer course; adherence is crucial to avoid drug-resistant TB, which carries higher costs and lower cure rates. Beijing’s plan expands free drugs and promotes all-oral regimens, with enhanced screening.

triage.headline_ja: 過去10年で結核報告発病率が36%に低下_YNET.com北青網
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核の報告発病率低下を報じた世界結核デー関連の啓発イベントであり、新規アウトブレイク、異常な疾患増加、または深刻な未制御の感染症イベントではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は北京での世界結核デーの啓発イベントと結核管理成績の向上を報じたもので、プレスリリース性が強い。結核は既知の風土病であり、発病率が低下している状況は肯定的な公衆衛生指標であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。フィリピン、インドネシア、インドは統計比較の文脈でのみ言及されており、これらの国での新規イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Drive against TB launched
article.articleSummary: On World TB Day in Kanpur, the health department launched a TB elimination drive. MLA Mahesh Trivedi and Saroj Kureel MLC Salil Vishnoi flagged off a Nikhshay vehicle from the new auditorium at Sarsaiya Ghat. Nikshay Poshan Potli was distributed among 25 TB patients. The campaign, under the theme Yes! We Can End TB - Led by Bharat, Powered by Janbhagidari, called for public participation to achieve TB elimination. Heads of 58 Gram Panchayats were honoured as TB-free, and 16 Nikshay Mitras who contributed to the Nikshay Poshan Yojana in 2025 received certificates. DM Jitendra Pratap Singh greeted Additional Director Medical Health and Family Welfare Kanpur division G K Mishra, CMO Dr Hari Datt Nemi, and TB officer Subodh Prakash for effective execution of the National TB Abolition programme.

triage.headline_ja: 結核対策キャンペーンをカンプールで開始
triage.triage_reason: 世界結核デーに関連した公衆衛生キャンペーンの報道。新規の疾病クラスターや異常な流行を示す証拠がなく、既知の結核対策プログラムの実施報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界結核デーを契機とした定期的な公衆衛生キャンペーン活動の報道である。新規感染症クラスター、予期しない死亡増加、流行拡大の兆候等は記載されていない。インド国内の既知の結核対策プログラム（Nikshay、Nikshay Poshan Yojana等）の進捗報告であり、シグナル検知の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: CM calls for public role to eradicate TB - OrissaPOST
article.articleSummary: Odisha (Orissa) Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi on World Tuberculosis Day urged public participation to eradicate TB, saying government efforts alone cannot achieve a TB-free Odisha and India. Speaking in Bhubaneswar at Lok Seva Bhawan, he launched a 100-day drive under the TB-Free India Campaign 2.0, with Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda inaugurating the nationwide effort. As a symbol of intensified action, Majhi distributed a food basket to a beneficiary. He called on public representatives, self-help groups, civil society organisations, and educational institutions to spread awareness and dispel misconceptions about tuberculosis. The government reiterated its healthcare commitment with a budget of Rs 23,182 crore for 2026-27, underscoring TB elimination as a top priority for Odisha's health sector.

triage.headline_ja: CM calls for public role to eradicate TB - OrissaPOST
triage.triage_reason: 結核の新規感染症イベント報告ではなく、政策キャンペーン・啓発活動の報道。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれにも該当せず、社会的関心は行政的な政策宣伝に限定される。
triage.notes: 本記事はオディシャ州首相による結核撲滅キャンペーン（TB-Free India Campaign 2.0）の100日間ドライブ開始に関する政策発表・啓発活動の報道。新規の感染症クラスタ、異常な罹患率の増加、未制御の感染拡大、地域保健システムの限界などの具体的なシグナルは記載されていない。既存の風土病対策の政府プログラムの推進段階にあたる。

article.articleHeadline: "ตรัง" ประชุมคณะกรรมการโรคติดต่อ เฝ้าระวังโรคฤดูกาล-ไวรัสนิปาห์ เตรียมรับมือโรคอุบัติใหม่
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Trang" holds a meeting of the Communicable Disease Committee to monitor seasonal infectious diseases and Nipah virus, preparing to respond to emerging diseases.
article.articleSummary: Trang Province held its first Communicable Disease Committee meeting of FY2026 to monitor seasonal infectious diseases and prepare for emerging threats, with Nipah virus surveillance at the forefront. Deputy Governor Api-chatch Sarabun chaired the session, joined by public health officials, local administration, and related agencies. The meeting reviewed current surveillance for seasonal illnesses in Trang and outlined proactive response plans to potential new pathogens to ensure timely public health action and maintain confidence among residents and visitors. Key measures include Nipah virus surveillance guidelines for Trang and the establishment of cross-border disease controls at Kantang Port (Port Kantang) for international travelers. Beyond medical interventions, officials emphasized public awareness campaigns using village health volunteers (อสม.) to deliver accurate prevention guidance at the community level. The deputy urged close monitoring and continuous reporting to refine Trang’s health strategy in line with evolving conditions.

triage.headline_ja: タイ・トラン県が伝染病委員会会議を開催、季節性感染症とニパウイルスを監視し、新興感染症に対応準備
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスの監視・準備会議であり、現在の症例報告や流行の証拠がない。予防的対応段階であるため、情報の追加確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の症例や流行の報告ではなく、タイ当局によるニパウイルス監視体制の構築・準備会議の開催である。国境検疫強化やコミュニティ啓発が強調されており、事前対策段階。症例発生の具体的情報がないため、DISMISS判定に近いが、ニパウイルスは高致死性で国際的関心が高いため、今後の展開を注視する価値があり WATCH とした。

article.articleHeadline: AI X-ray kits to be rolled out for 2-minute TB detection
article.articleSummary: AI-enabled handheld X-ray machines will roll out in Andhra Pradesh to detect TB within two minutes. In Vijayawada, Medical and Health Minister Y Satya Kumar Yadav announced procurement of about 100 units at Rs 20 crore, to be deployed in 4,126 Central-identified hotspot villages where free TB screening will reach about 71 lakh people over age 14. Each device, suitcase-sized and ~12 kg, captures a digital chest X-ray visible within 30 seconds; an AI-generated report completes the two-minute screening. Suspected cases will undergo confirmatory tests. Machines will be distributed across districts (6–8 per district) at Ayushman Arogya Mandir centres and can operate without internet. In 2025, Andhra Pradesh reported 78,416 TB cases; year-to-date 2026 identified 16,727. About 40,000 patients are on treatment with a 95.5% recovery rate. The initiative aims to strengthen grassroots TB control ahead of World TB Day.

triage.headline_ja: 2分のTB検出のためのAI X線キットが展開される
triage.triage_reason: 結核の診断技術導入に関する公衆衛生政策ニュースであり、新規感染症発生・流行状況ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当せず、シグナルとしての要件を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドのアンドラプラデシュ州における結核診断用のAI搭載携帯型X線機器の導入に関する政策ニュースであり、感染症の発生・流行を報告するものではない。既知の結核症例に対する診断能力向上の取り組みであるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 港股异动 | 三叶草生物-B(02197)早盘涨超16% 针对老年人群RSV疫苗1期临床试验获得更多积极数据
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HK-listed stocks on the move | Clover Biopharmaceuticals-B (02197) up more than 16% in early trading as Phase 1 data for an RSV vaccine targeting the elderly show more positive results.
article.articleSummary: RSV vaccine candidate SCB-1019, a PreF fusion protein from Clover Biopharmaceuticals-B, showed positive Phase I data in the United States, with heterologous booster dosing yielding ~60–80% higher neutralizing antibody GMTs for RSV-A and RSV-B versus AREXVY. The development news coincided with Clover HK-listed shares rising over 16% in early trading, at around HK$2.64 and turnover of about HK$21.82 million. Separately, Clover Hong Kong reached a full settlement with the Global Alliance for Vaccines and Immunization (GAVI) over a COVID-19 vaccine pre-purchase agreement, with GAVI withdrawing all claims. Clover will pay a US$7 million upfront and pursue biannual contingent payments tied to future cash receipts, with total potential payments in the mid-to-high tens of millions of dollars, well below GAVI’s US$224 million claim.

triage.headline_ja: 香港上場銘柄の変動 | クローバー・バイオファーマシューティカルズ-B(02197)が早盤16%以上上昇、高齢者向けRSVワクチンの第1相臨床試験で更に良好なデータを取得
triage.triage_reason: RSVワクチン候補の臨床試験成功と製薬企業の株価上昇に関するニュース。公衆衛生上の危機や疾患の流行・拡大を示唆するものではなく、医学開発・企業ニュースの範疇。感染症シグナルとしての該当基準なし。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の臨床試験成功と企業決済ニュース。RSVとCOVID-19という疾患名は含まれるが、実際の患者発生や流行・集団感染の報告ではなく、ワクチン開発段階のニュース。対象国内での発生事例ではないため verified_locations は空。シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Meghalaya launches 100-day campaign to boost tuberculosis elimination efforts
article.articleSummary: Meghalaya on World TB Day unveiled the second phase of its 100-day tuberculosis campaign, targeting active case finding, faster diagnosis, and improved treatment adherence to accelerate TB elimination in the state. The initiative widens awareness and aims to reduce stigma, with support from the State Tuberculosis Office under the National Health Mission. Health Minister Wailadmiki Shylla highlighted that Meghalaya allocates 9% of the state budget to health and per capita health spending of Rs 7,800—more than double the national average of Rs 3,500. The plan leverages AI-enabled tools and portable X-ray systems; 97% of TB diagnostic tests are conducted on advanced NAAT machines. 1,258 villages (about 18% of Meghalaya) have been declared TB-free. Ni-kshay Mitra volunteers mobilize communities; upcoming medical colleges in Shillong and Tura are projected to add ~200 doctors. A public health camp screens TB and non-communicable diseases as part of broader elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: メガラヤがテイベ撲滅の取り組みを強化するための100日間キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 結核対策キャンペーンに関する報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、予想外の公衆衛生危機、または国際的拡大リスクを示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核撲滅キャンペーンの発表であり、感染症の新規発生、異常な症例増加、または緊急の公衆衛生危機を報告していない。むしろ、既存のTB対策プログラムの強化と進捗状況に関する通常のヘルスケア関連ニュースである。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: De Detección A Aislamiento En Horas: El Ministerio Propone Medidas Urgentes Para Nueve Enfermedades Infecciosas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From Detection to Isolation in Hours: The Ministry Proposes Urgent Measures for Nine Infectious Diseases
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Ministry of Health proposes a draft decree to tighten infectious disease control by moving from detection to isolation within hours, in Vietnam. The plan targets nine priority diseases for immediate medical isolation after diagnosis to curb transmission. The list includes multi-drug resistant tuberculosis, Nipah virus infections, anthrax, Ebola, hantavirus hemorrhagic fever, Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever, and severe vaccine-preventable diseases, plus other transmissible illnesses with public-health impact. The draft comprises 11 chapters and 120 articles, with Section 3 (articles 18–26) detailing legal grounds to order isolation, procedures for transferring and admitting patients to dedicated isolation centers, maximum duration and follow-up protocols, and defined rights/responsibilities of patients, families, and health workers, alongside monitoring mechanisms. A public consultation is open to solicit expert and citizen input via the Ministry of Health. Expected outcomes include shorter detection-to-isolation intervals, stronger outbreak response, a robust legal framework, and greater public trust in prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: 検知から隔離まで数時間で：保健省が9つの感染症に対する緊急対策を提案
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける感染症制御強化を目的とした政策案の発表であり、複数の高リスク疾病（ニパウイルス、エボラ、CCHF等）が対象とされている。ただし現時点は政策立案段階であり、実際の患者発生や流行ではなく、情報が不足しているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の現在の流行や患者発生ではなく、ベトナム保健省による政策立案（法令案の草案）を扱っている。対象疾病に高リスク病原体が含まれており、ニパウイルス、エボラ、CCHFなど国際的に重要な疾病への対応強化を示唆している。ただし実際のイベント発生が報告されていないため、シグナルとしてはWATCH段階とし、今後の実装状況や実際の患者発生に関する続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu kills 4,400 chickens in Chhattisgarh's Bilaspur; surveillance intensified
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) outbreak at a state-run poultry farm in Koni, Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, with 4,400 of 5,037 chickens dead between March 19–24. Laboratory confirmation came from Bhopal after samples from the dead birds were tested; Pune lab also received samples. Authorities intensified surveillance within a 10 km radius and declared a 1 km infected zone around the farm. Under the Revised Action Plan for Prevention and Containment of Avian Influenza (2021), poultry, feed and eggs within the infected zone are to be destroyed, and their movement banned, with compensation provided by the Animal Husbandry Department; the farm will be sealed after culling. Ongoing outbreak response is in place; no imported/exported cases are mentioned. Date reference: 2026-03-25.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガルのビラスプルで鳥インフルエンザが4,400羽の鶏を殺害；監視が強化
triage.triage_reason: 動物での限定的な発生（4,400羽の家禽死亡）であり、ヒト感染は報告されていない。IHR基準は国際的拡大リスクが不明瞭で、一部該当の可能性があるが、スクリーニング基準では重症度と異常性で該当。社会的関心は不明のため、WATCH段階で続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 本件はヒト感染ではなく動物での限定的な発生。サマリーで「no imported/exported cases are mentioned」と明記されており、国際的拡大の直接的証拠なし。ただしH5N1型など高病原性鳥インフルエンザの可能性がある場合は人獣共通感染リスクが存在。ヒト感染例の有無確認が重要。

article.articleHeadline: В Красноярске уничтожат почти 4 тонны зараженных томатов из Китая
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Krasnoyarsk, almost 4 tons of infected tomatoes from China will be destroyed.
article.articleSummary: Tomatoes weighing almost 4 tons imported from China were destroyed in Krasnoyarsk Krai after tests confirmed the quarantine pest Tomato brown rugose fruit virus (ToBRFV) in a batch stored at Agroterminal-Tamozhnya. Laboratory confirmation by the Krasnoyarsk branch of the TsOK APK established ToBRFV, a highly dangerous plant virus capable of destroying all greenhouse crops within a week. Transmission occurs via contaminated tools, hands, clothing, soil, and pollinators. On detection, infected plants are burned to prevent spread. The nearly 4-ton batch is slated for destruction, illustrating strict containment of imported produce.

triage.headline_ja: クラスノヤルスクで中国から輸入された感染したトマト約4トンが破棄される予定
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは植物病害（トマト褐色しわ果ウイルス）の検出および破棄措置に関するもので、ヒト感染症ではない。IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準はいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは植物病害（ToBRFV）であり、ヒト感染症ではない。CEPRのEBS活動は人獣共通感染症および公衆衛生上の脅威を対象としており、純粋な植物病害はスコープ外。中国からの輸入品検出であるが、ロシア連邦での適切な対応措置（破棄）が実施されており、公衆衛生リスクは存在しない。対象国リストに該当する国でのヒト感染症イベントではないため、verified_locationsは空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Hanoi targets rabies elimination as pet meat trade revenues plummet
article.articleSummary: Rabies elimination drives Hanoi's intensified crackdown on the dog and cat meat trade, targeting zero human rabies deaths by 2030 as revenues crater. A March 24 conference outlined a phased plan to phase out the trade, tighten controls on origin, slaughter conditions, and product circulation, and bolster animal disease surveillance. A 2025 survey of 113 establishments across 14 wards found 83% reported revenue declines, with some falls up to 70%. Rabies remains a persistent threat across Vietnam, recorded in 60 of 63 provinces over the last decade, causing about 70 deaths annually and costing the healthcare system more than $41.7 million annually for vaccines and immunoglobulin. International partners, including Faizan Jalil of Soi Dog Foundation, back a sustainable transition, while households are supported to exit the trade; implementation stresses risk prevention and urban development of a civilized environment. The programme aims to reach zero human rabies deaths by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイがペット肉取引収入の急減に対応し狂犬病排除を目指す
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける狂犬病は公衆衛生上の懸念（年間70人死亡、医療費負担）であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当するが、記事主題は疾病制御政策・貿易規制であり、新規感染症事象の報告ではない。情報が十分であるため続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病排除に向けたハノイの政策的対応（犬猫肉取引の規制）が主題であり、新規の感染症クラスタ報告ではない。ベトナム全体での狂犬病の持続的脅威（60/63州で確認、年70人死亡）は既知の問題であるが、国際的な政策連携と強化されたサーベイランス計画は評価対象。IHR基準は1項目のみ（深刻な公衆衛生影響）で、異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ca tay chân miệng ở TP.HCM tăng cao: Cách nhận biết sớm và chủ động phòng ngừa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease cases in Ho Chi Minh City on the rise: Early recognition and proactive prevention
article.articleSummary: HFMD cases are rising in Ho Chi Minh City. In week 11 (Mar 9–15, 2026), TP.HCM reported 837 HFMD cases, up 97.1% from the four‑week average (424) and 241.3% higher than the same week in 2025, exceeding the warning threshold. The city also received 138 cases from other provinces (20.6% of total), with eight severe cases—six of which were transfers. Two deaths occurred in week 11, bringing 2026’s toll to 3 (versus none in 2025). Across 168 wards, 117 reported higher incidence than the four‑week average; 37 localities were at alarm. There were 30 school clusters and 49 community clusters; cumulative outbreaks this year reach 286. Classic signs include vesicular rash on palms/soles, knees, buttocks, and elbows, with painful oral ulcers. Children should stay home for 7–10 days and be monitored; seek care for warning signs (high fever, startle or limb tremors, vomiting, rapid breathing). EV71 re‑emerged linked to severe cases.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市の手足口病患者数が急増：早期認識と積極的な予防
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外な上昇、国際拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。死亡例の増加とEV71の関連、急激な症例増加（241.3%）が確認され、シグナルとして識別すべき。
triage.notes: EV71の再発生が重症例と関連。2026年3月時点で既に3名の死亡例（2025年同期は0例）。週間患者数が過去4週平均比97.1%増、前年同週比241.3%増と急激な増加。学校30クラスター、地域49クラスター計286件の累積アウトブレイク。複数ワードに警報閾値超過。国際的な感染症監視体制への通知が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 3 minutes, 1 life lost: Grim reality of TB
article.articleSummary: Berhampur, India – On World TB Day, eminent chest physician Narayan Mishra warns that tuberculosis remains a grave, routine killer in India, reporting that one person dies of TB every three minutes in the country. He stresses that tuberculosis is deadly but entirely preventable and curable if detected early and treated properly. Mishra attributes the rise of drug-resistant TB to negligence, irregular medication, and lack of awareness, calling it largely a 'man-made crisis.' His remarks highlight the persistent TB burden in India, the crucial need for early diagnosis and adherence to treatment, and the social factors that fuel resistance. The statement, delivered during World TB Day observances in Berhampur, underscores the urgency of sustained public health measures to curb TB transmission and drug resistance.

triage.headline_ja: 3分ごとに1人が死亡：結核の悲劇的現実
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける結核による高い死亡率が報告されており、スクリーニング基準の「重症度」と「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性がありますが、記事は啓発的な発言報告であり、新規患者集団発生の報告ではないため、情報不足のため経過観察に留めます。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界結核の日（World TB Day）に際した医師による啓発発言の報告であり、新規感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、患者集団発生）の報告ではありません。インドの結核負荷は既知の慢性的課題であり、異常性や突発性は認められません。記事内に新規患者群や地域的な感染拡大の報告は含まれていません。

article.articleHeadline: 国家卫健委：基孔肯雅热和发热伴血小板减少综合征将纳入乙类传染病管理
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Health Commission: Chikungunya fever and fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome will be included in Category B infectious disease management.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-25, China’s National Health Commission announced that from 2026-04-01, chikungunya fever and fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTSV) will be managed as Category B infectious diseases with corresponding prevention and control measures. Chikungunya fever, caused by chikungunya virus and transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, presents with fever, rash, and joint/muscle pain. Globally, over 100 countries/regions report local chikungunya transmission; China recorded its first imported cases in 2008, the first importation-triggered local outbreak in 2010, and by 2025 some provinces saw imported cases leading to local clusters. SFTSV causes fever with thrombocytopenia and leukopenia and is transmitted mainly by ticks; China’s first cases appeared in 2009, with incidence concentrated in tick-endemic mountainous and hilly areas. Authorities will strengthen multi-channel surveillance of vectors, cases, and host animals, and enhance public health education, information release, and standardized diagnosis and treatment to curb outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 国家卫健委：基孔肯雅热和发热伴血小板减少综合征将纳入乙类传染病管理（国家衛生健康委員会：チクングニア熱と血小板減少を伴う発熱症候群は乙類感染症管理に組み入れられる）
triage.triage_reason: 中国においてチクングニア熱とSFTS（発熱伴血小板減少症候群）が乙類感染症として公式に管理対象に昇格される政策決定である。既に国内での発生実績があり、複数の省で局所的なクラスターが報告されている。疾病管理の強化は国家レベルの公衆衛生対応を示唆しており、スクリーニング基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 本イベントは新規の感染症発生ではなく、既知の2疾患（チクングニア熱とSFTS）が中国で感染症分類の昇格（乙類への組み入れ）を受けたという政策公表である。ただし、中国内で複数省での局所的クラスター発生が報告されており、蚊とダニを主要媒介者とする流行性疾患の管理強化が国家として宣言されたものである。スクリーニング基準のうち「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当し、政府関心が極めて高い。国際的拡大リスクは現在のところ限定的と見なされる。

article.articleHeadline: 3 người bị chó cắn đã tiêm vaccine và huyết thanh kháng dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three people bitten by dogs have received rabies vaccine and rabies immunoglobulin.
article.articleSummary: Rabies exposure in Lam Dong Province (Ham Thang Ward, Ham Thuan Bac District, formerly part of Bình Thuận Province) as of 25 March 2026: a two-year-old male brown-gray dog tested rabid bit three residents—two in Thắng Hiệp and one in Thắng Thuận. The owner euthanized the dog; laboratory confirmation was provided by the Central Veterinary Diagnostic and Testing Center II. Authorities sprayed around affected homes, disposed of the carcass, and healthcare workers advised wound management and urged full rabies vaccination plus rabies immunoglobulin for all bite victims; three people have completed vaccination and immunoglobulin. In 2025, Lam Dong reported 11 rabies cases in dogs and cats across seven communes, indicating ongoing spillover risk. Separately, in Bình Thuận Province (Phan Thiết), on 20 February a rabid dog attacked three people in Phú Tài ward; authorities issued urgent contact-notification for exposures.

triage.headline_ja: 犬に咬まれた3人が狂犬病ワクチンと狂犬病免疫グロブリンを接種
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの限定的な狂犬病曝露事例（3名）で、接触者管理は適切に実施されている。ただし地域での継続的な動物スピルオーバーリスク（2025年に11症例）があり、情報を継続監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理情報に矛盾がある（Lam Dong Provinceが主題だが、発生地域にBình Thuận Provinceが記載されている）。サマリーから判断するとラムドン省が主要発生地。2025年の11件の動物狂犬病症例との関連性があり、継続監視が必要だが、現在のところ公衆衛生的な深刻度や国際的波及リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Thousands of chickens die in bird flu outbreak at Chhattisgarh poultry farm
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza outbreak at a government-run poultry farm in the Koni area of Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, has caused the deaths of more than 4,400 of 5,037 birds between 19–24 March. Laboratory tests confirmed avian influenza after samples were sent to laboratories in Bhopal and Pune, with the Bhopal facility confirming the virus. The facility housed 5,037 birds. In response, district authorities led by Sanjay Agrawal imposed containment under the Revised Action Plan for Prevention and Containment of Avian Influenza (2021): an infected zone within 1 kilometre of the farm and a 10-kilometre surveillance zone. Containment measures were tightened and zones declared in Bilaspur district as of 25 March 2026.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガル家禽農場での鳥インフルエンザ発生で数千羽のニワトリが死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド（対象国）での確認済み鳥インフルエンザ発生。4,400羽以上の死亡という重大な影響があり、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度・異常性・管理対応）複数に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはチャッティスガル州ビラスプル地区での政府系家禽農場での発生を明示。4,400羽の死亡という重大な動物健康被害と確定診断が得られている。対応措置（隔離区域・監視区域設定）も実施済み。ヒト感染の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Journée mondiale de lutte contre la tuberculose I Les Comores ont enregistré...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Tuberculosis Day | The Comoros have recorded....
article.articleSummary: World Tuberculosis Day was observed in Moroni, Comoros, on March 24 under the theme 'Yes, we can eradicate tuberculosis.' Health Minister Ahamada Sidi Nahouda reported that in 2025 the National TB Program notified 140 TB cases (all forms), about 74% of the 190 cases expected; 26% remain undetected. In 2024, 131 cases were notified out of a 160-case objective. The authorities cited a cure rate above 90% and pledged to intensify screening and advocacy, while warning of co-infection risks with HIV, noting 4 TB/HIV co-infections in 2025. WHO Africa’s Dr Mohamed Janabi, via Dr Nassuri Ahamada, highlighted regional data: 378,000 TB deaths and 2.7 million infections in 2024; every 83 seconds a death in Africa; deaths declined 46% and incidence 28% since 2015; South Africa reached its 2025 target; Mozambique, Tanzania, Togo and Zambia saw 75% fewer TB deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 結核との戦いに関する世界デー | コモロスが2025年に140例を記録
triage.triage_reason: コモロス（対象国外）が主体であるが、記事サマリーにザンビアなど対象国の結核・HIV関連データを含む。対象国での新規アウトブレイクではなく、監視・報告統計の位置付けのため、情報不足のまま経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコモロスの世界結核デー記念行事であり、対象国外。ただしサマリーに南アフリカ、モザンビーク、タンザニア、トーゴ、ザンビアのTB統計データが含まれており、ザンビアが言及されている。結核・HIVは長期曝露・流行しやすい疾患だが、本記事は既知の監視統計の報告であり、新規アウトブレイクやシグナルではない。対象国における実際の発生動向の続報を待つ価値があり、WATCHが適切。

article.articleHeadline: "蜱虫病"4月起纳入乙类传染病管理，中疾控：可防可控_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Tick-borne disease" to be included in Category B infectious disease management from April; China CDC: preventable and controllable
article.articleSummary: From April 1, 2026, febrile illness with thrombocytopenia syndrome (FTS) will be managed as Category B infectious disease in China. FTS is a tick-borne illness caused by the FTS virus, primarily transmitted by Haemaphysalis longicornis; cases are reported across Asia (China, Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Thailand, Myanmar) with imported cases in the U.S. and parts of Europe; China first reported in 2009. It is seasonal (mainly April–October) and affects people in outdoor rural work. Core symptoms include fever, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, fatigue, nausea/vomiting; severe cases may involve bleeding or neurological symptoms. There is no specific antiviral; treatment is supportive. Prevention emphasizes tick control and personal protection (light clothing, repellents), environmental sanitation, and timely medical care with exposure history. After reclassification, China CDC will bolster surveillance, cross-sector coordination, and preventive measures in agriculture and livestock to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 「蜱虫病」4月から乙類感染症管理に納入、中国疾病管制預防センター：予防可能・制御可能
triage.triage_reason: SFTS/FTSは既知の蜤虫媒介疾患であり、中国が制度的に管理分類を引き上げる政策ニュースである。複数国での発生が報告されているが、新興の流行や急激な重症例増加などの新規シグナルは記事に明記されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中国疾病管制予防センターがSFTS/FTSを乙類感染症に昇格させるという行政的ニュースであり、新規の流行警告ではない。アジア地域での既知の季節的疾患の制度改革である。スクリーニング基準は「長期曝露」（季節的だが継続的）と「流行しやすさ」（蜤虫媒介、農村部での職業曝露）で該当するが、現在の疫学的危機を示す明確なシグナルは不足。公式な管理体制強化により管理可能性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Myanmar marks World Tuberculosis Day 2026
article.articleSummary: World Tuberculosis Day 2026 observed in Myanmar with Deputy Health Minister Aye Tun stating Myanmar remains among the 30 countries with the highest TB prevalence, TB/HIV co-infection, and drug-resistant TB, and recording the region’s second-highest incidence of new TB cases in the WHO South-East Asia region. In Naypyitaw, the Ministry of Health outlines national strategies, including the Double X Strategy for diagnosis and treatment, expanded stool-sample TB detection, and TB preventive treatment for children under eight. Diagnostic gains include AI-assisted chest X-ray interpretation and portable TB testing devices, complemented by an integrated real-time TB e-surveillance system. Officials emphasize multi-ministerial and public cooperation to strengthen control as Myanmar works with partners to accelerate detection and treatment of TB.

triage.headline_ja: ミャンマーが2026年世界結核デーを記念
triage.triage_reason: 結核とHIV/結核共感染が高度に蔓延している重要な公衆衛生課題だが、記事は記念イベント・政策発表が主体で、新規の急性爆発的イベントではない。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: ミャンマーはTB/HIV共感染、耐性結核が高い負担国。記事は世界結核デー記念イベントとして、ナイプタオでの診断・治療戦略の発表が中心。既知の公衆衛生課題の進行状況報告であり、新規シグナルではないため、急性イベントでの『PICKUP』ではなく『WATCH』判定。ただしWPRO基準の重症度、持続的曝露、流行素因が複数該当し、かつ政府の対策実施がある。地理的にはMyanmarのみが対象国リストに該当。

article.articleHeadline: Myanmar marks World TB Day 2026; Dy Minister outlines fight against high TB rates | Ministry Of Information
article.articleSummary: World TB Day 2026 commemorations held in Nay Pyi Taw, Myanmar. Deputy Health Minister Dr Aye Tun notes Myanmar remains among the 30 countries with the highest TB prevalence, TB/HIV co-infection, and drug-resistant TB, and records the second-highest incidence of new TB cases in the WHO South-East Asia Region, underscoring urgency to accelerate detection and treatment. National Strategic Plans, including the 'Double X Strategy,' are applied to expand diagnosis and treatment; stool-based TB detection is being scaled, and Tuberculosis Preventive Treatment (TPT) is provided for children under eight. Diagnostic capacity is strengthened with AI-assisted chest X-ray interpretation (X-ray CAD) and portable Truenat devices. An Integrated TB e-Surveillance System is being rolled out to manage TB control activities in real time. Under the 2026 theme 'Let the State Lead and the People Lead,' a multi-sectoral approach with government leadership, partners, organizations, and citizens is emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: ミャンマーが2026年世界結核デー を記念；次官が高い結核率対策を概説
triage.triage_reason: 世界結核デーのキャンペーン・記念式典に関する報道であり、新規のアウトブレイク、疾病集積、または緊急的な公衆衛生危機を示すものではない。ミャンマーのTB負担は既知であり、予防・診断強化の取組みを述べているが、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準の該当が乏しい。
triage.notes: 公式保健当局による世界結核デーの記念キャンペーンであり、既知の高い結核病負担を背景としたルーチンの公衆衛生活動の一部。新規の感染症シグナルやアウトブレイク報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mohammad Alyas Khan launches 100-day TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan
article.articleSummary: Ramban district, Jammu and Kashmir, launched a 100-day TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan to screen vulnerable populations for tuberculosis. Deputy Commissioner Mohammad Alyas Khan flagged off a mobile van equipped with a portable handheld X-ray machine, donated under CSR by Jammu and Kashmir Bank at a cost of ₹25 lakh, and inaugurated the device. The campaign aims to strengthen screening in remote and difficult areas and conduct early TB detection through X-ray screening and NAAT testing, prioritizing vulnerable groups to ensure timely diagnosis and treatment. The initiative supports the national mission to eliminate TB by 2026 under the theme Jan-Jan Ka Rakhe Dyaan TB- Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan. The Deputy Commissioner urged close coordination among Health Department and stakeholders and emphasized community participation, outreach, and awareness. Participants pledged commitment to intensify TB detection and treatment during the 100 days.

triage.headline_ja: モハンマド・アリヤス・カーン副長官が100日間のTB Mukt Bharat Abhiyanキャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 本件はインドのラムバン地区でのTB検診キャンペーンの開始報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク事象ではなく、既存のTB対策プログラムの拡大展開である。異常性、重症度の上昇、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本件は新規の疾病検出や異常な増加事象ではなく、インド政府の既存のTB撲滅キャンペーン（TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan）の地域的実施報告である。検診プログラムの開始は公衆衛生上の好ましい取組ではあるが、シグナルトリアージの対象となる新規感染症危機事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ho Chi Minh City reports surge in HFMD cases, 2 deaths in a week
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, reports a hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) surge with 2 deaths in the week. The four‑week average was 424; 529 HFMD cases were recorded March 2–8. Infections climbed in 117 of 168 local areas, including 37 at alert levels. The city treated 138 patients transferred from other provinces (20.6% of cases); eight severe cases were recorded, six of them from outside the city. Two deaths this week raise 2026 fatalities to three, with none in 2025. Health authorities will boost surveillance, early detection, and outbreak control, especially in childcare settings. The week saw 30 school outbreaks and 49 community clusters. EV71 was detected in six of 25 samples tested this year, a strain linked to more severe HFMD.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市がHFMD患者の急増を報告、1週間で2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病の急速な増加（1週間で529例）、死亡2例、重症例8例、EV71検出によるIHR基準2つ以上（深刻な影響、異常）該当。ベトナムは対象国。
triage.notes: EV71株の検出（25検体中6検体）は重症化リスク増加を示唆。学校アウトブレイク30件、コミュニティクラスター49件と多数。2025年に死亡例なし（前年比での異常性）。対象国ベトナムでの発生確認。

article.articleHeadline: Peningkatan Campak, Salah Satunya Disebabkan Penurunan Kekebalan Pascapandemi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Measles, One of Which Is Caused by Waning Immunity Post-Pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in Indonesia have risen due to waning immunity following the COVID-19 pandemic. Epidemiologist Dicky Budiman notes that lower complete measles vaccination coverage after the pandemic raises outbreak risk, as two-dose coverage should exceed 94%. As of mid-March 2026, Indonesia reported 10,301 confirmed measles cases, 13,046 suspected cases, and 8 deaths, with 54 outbreaks (KLB) across 37 regencies/cities in 13 provinces. To curb spread, the Ministry of Health accelerated Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) and Measles-Rubella (MR) campaigns in affected and high-risk areas. Free immunization is available in 102 regencies/cities targeting children 9–59 months, at Puskesmas, Posyandu, schools, places of worship, and Eid al-Fitr travel hubs. No imported/exported case details were provided. The government emphasizes rapid response to prevent wider transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹の増加、パンデミック後の免疫低下が原因の一つ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹の確認症例10,301件、死亡8件、37地域54件のアウトブレイクが報告されており、IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、予防接種カバレッジ低下による流行リスクが高い。
triage.notes: COVID-19後の予防接種カバレッジ低下が麻疹アウトブレイクの背景。政府による予防接種キャンペーン（ORI、MR）が実施中。2026年3月中旬時点で13地域37地域における多地域多州でのアウトブレイクとなっており、域内感染の継続的リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Chhattisgarh: Bird flu kills 4,400 chickens in Bilaspur; surveillance intensified
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, has killed about 4,400 of 5,037 chickens at a government poultry farm in Koni between March 19–24, with samples sent to labs in Bhopal and Pune; Bhopal confirmed avian influenza. As of 25 March 2026, containment is under the Revised Action Plan (2021), declaring a 1 km infected zone and a 10 km surveillance zone. Within the infected zone, culling of poultry, feed and eggs is mandatory and movement is banned, with compensation provided by the Animal Husbandry Department. The farm will be sealed after culling; Rapid Response Teams will conduct culling, disposal, surveillance and sanitisation. Warning signboards and strict monitoring of poultry movement and sales are enforced; health monitoring of farm workers with testing and antiviral treatment if needed. No human infections have been reported to date; authorities coordinate across revenue, police, urban administration and panchayat.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガル州：ビラスプル地区で鳥インフルエンザにより4,400羽のニワトリが死亡、監視活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの動物流行（4,400羽の死亡）が確認され、これは異常かつ予想外のイベントである。また、政府農場での大規模発生であり、管理可能性の観点から公式な対応計画が発動されている。IHR基準2つ以上に該当する可能性がある。
triage.notes: ヒト感染例は報告されていないため、現段階では人獣共通感染症のエスカレーションリスクは低い。ただし、鳥インフルエンザの動物流行は監視対象として重要。インド当局が公式な対応計画（改訂版2021）を発動し、適切な管理下で対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Chhattisgarh Bird flu | बिलासपुर में बर्ड फ्लू का तांडव! सरकारी पोल्ट्री फार्म में 4,400 मुर्गियों की मौत, 10 किमी का इलाके में अलर्ट जारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chhattisgarh Bird Flu | Bird Flu Rampage in Bilaspur! 4,400 chickens die at a government poultry farm, alert issued for a 10-km radius.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) outbreak in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, at a government poultry farm in the Konni area. Between 19 and 24 March, about 4,400 of 5,037 chickens died; laboratory confirmation came from a Bhopal facility, with samples also sent to Pune labs. The district collector declared infected status and activated measures under the amended 2021 plan, establishing a 1 km infected zone and a 10 km surveillance zone. Within the infected area, poultry, feed, and eggs will be culled and destroyed; movement is restricted; compensation will be paid to farmers. After culling, the farm will be sealed and rapid-response teams deployed for disposal, monitoring, and sanitization. Signboards and strict surveillance of poultry movement and sales will be enforced district-wide. Farm workers are health-monitored and tested if symptomatic, with antiviral treatment as needed. No human infections reported so far.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガル州の鳥インフルエンザ | ビラスプルでの鳥インフルエンザの猛威！政府家禽農場で4,400羽のニワトリが死亡、10km圏内でアラート発令
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの急性アウトブレイクで、家禽での高い死亡率（4,400羽中の大量死）が記録され、確定検査により確認された。公衆衛生への対応措置（隔離ゾーン、監視体制、農家補償）が発動されており、WPRO基準（異常性・重症度・管理対応）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは人感染は報告されていないが、家禽での確定アウトブレイク。地区集約レベルでの感染制御対応がすでに実施中（1km感染ゾーン、10km監視ゾーンの設定、殺処分計画）。農場労働者の健康監視と症状のある者への抗ウイルス治療が行われており、管理体制は構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: ABP Live Doc Talk | When Viruses Attack The Brain: Understanding Nipah Virus And Its Life-Threatening Impact
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus infection is a zoonotic disease with the Malaysia 1998 outbreak and later cases in India (Kerala). Fruit bats (flying foxes) are natural carriers; transmission occurs via contact with infected animals (bats, pigs) or contaminated foods such as fruits or raw date palm juice, and it can spread human-to-human through close contact with body fluids. The clinical picture ranges from asymptomatic or mild fever, cough and malaise to severe encephalitis and myocarditis, with mortality up to about 60%. Survivors may have long-term neurological deficits. Diagnosis relies on laboratory tests of blood, urine, nasal or throat swabs, and cerebrospinal fluid. There is no specific antiviral or vaccine; management is supportive, including seizure control and intensive care for encephalitis. Prevention emphasizes avoiding potentially contaminated foods, good hygiene, strict isolation of cases, and timely public health interventions to prevent outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスが脳を攻撃するとき：ニパウイルスとその生命に関わる影響を理解する
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは既知の高致死性人獣共通感染症であり、複数のWPRO基準に該当するが、記事は教育的な内容解説であり、現在の流行情報や新規患者数の報告がない。続報による事態発展を注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはニパウイルスの一般的な特性、歴史的流行事例（マレーシア1998年、インド・ケララ州での事例）、診断・治療について述べた教育的コンテンツであり、現在のアウトブレイク情報ではない。Malaysiaは発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーは過去の事例参照のみであり、現在の流行状況について述べていないため、verified_locationsから除外した。インドは対象国リストに含まれ、過去の発生地としても記載されている。IHR基準は2つ以上該当（深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク）するが、PICKUP判定に至らないのは、現在進行中の新規流行を示す根拠が記事に明示されていないため。

article.articleHeadline: TB remains India's biggest infectious killer, but mass screening push shows results
article.articleSummary: TB remains India's biggest infectious killer, accounting for about 25% of global TB cases. India reported 26 lakh TB cases notified in 2024 and over 32 lakh detected through the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan. At World TB Day 2026 in Greater Noida, officials cited a 21% decline in incidence and a 25% drop in deaths since 2015, with treatment coverage at 92% and treatment success around 90%. The mass screening effort has screened over 20 crore people, uncovering many asymptomatic cases and reducing undetected cases from over 10 lakh to under one lakh. A 100-day intensified drive covers 1.58 lakh villages and urban wards, supported by an AI-enabled TB Mukt Bharat app. Drug-resistant TB exceeds 55,000 cases in 2024. TB remains linked to poverty, malnutrition, diabetes, HIV, and crowded settings; stigma and affordability impede care. Indigenous tools like TrueNat and digital platforms aid rapid diagnosis and care linkage.

triage.headline_ja: 結核はインドの最大の感染症による死因であるが、大量スクリーニング推進は成果を示している
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける結核の高い負担（世界のTB症例の約25%）と継続的な感染リスクが確認されるが、スクリーニングと治療成功率の改善が報告されており、国内での制御が進行中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは明示的でない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の継続的で深刻な公衆衛生負担を記述しているが、むしろ予防的スクリーニングと治療成功の改善に焦点があり、急性の危機シグナルではない。HIV共感染の言及あり。情報不足な要素なし。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさで該当するが、IHR基準では国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクは明示されていない。公式なワールドTB Day行事であり政府・社会的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Child dies of rabies in Mumbai region after incomplete vaccination
article.articleSummary: Rabies death in Mumbai Metropolitan Region: a 9-year-old girl from Nalasopara, Palghar, Kashish Sahini, died after a stray dog scratch five to six months earlier and incomplete anti-rabies vaccination. Initially minor wound; vaccination course not completed. She remained stable for months, then developed rabies symptoms (difficulty swallowing, inability to eat/drink, behavioral changes) and was shifted from a local hospital to Kasturba Hospital in Mumbai, a center for infectious diseases. Despite treatment, she succumbed. Doctors reiterate that rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms appear, stressing immediate wound washing and completing full vaccination. Public health officials cite gaps in awareness and stray-dog management in urban/suburban areas, urging treating every bite or scratch as a medical emergency and ensuring timely, full treatment to prevent such tragedies.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ地域の子どもが不完全なワクチン接種後に狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 個別死亡事例であり、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは明確でないが、スクリーニング基準（重症度：死亡事例、管理可能性：公衆衛生意識の課題）で1項目以上該当。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は散発的個別死亡事例であり、流行状況ではない。ただし、公衆衛生当局が野犬管理と啓発の課題を指摘しており、管理可能性に関する懸念がある。IHR基準は1つのみ（重症度：死亡）であるため、PICKUP基準（2つ以上）には達しない。WPRO基準で2つ該当するが、社会的関心や国際的拡大リスク、異常性が低いため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: No Shortage Of Anti-Rabies Vaccine, Rabies Immunoglobulin In India: Union Health Minister J P Nadda
article.articleSummary: India has no shortage of Rabies Immunoglobulin (RIG) and Anti-Rabies Vaccine (ARV), according to Union Health Minister J P Nadda. Annual installed capacity is 8.17 crore ARV vials and 1.77 crore RIG vials. Nationwide animal bite cases total about 58 lakh per year, with 47 lakh being dog bites. A real-time tracking system and decentralised procurement under the National Rabies Control Programme (NRCP) and National Free Drug Initiative (NFDI) help ensure adequate supply; exports are allowed and there is surplus stock for export. Health is a state subject, placing distribution responsibility on state governments. Yearly production data are not centrally maintained due to multiple producers. Exports in 2024-25: RIG 64,131 kg; ARV 281,139 kg. The rabies virus, primarily transmitted via animal bites, remains fatal, but domestic demand is reportedly well met with intact export capacity.

triage.headline_ja: インド、狂犬病ワクチンと狂犬病免疫グロブリン不足なし：連邦保健相ナッダ
triage.triage_reason: インドの狂犬病ワクチン・免疫グロブリンの供給が十分であることを述べた政策発表記事であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルではない。年間58万件の動物咬傷があるという統計的背景情報は提供されているが、異常な増加や管理不能な状況を示す証拠はない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド政府による狂犬病対策の供給体制が良好であることを強調する政策発表である。既知の慢性的な公衆衛生課題（年間58万件の動物咬傷）について言及されているが、新規のアウトブレイク、異常な増加、または制御不能な状況を示すシグナルはない。RIG・ARVの輸出拡大も言及されており、むしろ管理面での成功を示すものである。

article.articleHeadline: Risco à saúde: amostras de vírus furtadas na Unicamp estavam em laboratório com maior nível de biossegurança disponível no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health risk: virus samples stolen from Unicamp were in a laboratory with the highest biosafety level available in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Virus samples were stolen from Unicamp and stored in a NB-3 biosafety area—the highest containment level for infectious agents—at the university’s Animal Virology Laboratory in Campinas, Brazil. The theft occurred February 13; by March 23, the Federal Police located the samples across three Unicamp labs: a freezer at the Food Engineering Faculty, manipulated tubes and discarded material in the Tropical Diseases Laboratory (Institute of Biology), and discarded vials in a laboratory trash bin at the Cell Culture Laboratory (Institute of Biology). The materials were moved and stored in uncontrolled spaces, posing direct health risks. Professor Soledad Palameta Miller is accused of illegally producing/storing/transferring genetically modified organisms, endangering others’ life or health, and procedural fraud, allegedly using a master’s student to access labs and, at times, with others’ authorization to use freezers. She was granted provisional freedom March 24 with conditions; Unicamp launched an internal inquiry. Brazil’s future BSL-4 facility, Orion, is under construction in Campinas (expected 2027).

triage.headline_ja: 健康被害リスク：ユニキャンプから盗難されたウイルスサンプルはブラジルで利用可能な最高レベルのバイオセーフティを備えた研究室に保管されていた
triage.triage_reason: バイオセキュリティ上の重大な懸念事項：BSL-3施設からのウイルスサンプル盗難、管理されていない環境での長期保管、および教授による違法な遺伝子組み換え生物の製造・保管・移動の疑いがあり、IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外性）および社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ウイルス種が「Unknown Illness」と特定されていないため、具体的な病原体リスク評価は限定的。ただしBSL-3施設からの盗難という事実、管理不十分な環境での長期保管（2月13日から3月23日まで）、および複数の研究室での不適切な保管状態は、バイオセーフティ・バイオセキュリティの重大な懸念を構成する。刑事捜査進行中で、ユニキャンプが内部調査を実施。国家的・制度的レベルでの関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Medicos lead TB awareness drive in Nagarkurnool
article.articleSummary: TB awareness drive in Nagarkurnool: Medical college students and frontline health workers conducted a tuberculosis education rally from Bijinapally Primary Health Centre to Ambedkar Chowrasta to educate the public on prevention and treatment. Flagged off by Medical Officer Dr. P. Srujana, the event stressed that early detection and timely treatment can completely cure TB and aimed to dispel misconceptions to encourage testing and care. The rally included medical students, health staff, ASHA workers, and TB supervisors, with participation from Dr. Naresh, D. Balamma, Ashok Kumar, Chandrasekhar, Srinivasulu, Arif, Shravan, K. Manga, Shwetha, and others. Under the TB Mukt Bharat programme, nutritional kits were distributed to TB patients to support recovery. The gathering highlights ongoing public health efforts to reduce TB burden in Nagarkurnool.

triage.headline_ja: ナガルクルノール地区でTB認識向上キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 結核の啓発活動であり、新規感染症の集団発生やアウトブレイク報告ではない。公衆衛生教育プログラムのため、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド・テランガナ州ナガルクルノール地区における結核予防啓発活動（TB Mukt Bharat programme の一環）であり、患者数増加やアウトブレイク報告ではない。医学生および保健医療従事者による公衆衛生教育キャンペーンであるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: 9 Year-Old Dies 6 Months After Skipping Rabies Vaccine: Why Not Getting Jabbed After A Dog Bite Can Be Fatal
