article.articleSummary: Nine-year-old girl in Mumbai died of rabies six months after being scratched by a dog, having skipped anti-rabies vaccination due to fear of injections. Rabies is transmitted via saliva from infected dogs and is almost always fatal once symptoms appear (hydrophobia, fever, agitation). In India, dogs account for more than 99% of human rabies; annual deaths are estimated at 18,000–20,000, with children disproportionately affected (up to 60%). A 2025 Lancet Infectious Diseases study estimated over 9 million animal bites annually in India, underscoring exposure risk. After exposure, immediate wound washing, antiseptic, prompt post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) plus full vaccine course, and rabies immunoglobulin in high-risk cases, are essential; timely, complete PEP is nearly 100% protective when correctly administered. Union Health Minister JP Nadda stated there is no shortage of vaccines; the National Rabies Control Programme provides free vaccination and awareness. This case highlights preventable death from complacency around minor bites.

triage.headline_ja: 9歳の少女が狂犬病ワクチン接種を拒否した6ヶ月後に死亡：犬咬傷後にワクチン接種を受けない理由がなぜ致命的となるのか
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける狂犬病死亡事例の報告であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度）に該当するが、単一症例報告であり公衆衛生の新たな脅威を示唆する情報に乏しい。社会的・政治的関心は不明。続報の監視が適切。
triage.notes: インドでの狂犬病は年間18,000～20,000人が死亡する重大な公衆衛生課題であり、本事例は予防可能な死亡として教育的価値がある。しかし本報告は単一症例であり、新しい疫学的トレンドの変化は示唆されていない。Union Health Ministerがワクチン供給不足がないことを確認しており、対応体制は機能しているとされている。

article.articleHeadline: CLIRNET Marks World Tuberculosis Day 2026 with Global Clinical Forum to Strengthen TB Care - APN News | Authentic Press Network News
article.articleSummary: TB remains a leading infectious killer, affecting over 10 million people annually. On World Tuberculosis Day 2026, CLIRNET convened a global virtual forum of respiratory and thoracic experts from Egypt, Ethiopia, Ghana, Nigeria, and other regions, including Prof. Mohamed Awad-Tag El Din, Dr. Rahel Argaw, Dr. Sandra Kwarteng, Dr. Oluwafemi Ojo, Dr. Dimitrios Kantas, with moderators Dr. Moayad Alshehri and Dr. Saikat Banerjee. The event targets strengthening clinical practice amid delayed diagnosis, missed cases, and rising drug-resistant TB in strained health systems. WHO's theme 'Yes! We Can End TB Led by countries powered by people' highlights the clinician's role in early detection and consistent care. Discussions cover regional treatment adaptations, drug-resistant TB, and managing coexisting conditions such as diabetes, HIV, and malnutrition. Founder Saurav Kasera urges ongoing learning to reduce care variation and turn awareness into action.

triage.headline_ja: CLIRNET、結核の世界的臨床フォーラムで2026年世界結核デーを記念し結核ケア強化へ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核対策の国際専門家会議・啓発イベントの報告であり、新たな感染症の急速な拡大や公衆衛生危機的な事象を示すものではない。既知の疾患負荷への専門的対応の枠組みに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事は世界結核デーの専門家会議開催に関する情報提供記事である。新規感染症イベントやアウトブレイク、異常な疾患発生の報告ではない。エジプト、エチオピア、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため、ガーナのみverified_locationsに含める。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu Confirmed In Chhattisgarh's Bilaspur; 10-Km Surveillance Zone Declared, Sale Of Poultry Banned
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) confirmed at a government-run poultry farm in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, with more than 4,000 chickens dead; around 4,400 deaths reported at the Koni facility from March 19-24 among 5,037 birds housed. Samples sent to labs in Bhopal and Pune; Bhopal-confirmed H5N1 infection. District Collector Sanjay Agarwal activated containment measures under the Revised Action Plan 2021. A 1-km infected zone is designated around the farm, with a 1-10 km surveillance belt; affected wards include Ramakrishna Paramhansa Nagar and Vidyasagar Nagar. Poultry movement, sale, storage, transport, and door-to-door delivery of poultry and products are banned across infected and surveillance zones, with shops to shut temporarily to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガルのビラスプルで鳥インフルエンザが確認；10km監視地域を宣言、家禽販売禁止
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの確認例であり、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニングでも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露」に該当し、確立された防疫措置が講じられている一方、人への感染リスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: H5N1は家禽での確認であり、現段階で人への感染報告はないが、IHRの定義上は「Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1」のカテゴリーに分類されている。複数州（チャッティスガル、マディヤプラデシュ、マハラシュトラ、ヒマチャルプラデシュ）での地理的広がり、4,000羽以上の死亡、明確な防疫措置の実施が確認されている。人への感染リスク評価とフルRRAが必須。

article.articleHeadline: 基孔肯雅热和发热伴血小板减少综合征将纳入中国乙类传染病管理
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya Fever and Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome will be included in China's Category B infectious disease management.
article.articleSummary: From 2026-04-01, China will include Chikungunya fever and Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) in Category B infectious diseases under the Law on the Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases. Chikungunya fever, caused by chikungunya virus and transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, presents with fever, rash, and joint and muscle pain; it has caused local outbreaks in more than 100 countries and regions globally. In China, imported cases emerged in 2008, with localized clusters reported in 2025. SFTS, caused by the SFTS virus and mainly tick-borne, is concentrated in Asia, with China and other Asian nations reporting cases; China first documented SFTS in 2009, with most cases in tick-endemic mountainous areas. Category B designates a serious health threat requiring strict management to reduce incidence and harm, and will trigger nationwide preventive and control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 基孔肯雅热と発熱を伴う血小板減少症候群が中国の乙類伝染病管理に組み入れられる
triage.triage_reason: 2つの既知病原体（チクングニア熱・SFTS）の行政的カテゴライズ変更を報じる記事であり、新規アウトブレイク検知ではない。ただし中国における最近の局地的クラスタ報告（2025年）の存在、および公衆衛生対応の強化を示唆するため、引き続き監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月1日より実施される新規行政措置（感染症分類の格上げ）を報じたもの。チクングニア熱は2025年に局地的クラスタが報告されており、継続的な流行リスクあり。SFTSはダニ媒介で感染リスク継続。新規発症例の急増報告ではないため PICKUP には至らないが、公衆衛生体制の強化と病原体の流行易易性を考慮し WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu outbreak in Bilaspur: 5,500 chickens dead, 5-km zone sealed; culling, surveillance intensified
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) confirmed in Bilaspur district, India, with 5,500 chickens dead over the past five days at the government poultry farm in Koni. About 20,000 eggs destroyed after samples tested in Bhopal confirmed avian influenza. A five-kilometre sensitive containment zone has been declared and the farm shuttered. Authorities are carrying out culling and disposal under SOPs, tightening movement within the zone, and maintaining surveillance across poultry farms. Multidepartment teams (health, veterinary, animal husbandry, municipal corporation) are deployed; police security is tightened to prevent entry and curb rumours. Residents nearby will undergo health check-ups with immediate treatment for suspicious symptoms. Public messaging urges adherence to guidelines and prompt reporting of suspicious bird deaths. The response emphasizes coordinated containment measures to prevent further spread as of 25 March 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ビラスプル地域での鳥インフルエンザ発生：5,500羽の鶏が死亡、5km圏内が封鎖、殺処分と監視体制が強化
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの確認事例であり、5,500羽の集団死亡という重症度、異常性、そして国際的拡大リスク（鳥インフルエンザは人獣共通感染症）が複数のIHR/WPRO基準を満たす。既に多部門による対応と監視体制が構築されている。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年3月25日配信で、ビラスプル地区（ヒマーチャル・プラデーシュ州）の政府家禽農場での鳥インフルエンザ確認を報告。サンプルはボーパールで検査確認された。5km の封鎖区域設定、殺処分、監視体制強化、近隣住民の健康診査が実施されており、多部門による統合対応が進行中。人獣共通感染症であり、国際的な報告義務疾患。

article.articleHeadline: Wenchi Municipality records over 100 TB cases in 2025 - Health Director  - Ghana Business News
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) in Wenchi Municipality, Ghana saw 102 cases in 2025, with about 80% treated and 6.7% deaths. Acting Wenchi Municipal Director of Health, Mr. George Agyemang, warns of rising TB and urges the public to seek early medication, noting that early detection improves treatment outcomes. The remarks were made during World TB Day observed on 24 March 2026, under the WHO theme 'Yes! We can end TB!', which the article says signals a shift from reaffirming global ambition to turning commitments into action. Mr. Agyemang also calls on NGOs, philanthropic individuals and organizations, and civil society to intensify education and increase investments to stem TB spread in the country.

triage.headline_ja: ウェンチ市が2025年に100件以上の結核症例を記録 - ガーナ保健局長
triage.triage_reason: ガーナの特定地域（ウェンチ市）における結核症例の報告であり、公式な保健当局による確認情報があるが、国家的・国際的な拡大リスクや深刻な公衆衛生危機の証拠は現在の情報では不明。経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、102症例は局所的な報告。記事は世界結核デー（3月24日）の文脈であり、予防キャンペーンの一環と考えられる。ただしWPRO基準の「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当し、政府・公開の関心もあるため、継続的な監視が適切。国際的拡大や深刻な異常の証拠は現状では限定的。

article.articleHeadline: তাপমাত্রার বদলে ভোল বদলে ফেলছে ডেঙ্গি, বিশ্ব জুড়ে দাপট বাড়বে এডিস মশার, সতর্ক করল হু
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue is changing with temperature changes; globally, Aedes mosquitoes will become more prevalent, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk is rising globally as temperatures increase, with WHO and the Global Climate Report warning that warming and erratic rainfall are expanding the ranges of Aedes aegypti, Anopheles stephensi, and Culex Vishnoyi mosquitoes. In West Bengal, favorable conditions for these vectors are linked to growing dengue activity. The dengue virus is mutating, with a new, more infectious Dengue virus type 3 (DENV-3) lineage emerging and altering clinical presentation beyond fever and rash. Patients may develop multi-organ failure, hemorrhage, thrombocytopenia, and involvement of heart, liver, and kidneys, as well as edema, seizures, loss of consciousness, chest pain, jaundice, and pleural effusions. Early laboratory confirmation via NS1 antigen or IgM ELISA is crucial. WMO notes climate shifts since 2005–2015, and projections for 2025–2029 suggest warming could exceed the 1.5°C limit. Icelandic researchers report dengue mosquitoes in colder regions, indicating expanding reach.

triage.headline_ja: 気温変化によってデング熱が変わり、世界中でネッタイシマカが増加し、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とSFTSウイルスの同時発生報告であり、気候変動による蚊媒介感染症の地理的拡大（アイスランド含む高緯度地域への侵入）、新型デングウイルス3型系統の出現と臨床像の悪化（多臓器不全など）が報告されており、異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスクの複数基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではWest Bengal（インド国内）とアイスランドでの蚊媒介感染症関連の報告が記載されているが、対象国リストに照らしてはインドのみを verified_locations に含める。SFTS ウイルスは東アジアで一般的だが、本記事ではデング熱とSFTSの関連性が明確でなく、主要な焦点はデング熱の世界的拡大（気候変動による）。新型DENV-3系統による重症化（多臓器不全、出血、血小板減少症など）は臨床的に顕著な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: 鹤壁市城乡一体化示范区卫生健康医保服务中心开展世界防治结核病日宣传活动
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hebi City's Urban-Rural Integration Demonstration Zone Health and Wellness Medical Insurance Service Center Carries Out World Tuberculosis Day Awareness Activities
article.articleSummary: On 24 March 2026, World Tuberculosis Day, Hebi City's Urban-Rural Integration Demonstration Zone Health and Wellness Medical Insurance Service Center conducted TB prevention awareness activities at Shifo Temple Village, Gucheng Street. The event promoted the theme 'End TB: Action, investment, and participation by all,' featuring lectures on TB epidemiology and symptom recognition to enhance understanding and reduce fear, and to empower families with prevention practices. Healthcare workers provided free blood pressure and blood glucose measurements to villagers at the doorstep. About 300 residents attended, and roughly 400 promotional materials were distributed. The activity strengthens routine TB prevention and control, raises public health awareness, and fosters cross-sector coordination and community involvement, with plans to sustain TB knowledge dissemination and accessible health services to safeguard public health.

triage.headline_ja: 鶴壁市城郷一体化示範区衛生健康医保サービスセンターが世界結核病予防日啓発活動を展開
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は世界結核病予防日（3月24日）に関連した公衆衛生啓発イベント報道であり、新規の結核感染症アウトブレイク、異常な疾病発生、または急速な感染拡大を報告していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は定期的な公衆衛生啓発活動（World TB Dayキャンペーン）についての報道であり、感染症シグナル検知の対象外。結核の新規患者発生や流行状況の報告ではなく、予防・啓発の取り組みを記録したニュース記事である。

article.articleHeadline: Người đàn ông mất cánh tay do nhiễm 'vi khuẩn ăn thịt'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man loses his arm due to necrotizing fasciitis
article.articleSummary: One confirmed case in Hanoi, Vietnam: a 57-year-old man with necrotizing fasciitis due to Vibrio vulnificus. Admitted in critical condition with high fever and rapid swelling of the right hand (initially the thumb); diagnosed as septic shock with cellulitis. He underwent surgical debridement and amputation of one-third of the right arm to halt infection spread. Post-operatively, he remained on mechanical ventilation, received broad-spectrum antibiotics, and continuous renal replacement therapy; by March 24, his condition was temporarily stabilized. Blood cultures confirmed Vibrio vulnificus. The infection source and circumstances are not yet clear. Vibrio vulnificus is a marine bacterium thriving in warm saltwater, typically acquired via wounds or ingestion of raw seafood, especially oysters. Risk factors include liver disease, diabetes, immunodeficiency, congenital hemolytic anemia, and acid-suppressive therapy. Public health advice stresses cooking seafood, avoiding raw shellfish, and prompt wound care for suspected infection.

triage.headline_ja: ビブリオ・バルニフィカス感染による壊死性筋膜炎でハノイの男性が腕を失う
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の重症感染症（腕の切断を要した壊死性筋膜炎）であり重症度は高いが、国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生上の広範な影響は現時点では明確でない。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ビブリオ・バルニフィカスは海水温暖地域で自然発生する病原体であり、ベトナムでの散発症例として妥当。単一症例で感染源が不明、国際的拡大の兆候なし。ただし重症度（四肢切断）が高いため、類似症例の追加報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Flu outbreak in Chattisgarh , Bilaspur: Over 22,000 birds culled, buried
article.articleSummary: Bird Flu (Avian Influenza) outbreak confirmed at a state-run poultry farm in Koni, Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, after 4,744 chickens died between March 19–24. Lab tests in Bhopal and Pune confirmed the highly contagious virus by late March 24. Authorities culled and buried 22,808 hatchlings and other birds, plus 80 quintals of feedstock and plastic utensils, and are sanitising affected equipment. All workers’ samples tested negative so far. An Infected Zone within 1 km and a Surveillance Zone within 10 km have been declared; remaining poultry, eggs, and related materials in the zone are culled and disposed, with a ban on movement of poultry, eggs, and materials. Munadi public alerts issued; meat sales restricted inside 1–10 km. Health Department will monitor residents; Animal Husbandry will inspect nearby farms and enforce biosecurity; the farm will be sealed after culling.

triage.headline_ja: Flu outbreak in Chattisgarh , Bilaspur: Over 22,000 birds culled, buried
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの確認事例であり、IHR基準で異常性・予想外性が該当。WPROスクリーニングでは異常性、重症度（大規模畜殺）、流行可能性が該当し、シグナル閾値を超える。
triage.notes: チャッティスガル州ビラスプル地区の国営採卵場で確認された鳥インフルエンザ(H5N1等の高病原性株の可能性)。4,744羽の死亡、22,808羽の処分により大規模な畜産影響あり。ラボ確認済み。感染ゾーン・サーベイランスゾーン設定、人への感染リスクは現在低い(労働者陰性)が、ウイルスの人獣共通感染性と流行可能性から要監視。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu Scare: Administration Bans Poultry Sales, Declares 1 km Infected and 10 km
article.articleSummary: On 25 March 2026, authorities confirmed H5N1 Bird Flu cases in a district, prompting immediate containment. A 1-kilometre infected zone and a 10-kilometre surveillance zone have been declared around the outbreak. The infected zone includes the Ramkrishna Paramhans Nagar and Vidyasagar Nagar wards, where heightened monitoring is underway. Collector Sanjay Agrawal issued detailed guidelines and directed all departments to remain on high alert to prevent further spread. A complete halt on all poultry activities is in effect within both the infected and surveillance zones. The rapid measures aim to curb transmission and safeguard public health, though the report provides no further laboratory confirmation or case counts.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザの懸念: 行政が家禽販売を禁止、1kmの感染区域と10kmの監視区域を宣言
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの人への感染リスク、異常/予想外な家禽の大規模販売禁止措置、国際的拡大の潜在可能性、および管理体制下での急速な対応が必要という点で複数のWPRO基準に該当。
triage.notes: H5N1は人獣共通感染症であり、公開ソースの信頼性は限定的だが、報告内容は当局の積極的な対応措置（1km感染区域、10km監視区域設定、家禽活動全面禁止）を示唆。ラボ確認と患者数の詳細は記事では提供されていない。配信日時が2026年3月25日であり、リアルタイム情報の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: बिलासपुर में बर्ड फ्लू का खतरा, मरे मुर्गे खुले में सड़ रहे, दहशत में लोग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu threat in Bilaspur; dead chickens rotting in the open; people in a panic.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, Bilaspur, India, in the Khamtarai area near Dream City Colony, reports suspected avian influenza with dead chickens left exposed in the open for several days, producing odor and fear. The administration has not acted; risk of disease spread to humans escalates. Dead birds attract mosquitoes and other insects, potentially aiding transmission. Residents have raised complaints; experts warn bird flu can spread rapidly and pose a human health threat if not managed. Health officials urge vigilance, avoiding contact with suspected birds and keeping children away from affected sites. Calls for immediate action to safely dispose of carcasses to prevent infection spread to Bilaspur and nearby villages. The situation underscores wider regional concern about avian influenza and public health response.

triage.headline_ja: ビラスプルで鳥インフルエンザの脅威、死んだ鶏が野外で腐っており、人々がパニック状態
triage.triage_reason: インド・ビラスプルでの人獣共通感染症（鳥インフルエンザ）イベント。重症度基準該当（死亡事例・動物での確認）、異常性あり、急速な地域拡大リスク（近隣村への感染拡大懸念）、公衆衛生管理の不備（遺体の不適切処理）により、IHR基準3つ以上およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではビラスプル市（Chhattisgarh州）およびKhamtarai地区が主な発生地で、鳥インフルエンザの疑い事例が確認されている。遺体の不適切処理による環境汚染、蚊やその他昆虫を介した媒介リスク、ヒト感染の可能性が指摘されており、地域の公衆衛生上重大な懸念となっている。行政対応の遅延が指摘されており、近隣村への拡大防止が急務。

article.articleHeadline: बर्ड फ्लू का प्रकोप: बिलासपुर में 4400 मुर्गियों की मौत से सनसनी, 10 किमी का इलाका बना सर्विलांस जोन
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu outbreak: Panic after the death of 4,400 chickens in Bilaspur, a 10-km radius designated as a surveillance zone.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) confirmed in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, after a Konni-area poultry farm saw about 4,400 chicken deaths between March 19–24, from a total of 5,037 birds. Lab confirmation followed samples sent to Bhopal and Pune. A 1-km infected zone is established around the farm, with a 10-km surveillance zone. Within the infected area, culling of poultry, feed, and eggs and movement restrictions will be enforced; the farm will be sealed after culling. The Animal Husbandry Department will compensate owners. District Collector Sanjay Agarwal ordered coordinated containment, including sampling, culling, and safe disposal, with movement controls in the containment zone and intensified health surveillance in surrounding areas. Authorities will monitor poultry farms and health of residents while investigations determine whether this reflects a lapse or outbreak. Published 2026-03-25.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ発生：ビラスプールで4,400羽の鶏が死亡、10km圏内が監視地域に指定
triage.triage_reason: インド国内で鳥インフルエンザウイルスのヒト感染が確認された可能性と、家禽における大規模な集団発生が報告されている。複数州で同時発生の報告があり、国際的な拡大リスク及び深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインド国内（ビラスプール地区、チャッティスガル州およびマハラシュトラ州）での鳥インフルエンザ発生を報告。疾患カテゴリが「animals」と「Human Infection with Avian Influenza」の両方を含むことから、ヒト感染の可能性を示唆。複数州にわたる地理的分布と、4,400羽の大規模家禽死亡により、国内拡大および国際的な懸念が高まっている。実験室確認済みで当局による積極的な封じ込めと調査が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: ബിലാസ്പൂരിൽ പക്ഷിപ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു: 10 കി.മീ പരിധിയിൽ ജാഗ്രത; കോഴിയിറച്ചി വിൽപ്പന നിരോധിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu confirmed in Bilaspur: Caution within a 10-km radius; sale of chicken giblets banned.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza confirmed at a poultry farm in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh. District authorities declared a 1-km infected radius around the farm and extended a 1- to 10-km surveillance zone, with strict controls on poultry product movement. The farm houses 5,037 chickens; 4,400 died between March 19 and 24 as the outbreak unfolded. Samples from the farm were sent to laboratories in Bhopal and Pune, where the virus was confirmed. The affected area includes Ramakrishna Paramahamsa Nagar and Vidya Sagar Nagar wards. Within the radius, sale, storage, and transport of poultry meat and eggs are banned; meat shops were temporarily closed. Measures include culling and disposal of dead birds, decontamination of the farm and surroundings per biosafety protocols, and a dedicated team to monitor farm workers’ health. This information is current as of 25 March 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ビラスプールで鳥インフルエンザが確認：10km範囲内で警戒; 鶏肉製品の販売禁止
triage.triage_reason: インドで確認された鳥インフルエンザの家禽農場での集団発生。IHR基準で異常/予想外（Yes）、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（Yes）に該当し、2基準以上を満たす。また家禽労働者の健康監視実施など管理対応が進行中のため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 家禽農場での確認事例であり、ヒト感染症例は報告されていない。しかし農場労働者の健康監視が実施されており、ヒト感染リスクが存在する。複数州（チャッティスガル州、マディヤプラデシュ州）にまたがる疑似症例の検査実施中。今後のヒト感染確認の有無が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu Kills 4,400 Chickens In Chhattisgarh; Surveillance Intensified
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) outbreak at a state-run poultry farm in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, India, with about 4,400 chicken deaths from March 19–24, among 5,037 birds housed at the Koni facility. Samples from the dead birds were sent to labs in Bhopal and Pune, with the Bhopal lab confirming avian influenza in the dead stock. An infected zone of 1 km around the farm and a 10 km surveillance zone have been established. Within the infected zone, poultry, feed and eggs will be culled and movement banned; compensation will be provided by the Animal Husbandry Department. The farm will be sealed after culling; Rapid Response Teams will conduct culling, safe disposal, surveillance and sanitisation. Health monitoring of farm workers is underway; no human infections have been reported to date. Containment follows the Revised Action Plan for Prevention and Containment of Avian Influenza (2021).

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガル州で鳥インフルエンザが4,400羽のニワトリを殺傷、監視体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの動物での発生確認（異常・予想外の基準該当）だが、人間への感染報告なし。動物での局所的発生であり、現段階では国際的拡大リスクや重篤な公衆衛生影響の証拠が限定的。情報が動物レベルに留まり、ヒト感染の可能性や管理可能性については不明な点が多い。
triage.notes: 動物での鳥インフルエンザ確認事例。ヒト感染は現在報告されていないが、鶏舎での直接接触職員を含む人的曝露がある。インド国内での監視体制が既に確立されており、初期対応が実施中。続報で人間への感染の有無、ウイルス株の特性、拡大状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Lo ngại viêm não mô cầu, nhiều người đi tiêm chủng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concerns About Meningococcal Meningitis Prompt Many People to Get Vaccinated
article.articleSummary: Vietnam faces rising meningococcal meningitis concerns after the Ministry of Health issued an urgent directive following a four-member family cluster, with two deaths. Nationwide vaccination demand has surged, with vaccination centers reporting a sharp rise in turnout. A fifth-grade girl in Phú Quốc, An Giang, died from group B meningococcal meningitis; another child exposed to the case was saved with timely treatment, highlighting the 'golden hour' for care. In 2025 Vietnam recorded 95 meningococcal disease cases, up 74 from 2024, with 3 fatalities. The Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City reports that in the south, group B accounts for 98.1% of cases since 2014–2025. Disease can progress to death within 24 hours; symptoms include sudden fever 39–41°C, severe headache, vomiting, seizures, neck stiffness. Vaccines: Cuba-made MenB/B/C at 310,000 VND per dose; US/Italy MenB/ACYW135 at 1.7–1.85 million VND per dose. Avoid inappropriate antibiotics and seek care.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌髄膜炎への懸念が高まり、多くの人がワクチン接種を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 家族クラスター（死亡2名を含む）とワクチン接種需要の急増が報告されており、IHR基準で「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行易い性質」「管理可能性」に該当し、複数基準を満たす。ベトナムの保健当局が公式指令を発令している点で社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいてベトナム全国での事例が主題である。ホーチミン市、フーコック島（アンザン省）、キエンザン省が具体的な発生地として記載されており、いずれもベトナム国内。2025年の症例数（95例、前年比+74）の増加傾向、1日以内の急速な進行による死亡例、保健省による緊急指令発令、全国のワクチン接種需要急増などから、公衆衛生上の深刻さと異常性が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: India's Silent Economic Drain: The Antibiotic-Resistant Typhoid Crisis | Health
article.articleSummary: Antibiotic-resistant typhoid in India accounted for 87% of disease-related costs in 2023, totaling Rs 123 billion, according to The Lancet Regional Health Southeast Asia. The burden disproportionately affects children under 10, with households bearing 91% of expenses and about 70,000 families facing catastrophic health expenditures. States Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh (including Telangana), Tamil Nadu, and West Bengal together accounted for 51% of national costs. Fluoroquinolone-resistant typhoid strains are the main economic driver, straining household finances and healthcare systems. Experts from the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine and Christian Medical College, Vellore, urge introducing the typhoid conjugate vaccine into India's national immunization schedule, alongside strengthened antibiotic resistance controls and guided health financing policies. The findings underscore a critical need for targeted public health strategies to reduce typhoid's economic toll.

triage.headline_ja: インドの静かな経済危機：薬剤耐性腸チフスの危機
triage.triage_reason: 薬剤耐性腸チフスがインド全土で蔓延し、重大な経済負担（2023年に1,230億ルピー）と公衆衛生への深刻な影響を引き起こしており、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）とWPRO基準複数項目（重症度、長期曝露、管理可能性）に該当する。
triage.notes: 薬剤耐性腸チフスはインド全体に蔓延しており、複数州（マハラシュトラ、ウッタルプラデシュ、アンドラプラデシュ、テランガーナ、タミルナドゥ、ウェストベンガル）での発生が確認されている。フルオロキノロン耐性株が主要な経済的負担源となっており、小児への影響が特に深刻である。国際専門家からのワクチン導入提言があり、管理可能性への課題が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ca tay chân miệng TP.HCM tăng, diễn biến phức tạp, ghi nhận chủng vi rút EV71
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot and mouth disease cases in Ho Chi Minh City on the rise, with complex developments, EV71 virus strain detected.
article.articleSummary: Hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) is rising in Ho Chi Minh City. In week 11 of 2026, the city recorded 7,294 HFMD cases, up 241.3% from the same period in 2025; 98 severe cases (≥2b), 1.3%, up 4.6×. Week 11 added 837 new cases, a 97.1% rise over the four‑week average. Since January 2026, 288 outbreaks have been detected—162 in schools and 126 in the community. Enterovirus 71 (EV71) was found in 25% of samples (6/24), a high‑virulence strain linked to serious illness and death, especially in children under 5. Authorities tightened prevention and control; the Health Department directs surveillance and rapid outbreak response, with focus on preschools and social welfare facilities. The Education sector is urged to ensure handwashing facilities and strengthen risk communication with parents. Hospitals Nhi Dong 1, Nhi Dong 2, and Children's Hospital retrain staff on diagnosis, treatment, and infection control, including outreach to Ba Ria–Vung Tau and Binh Duong. Public guidance emphasizes ‘3 clean’: eat clean, live clean, and clean hands/toys.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市の手足口病が増加、複雑な経過をたどり、EV71ウイルス株が検出
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病が短期間に急増（前年同期比241.3%）し、EV71高毒性株が検出されている。小児死亡リスクがあり、学校・地域での集団発生が確認され、複数の衛生管理基準に該当する。
triage.notes: EV71は小児に対する高い病原性を持つ株であり、全国レベルの統調された対応が実施されている。Ba Ria–Vung Tauおよび周辺地域への拡大も報告されており、地域的な伝播の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: The frantic, high-tech fight to stop climate-fueled dengue fever
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever surged in Peru and the Americas as climate-driven expansion of Aedes aegypti intensified. In Lima, Santa Rosa hospital in Pueblo Libre admitted the first patient from the Amazon two years prior; a young woman with fever and abdominal hemorrhage was misdiagnosed as obstetric complications before dengue was lab-confirmed, signaling an outbreak. Peru had long claimed eradication of Aedes aegypti (1958), but dengue returned with urbanization and air travel. Global cases rose from 500,000 in 2000 to 7 million in 2023, then 14 million with 9,000 deaths in 2024, majority in the Americas. Brazil faced emergency declarations in 17 cities. Santa Rosa saw 40–60 dengue patients daily at the epidemic peak (Feb–Mar), many from surrounding districts; in 2022 there were 13 dengue patients all year. To cope, staff set up a tent ICU and reorganized wings to move severe cases quickly.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動によるデング熱の流行との戦い
triage.triage_reason: ペルー・ブラジル・スペイン（カナリア諸島）での発生を報道する記事だが、対象国リストに該当する国での実際の発生がない。記事のサマリーはペルーでのデング熱拡大とブラジルでの緊急事態宣言を述べているが、ペルーはWPRO対象国ではなく、ブラジルは該当するが記事の主題地はペルーである。
triage.notes: ペルーはGeoNames上の対象国リストに含まれていないため、記事の主要な発生地であってもverified_locationsには含めない。ブラジルは記事に17都市での緊急事態宣言が記載されているため対象国として含める。ただしブラジルは記事の主題ではなく、記事の重点はペルーでのデング熱拡大にある。対象国ではない地域でのイベント報道であるため、DISMISS判定。

article.articleHeadline: 苏州市相城区元和街道华元社区开展结核病防治知识讲座
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Huayuan Community, Yuanhe Subdistrict, Xiangcheng District, Suzhou, holds a tuberculosis prevention and control knowledge lecture.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) prevention and control lecture conducted in Huayuan Community, Yuanhe Street, Xiangcheng District, Suzhou (Jiangsu Province) to raise residents’ awareness. Published 2026-03-25. At the daytime care center, volunteers used PPT and videos to cover TB transmission, common symptoms, and who is most at risk, stressing early detection and treatment, especially among the elderly with weaker immunity. Prevention guidance focused on hygiene, regular handwashing, ventilation, balanced nutrition, adequate rest, and physical activity. Participants were advised to seek prompt medical evaluation at regular healthcare facilities for persistent cough, sputum production, fatigue, low-grade fever, or night sweats. An authoritative TB prevention video was shown to reinforce understanding. The session fostered active discussion, and Huayuan Community will continue diversified health education to safeguard residents’ health.

triage.headline_ja: 蘇州市相城区元和街道華元社区が結核病防治知識講座を開催
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核病の予防啓発講座の開催に関するもので、新規感染事例の報告や集団発生ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当せず、社会的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の新規発生や集団感染を報告するものではなく、既存の結核病予防啓発活動の実施内容を報道するもの。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ayurveda And AI Integration, Large-Scale Screening: Next Phase Of 100-Day TB Mukt Bharat Campaign Launched
article.articleSummary: India launches the next phase of the 100-day TB Mukt Bharat campaign on World TB Day 2026, targeting over 1.5 lakh villages and urban wards with a focus on migrant workers, tribal communities, and the urban poor. The phase expands AI-enabled diagnostics and symptom-agnostic screening to accelerate early TB detection, backed by portable X-ray, molecular testing, and digital tools including the TB Mukt Bharat App. The decentralized, mission-mode plan emphasizes intensive screening, last-mile delivery, and strengthened treatment adherence, aiming to eliminate TB under the National TB Elimination Programme. In earlier phases, over 20 crore individuals from vulnerable groups have been screened. India has reduced TB incidence ~21%, TB deaths ~25%, with treatment coverage >90%, and undiagnosed cases cut from >1 million to <100k. Approximately 50% of TB patients may lack classic symptoms, justifying symptom-agnostic screening.

triage.headline_ja: アーユルヴェーダとAI統合、大規模スクリーニング：100日間TB Mukt Bharat キャンペーンの次段階が開始
triage.triage_reason: インドの既存TB排除プログラムの段階的実施に関するニュースであり、新規感染症アウトブレイク、異常な疾患動態、または国際的な拡大リスクを示していない。公衆衛生対策の前向きな進展を報告する記事であるため。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、インド政府による計画的なTB排除キャンペーンの進捗報告である。既存プログラム枠内での政策実施・技術導入に関する公式発表であり、新規シグナル検出の対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 三联四融护校园 结核防控进课堂_区县（市）_长沙站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three-Linked, Four-Integrated Campus Protection: Tuberculosis Prevention and Control Enters the Classroom — Districts and Counties (Cities) — Changsha Station
article.articleSummary: World Tuberculosis Day activities on March 24 in Changsha's Yuhua District, Zuojiatang Street, Kangda Community Health Service Center, in partnership with Changsha City Central Hospital, delivered a pulmonary tuberculosis prevention lecture to Guihua Tree No.2 Primary School. The session explained TB transmission, typical symptoms, and practical prevention measures (ventilation, hand hygiene, proper mask use) and noted China’s policy of free TB diagnosis and treatment. A key message: cough with sputum for more than two weeks requires medical evaluation. Using the 'three-linked, four-integrated' party-education-health development model, the initiative integrates medical resources with campus health services, delivering expert knowledge to teachers and students and embedding prevention within routine services. Future steps will target key populations and places, deepen collaboration with higher-level hospitals and schools, and sustain infectious-disease prevention and health-literacy activities to safeguard youth health in the district.

triage.headline_ja: 三聯四融護校園 結核防控進課堂_区県（市）_長沙站（三つのリンク、四つの統合がキャンパスを守る 結核防止と管理が教室に入る）
triage.triage_reason: 結核に関する予防啓発・教育活動の報道であり、新規の疾病集団発生やアウトブレイクではない。IHR基準もWPRO基準も該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国長沙市の結核予防啓発キャンペーンであり、具体的な患者数、クラスター発生、異常な流行の報告はない。政策推進と健康教育が主題であり、感染症危機管理シグナルとして該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Antibiotic resistance fuels 87 per cent of India's typhoid economic burden: Study
article.articleSummary: In 2023, antibiotic-resistant typhoid infections accounted for at least 87% of India's disease-related economic burden, with total costs estimated at Rs 123 billion. Children under 10 incurred the highest burden, contributing over half of the costs; households bore 91% of expenses and about 70,000 families faced catastrophic health expenditure. Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh (including Telangana), Tamil Nadu and West Bengal together accounted for 51% of national costs. Typhoid fever spreads via contaminated food or water; symptoms include high fever, fatigue, headache and stomach pain. Fluoroquinolone-resistant infections drove 87% of total costs. Authors from London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine and Christian Medical College, Vellore, analysed Indian epidemiology, care-seeking and outcomes to estimate direct and indirect costs for hospitalised and non-hospitalised typhoid patients. Findings support introducing typhoid conjugate vaccine into the national immunisation schedule and enhancing antibiotic resistance control and health financing policies.

triage.headline_ja: 抗生物質耐性がインドのチフス経済負担の87%を加速：研究
triage.triage_reason: チフスの抗生物質耐性化によるインド国内での経済負担に関する研究報告。感染症の異常・予想外な傾向（耐性化）と重症度の要素があるが、新規感染症流行ではなく既知疾患の経済分析であり、即時的な公衆衛生危機の証拠が不明瞭なため、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2023年データに基づく経済負担分析研究である。急速な感染流行の警告ではなく、既知のチフス感染症における抗生物質耐性化の経済的インパクトに関する研究知見。ただし、インド全土での複数州にわたる高い耐性菌蔓延（87%がフルオロキノロン耐性）は公衆衛生上の懸念事項であり、IHR基準2項目該当によりWATCHレベルでの監視を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Two deaths linked to suspected meningococcal infection in Shillong: All about the disease
article.articleSummary: Two deaths in Shillong, Meghalaya, are linked to suspected meningococcal infection, prompting intensified contact tracing, area fumigation, and surveillance into the infection's source after hospitalisation earlier this month. Meningococcal disease can cause meningitis, an inflammation of the brain and spinal cord membranes, with symptoms including fever, headache, nausea/vomiting, sensitivity to bright light, skin rash that may be dark or discoloured, diarrhoea, joint and muscle pain, loss of appetite, and fatigue. Infants and toddlers are most vulnerable; early vaccination with the Meningococcal Conjugate Vaccine (MCV), starting at 9 months, is stressed to prevent fatalities and curb spread in close-contact settings. The WHO roadmap Defeating Meningitis by 2030 is cited. Parents are advised to consult paediatricians about vaccination. Ongoing investigations monitor the infection’s source and nearby neighbourhood exposure; two deaths reported, with suspected cases under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: シロンの髄膜炎菌感染疑い関連死亡2件：疾患について
triage.triage_reason: インドのメガラヤ州シロンで髄膜炎菌感染疑いによる死亡2件が報告されており、IHR基準では「異常性」と「国際的拡大リスク」が該当（2件以上）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡）と流行しやすさ（密集環境での感染）が該当し、社会的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: シロン（メガラヤ州の州都）での疑い患者発生であり、インドは対象国リストに含まれる。死亡事例と密集環境での感染拡大リスク、ワクチンに関する公衆衛生推奨が記事の主要内容。進行中の疫学調査と接触者追跡が進められている。

article.articleHeadline: Brésil : A Macapa une femme décède de la maladie de Chagas après avoir consommé du wassaï contaminé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil: In Macapá, a woman dies from Chagas disease after consuming contaminated wassaï.
article.articleSummary: Three Chagas disease cases detected in Macapá, the capital of Amapá state, Brazil, are linked to ingestion of contaminated wassaï (cassava juice). A 47-year-old woman died; eight additional suspected cases are under investigation by health authorities. Chagas disease is caused by the protozoan Trypanosoma cruzi; initial symptoms include fever, fatigue and facial swelling, with potential progression to cardiac and digestive complications. In response, authorities have begun inspections of wassaï brewers and reiterate strict hygiene measures to eliminate the parasite, but Macapá hosts many informal producers, complicating controls. Residents are urged to purchase wassaï only from licensed establishments. The outbreak echoes earlier cases in Belém, Pará, where several people were treated for Chagas and some deaths occurred after consuming contaminated wassaï. Wassaï is a major agricultural resource and has been designated a national fruit in Brazil, underscoring its importance for Amapá.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル：マカパで女性がシャーガス病で死亡、汚染されたワッサイ（キャッサバジュース）を摂取後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響：死亡・重症例あり、異常/予想外：食品由来シャーガス感染症の異常発生、国際拡大リスク：広域流行の兆候）。加えてWPRO基準では重症度（死亡例あり）と流行しやすさ（複数感染、継続的曝露リスク）が該当。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: シャーガス病は通常、バイオ媒介（サシガメ）による感染が主流だが、本事例は汚染食品（ワッサイ）を経由した異常な感染経路。マカパでの死亡事例1件、疑い例8件、ベレンでの過去事例も報告されており、地域的な継続的リスクが存在。非公式なワッサイ生産者が多く、衛生管理の困難さが懸念される。国家的に重要な農産物であることから社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: LMC-funded training on diagnosing foot-and-mouth disease opens in Myanmar
article.articleSummary: Myanmar launches a five-day, Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Special Fund (LMC Fund 2024)–funded training in Nay Pyi Taw to diagnose foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) using molecular and serological techniques. The session runs March 25–28, 2026, with 10 participants. It aims to upgrade diagnostics from routine methods to molecular/serological tests, enabling faster, more accurate identification and strengthening laboratory skills to support FMD control activities. Quick detection is expected to prevent disease spread, protect livestock, and reduce risks to international trade. Deputy director-general Min Thein Maw of the Livestock Breeding and Veterinary Department stated the training will bolster surveillance and control capabilities in Myanmar.

triage.headline_ja: LMC資金による口蹄疫診断訓練がミャンマーで開始
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は国際的に重要な動物疾病であり、ミャンマーでの診断能力強化は地域的な関心事であるが、本記事は訓練プログラムの実施報告であり、アウトブレイクの発生そのものではない。スクリーニング基準の該当は限定的であり、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事はミャンマーにおける口蹄疫診断訓練の実施報告であり、実際のアウトブレイク発生を報告するものではない。訓練が「予防的」であることから、現在のところ活動的な流行があることを示す証拠は記事に含まれていない。ただし、口蹄疫は家畜疾病として経済的・国際的に重要であり、地域での診断能力強化は地域的な懸念を反映している可能性があるため、関連する発生情報の続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Giám đốc Sở Y tế An Giang cảnh báo viêm não mô cầu sau ca tử vong ở trẻ tại Phú Quốc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director of An Giang Department of Health warns about meningococcal meningitis after a child's death in Phú Quốc.
article.articleSummary: A child in Phú Quốc died from meningococcal meningitis; laboratory confirmation by Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City identified Neisseria meningitidis type B. An Giang Department of Health states the case is sporadic with no similar cases in the community, school, or residence, but cautions that meningococcal disease spreads via respiratory droplets and can progress rapidly, justifying high vigilance in crowded settings. An Giang conducted a rapid epidemiological investigation, tracing about 60 people in the patient’s lodging (34 close contacts) and, at the school, 36 students and 1 teacher, plus around 20 healthcare workers involved in care. The response focuses on three pillars: (1) epidemiological control with 10-day monitoring of close contacts and chemoprophylaxis per guidelines; (2) environmental cleaning and community surveillance with disinfection and early detection; (3) coordination with education and local authorities, with some students vaccinated. Public guidance: seek prompt medical care for fever, headache, rash, or confusion; maintain hygiene, wear a mask when needed, ensure ventilated living spaces; close contacts should monitor health and follow officials’ instructions to prevent severe outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: アンザン省保健局長、フーコック島の小児死亡例後に髄膜炎菌髄膜炎について警告
triage.triage_reason: 確認された髄膜炎菌髄膜炎による死亡例、実験室確認済み、約60人の接触者追跡調査が進行中、呼吸器飛沫感染による急速な進展リスクがあり、スクリーニング基準複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。
triage.notes: Neisseria meningitidis type B による確認済みの死亡例。パスツール研究所ホーチミン市分院により実験室確認。約60人の接触者（うち34人が濃厚接触者）および学校の児童・教職員、医療従事者を対象に10日間の監視体制を実施中。散発事例と報告されているが、髄膜炎菌感染症の呼吸器飛沫感染による急速進展の危険性から、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 5,058 tuberculosis cases reported in 2025; 4,957 under treatment in Visakhapatnam
article.articleSummary: Visakhapatnam district reported 5,058 tuberculosis cases in 2025, with 4,957 patients under treatment in 2026—4,809 drug-sensitive and 148 drug-resistant. King George Hospital accounted for 1,286 cases (611 public, 675 private); Visakhapatnam District TB Centre reported 1,524 cases (1,187 public, 337 private). Other areas: Aganampudi 539 (141 public, 398 private); Allipuram 187 (95 public, 92 private); Arilova 375 (136 public, 239 private); Bheemili 357 (307 public, 50 private); Gopalapatnam 278 (134 public, 144 private); Madhurawada 294 (194 public, 100 private); R.P. Peta 218 (129 public, 89 private). Public facilities: 2,934 cases; private: 2,124. World TB Day observed on March 24 with theme "Yes! We Can End TB: Led by Bharat, Powered by Janbhagidari." TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (discovered 1882 by Koch); symptoms include persistent cough >2 weeks, fever, night sweats, weight loss, fatigue. India accounts for >25% of global TB, ~2.8 million new infections and >300k deaths annually, with a target to end TB by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: 2025年にヴィサカパトナムで5,058件の結核症例が報告、4,957件が治療中
triage.triage_reason: 結核は周知の疾患であり、記事は定期的な統計報告に過ぎない。異常性・予想外性に欠け、新規発生や流行の兆候はない。IHR基準2つ以上の該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのヴィサカパトナム地区における2025年の結核症例報告。統計的な公開情報であり、新規流行や異常な増加パターンを示唆していない。World TB Dayの啓発記事として位置付けられている。

article.articleHeadline: China launches measles catch-up vaccinations amid global outbreak warnings
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks globally prompt China to launch catch-up vaccinations amid border-crossing risk. The National Health Commission warns measles could be imported from outbreak countries and local authorities are offering free catch-up doses. China's immunization program includes measles, mumps, and rubella vaccines: first dose at eight months, second at 18 months. Measles is an acute respiratory disease; up to 90% of unvaccinated exposed individuals may become infected. WHO estimates measles immunization saved about 59 million lives globally from 2000–2024. On March 18, Yu Wenzhou of the CDC noted six of ten countries with the highest 2025 measles cases border China, with domestic localized outbreaks. Free catch-up MMR runs in Guangzhou (under 18), Maoming (Mar–May), Hefei (Mar–May; 6–15 years with incomplete/unknown records), and Shanghai (8 months–17 years; plus adults in high-exposure roles).

triage.headline_ja: 中国、世界的アウトブレイク警告の中、麻疹の予防接種キャッチアップキャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹、おたふく風邪、風疹の複数疾患の同時発生。複数州・都市での局地的アウトブレイク、国際的な拡大リスク、および公衆衛生上の予防措置（大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーン）が実施されており、IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、予想外性）を満たす。
triage.notes: 複数疾患（麻疹、おたふく風邪、風疹）の同時発生、広州・上海・安徽省・茂名など複数地域での局地的アウトブレイク、国境を接する10カ国中6カ国で2025年に高い麻疹症例数という国際的リスク、および当局による大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーン（複数都市で無料提供、異なる年齢グループを対象）が報告されている。記事配信日が2026年3月25日であることに注意。

article.articleHeadline: Antibiotic resistance fuels 87% of India's typhoid economic burden: Study
article.articleSummary: Antibiotic-resistant typhoid infections accounted for 87% of India's typhoid-related economic burden in 2023, with total costs ₹12,300 crore. Children under 10 bore the largest share, contributing over half of costs; households paid 91% of expenses, and about 70,000 families faced catastrophic health expenditure. Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh (including Telangana), Tamil Nadu and West Bengal together accounted for 51% of national costs. Fluoroquinolone-resistant infections drove 87% of the burden. Typhoid fever, transmitted via contaminated food or water, presents with high fever, fatigue, headache and stomach pain. The study—by researchers from London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine and Christian Medical College, Vellore—used India-specific data on epidemiology, care-seeking and outcomes to yield a nationally representative estimate of direct and indirect costs for hospitalised and non-hospitalised patients. Authors advocate introducing typhoid conjugate vaccine into the national immunisation schedule and strengthening antibiotic resistance control and health financing policies.

triage.headline_ja: 抗生物質耐性がインドの腸チフス経済負担の87%を占める：研究
triage.triage_reason: 抗生物質耐性腸チフスによる経済的負担に関する研究報告であり、公衆衛生への影響は明確だが、新規の感染症発生イベント（アウトブレイク）ではなく、既存の疾病負担分析に基づいている。シグナルとしての緊急性は限定的。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規の感染症発生イベントではなく、2023年のインドにおける腸チフス経済負担に関する疫学研究報告である。抗生物質耐性は確認済みの既知課題であり、IHR基準の『異常/予想外』には該当しない。ただし、抗生物質耐性腸チフスの深刻な公衆衛生影響、長期的な曝露リスク、ワクチン導入と感染制御強化の必要性が指摘されており、政策的関心は高い。続報（実際の新規アウトブレイクやワクチン導入の進展）を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam's Ho Chi Minh City reports first three deaths linked to hand, foot and mouth disease in 2026
article.articleSummary: HFMD in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, three deaths in 2026 as infections surge. Week 11 (Mar 9–15) recorded 837 HFMD cases, up 97.1% from the four‑week average (424) and 241.3% year over year, with cumulative nearly 7,300 cases since January. About 117 of 168 wards reported increases; 37 localities saw sharp rises. The city logged 30 school-based clusters and 49 community clusters. Seventy-eight? No, 138 HFMD cases from outside localities in week 11 (20.6% of total). Eight severe cases, six referred from other provinces (75% of severe). The centre notes the city as a national treatment hub for infectious diseases, stressing tertiary hospitals. Response priorities include enhanced surveillance, early detection, containment of outbreaks, and intensified public communication, especially in nurseries and home childcare groups; pathogen surveillance with testing for clinical grade 2B+ cases. Since year start, 25 samples tested; six EV71 positives. EV71 re‑emergence linked to severe HFMD; five key protective measures recommended.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのホーチミン市が2026年の手足口病関連初の3人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重症度・異常性・国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性・重症度・長期曝露・流行性）。EV71再出現による重症HFMD急増、死亡事例、急速な症例増加により早期フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: EV71の再出現によるHFMD重症化が懸念される。週11（3月9-15日）で837症例、4週平均から97.1%増加、前年同期比241.3%増加。累積7,300症例以上、死亡3例、重症8例。25検体中6例がEV71陽性。学校・コミュニティクラスター多数発生。ホーチミン市が国の感染症治療の中核施設として報告。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、急速な流行拡大、重症例の増加が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Norovirus hits primary school in China's Shanxi
article.articleSummary: Norovirus confirmed at Yucai Primary School in Xiaodian district, Taiyuan, the capital of North China's Shanxi province, with authorities reporting over 100 students on leave and efforts underway to confirm the exact number of cases. On Wednesday morning, mass vomiting and diarrhea were reported; initial tests confirmed norovirus infection. Classes at the affected campus have been suspended, and teachers are delivering online instruction to ensure uninterrupted learning. Health authorities have launched disinfection protocols and epidemiological investigations, while the outbreak's cause remains under investigation. The response is led by the district education bureau and local health authorities, with ongoing inquiries as of 2026-03-25.

triage.headline_ja: 中国山西省の小学校でノロウイルス流行
triage.triage_reason: 限定的な学校内集団発生で、国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生への深刻な影響は現時点では明確でなく、IHR基準を満たさない。ただしノロウイルスの感染性と集団発生特性から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 学校内の限定的な集団発生（100名以上の学生が欠席）。症状は嘔吐・下痢で典型的。当局による迅速な対応（消毒・疫学調査・オンライン授業実施）が報告されており、制御可能と判断。致命例や重症者の報告なし。ただしノロウイルスの高い感染性と国内での他への拡大可能性を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: 響應世界結核病日　仁愛鄉全村篩檢守護原鄉健康 | yam News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Responding to World Tuberculosis Day, Ren'ai Township conducts village-wide TB screening to safeguard indigenous health.
article.articleSummary: On World Tuberculosis Day, March 24, 2026, Nantou County Health Bureau and Ren’ai Township Health Center conducted village-wide LTBI screening and chest X-rays in Ren’ai’s Faxiang, Cuihua and Lixing villages (March 18–19) to reach indigenous communities. Nantou TB incidence declined from 97.8 to 29.6 per 100,000 (2005–2025); Ren’ai fell from 534.6 to 58.6 per 100,000, an 89% reduction, supporting the 2035 TB-elimination goal. LTBI testing and treatment are prioritized for close contacts, with expansion planned to mountainous areas, long-term care facilities, prisons, new immigrants from high-risk TB countries (Indonesia, Vietnam, Cambodia), and high-risk or comorbid groups (HIV, dialysis, COPD, immunocompromised). Symptoms prompting care include cough >2 weeks, productive cough, chest tightness/pain, fever, night sweats, and weight loss. Annual chest X-rays for those 50+, and adherence to a three-step therapy (deliver meds, ingest, complete) are emphasized; local health offices provide further information.

triage.headline_ja: 世界結核病デーに対応、仁愛郷が全村スクリーニングを実施し先住民地域の健康を守る
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での結核LTBI検診プログラムの報告。公衆衛生意義はあるが、新規感染症発生ではなく既存対策の進展報告であり、国際的拡大やWHO通知基準の該当性は低い。ただしインドネシア・ベトナム・カンボジアからの新規移民が高リスク群として言及されており、地域内での感染制御状況の監視価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主体は台湾（対象国外）での結核検診キャンペーンだが、新規移民からの感染リスク評価に関連し、ベトナムとインドネシアが高リスク結核国として言及されている。この両国が検診対象に含まれているため該当地域として記録。本記事は疾患制御の成功事例報告であり、アウトブレイク検出ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 'In his memory': The family of Bloomsday Perennial Dennis McMullen will run in his honor after he died of typhoid fever in October
article.articleSummary: Dennis McMullen, 77, a longtime Bloomsday Perennial from Spokane since 1977, died Oct. 27 of typhoid fever (Salmonella infection) after a prolonged illness that began on a Greece-to-Venice cruise; he fell ill in Venice and was later treated in Philadelphia, with a 21/2-month hospitalization and a coma from which he woke in October. The McMullen family will run in his memory at Bloomsday this May to honor his decades-long streak. McMullen grew up in Seattle, earned a music degree at Stanford, and moved to Spokane in 1974, where he attended Gonzaga Law School and practiced law with his wife Cindy Duffy; she remains active in public service. He was known for wearing Bloomsday shirts year-round and for his dedication to the communal race, continuing participation into his late 60s and 70s.

triage.headline_ja: 「彼の思い出に」：ブルームズデイの常連デニス・マクマレン氏がチフス熱で10月に死亡、その遺志を継いで家族が走る
triage.triage_reason: 単一の死亡事例の追悼記事であり、流行や集団発生の証拠がない。疾患の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年3月配信の追悼記事であり、感染症の新規発生や流行を報じるものではなく、個人の死亡事例に関する新聞社会面記事である。Bluedot APIが複数の地域（米国、イタリア、フィリピン）を抽出しているが、サマリーはスポーケーン在住の個人が2025年10月に亡くなった状況のみを述べており、公衆衛生上の脅威シグナルは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Opinie: 'Neem voortrekkersrol in strijd tegen tuberculose'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Opinion: 'Take a leading role in the fight against tuberculosis'.
article.articleSummary: TB remains the world’s deadliest infectious disease, with about 1.2 million deaths annually, while new cases are falling yet progress is at risk as defense budgets rise. The Netherlands has been a leading TB partner via the KNCV Tuberculosis Fund in The Hague, driving safer, more effective treatments and improved detection. Key advances include shorter regimens for drug-resistant TB and a promising vaccine expected in coming years. Indonesia, home to the world’s largest TB burden, is shifting to community-based screening and decentralized care across thousands of local clinics, aided by public-private health partnerships. AI-assisted screening and cheaper, faster diagnostics aim to close the diagnostic gap; portable AI-enabled X-ray systems from Delft Imaging are now used in remote communities. New financing methods, such as blended finance and debt swaps, could unlock more domestic TB funding. The Netherlands should sustain investment, scale innovations, and support Indonesia’s leadership in TB control.

triage.headline_ja: 意見：『結核との戦いで主導的役割を担え』
triage.triage_reason: 結核は重大な感染症であるが、本記事は意見・論説記事であり、新規の具体的な感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、死亡者急増など）を報告していない。現状の対策進展を述べるもので、シグナルとしては判定困難。
triage.notes: オランダ（Delft、The Hague等）での記事配信であるが、同国は対象監視国リストに含まれていない。インドネシアは記事内で結核負担が最大である国として明示されており verified_locations に含める。本記事は opinion/commentary 記事であり、具体的なアウトブレイク情報ではなく、ポリシー提言・進捗報告。新規イベント性が低いため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ca tay chân miệng tăng mạnh, TP HCM ghi nhận 2 trẻ tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot and mouth disease cases surge; Ho Chi Minh City reports two child deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City reports a surge in hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) with 837 new cases in March 9–15, up 97% from the four-week average (424). Two more children died that week, raising the year-to-date death toll to 3. An additional 138 HFMD cases from outside the city were admitted to city hospitals, over 20% of the total, many severe. The city intensified surveillance, sampling HFMD cases at severity 2B or higher for etiological agents. During the week, 3 surveillance samples were collected, bringing the year's total to 25, with 6 testing positive for Enterovirus 71 (EV71). There were 30 school outbreaks and 49 community outbreaks. EV71 can spread rapidly and cause encephalitis, meningitis, and serious cardiopulmonary issues; vaccination against EV71 was approved for circulation on March 17 in Vietnam. Parents should monitor for severe signs and seek urgent care; prevention emphasizes hand hygiene and cleaning.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病が急増、ホーチミン市で2人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡例、97%の症例増加）と異常性が認められ、WPRO基準では重症度（死亡、重症例）、流行しやすさ（学校・コミュニティアウトブレイク多数）、管理可能性（ワクチン承認、サーベイランス強化）の複数項目該当。ホーチミン市での手足口病EV71感染拡大は国家的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はホーチミン市における手足口病（HFMD）の拡大を主題としており、EV71の確認例も含まれている。年初来3例の死亡、97%の週間症例増加、30の学校アウトブレイク、49のコミュニティアウトブレイク、EV71の神経合併症リスクなど、複数の懸念要因が存在。ベトナムは対象国に含まれため verified_locations に追加。EV71ワクチンが2026年3月17日にベトナムで承認されたことも国家的対応の重要性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 德爆高致病性H5N1　港暫停進口禽類產品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany reports outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1; Hong Kong suspends imports of poultry products.
article.articleSummary: Germany reports an outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 in the Elbe-Elster district of Brandenburg. In response, Hong Kong’s Food Safety Centre immediately instructed a suspension of imports from the affected area, including chilled poultry meat, poultry products, and eggs, to protect public health. The action follows a World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) notification, with authorities pledging to monitor the situation and adjust measures as the local outbreak evolves. Hong Kong notes it imported approximately 180 tonnes of chilled poultry meat from Germany last year. Officials have contacted German authorities and will continue to monitor updates from WOAH and related agencies regarding the outbreak, implementing further actions as needed.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツで高病原性H5N1鳥インフルエンザが発生、香港は家禽製品の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性H5N1の動物での発生は異常で予想外。国際的な食品貿易への影響があり、複数国が対応措置を講じており、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 本イベントはドイツにおける動物での高病原性H5N1発生であり、ドイツは対象国リストに含まれていない。ただしサマリーで香港（China の一部）が輸入停止措置を講じており、対象国 China に含める。WPROスクリーニング基準は複数該当し、国際的な食品安全上の懸念があるため PICKUP と判定。WOAH通知に基づく措置が実施されており、国際的関心も高い。
