article.articleHeadline: Įspėjimas lietuviams: jei vykote šiuo reisu, didelė itin užkrečiamos infekcijos rizika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning to Lithuanians: if you traveled on this flight, a high risk of an extremely contagious infection.
article.articleSummary: On 18 March 2026, a measles-infected passenger traveled on flight BT346 from Vilnius to Riga, prompting Lithuania’s National Public Health Center (NVSC) to warn exposed individuals. Latvia’s SPKC reported 24 laboratory-confirmed measles cases in Latvia as of 25 March 2026 (six adults and 18 children), all epidemiologically linked to a Riga event led by a Lithuanian advocate of non-traditional medicine. An infected child who attended the event was hospitalized and is thought to have spread the virus to a school and, during the flight via Turkey, to another passenger from Latvia. Latvia reports a high transmission risk, especially among unvaccinated people; about 14,000 children aged 1–17 (4%) are unvaccinated. In Lithuania, 2025 measles cases were lower than 2024, with many imported from travel to Germany, Greece, Albania, the UK, the US, Vietnam, and Malaysia. Measles is highly contagious; vaccination coverage of at least 95% is needed to prevent outbreaks; complications occur in about a third of cases.

triage.headline_ja: リトアニア人への警告：このフライトを利用した場合、極めて感染力の強い感染症のリスクが高い
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の国際的な拡大リスク（フライトを通じた複数国への曝露）、中等度から重度の症例（入院）、高い伝播可能性（予防接種率不足）がWPRO基準を満たす。IHR基準も異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限リスクで複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはリトアニア・ラトビアでの麻疹事例を中心に述べているが、これら国は対象国リストに含まれていない。ただし、サマリー内でベトナムが2025年の輸入症例の渡航源として明記されており、ベトナムは対象国（id:1562822）に該当するため verified_locations に含める。国際的なフライト（イスタンブール経由）を通じた複数国間の伝播が確認されており、高い伝播リスク下での流行である点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe: campanha de vacinação começa nesta quarta-feira (25) no DF | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu: vaccination campaign begins this Wednesday (25) in the Federal District | G1
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination campaign begins March 25, 2026, in the Federal District (Distrito Federal), Brazil. In the initial phase, priority groups are pregnant women; children aged 6 months to under 6 years; adults 60 years and older; people with disabilities or chronic diseases; and professionals in specific fields. The flu vaccine is available to all residents aged over six months. Individuals vaccinated in previous years should still receive the 2026 vaccine, as formulations are updated annually to protect against the main circulating influenza strains. Vaccination sites are listed locally, with channels provided for updates (including WhatsApp). The campaign aims to broaden coverage across the region and emphasizes ongoing public health measures to mitigate influenza impact; the article does not report case counts or an ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ：3月25日（水）にブラジル連邦直轄地区で予防接種キャンペーンが開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインフルエンザの予防接種キャンペーン開始を報じるもので、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常な疾患活動、または緊急の公衆衛生上の懸念を示していない。定期的な公衆衛生対応のための情報であり、IHRおよびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は通常の季節性インフルエンザ対策としての予防接種キャンペーン告知であり、アウトブレイク検知や異常感染症活動の報告ではない。患者数、重症度、異常な流行パターンのいずれも報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu Outbreak In Chhattisgarh's Bilaspur Leads To Culling Of Over 22,000 Poultry
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) outbreak in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, India, at a state poultry farm in Koni where 4,744 chickens died between March 19 and 24; the farm housed 5,037 birds. Laboratory tests confirmed highly contagious avian influenza; samples from the dead birds were sent to labs in Bhopal and Pune, with results by late Tuesday night confirming infection. Immediate culling and sanitation followed: 22,808 hatchlings and other birds buried, along with 80 quintals of feedstock and plastic utensils. A 1 km Infected Zone and a 10 km Surveillance Zone were declared, with strict movement bans on poultry, eggs, and related materials. Remaining poultry, eggs, and meat within the zones are culled or restricted in sale. Compensation will be provided; munadi alerts issued; health checks for residents and inspections of nearby farms ongoing; the farm will be sealed after culling.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガル州ビラスプルの鳥インフルエンザ大流行により22,000羽以上の家禽が殺処分される
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザの確認事例であり、IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・公衆衛生への影響が認められ、2基準以上該当。WPRO基準でも重症度（大規模殺処分）・長期曝露リスク・流行可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザ(H5N1型の可能性)の確認。4,744羽の死亡、22,808羽の殺処分実施。感染域1km、監視域10km設定。人間および動物の両者に影響。ヒト感染リスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: China's Shanxi sees norovirus outbreak at primary school
article.articleSummary: On March 25, 2026, Yucai Primary School in Xiaodian District, Taiyuan, Shanxi Province, China, reported mass vomiting and diarrhea among students; initial tests confirmed norovirus infection. Over 100 students have taken leave; classes at the affected campus were suspended, with teachers providing online instruction to maintain learning. Health authorities have launched disinfection protocols and epidemiological investigations, and the outbreak's cause remains under investigation. Norovirus is the world’s leading cause of acute gastroenteritis, with symptoms of acute diarrhea and vomiting; most patients recover in 1–3 days but can spread the virus for several days. Globally, the WHO estimates about 685 million cases annually, including 200 million in children under 5, with around 200,000 deaths per year (about 50,000 child deaths) and costs of roughly $60 billion.

triage.headline_ja: 中国山西省で小学校のノロウイルス集団発生
triage.triage_reason: ノロウイルスは既知の病原体で、学校での限定的な集団発生である。重症度・死亡報告がなく、国際的拡大リスクも明確でないが、100名以上の学生が影響を受けており、疫学的調査が進行中のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 学校での限定的な集団発生。ノロウイルスは既知の病原体で、通常は自己限定的である。重症度や死亡の報告なし。中国当局が対応中（消毒プロトコルと疫学調査を実施）。国際的な懸念は低いが、感染力が強く集団環境での拡大可能性があるため注視を継続。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat Achieves Milestones in Fight Against Tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: Gujarat under the national TB elimination programme achieved about 94% of its detection and treatment targets. The state identified and registered 131,801 TB patients against a target of 140,000; 125,301 started treatment and 121,912 completed it, indicating strong treatment coverage. Nikshay Poshan Yojana disbursed ₹49.10 crore in 2025 to 92,921 beneficiaries to support nutrition during treatment. Nikshay Mitras engaged 31,058 volunteers to assist with nutrition support and patient follow-up. A 100-day TB elimination campaign screened over 75 lakh individuals and identified more than 1.63 lakh TB cases, bringing them under treatment. Gujarat emphasizes early detection, prompt treatment initiation, patient support, and community participation to advance TB elimination.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州、結核との闘いで大きな成果を達成
triage.triage_reason: 記事は結核対策における肯定的な進捗を報告しており、新たな感染症の危機やアウトブレイクを示すシグナルではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当せず、社会的関心も公開衛生上の懸念もない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核対策プログラムの成功事例であり、検出率94%、治療完了率などの肯定的指標を報告している。これは感染症の新たなアウトブレイク、異常な拡大、または管理困難な事態を示すシグナルではなく、むしろ既存プログラムの進捗レポートである。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Rekomendasikan Alat Tes Diagnostik Baru untuk Percepat Eliminasi TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Recommends New Diagnostic Testing Tools to Accelerate TB Elimination.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization, on World TB Day 2026, urges accelerated action to end tuberculosis by expanding access to rapid, near-patient diagnostics. The new guidelines endorse point-of-care tests, including tongue-swab assays, and improved sputum-collection strategies, with portable, battery-operated devices delivering results in under an hour at roughly half the cost of most molecular tests. The approach aims to broaden testing, especially for patients who struggle to produce sputum, and uses sample pooling to cut costs and speed diagnoses in resource-limited settings. TB remains a major threat, with more than 3,300 deaths and about 29,000 new infections daily; since 2000, global efforts have saved around 83 million lives, but funding gaps threaten progress. WHO calls for country-led action, strengthened community services, sustained R&D in drugs and vaccines, and to extend these innovations to HIV, mpox, and HPV testing where feasible.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、結核排除を加速するための新しい診断検査ツールを推奨
triage.triage_reason: 結核に関する診断ツール推奨のニュースであり、公衆衛生への肯定的な取り組みである。IHR基準やWPRO基準には該当せず、緊急のシグナルではないが、インドネシアでの実装動向に関する続報を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOが発表した診断ツール推奨に関するニュースであり、新規の疾患発生や異常なイベントではない。インドネシアが具体的な発生地として記載されているが、記事サマリーではWHOの世界的な推奨内容が主体であり、インドネシアでの流行状況の悪化を示す情報は含まれていない。Mpox、HIV、結核の3疾患が関連付けられているが、診断ツール開発の話題に限定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Antibiotic resistance fuels 87% of India's typhoid economic burden: Study - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: Typhoid fever in India imposes a 2023 economic burden of ₹123 billion, with antibiotic-resistant (fluoroquinolone-resistant) infections comprising at least 87% of disease-related costs. A Lancet Regional Health Southeast Asia study using Indian epidemiological data found children under 10 bear the heaviest financial impact, contributing more than half of total costs, while households cover 91% of expenses and about 70,000 families face catastrophic health expenditure. Five states—Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh (including Telangana), Tamil Nadu, and West Bengal—account for about 51% of national costs. Transmission occurs via contaminated food or water; symptoms include high fever, fatigue, headache, and stomach pain. The study supports introducing the typhoid conjugate vaccine into India's national immunisation schedule and informs antibiotic resistance control and health-financing policy, based on data from hospitalized and non-hospitalized patients.

triage.headline_ja: 抗生物質耐性がインドのチフス経済負担の87%を占める：研究
triage.triage_reason: インドにおけるチフスの抗生物質耐性の経済的負担に関する研究報告。複数州での負担が明らかで重要だが、新規の急性発生イベントではなく、既知の流行の経済評価・負担研究であり、直近の公衆衛生緊急事態としての証拠が限定的。IHR基準該当は限定的だが、多州への影響と公開情報として注視の価値あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは既知の流行に対する経済負担研究であり、新規の急性発生を報告するものではない。チフスは風土病として存在し、抗生物質耐性による深刻な経済的影響が定量化されている。WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で複数該当するが、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。政策立案への関心は高い可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: ETTEVAATUST ⟩ Paljudes riikides on täheldatud sääskedega leviva ohtliku viiruse ägenemist
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WARNING: A resurgence of a dangerous mosquito-borne virus has been observed in many countries.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, the U.S. CDC has issued a Level 1 travel advisory—the lowest level—due to a resurgence of dengue fever, a mosquito-borne illness, across multiple regions. Case numbers have risen unusually quickly, with 16 countries identified as higher risk, including Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Colombia, Cuba, Maldives, Pakistan, Vietnam, and other tropical or subtropical areas; the article does not provide exact counts. Travelers are urged to exercise caution, especially ahead of spring and summer holidays. The advisory emphasizes preventive measures to avoid mosquito bites and to seek medical advice if illness develops after travel. No details on imported or exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：多くの国で蚊媒介の危険なウイルスの再興が観察されている
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の多国間における再興が報告されているが、IHR基準の該当数が明確でなく、重症度や死亡情報が欠落している。対象国（ベトナム、バングラデシュ）を含む複数国での動向は注視する価値があるが、情報不足のためWATCH段階とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに8カ国が含まれるが、対象国リスト内で検証されたのはベトナムとバングラデシュのみ。記事では『16カ国がより高いリスクとして特定された』とあるが、正確な患者数や死亡者数の記載がなく、重症度の評価が困難。CDCのLevel 1旅行勧告（最低レベル）であり、貿易制限リスクは現時点で低い。対象国での更新情報の継続監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Hô Chi Minh-Ville vise l'objectif d'éliminer la tuberculose d'ici 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City aims to eliminate tuberculosis by 2030.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City aims to eliminate tuberculosis by 2030 by introducing active, targeted screening from 2026–2030, focusing on high-risk groups (people living with HIV, diabetics, the elderly) and densely populated areas to boost community case detection. In 2025, the city accounted for the largest TB burden in Vietnam, with more than 16,000 cases detected and treated, representing about 23% of the Southern region and 14% nationwide. It pioneered mobile radiography to identify pulmonary lesions without patient travel, and widely uses GeneXpert to detect Mycobacterium tuberculosis and drug resistance; AI is now used to interpret radiographs, improving initial screening. The five-year program 2020–2025 screened over 731,000 people and performed more than 713,000 chest X-rays, expanding to non-communicable disease screening as well. Public-private coordination strengthened; future plans include Con Dao district, Pluslife, AI-assisted stethoscope, and post-TB sequelae screening. US Consulate applauds progress and commitment.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市は2030年までに結核を排除することを目指している
triage.triage_reason: 結核とHIV共感染対策の戦略的な施策報告であり、異常な流行イベントではなく、計画的な公衆衛生キャンペーンである。スクリーニング基準では重症度と流行しやすさが該当する可能性があるが、IHR基準には該当しない。情報不足のため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 本件は既知の結核流行（2025年にホーチミン市で16,000件以上の症例）に対する段階的な対応計画の発表である。新規の異常事象ではなく、計画的な公衆衛生戦略の進展報告のため、シグナルとして扱うレベルではない。ただし結核・HIV共感染対策の進行状況は継続監視の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Hơn 31.000 người bị chó, mèo cắn, Lâm Đồng siết chặt phòng chống bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 31,000 people bitten by dogs and cats; Lam Dong Province tightens rabies prevention measures.
article.articleSummary: Lam Dong Province, formerly Bình Thuận region, faces rising rabies risk. From March 1, 2025–February 28, 2026, 31,570 people bitten by dogs or cats required vaccination; 9.8% did not complete the series. Five rabies deaths occurred in 2025, with one more in 2026 as of March 25. Key drivers are post-bite complacency, roaming dogs and cats, and insufficient vaccination coverage among pets. The Health Department directs 100% of bite cases to be recorded, with exposure data shared with veterinary authorities within 24 hours, and deaths investigated within 48 hours. They urge expanded vaccination points, mobile clinics in high-risk areas, aiming for >70% vaccination across all dogs and cats and ≥80% coverage. Pet owners should sign commitments to vaccinate, prevent roaming, and muzzle animals in public; enforce roaming-dog controls at least twice weekly. A Lao Cai case reports a man dying of suspected rabies after four months post-bite without vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 3万1000人以上が犬・猫に咬傷; ラムドン省が狂犬病対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで狂犬病による複数死亡例が報告され、1年間に31,570人の咬傷被害が発生している。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な事象、およびヒト-ヒト感染ではないが管理可能性の問題から、フルRRA対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は100%致命的であり、5人の2025年死亡例と2026年の追加死亡例が報告されている。9.8%がワクチンシリーズ完了不成功であり、管理可能性の課題が明確。ラムドン省（Lam Dong）とラオカイ省（Lao Cai）の両地域で確認されているが、記事サマリーの主題はベトナム全国のレベルでの対応。

article.articleHeadline: India's Dairy Surge: Aiming for FMD-Free Status | Headlines
article.articleSummary: India's milk production surged ~70% over 11 years, from 146.3 million tonnes in 2014-15 to an expected 248 million tonnes in 2024-25, making it the world's leading milk producer. Union Minister Rajiv Ranjan Singh told the Rajya Sabha that the country aims to achieve Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD)‑free status within three years, alongside efforts against Brucellosis. Productivity per animal rose from 1,648 kg/year to 2,251 kg. FMD and Brucellosis outbreaks have been addressed through extensive vaccination programs, reducing occurrence. The government pursues FMD certification from the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) to boost international trade, as FMD remains a barrier to exporting dairy products to developed countries.

triage.headline_ja: インドの酪農産業の急成長：口蹄疫清浄国の地位を目指す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドの酪農産業の成長と疾病管理の成果を報じるもので、急性の感染症危機を示さない。既にワクチンプログラムにより口蹄疫とブルセラ症の発生が抑制されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響や異常・予想外の事象は見当たらない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベントの発生報告ではなく、インドの酪農産業の成長と既存の疾病制御プログラムの進展に関するポジティブなニュース。記事は病気の発生抑制と国際的な認証取得への政府の取り組みについて述べており、現在の危機的状況を示唆するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Быстрее и хитрее обычных: африканские клещи-мутанты начали настоящую охоту на людей в России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Faster and craftier than usual: African mutant ticks have begun a real hunt for people in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Hyalomma ticks expanding from Africa and Asia into Russian regions due to climate change and migratory birds. These larger, yellow-banded arthropods actively hunt prey, with keen vision and respiration-detection, moving toward targets up to two meters per minute. Hyalomma is described as the main reservoir/vector for Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever virus; Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever is a severe disease with high fever and massive internal bleeding, with mortality around 40%. The ticks also carry rickettsioses (spotted fever group). They prefer open landscapes such as steppes and pastures, waiting on soil or low vegetation. Prevention emphasizes wearing closed clothing and performing self-examinations during outdoor activity. Ongoing expansion into Russian territories as of 2026-03-25 raises outbreak risk and underscores the need for surveillance and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: いつもより速くて狡猾：アフリカの突然変異ティック（ダニ）がロシアで人間への本格的な狩りを開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において国際的拡大リスク（気候変動による北上）と深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡率40%のCCHF）が認められ、2つ以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性の複数基準に該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはAustralia、Russian Federationが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はアフリカからの病原体媒介ダニの拡大とロシアへの侵入リスクを述べており、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際の発生地として記述されている。CCHF自体は既知の疾患だが、アフリカからロシアへのHyalommaダニの北上拡大は気候変動に関連した新規のベクター脅威として異常性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Antibiotic Resistance Is Responsible For 87% Of India's Typhoid Economic Burden: Lancet Study
article.articleSummary: Antibiotic-resistant typhoid drove at least 87% of India's typhoid-related economic burden in 2023, according to The Lancet Regional Health Southeast Asia. The total economic burden was Rs 123 billion, with children under 10 bearing more than half the costs. Households paid 91% of expenses, and about 70,000 families faced catastrophic health expenditure. Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh (including Telangana), Tamil Nadu, and West Bengal together accounted for roughly 51% of national costs. Typhoid, transmitted via contaminated food or water, presents with high fever, fatigue, headache, and stomach pain. The study supports introducing the typhoid conjugate vaccine into India’s national immunisation schedule and calls for stronger antibiotic-resistance control and informed health financing. Fluoroquinolone-resistant infections represented 87% of total costs; fluoroquinolones are used to treat severe infections and can reduce fever within four days. Data derive from India-specific epidemiology, care-seeking, and outcomes for hospitalized and non-hospitalized cases.

triage.headline_ja: 抗生物質耐性がインドのチフス経済的負担の87%を占める：ランセット研究
triage.triage_reason: チフスの抗生物質耐性株がインドで経済的負担の大部分を占めるという疫学研究の報告。公衆衛生への影響と対策の必要性は認識されるが、新規の流行や急速な感染拡大を示す直接的証拠に乏しく、主として経済分析と予防接種政策提言の記事である。
triage.notes: この記事は2023年のチフス経済負担に関する事後分析・政策研究であり、新規の流行検出や急速な感染拡大の報告ではない。抗生物質耐性の深刻さは認識されるが、IHR通知基準の国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクは明記されていない。ただしインド国内での重症度、罹患の持続性、公衆衛生システムへの負荷があるため、スクリーニング基準では複数該当し、政策的関心も高い。続報（新規感染の急増、耐性株のさらなる拡大など）を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Археологи нашли древние следы сифилиса во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Archaeologists found ancient traces of syphilis in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Archaeologists in northern Vietnam’s Man Bac site analyzed 309 skeletal remains dating to 4000–3200 years ago and found diagnostic signs of congenital treponematosis in three infants, suggesting treponematoses affected mainly children and adolescents. The findings, linked to inherited treponematoses rather than venereal syphilis alone, align with frambesia/yaws transmitted by skin contact, though intrauterine transmission was documented. Lead author Melandri Vlok notes that prior views tied congenital infection strictly to maternal transmission of venereal syphilis; this evidence shows that other treponematoses can cross the placenta. There is currently no genetic evidence of venereal syphilis existing before the Columbian era in either the Old or New World; ancient treponemes from the Americas belong to a common ancestor of all subtypes, not the modern pathogen. The Vietnamese find adds nuance to the debate on syphilis origins, highlighting a more complex evolutionary history of treponematoses.

triage.headline_ja: 考古学者がベトナムで梅毒の古代の痕跡を発見
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は4000～3200年前の遺骨から検出された古代トレポネーマ感染の考古学的分析であり、現在の活動的な感染症イベントではない。公衆衛生上の直接的な影響や国際的な拡大リスクはない。
triage.notes: これは現在の感染症イベントではなく、過去4000年以上前の古代遺骨に関する考古学的発見である。梅毒とヤフス（フランボジア）の進化史に関する学術的な知見を提供するが、現在の公衆衛生上の脅威や流行性疾患の警告信号ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Drought May Fuel Rise of Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria
article.articleSummary: March 23, 2026 Nature Microbiology study links drought to rising antibiotic resistance in soil microbes; droughts concentrate antibiotics in soil via water evaporation, causing susceptible bacteria to die while resistant strains thrive. Researchers found resistance genes in soil bacteria that match genes in resistant pathogens from hospital patients, suggesting environmental-to-human transfer via genetic exchange. The analysis across croplands, grasslands, forests and wetlands in the U.S., China, and Switzerland showed higher drought regions reported more antibiotic-resistant pathogens in hospitals, even after accounting for socioeconomic factors. Lead researcher Dianne Newman (Caltech) notes the rapid global spread of pathogens and the concern across locations. Laboratory experiments corroborate the mechanism, and climate change could expand dry areas, accelerating resistance spread. Implications call for faster diagnosis, combination therapies, and renewed investment in new drugs; WHO cites ~1.27 million deaths in 2019.

triage.headline_ja: 干ばつが抗生物質耐性菌の増加を助長する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 抗生物質耐性という重要な公衆衛生課題を取り扱う学術研究報告だが、記事は土壌微生物の環境メカニズムに焦点を当てた因果関係分析であり、現在進行中の具体的な感染症アウトブレイク・ピークイベントではない。気候変動と耐性菌拡大の関連を示唆する研究報告として注視が必要だが、シグナル化の判断には更なる疫学的実績データが必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが抽出した発生地域（United States、Switzerland、China）のうち、対象国リストに含まれるのはChinaのみ。記事は学術研究報告であり、個別の具体的アウトブレイク報告ではない点が重要。抗生物質耐性の公衆衛生への深刻な影響（IHR基準1該当）と長期曝露・流行性（WPRO基準2つ該当）は認められるが、現在の疫学的インパクトについては情報不足。気候変動との相関を示唆する報告として政策立案者の関心が高まる可能性があるため、経過観察推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ученые раскопали древнейший образец смертельной болезни
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists Have Unearthed the Oldest Specimen of a Deadly Disease
article.articleSummary: Three cases of congenital treponematosis (congenital syphilis) were identified in children from prehistoric Vietnam, prompting a rethink of how this disease spread in Neolithic times. A study analyzing 309 skeletons from 16 Vietnamese sites dating roughly 10,000–1,000 years ago found signs at two Neolithic locales: Man Bac in the north (4,000–3,500 years ago) with two cases, and An Son in the south (3,800–3,200 years ago) with one case. The standout case is a 1.5-year-old from Man Bac showing moon-shaped molars on deciduous and permanent teeth, multiple bone lesions, frontal bone thickening, and thickened long bones. The concentration of cases in children suggests non-venereal treponematosis in this tropical setting, potentially transmitted in utero or in early infancy. The disease appears spatial-temporally confined to two sites and vanishes by the Metal Age, implying spread linked to high population density and early agricultural migrations.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者が致命的な病気の最古の標本を発掘
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは史前時代（新石器時代）のベトナムにおける先天梅毒の考古学的発見であり、現在の感染症の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。現代の感染症発生ではなく、歴史的/学術的な報告である。
triage.notes: 本記事は考古学的発見（10,000～1,000年前の遺跡における先天梅毒の骨学的証拠）に関するもので、現在進行する感染症の公衆衛生危機ではない。EBS監視の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Tay chân miệng vượt ngưỡng cảnh báo, TPHCM tăng cường phòng dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease Exceeds the Alert Threshold; Ho Chi Minh City Steps Up Disease Prevention.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease exceeds Ho Chi Minh City’s alert threshold with Enterovirus 71 detected. In week 11 (Mar 9–15, 2026), 837 cases were reported, up 97.1% from the prior four weeks; year-to-date total 7,294, up 241.3% versus 2025. Severe cases reached 98 (1.3%), up 4.6-fold. The city logged 30 school outbreaks and 49 community outbreaks; since January, 286 outbreaks have occurred. Lab surveillance found Enterovirus 71 in 6 of 24 samples (25%), a virulent lineage linked to rapid spread and higher risk of complications and death, especially in children under 5. Two deaths occurred this week; total 3 deaths in 2026 to date. Authorities have mobilized intensified surveillance, outbreak control, and improved school hygiene and staff training. Hospitals will admit 2b+ cases per MOH guidelines and report via the Community Health Management Platform. Parents and schools should monitor fever, mouth ulcers, and vesicular rash on hands, feet, knees, buttocks, or elbows, seeking care promptly for signs of illness.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病が警戒閾値を超える、ホーチミン市が感染症対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常/予想外な急増、公衆衛生への深刻な影響）。WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度（死亡・重症例の増加）、流行しやすさ（ウイルス71の検出と高い伝播性）が明確。政府対応と国際的懸念事項である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはホーチミン市での手足口病（HFMD）急増を明確に記述。週別で837例（前4週比97.1%増）、年初来7,294例（前年同期比241.3%増）。Enterovirus 71検出率25%（6/24サンプル）で、重症度上昇（重症例4.6倍増）と死亡（今週2例、年初来3例）が報告。学校・地域での大規模集団発生（286件）。政府による積極的な対応（強化監視、院内隔離基準の適用、学校衛生改善）が実施中。国際的には東南アジアでのEV71流行リスク監視対象となる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: EXCLUSIVE: Co-Diagnostics Ships Diagnostic Tests To India Ahead Of TB Study Launch - Co-Diagnostics (NASDAQ:CODX)
article.articleSummary: TB diagnostic materials are being shipped to India ahead of clinical performance studies of Co-Diagnostics' Co-Dx PCR MTB TB test on its PCR platform. Co-Diagnostics has signed an agreement with CoSara Diagnostics Pvt. Ltd to expand its South Asia territory to Bangladesh, Pakistan, Nepal, and Sri Lanka. The company's PCR testing platform and NPOC TB test kit align with WHO guidance, enabling either sputum or tongue-swab samples in point-of-care and near-point-of-care settings. Third-party preclinical results continue to support further clinical evaluation. In India, regulatory progress for the PCR Pro Instrument underpins the planned TB studies. Separately, in October, Co-Diagnostics formed CoMira Diagnostics with Arabian Eagle to manufacture, assemble, and distribute Co-Dx technologies in Saudi Arabia as part of Saudi Vision 2030. CODX shares rose 7.93% to $2.45 in premarket trading.

triage.headline_ja: 独占：Co-Diagnosticsがインドへの結核診断検査出荷、TB研究開始を前に
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核診断キットの商業的な出荷・臨床研究計画に関するプレスリリース性の報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクやシグナル検出ではない。IHR基準・スクリーニング基準いずれも該当せず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は診断企業Co-Diagnosticsが結核診断キットをインドで臨床研究するために出荷する計画を報じた商業ニュースである。既存のアウトブレイク状況を報道したものではなく、感染症危機管理上のシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Three children die as hand, foot and mouth disease surges in HCM City
article.articleSummary: HFMD surge in Ho Chi Minh City: as of week 11, 7,294 cases (up 241.3% YoY); 98 progressed to severe (level 2b+), 4.6-fold rise. Week 11 alone recorded 837 new cases, up 97.1% from the four-week average. Since year start, 3 deaths and 288 outbreak clusters (162 in schools, 126 in the community). Pathogen surveillance detected Enterovirus 71 in 25% of samples (6/24), EV71 linked with high virulence and risk of neurological and respiratory complications in children under five. In response, the City Department of Health issued an urgent directive: HCDC to coordinate prevention at the grassroots level, with focus on kindergartens, childcare groups and social protection centres; mobilize community health collaborators; Education Department to ensure schools have handwashing facilities and to strengthen public communication about EV71. Hospitals must follow MOH guidelines; all level 2b+ cases require mandatory testing and reporting via the national health management platform. Three-clean principle urged; early care for fever or blisters.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病がホーチミン市で急増、3人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急増、国際的拡大リスク）。EV71による重症化・死亡事例、241%のYoY急増、神経・呼吸系合併症リスクがあり、緊急対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: EV71は神経性合併症（特に5歳以下の小児における髄膜炎、脳炎、四肢麻痺）の高リスク病原体。241%のYoY増加、死亡3名、重症例（level 2b+）98名の発生は異常。ベトナム保健当局は緊急指令を発令し、学校・保育施設での感染対策強化、全レベル2b+症例の強制検査・報告を実施。地域レベルでの持続的曝露リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza aviaria in Lombardia, ecco quanto è pericoloso il virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza in Lombardy: here's how dangerous the virus is.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, Italy's Lombardy reports the first human case of A(H9N2) avian influenza detected in Europe. The patient, frail with comorbidities, returned from a non-European country where infection occurred and is hospitalized in Milan under close observation. Although the virus is classified as low pathogenicity, its emergence in Europe heightens concern: a Hong Kong University group found H9N2 has acquired genetic changes since 2015 that increase human cell infection and binding to human receptors, indicating greater human adaptability. Since 1998, H9N2 caused 173 human infections, mainly in China, and many infections may go undetected because they are milder and testing often targets H5N1. Interhuman transmission remains unproven; further viral changes would be needed for sustained spread. Experts urge stronger surveillance, including monitoring mammals in contact with birds and transparent reporting of low-pathogenicity strains.

triage.headline_ja: ロンバルディア州の鳥インフルエンザ：ウイルスの危険性は？
triage.triage_reason: 欧州初のH9N2人感染例の報告で異常かつ予想外。重症度は低いが国際的拡大リスク懸念あり。IHR基準3項目、WPRO基準3項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイタリア（ロンバルディア）での欧州初H9N2人感染例を主題としているが、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。一方、H9N2の歴史的な流行（1998年以降173例、主に中国）と香港大学グループの遺伝子解析に関する記述があるため、China(香港含む)を記載。low pathogenicity avian influenza (LPAI) の人感染であるため直接的な重症度は低いが、遺伝子変化による人への適応増加の可能性が懸念される。人人感染は未確認だが流行可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: चीन के शांक्सी में प्राइमरी स्कूल में नोरोवायरस का प्रकोप, कई बच्चे संक्रमित | Norovirus hits primary school in China's Shanxi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Norovirus outbreak at a primary school in Shanxi, China; several children infected.
article.articleSummary: Norovirus outbreak at Yukai Primary School in Xiaodian District, Taiyuan, Shanxi Province, China, with numerous students experiencing vomiting and diarrhea; initial tests confirm norovirus infection. More than 100 students have taken leave, classes suspended, and online instruction provided to maintain learning. Health authorities have begun disinfection protocols and an epidemiological investigation, while the exact cause remains under review. Norovirus is the leading global cause of acute gastroenteritis, presenting with vomiting and diarrhea. Worldwide figures cited: about 685 million cases annually, around 200 million in children under five, and about 200,000 deaths, including roughly 50,000 child deaths, with an estimated $60 billion in healthcare and economic losses. Most patients recover in 1–3 days but can continue to shed the virus.

triage.headline_ja: 中国山西省の小学校でノロウイルス流行、多数の児童が感染
triage.triage_reason: 限定的な規模の学校内集団発生であり、IHR基準の2つ以上該当は確認されない。ただしスクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度）1つ以上該当し、国内対応継続中のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 山西省太原市小東地区の学園内集団発生。100名以上が休学、当局による消毒・疫学調査実施中。ノロウイルスは一般的で世界的流行性が高いが、本イベントは学校限定的で国際的拡大の即時リスクは低い。現段階では継続的な情報収集を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Así ha vuelto a entrenar el Castellón B tras la polémica suspensión de su partido en Torrent tras el virus gripal contagioso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Castellón B has returned to training after the controversial suspension of its match in Torrent due to the contagious influenza virus.
article.articleSummary: CD Castellón B resumed training at Gaetà Huguet’s Field B with 23 players, including two youths (Alejandro Anes, Julián Rodríguez) after recovering from contagious influenza that forced the suspension of Torrent CF–CD Castellón B on 22 March 2026 at 12:00 at San Gregorio, postponed to 1:02 a.m. the same Sunday. Absences: Ismael Fadel and Isi Angulo (Angulo may train with the first team); two additional youths, Óscar Albiol and Fran Santamaría, were missing. The RFEF is expected to set a new date today or Thursday, aiming for midweek action next week or within two weeks. In Group 3 of Segunda Federación, Castellón B sit three points from the play-out and five from direct relegation. They face bottom-placed UE Porreres this Sunday at 11:30 at Gaetà Huguet to reinforce their survival bid.

triage.headline_ja: カスタリョンB、伝染性インフルエンザウイルスによる試合中止の波紋の後、トレーニングを再開
triage.triage_reason: 記事は地元のサッカーチーム内でのインフルエンザ集団発生に関する短期的な運動選手の欠場報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、または渡航・貿易制限の懸念がない。
triage.notes: イベントはフィリピンとスペイン両国のGeoNames IDが含まれているが、記事の主題はスペインのカスタリョン地域のサッカーチーム内での限定的なインフルエンザ事例であり、対象国リストに該当する国での公衆衛生上の懸念はない。フィリピンのID(1694008)がAPI出力に含まれている理由は不明瞭（恐らく誤検出）。

article.articleHeadline: चीन के शांक्सी में प्राइमरी स्कूल में नोरोवायरस का प्रकोप, कई बच्चे संक्रमित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Norovirus outbreak in a primary school in Shanxi, China; several children infected.
article.articleSummary: Norovirus outbreak at Yukai Primary School in Xiaodian District, Taiyuan, Shanxi Province, China, began Wednesday morning with widespread vomiting and diarrhea. Initial tests confirmed norovirus infection among students. Officials report over 100 students have taken leave; classrooms are suspended and teachers are delivering online lessons to maintain learning. Health authorities have initiated disinfection protocols and epidemiological investigations; the exact source of the outbreak is under investigation. Norovirus is the leading global cause of acute gastroenteritis, with symptoms of sudden vomiting and diarrhea and dehydration risk, particularly in children. Most infections resolve in 1–3 days, but the virus may be shed after recovery. No deaths are reported in this briefing, and authorities continue monitoring and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 中国陝西省の小学校でノロウイルス集団感染、多数の児童が感染
triage.triage_reason: ノロウイルスの学校集団感染で100人以上の患者が報告されており、異常性・重症度スクリーニング基準に該当する可能性があるが、死亡報告がなく情報が限定的なため、続報を注視する段階と判定。
triage.notes: 学校という限定的な環境での集団感染であり、致命的ではないが、100人以上の患者発生は注視に値する。ノロウイルスは環境抵抗性が高く、学校施設での継続感染のリスクがある。当該施設内での管理状況と域外拡大の有無について続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bilaspur Bird Flu News : न्यायधानी में बर्ड फ्लू की खौफनाक दस्तक, शहर में इस हालत में फेंक दिए गए दर्जनों मरे मुर्गे, इलाके में फैला संक्रमण का डर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bilaspur Bird Flu News: The terrifying onset of bird flu in the City of Justice, dozens of dead chickens were dumped in the city in such a state, the fear of the infection spreading in the area.
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (H5N1) outbreak confirmed in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, with infection in Ramakrishna Paramhans Nagar and Vidyasagar Nagar wards. Dozens of dead chickens were dumped in an open field near Dream City Colony, Khamtarai, triggering fears of spread due to decay and odor. District authorities declared an infected zone of 1 kilometer and a surveillance zone of 10 kilometers, imposing a total ban on poultry activities, including sale, transport, and storage of poultry products (chickens and eggs) within both zones; poultry shops are closed and door-to-door deliveries halted. Checkposts were established to monitor poultry movements inside and outside the zones. Health and veterinary departments were activated; workers at poultry farms will undergo health checks. A district control room has been set up to coordinate the emergency response, with District Collector Sanjay Agrawal issuing detailed directives.

triage.headline_ja: ビラスプルの鳥インフルエンザ情報：司法都市での鳥インフルエンザの恐ろしい兆候、市内に放置された数十羽の死んだ鶏、地域での感染拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの人獣共通感染症として、IHR基準の異常性・国際拡大リスクが該当し、WPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさが認められる。確認された感染に対する迅速な公衆衛生対応が開始されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: H5N1は既知の高致死率病原体。ビラスプルおよびヒマーチャル・プラデーシュで複数地域での発生が報告。当局は感染地域の設定、家禽活動の全面禁止、保健・獣医部局の活性化など迅速な対応措置を実施。人畜感染の可能性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクいずれも存在。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus Oropouche: número real de infecções pode ser 200 vezes maior (e 5,5 milhões de brasileiros já terem sido contaminados), revela estudo da USP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oropouche virus: the real number of infections could be 200 times higher (and 5.5 million Brazilians may already have been infected), according to a USP study.
article.articleSummary: Oropouche fever, caused by OROV, is likely undercounted in Brazil and the Americas. A USP-led study estimates 5.5 million Brazilians infected between 1960 and 2025, vs. official counts of about 26,700 in 2023–2025 (834 in 2023, 13,856 in 2024, 11,988 in 2025). Across Latin America and the Caribbean, 9.4 million infections are projected. In Manaus, infections reach 200 times the confirmed cases, with seroprevalence rising from 11.4% to 25.7% between late 2023 and mid-2024. The virus circulated historically in rural/forest-adjacent areas, with two Manaus outbreaks in 1980–1981 and 2023–2024, and urban spread linked to high density and air travel. A 2024 lineage OROV BR-2015-2024 may escape antibodies and replicate faster. First Oropouche deaths were reported in July 2024. Symptoms resemble dengue/chikungunya: fever, headache, myalgia, arthralgia, 2–7 days; incubation 4–8 days; no vaccine or specific treatment; testing expanded in 2023; imported/exported cases noted to Europe, North America and the Caribbean.

triage.headline_ja: オロポーシェウイルス：感染者の実数は200倍高い可能性（ブラジル人550万人が感染していたか、USP研究発表）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、新興感染症の大幅な過小計測、国際拡大リスク、死亡報告を示す。スクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当し、公衆衛生上の重大な関心事。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジル（特にマナウス）でのオロポーシェ熱の過小計測を主題としている。公式統計の200倍の感染が推定され、ラテンアメリカ・カリブ海地域への拡大、ヨーロッパ・北米への輸入症例、初の死亡報告（2024年7月）が報告されている。ワクチンや特異的治療がなく、新規ウイルス株による免疫回避の可能性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Co-Diagnostics Ships Diagnostic Materials to India for Initiation of Tuberculosis Clinical Studies Following Recently Issued Guidance from the World Health Organization
article.articleSummary: Co-Diagnostics ships PCR Pro instruments, CoDx MTB TB test kits, and proprietary sample preparation tools to CoSara Diagnostics Pvt. Ltd. in India to begin clinical performance studies of the TB assay on the PCR platform. This aligns with WHO’s 2025 Global TB Report and the March 9, 2026 guidance endorsing near-point-of-care molecular TB testing and tongue-swab sampling for patients who cannot produce sputum. The Co-Dx platform is designed for broad point-of-care use with either sputum or tongue-swab samples. India accounts for about 25% of global TB cases, while global TB incidence has fallen 12% since 2015; End TB target is a 50% reduction. CDSCO granted a license for the PCR Pro instrument; the company plans regulatory submission for Indian clearance and clinical performance studies in the near term. The platform remains under FDA/other-regulator review; third-party preclinical results are encouraging.

triage.headline_ja: Co-Diagnosticsがインドへ診断材料を出荷、世界保健機関の最近発行されたガイダンスに続き結核臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核診断技術の臨床研究開始であり、新規の感染症危機や異常発生ではなく、医療技術導入の進捗報告である。公衆衛生への急迫的な脅威、異常な症例発生、国際的拡大リスク、あるいは渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本事象は製薬企業による診断キット供給と臨床研究開始に関する商業ニュースであり、感染症の異常発生や危機管理を必要とするシグナルではない。インドの結核負荷が言及されているが、これは背景情報であり、新規のアウトブレイクや急速な拡大を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Panna News: विश्व क्षय दिवस पर टीबी मरीजों को पोषण आहार किट का वितरण | Panna News Distribution of Nutritional Food Kits to TB Patients on World TB Day
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panna News: Distribution of Nutritional Diet Kits to TB Patients on World TB Day.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) patients in Panna district, Madhya Pradesh, India received nutritional diet kits on World TB Day under the National TB Elimination Programme. Collector Usha Parmar led the distribution at the District Panchayat Hall with Red Cross Society facilitating; District Panchayat CEO Umarav Singh Maravi and doctors Neeraj Jain, Jitendra Yadav, Dinesh Singh, Vikas Srivastav, Rajesh Arkh, and Ramu Babu attended. Additional kits were given to in-patients in the TB ward of Panna District Hospital. A TB screening camp was organized at Tikaria in the Pawai Development Block. The event highlights ongoing public health measures to support TB-affected individuals; the article does not report case counts.

triage.headline_ja: パンナニュース：世界結核デーにTB患者への栄養食キット配布
triage.triage_reason: 結核患者への栄養支援キット配布というルーチンの公衆衛生対応であり、新規の疫学的危機や異常な感染症イベントではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準への該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界結核デーの公式行事において、マディヤプラデーシュ州パンナ地区の結核患者に対する栄養支援キット配布を報道したもの。これはNational TB Elimination Programmeの通常の公衆衛生活動であり、新規アウトブレイク、異常な症例増加、または管理不能な拡大を示唆する情報は含まれていない。署名対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Oropouche atingem 2% da população brasileira sob forte subnotificação - News Rondônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oropouche fever cases reach 2% of the Brazilian population amid strong underreporting - News Rondônia.
article.articleSummary: Oropouche fever may have infected as many as 5.5 million Brazilians since the 1960s, about 2% of the current population, indicating substantial underreporting. Transmission occurs through the biting midge Culicoides paraensis (known in the North as maruim or mosquito-pólvora). The arbovirus is shifting from sylvatic cycles to urban outbreaks, with Manaus as the main dispersal hub due to air and road connectivity, facilitating spread to Espírito Santo and Rio de Janeiro. A large share of infections are asymptomatic or mild, and limited healthcare access in the Amazon basin enables silent circulation. Symptoms resemble dengue; severe cases can involve neurological complications and maternal-fetal risks. There are no licensed vaccines or antivirals; laboratory studies show promise for acridone compounds. Recommendations include genetic tracking, fever-syndrome surveillance, and strengthening differential diagnosis at health posts, alongside individual protection in forested areas to counter spread and emerging variants across Latin America and the Caribbean.

triage.headline_ja: オロポーシ熱の感染者数がブラジル人口の2%に達する - 強い過少報告の下で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の都市化シフト、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニングでも異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で複数該当し、ブラジル国内での関連省庁の関心が高まっている。
triage.notes: オロポーシ熱は従来は野生動物-ベクター循環に限定されていたが、都市部への拡大シフトが新たな脅威。推定550万人の感染（ブラジル人口の2%）を示唆する過少報告の広がり。マナウスが地域的拡散ハブとなり、航空・陸路ネットワーク経由でエスピリット・サント州およびリオデジャネイロ州への拡大。ラテンアメリカ・カリブ海地域への国際的波及リスク。ワクチンや抗ウイルス薬が利用できず、神経学的合併症および母胎感染のリスク。現在のシステムでは検査室診断と遺伝子追跡が限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Co-Diagnostics Ships Diagnostic Materials to India for Initiation of Tuberculosis Clinical Studies Following Recently Issued Guidance from the World Health Organization - Co-Diagnostics (NASDAQ:CODX)
article.articleSummary: Co-Diagnostics ships diagnostic materials to India to initiate tuberculosis clinical studies in line with World Health Organization guidance on near-point-of-care molecular testing and tongue-swab samples. The near-term trials are expected to align with these recommendations, leveraging Co-Dx’s PCR testing platform and its NPOC TB test kit, already aligned with the guidance. India, despite a 21% reduction in TB incidence since 2015, still accounts for about 25% of global TB cases per the 2025 Global TB report. The move underscores development of point-of-care molecular TB testing in high-burden settings and relies on regulatory timelines. The move underscores Co-Diagnostics’ design and mission, aiming to scale TB diagnostics in India through imported materials for clinical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: Co-Diagnosticsがインドに診断材料を出荷し、世界保健機関の最近のガイダンスに従って結核臨床試験を開始 - Co-Diagnostics (NASDAQ:CODX)
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は診断技術の臨床試験開始に関する企業プレスリリースであり、結核の新規アウトブレイク、未制御の感染症流行、または公衆衛生危機を報告していない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は企業のプレスリリースであり、進行中の感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、流行など）の報告ではなく、診断技術の臨床試験開始について述べている。WHOガイダンスへの準拠と背景情報としてのインドのTB負担統計が記載されているが、これは新規または緊急の公衆衛生イベントを示していない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu strikes government poultry farm in Chhattisgarh
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, bird flu (avian influenza) has been confirmed at a government poultry farm in Koni, Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh. Authorities have declared a 1-km infected zone around the farm and a 10-km surveillance zone, within which sale, purchase and transport of poultry products are banned. The confirmation came from a laboratory in Bhopal after samples from the veterinary department were tested. Containment is led by the district administration with the animal husbandry and health departments, while police, forest and transport agencies set checkpoints to monitor poultry and bird movements. The infected zone includes Ramakrishna Paramhans Nagar and Vidyasagar Nagar wards; nearby areas fall under surveillance. Bilaspur collector Sanjay Agrawal says actions follow the Avian Influenza Action Plan, with regular reports to be filed. Residents are urged not to spread rumours and to follow guidelines, with strict action envisaged for violators.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティースガル州の政府家禽農場で鳥インフルエンザが発生
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの確認事例であり、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性と流行可能性を満たす。インド国内での継続的な曝露リスクと地域的な制御措置が必要な状況であることから、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 政府家禽農場での確認事例であり、公式な検査結果に基づいている。制御措置（1km感染区域、10km監視区域の設定）が既に実施されている。記事では死亡や重症の詳細が記載されていないが、鳥インフルエンザの人獣共通感染リスク管理の観点から監視対象。チャッティースガル州およびマディヤプラデーシュ州での地理的広がりを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Một bệnh nhi tử vong do viêm não mô cầu nhóm B, bác sĩ cảnh báo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A child dies from serogroup B meningococcal meningitis, doctors warn.
article.articleSummary: An 11-year-old girl in Phú Quốc died of meningococcal meningitis caused by Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B; a schoolmate with suspected infection was treated at Ho Chi Minh City's Tropical Diseases Hospital. Transmission occurs via close respiratory droplets; casual contact is rarely involved. Vaccination is the most effective long-term defense. High-risk groups include people in outbreak areas, close contacts of cases, the immunocompromised, and children under 5 (especially under 1) and teenagers. Preventive measures: masks, hand hygiene, avoiding crowds, antiseptic oral rinses, and antibiotic prophylaxis for close contacts after exposure. Seek urgent care for sudden high fever, severe headache, vomiting, neck stiffness, lethargy, or purpuric rash. In 2025, Vietnam reported 95 meningococcal disease cases and 3 deaths; rapid progression to adrenal and multi-organ failure can occur within 24 hours. Vaccination across common serogroups remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: 11歳の少女がセログループBの髄膜炎菌髄膜炎で死亡、医師が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡例、予想外性、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニングで全5項目該当。ベトナムにおけるメニンゴコッカス感染症の流行信号として認識され、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: セログループBメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎による小児死亡例であり、24時間以内に多臓器不全へ進行する危険性が高い。2025年にベトナムで95例の報告、3例の死亡があり、流行の兆候を示している。ホーチミン市およびフータン市での患者確認により複数地域への拡大が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: 乙类传染病暴发流行时，可宣布划定"疫区"。                                                [全文]
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: During outbreaks of Category B infectious diseases, an 'epidemic area' may be designated.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-25, China announced that chikungunya fever and fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome will be managed as Category B infectious diseases from 2026-04-01 under the Infectious Disease Prevention Law, applying Category B prevention and control measures. During outbreaks, local governments at or above the county level may designate an 'epidemic area' and implement emergency actions; the State Council can declare epidemic areas spanning multiple provinces. For chikungunya, cases must be reported within 24 hours via an online national system, and clustered outbreaks within 2 hours via the public health emergency management system. Surveillance includes entry screening of inbound travelers, risk assessment of key regions, and intensified vector control; for local transmission, rapid case finding and mosquito elimination are prioritized. For fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome, multi-channel surveillance and tick-control measures are emphasized. Both diseases have no specific antiviral therapy; treatment is supportive. China reported imported chikungunya cases in 2008, local outbreaks in 2010, and imported-associated clusters in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 乙类传染病暴发流行时，可宣布划定"疫区"。
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱とSFTS（発熱血小板減少症候群）が中国で感染症分類の引き上げと管理体制の強化を発表したが、新規の大規模発生ではなく制度的措置の公表であり、現在の流行状況に関する具体的な患者数や地理的拡大の証拠が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は中国政府による感染症管理体制の制度的変更・強化を発表したもの。チクングニアは2025年に輸入関連クラスターが報告されているが、現在の流行規模や重症度については具体的記載がない。SFTSとチクングニア双方とも対症療法のみという治療上の制限がある。国際的拡大の直接的な証拠はなく、現在のところはWATCH段階が妥当。続報（実際の患者数増加、新規発生地域の拡大等）を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Vander Loubet e Camila Jara garantem apoio federal contra chikungunya - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vander Loubet and Camila Jara Secure Federal Support to Combat Chikungunya - Boca do Povo News.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, is confronting a chikungunya outbreak with four deaths and more than 600 cases, most severe in the indigenous reserve. Federal deputies Vander Loubet and Camila Jara met with Nilton Pereira Júnior of the Health Ministry to coordinate emergency actions. The ministry will deploy vector-control agents, the SUS National Force, and specialists to reinforce hospitals at capacity and provide emergency supplies and medicines. An Emergency Operations Center (COE) will be established to coordinate the response and prioritize cleanup in the hardest-hit areas, especially the indigenous village, to curb the transmitter mosquito. Jara called for interministerial action involving Funai, the Civil House, the Ministry of Defense, and the Armed Forces. The meeting forms part of PT Mato Grosso do Sul’s push to secure immediate municipal support against the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァンダー・ルーベットとカミラ・ジャラがチクングニア対策の連邦支援を確保 - ボカ・ド・ポーヴォ・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマットグロッソ・ド・スル州で4人の死亡と600件以上の患者が発生しているチクングニア流行事例。IHR基準（重症度、異常性、国際拡大リスク）を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）も複数該当。連邦政府の対応が進行中であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ドゥラード市（マットグロッソ・ド・スル州）の先住民保護区での流行が最も深刻。連邦省庁による統合対応（保健省、ファナイ、国防省など）が発動され、緊急オペレーションセンター（COE）が設立予定。チクングニアはベクター媒介性疾患で、蚊媒介感染の持続的なリスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: TB Symptoms | सतत खोकला येतोय? तर जाणून घ्या सविस्तर टीबीची लक्षणं कशी ओळखायची?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB Symptoms | If you have a persistent cough, learn in detail how to recognize TB symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) in India remains a major public health issue, with rising cases. India accounts for the highest share of global TB patients; in 2020, about 27% of the world's TB patients were in India, according to the World Health Organization. TB is a bacterial airborne infection primarily affecting the lungs, but it can involve brain, spine, and kidneys. Transmission occurs when an infected person coughs or sneezes. Key symptoms include persistent cough for more than two weeks, fever, rapid weight loss, fatigue, and night sweats. Early diagnosis and treatment can cure TB. Completing the full course of medicines is essential to prevent drug resistance. Preventive measures include covering coughs, wearing masks, maintaining household hygiene, and a balanced diet to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: TB症状 | 続く咳が出ていますか？TB症状を詳しく認識する方法を学びましょう
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける結核の継続的な公衆衛生上の課題として認識されているが、記事は一般的な症状啓発・教育コンテンツであり、新規アウトブレイク、異常な増加、または国際的拡大の具体的なシグナルを示していない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドにおける結核の一般的な症状と予防に関する教育的コンテンツであり、新規の感染症危機を示唆していない。WHO統計を参照しながら周知啓発を行うもので、緊急性の高いシグナルではないが、インドの結核負担が世界最高水準である事実から「WATCH」と判定。追加情報（新規クラスター、異常な発生率の増加、薬剤耐性結核の急増など）により「PICKUP」への昇格が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados registra alta de casos de chikungunya - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados reports a surge in chikungunya cases - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya surge in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with 648 confirmed cases, 1,426 notifications, and four deaths registered in the Indigenous Reserve as of March 25, 2026. Aedes aegypti remains the vector; public health officials warn eggs can stay viable for up to a year, underscoring the need for community participation to eliminate breeding sites. A municipal–state–federal task force is conducting awareness and control activities, including the installation of Larvicidal Dissemination Stations to curb larval development. The most affected areas include Jardim dos Estados, Novo Horizonte, and the Jóquei Clube region, as well as the Jaguapiru and Bororó villages. Infectologist Rivaldo Venâncio cautions about health-system strain and risks for the elderly and those with comorbidities. The state government is seeking inclusion of Mato Grosso do Sul in the national vaccination plan approved by Anvisa, awaiting dose allocation.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスがチクングニア熱の症例急増を報告 - ボカドポヴォニュース
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国）でチクングニア熱の有意な増加が報告され、648例の確定症例、1,426例の報告、4例の死亡が記録されており、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常/予想外」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡を含む）、流行しやすさ（Aedes aegyptiによるヒト媒介感染、多くの人口に影響）、管理可能性（複数レベルの政府対応と全国予防接種計画への組み込み要請）が確認され、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ドゥラードスはマットグロッソドスル州に位置し、記事サマリーで明示されている。先住民保護区での4例の死亡を含む有意な死亡数が報告されており、公衆衛生危機の兆候が明らか。ブラジル政府が全国予防接種計画への組み込みを要請中であり、政府レベルの対応と国際的な支援ニーズが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Vander articula ações emergenciais devido ao surto de chikungunya em Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vander outlines emergency actions in response to the chikungunya outbreak in Dourados.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, has caused four deaths and over 600 reported cases, including in the Jaguapiru and Bororó indigenous villages, as of 25 March 2026. Federal deputies Vander Loubet and Camila Jara urged rapid federal action, and the Health Ministry dispatched vector-control agents, the SUS National Force, and specialists to bolster the city’s strained hospitals. A Center for Health Emergency Operations (COE) will coordinate the response. Priorities include medical care and sanitation, with particular focus on the indigenous village where inadequate garbage collection and sanitation amplify the mosquito reservoir. Vander stated the need for unified action across government to save lives and halt spread, while Camila Jara called for interministerial coordination including Funai, the Civil House, the Ministry of Defense, and the Armed Forces to reinforce emergency measures and prevent new victims.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスのチクングニア熱流行に対応する緊急措置をヴァンダーが調整
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マトグロッソドスル州ドゥラードスでのチクングニア熱流行は、4人の死亡と600件以上の報告症例を含む重大な公衆衛生事象であり、先住民地域での蔓延、医療施設逼迫、複数省庁による国家レベルの緊急対応が必要とされている。IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当、社会政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国に含まれていないが、提供されたイベント情報がブラジルを明確に主題としており、重大な感染症事象である。シグナルトリアージのプロトコルに基づきPICKUPとして扱うが、通常の監視対象国ではないため、組織のポリシーに応じて追加判定が必要な場合がある。死亡4件、600件以上の症例、先住民地域での蔓延、医療逼迫、複数省庁の国家的対応調整が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: SES incentiva o diagnóstico precoce da tuberculose em Mato Grosso | Cliquef5 - Noticias de Primavera do Leste e Campo Verde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State Health Secretariat Encourages Early Diagnosis of Tuberculosis in Mato Grosso | Cliquef5 - News from Primavera do Leste and Campo Verde
article.articleSummary: On World TB Day (Mar 24), Mato Grosso State Health Secretariat (SES-MT) reinforced early diagnosis, prevention, and control of tuberculosis across the state. Capacity-building targeted physicians and nurses in municipal networks, Indigenous District Health Services (Dseis), and the prison system, with surveillance and control workshops, PPD testing guidance, and in-field training to improve case notification, data updates, and timely closure. TB is an airborne, curable, and preventable infection; common symptoms include cough for three weeks or longer, evening fever, night sweats, weight loss, fatigue, and sputum with or without blood. Transmission occurs via aerosols in poorly ventilated indoor spaces, disproportionately affecting vulnerable groups such as incarcerated individuals and people experiencing homelessness. A mobile TB prevention unit served 4,650 incarcerated people in 2025 with rapid molecular testing and chest X-rays. In 2025, Mato Grosso recorded 1,494 new TB cases (39.1 per 100,000) and 114 TB deaths (SIM).

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ州保健局が結核の早期診断を推奨｜クリックF5 - プリマヴェーラ・ド・レステとカンポ・ヴェルデのニュース
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、州レベルの予防・啓発活動の報道。国際的な懸念やアウトブレイク兆候は明確でないが、高い死亡数と脆弱層への影響から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 結核は周知の感染症であり、マット・グロッソ州での2025年1,494例、114死亡という数字は深刻だが、異常や予想外の発生ではない。記事は世界TB記念日に関連した啓発活動の報道であり、アウトブレイク通知ではない。ただし高死亡率と受刑者・ホームレス等脆弱層への大きな影響が確認されているため、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: चीन के शांक्सी में प्राइमरी स्कूल में नोरोवायरस का प्रकोप, कई बच्चे संक्रमित - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Norovirus outbreak at a primary school in Shansi, China; several children infected - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: Norovirus outbreak at Yukai Primary School in Xiaodian District, Taiyuan, Shanxi Province, China. As of March 25, 2026, initial tests have confirmed norovirus infection among students; over 100 pupils have taken leave, with classes suspended and teachers delivering online instruction. Health authorities have initiated disinfection protocols and an epidemiological investigation; the exact cause of spread is under review. Norovirus is a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis worldwide, with symptoms of sudden vomiting and diarrhea and potential dehydration, especially in young children. Global context cited: about 685 million cases annually, including ~200 million in children under five, and roughly 200,000 deaths, alongside substantial healthcare costs (~$60 billion). Most patients recover in 1–3 days, but the virus can remain transmissible for days. No imported/exported cases are mentioned in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 中国陝西省の小学校でノロウイルス集団発生、多くの児童が感染
triage.triage_reason: 学校での限定的な集団発生であり、国際的拡大の兆候がなく、重症度も低い。ただしノロウイルスの伝播性と児童への影響により、続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: ノロウイルスは学校という限定的な環境での発生であり、100名以上の児童が欠席、複数日の伝播性がある。記事では輸入・輸出症例が明記されていない。地域検証：太原市、山西省はいずれも中国内であり、Chinaのみを対象国として抽出。スクリーニング基準は長期曝露と流行性により2つ該当するが、国際的拡大リスクがなく、社会的関心も限定的であるため、WATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: ОСТОРОЖНО! ⟩ В нескольких странах зафиксирована вспышка опасного вируса, который переносят комары
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CAUTION! An outbreak of a dangerous mosquito-borne virus has been reported in several countries.
article.articleSummary: On 25 March 2026, the CDC warned of rapid dengue fever spread across 16 high-risk countries, including Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Colombia, Cuba, the Maldives, Pakistan, Vietnam, and other tropical/subtropical regions. The mosquito-borne disease can progress to life-threatening complications; symptoms appear within two weeks of infection and include high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, nausea, rash, and mild bleeding. Most cases are mild, but severe dengue can cause heavy bleeding, bloody vomit or stools, dangerously low blood pressure, organ failure, and rare brain hemorrhage. Travelers should use repellents, long clothing, bed nets, and consider air-conditioned or screened accommodations; precautions extend after return since mosquitoes can spread the virus. In Europe, dengue risk affects about half the global population; 100-400 million infections annually. Local transmission has been documented in France, Croatia, Spain, and Italy, with travel-linked introductions from Asia, Africa, the Americas, and the Pacific.

triage.headline_ja: 注意！複数の国で蚊が媒介する危険なウイルスの流行が報告されている
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の16カ国での流行報告であり、IHR基準3つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。対象地域のベトナムで現地伝播が記載されており、国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはパキスタン、アフガニスタン、バングラデシュ、モルディブなど複数国が列挙されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはベトナムのみ。記事サマリーは16カ国での流行を言及しており、ベトナムでは「現地伝播」が記載されている。CDCからの警告として信頼性が高く、デング熱の国際的拡大と旅行リスクについての具体的記述がある。

article.articleHeadline: "Redaksi Yth": Mengapa Rabies Tak Kunjung Beres?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dear Editors: Why Has Rabies Still Not Been Resolved?
article.articleSummary: Rabies persists in Indonesia, with elimination achieved in East Java, Central Java, Yogyakarta, and Jakarta, but remains challenging in Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Bali, Nusa Tenggara Timur, Nusa Tenggara Barat, and Maluku. Road Maps for elimination (2010–2020, then 2019–2030) show limited progress, making 2030 elimination unlikely. In Bali, lab-confirmed rabies in dogs occurred from 2023–2025; in 2025, suspected dog-bite cases reached 66,760 and there were 16 deaths. Vaccination coverage is stated to exceed 80% of the population, but vaccinators can vaccinate only owned dogs; stray, unowned dogs—including puppies—remain unvaccinated and are reservoirs. Foreigners in Bali reportedly pick up stray puppies; some bite and test positive for rabies, and market-sold puppies have also tested positive. The author urges prioritizing upstream control of stray dogs until elimination, with owned-dog vaccination as a secondary priority, a strategy used by the UK, Japan, and South Korea.

triage.headline_ja: 編集部様へ：狂犬病がなぜ解決しないのか？
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける狂犬病の継続的な流行・複数地域での人死亡事例を報告しており、IHR基準2項目以上（異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当。WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度・管理可能性）し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年配信で時間軸が将来を指しているが、2023-2025年のバリ州における犬の狂犬病確認例および66,760件の咬傷疑い事例と16件の死亡報告に基づく。野犬・放浪犬がワクチン未接種のまま蔵となっており、外国人観光客との接触リスクもある。複数地域での根絶進捗遅滞が報告されており、制御困難な公衆衛生課題として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Com alta circulação de vírus, vacinação deve começar imediatamente em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With high viral circulation, vaccination should begin immediately in MS.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity is high in Mato Grosso do Sul (MS), Brazil, with 80,000 influenza vaccine doses delivered to all 79 municipalities to date. Health authorities urge immediate organization and administration of the vaccine amid elevated risk of infection, hospitalization, and mortality from severe respiratory illness (SARI) caused by influenza. Vaccination prioritizes about 1.1 million vulnerable people across MS. The capital, Campo Grande, will start on March 26, 2026, with interior municipalities urged to proceed; the regional Dia D mobilization is planned for March 28, 2026. Vaccine deliveries have been advanced in recent years by the Ministry of Health to align with earlier circulation peaks. The state will deploy Vacimóveis (mobile vaccination units) to reach populations in Corumbá, Dourados, Ponta Porã, and other partnered towns.

triage.headline_ja: 高いウイルス循環の中、MSでは直ちにワクチン接種を開始すべき
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザの高い活動レベルが報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）の複数の基準に該当する。ただし、これは確立された季節性インフルエンザの公衆衛生対応であり、異常性や国際的拡大の具体的根拠が限定的であるため、フルRRA前の経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の公衆衛生対応の報告。SARI（重症急性呼吸器感染症）の言及と脆弱層への予防接種キャンペーンにより重症度・流行性では該当するが、この地域での異常性は明確でなく、国際的拡大のリスク言及なし。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、季節性インフルエンザ対応としての標準的な取り組みであることから、続報による確認が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Município no interior do Piauí decreta situação de emergência após surto de dengue; 290 casos em 2026 - Portal É Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipality in the interior of Piauí declares a state of emergency after a dengue outbreak; 290 cases in 2026 - Portal É Notícias
article.articleSummary: São Raimundo Nonato, in the interior of Piauí, Brazil, declared a public health emergency due to a dengue outbreak. A decree published March 24, 2026, sets an initial 60-day emergency period, extendable. The epidemic is considered high transmission per Brazil's Ministry of Health; 290 dengue cases were reported from February to March 2026. The municipality may purchase supplies, medicines, equipment, and hire services/professionals on a temporary basis; bidding may be waived for urgent arbovirus control. The Special Operations Committee for Arboviruses (COE-Arboviroses) will coordinate actions and issue periodic reports. Arboviroses include dengue, Zika, chikungunya transmitted by Aedes aegypti. Exceptional measures include suspending healthcare workers' vacations, enhanced home visits, school-based education, and property inspections to eliminate breeding sites. Prevention tips include removing standing water, closed water tanks, cleaning gutters, sand in plant saucers, proper waste disposal, and seeking care for fever, body pains, and rashes.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州内陸部の自治体がデング熱感染拡大を受け緊急事態を宣言。2026年に290件の症例が発生
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル内のデング熱感染拡大イベントであり、公衆衛生上の影響が深刻（自治体が緊急事態宣言）、予想外の重大な感染爆発として国際的な感染症モニタリング対象となるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ピアウイ州サン・ライムンド・ノナト自治体における3月24日の公式緊急事態宣言。290症例はわずか2ヶ月間（2月～3月2026年）で発生しており、高い感染伝播が認定されている。デング、ジカ、チクングニアの3つのアルボウイルス感染症が同時に確認されており、媒介蚊Aedes aegyptiの制御が重要な対策となっている。

article.articleHeadline: دراسة تكشف أن انتقال الفيروسات من الحيوانات للبشر لا يتطلب تغيرات تطورية مسبقة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A study reveals that animal-to-human transmission of viruses does not require preexisting evolutionary changes
article.articleSummary: As of March 25, 2026, a study by researchers at the University of California, San Diego, published in Cell, found that animal-to-human viruses—Ebola, influenza, SARS, and SARS-CoV-2—often do not require preexisting evolutionary changes to infect humans; such changes arise after spillover during human transmission. Cited by ScienceAlert, the study attributes spillover primarily to human activities—encroachment into wildlife, habitat destruction, and wildlife trade—which facilitate cross-species transmission and subsequent pandemics. The results support the natural-origin hypothesis for SARS-CoV-2, with no evidence of lab modification or unusual evolution before emergence. Preventive measures emphasized include reducing contact with wildlife, protecting ecosystems, and strengthening disease surveillance to mitigate future global health risks.

triage.headline_ja: 研究により、動物から人間へのウイルス伝播は事前の進化的変化を必要としないことが判明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は科学研究の発表に関する記事であり、実際の感染症の流行や健康危機を報告するものではない。理論的な知見の公開であり、直接的な公衆衛生への影響は生じていない。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症の流行や新規患者報告ではなく、カリフォルニア大学サンディエゴ校による学術研究の発表記事である。Bluedot APIがEbolaやDRCを検出しているが、これらは研究の対象となったウイルス（歴史的事例として）であり、現在の発生イベントではない。記事サマリーに具体的な患者数、死亡数、発生地の地理的位置などの感染症イベントの実証的情報は含まれていない。シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Monkeypox Surge in 2026: Travel Advisory, Symptoms, Vaccination & Prevention Guide
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox surge in 2026 as of 2026-03-25 prompts travel advisories. Symptoms appear 5-21 days after exposure: fever, chills, muscle aches, swollen lymph nodes, and a vesicular-pustular rash lasting 2-4 weeks; contagious until all lesions heal. Transmission mainly through skin-to-skin contact, respiratory droplets, and contaminated materials. Vaccination is central to prevention: Jynneos in two-dose schedule recommended for at-risk travelers; ACAM2000 reserved for certain cases due to adverse effects; post-exposure vaccination within 4-14 days can reduce severity. Prevention measures: frequent handwashing, alcohol sanitizers, masks in crowded settings, avoiding shared items, regular disinfection, and avoiding close contact with potentially infected individuals or animals. High-risk areas include Central and West Africa—Nigeria and the Democratic Republic of Congo—with endemic transmission; regions with recent outbreaks outside Africa also warrant caution. Travelers should follow evolving advisories, vaccination proof, screening, and quarantine guidelines as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年のサル痘感染拡大：渡航勧告、症状、ワクチン接種・予防ガイド
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数アフリカ国での地域流行、渡航勧告発令、ワクチン接種推奨が報告されており、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年時点のMpox（サル痘）地域流行について、中央アフリカ・西アフリカでの流行拡大を報告している。DRCとナイジェリアが具体的に言及されているが、ナイジェリア（GeoNames 2328926）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Angola も対象国リストに含まれない。複数クレード（Clade I/II）の同時流行、国際的な渡航勧告の発令、ワクチン接種推奨の展開は国際公衆衛生上の重要シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Η Co-Diagnostics αποστέλλει υλικά ελέγχου φυματίωσης στην Ινδία Πηγή: Investing.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Co-Diagnostics ships tuberculosis control materials to India.
article.articleSummary: Co-Diagnostics shipped PCR instruments and CoDx MTB TB test kits to CoSara Diagnostics in India to begin performance studies, including PCR Pro units and sample-preparation devices, with studies to start soon. The platform is designed for point-of-care or near-point-of-care use and can run sputum or tongue-swab samples. India's CDSCO previously authorized manufacture and sale of the PCR Pro as a medical device; regulatory submissions in India are anticipated after these performance studies. WHO guidelines issued on 09.03 encourage near-patient molecular diagnostics and tongue-swab sampling to broaden TB testing and address diagnostic gaps. The 2025 WHO Global TB Report shows global TB incidence fell 12% since 2015, with India accounting for about 25% of global TB cases despite a 21% reduction since 2015. The Co-Dx PCR platform remains under FDA review and is not yet for sale.

triage.headline_ja: Co-Diagnosticsがインドに結核検査用物資を出荷
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医療診断キットの商業的な配送・試験開始について述べており、新たな感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、集団発生、拡大傾向）の報告ではない。結核の既存負担についての背景情報含有のみ。
triage.notes: 記事はCo-Diagnostics社による診断キットの商業配送および性能試験開始に関する企業ニュースであり、感染症の新規発症、アウトブレイク、または疾患の拡大を示す信号ではない。WHO報告書の結核負担統計は背景情報として含有されているが、イベント性はない。シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Tick-borne Babesia is crippling Kolkata's pets, vets share prevention tips
article.articleSummary: Tick-borne Babesia Gibsoni is rising across Kolkata, seriously affecting dogs and cats, with cases such as a five-year-old beagle in Rajarhat who is bedridden after more than a month of illness. Vets describe an epidemic of Babesia Gibsoni, a hemoprotozoan infection transmitted by ticks that damages organs and can progress without early fever. Early signs include lethargy, loss of appetite, vomiting, and blood in urine or stool; some infections silently spread before detection. The surge is seasonal, aligning with tick population growth from April to October, with ticks commonly transmitting Babesia, Anaplasma, and Ehrlichia. In dogs, recovery is possible with timely treatment; in cats, the recovery rate is around 30% and relapses are possible. No vaccine exists. Regular RT-PCR/PCR testing every three months, strict tick control, and preventive measures (grooming, clean bedding, hygiene, tick prevention meds) plus routine checkups are essential.

triage.headline_ja: ダニ媒介バベシア症がコルカタのペットを苦しめている、獣医師が予防のコツを共有
triage.triage_reason: ダニ媒介感染症（バベシア、アナプラズマ、エーリキア）がインド・コルカタで増加している動物疾患事例だが、ヒト感染の明記がなく、現段階ではペット限定のシグナルと判断される。情報追加を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はペット（犬・猫）に限定したダニ媒介感染症の流行を報告しており、ヒト感染例の明記はない。しかし、バベシア・アナプラズマ・エーリキアはズーノーシスの可能性があり、ペット飼い主のヒト感染リスクは否定できない。また季節的流行（4月〜10月）との記載から、今後ヒト症例報告の可能性も考慮して経過観察が必要。発生地域はインド（西ベンガル州・コルカタ）であり、バングラデシュは発生地としての言及がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu strikes government poultry farm in Chhattisgarh
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) confirmed at the government poultry farm in Koni, Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh. Lab in Bhopal confirmed the infection. District authorities established a 1 km infected zone and a 10 km surveillance zone, with sale, purchase and transport of all poultry within the surveillance zone banned. Police, forest and transport departments set up checkpoints to monitor movement of poultry and birds. Infected zone includes Ramakrishna Paramhans Nagar and Vidyasagar Nagar; adjacent areas are under surveillance. Containment is being carried out jointly by the Bilaspur district administration, animal husbandry and health departments, under the Avian Influenza Action Plan. Bilaspur collector Sanjay Agrawal urged calm, cautioned against rumours, and warned of strict action for rule violations. Date: 25 March 2026.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガル州の政府家禽農場で鳥インフルエンザが発生

triage.notes: 記事では動物（家禽）での鳥インフルエンザ確認であり、人感染は報告されていない。インドの動物衛生当局が適切な封鎖措置（1km感染区、10km監視区）を実施しており、管理可能性は現時点では高い。ただしチャッティスガル州、ヒマチャル・プラデシュ州、マディヤ・プラデシュ州での複数地点の関連が示唆されており、今後の人感染例出現や地域拡大の可能性があるため、経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Co-Diagnostics отправила материалы для тестирования на туберкулез в Индию От Investing.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Co-Diagnostics Sent Materials for Tuberculosis Testing to India — From Investing.com
article.articleSummary: Salt Lake City-based Co-Diagnostics Inc. has shipped PCR instruments and TB diagnostic test kits to its India joint venture, CoSara Diagnostics, to begin clinical efficacy studies. The shipment includes PCR Pro instruments, Co-Dx PCR MTB test kits for detecting tuberculosis, and sample-preparation tools, designed for point-of-care use with sputum samples or tongue swabs. India’s CDSCO has licensed the PCR Pro instrument for manufacture and sale as a medical device, and Co-Diagnostics expects to file for regulatory approval in India after efficacy studies. The platform is under FDA review and not yet for sale. WHO, on March 9, issued guidelines promoting molecular diagnostics at the point of care and tongue-swab specimens to expand TB testing and close diagnostic gaps. Global TB incidence fell 12% since 2015; India accounts for about 25% of cases with a 21% reduction since 2015. Co-Diagnostics’ market cap is about $5.12 million, down 84%.

Clinical studies are expected before regulatory submission in India; the platform is not yet commercially available.

article.articleHeadline: HCM City records first three HFMD deaths of 2026 as cases surge
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City reports a surge in hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) driven by the virulent EV71 strain, with three deaths since early 2026. As of week 11, 7,294 HFMD cases have been recorded (over triple the year-ago total), including 98 severe cases; week 11 alone saw 837 cases. Since January, 288 outbreaks have been identified (162 in schools, 126 in the community). EV71 was detected in 25% of tested samples (6 of 24). In response, authorities issued a directive to strengthen prevention and control, focusing on kindergartens, childcare facilities, and social protection centers, with health stations monitoring and investigating outbreaks. The Education Department will ensure handwashing facilities and prompt case notification; hospitals will train staff on diagnosis, treatment and infection prevention. Vietnam reports sufficient HFMD medications.

triage.notes: EV71検出率25%（24サンプル中6件）、2026年初から累計7,294例（前年同時期の3倍超）、死亡3件、重症98件。学校162件・コミュニティ126件の集団発生計288件。当局が予防管理強化指令を発令、医療体制の整備も進行中。情報源はベトナム国営放送（VOV）。

article.articleHeadline: Anthrax-causing bacteria have dwelled in soil for centuries - cycling through people, animals and earth
article.articleSummary: Anthrax (Bacillus anthracis) persists in soil, forming spores that endure for decades and cycle between land, grazing animals, and humans. In herbivores, spores are ingested or enter via wounds; inside macrophages they germinate and multiply, causing rapid death if untreated; carcass decomposition returns bacteria to soil to sporulate again. Humans can be part of this cycle, with spores surviving more than 50 years and spreading through animal husbandry and trade. Notable events include early Egypt, Chinese texts, French explorers to North America in the 1700s, and the 1930s–40s Japanese releases in China; the Sept. 18, 2001 mailings killed five. In humans, cutaneous anthrax causes blisters and dark sores; inhalation causes fever, nausea, chest pain and is highly deadly; ingestion causes vomiting and bloody diarrhea. Treatments include antibiotics and monoclonal antibodies; vaccines by Pasteur and Greenfield exist, now recommended for high-risk groups like animal handlers and military personnel.

article.articleHeadline: Governo de MS amplia atendimento para Chikungunya em Dourados - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul government expands care for Chikungunya in Dourados - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya care expanded in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with 15 exclusive beds added on March 24, 2026 at Hospital Regional de Dourados: 10 for adults, 5 pediatric. The temporary measure augments capacity amid rising cases; HRD now operates 100 beds, including 20 ICU, with the new beds integrated. Director-general Andréia Alcântara emphasizes that internal organization is essential to ensure quality and safety. The SES reiterates prevention as the primary approach, focusing on eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Infectologist Renata Praça advises seeking care for symptoms such as high fever, joint pain, and skin rashes and avoiding self-medication. This action forms part of a broader public health effort to contain disease transmission in Dourados and surrounding areas.

article.articleHeadline: Teresina registra quase 600 casos de dengue em 2026; veja sintomas, cuidados e como evitar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teresina records nearly 600 dengue cases in 2026; see symptoms, precautions and how to prevent.
article.articleSummary: Teresina, Brazil, reports 558 confirmed dengue cases from January 1 to March 23, 2026, and 39 chikungunya cases in the same period, a 6.1% decline from 594 dengue cases in early 2025. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti, with risk rising during the rainy season as water accumulates. Common symptoms include sudden high fever, body and joint pains, extreme fatigue, eye pain behind the eyes, and headache. There is no specific antiviral treatment; management focuses on early medical care and supportive care such as rigorous hydration (water, juices, coconut water), rest, and medical follow-up. Prevention centers on eliminating standing water: keep water tanks and reservoirs closed, store empty bottles inverted, change water daily in animal containers, avoid litter buildup, remove exposed tires, and clean trays and reservoirs of air conditioners/climatizers, which can harbor larvae.

triage.headline_ja: テレジーナで2026年にデング熱ほぼ600件を記録；症状、注意事項、予防方法を確認

article.articleHeadline: A Renewed Fight Against TB: Kalyan-Dombivli Municipal Corporation Unveils 100-Day Intensive Campaign On World Tuberculosis Day
article.articleSummary: Kalyan-Dombivli Municipal Corporation (KDMC) launches a 100-day intensive TB-Free India Campaign 2.0 in Kalyan-Dombivli, Maharashtra, announced on World Tuberculosis Day. The effort seeks to accelerate TB elimination with door-to-door screening, free sputum testing and chest X-ray, enabling early detection and prompt treatment initiation. It emphasizes treatment completion through close monitoring, counselling, and follow-ups to prevent relapse and drug resistance. Special camps will operate in high-risk, densely populated areas; awareness drives target schools, colleges, marketplaces, and slum clusters. The Nikshay Mitra initiative invites individuals, NGOs, and corporates to adopt TB patients, offering nutritional, emotional, and financial support, while Nikshay Poshan Yojana provides ₹1,000 per month during treatment. At a launch event at Rukminibai Hospital, 210 TB patients received nutritional kits; MDR-TB patients underwent PFT and X-ray screening. Partners include Inner Wheel Club of Kalyan, Rotary Club of Thane District 3142, and IMA Kalyan; officials Dr. Sulakshana Tribhuvan and Dr. Pournima Dhake.

article.articleHeadline: Antibiotic Resistance Drives 87% of India's Typhoid Economic Burden: Lancet
article.articleSummary: Antibiotic-resistant typhoid infections drive 87% of India's typhoid economic burden in 2023, with national costs estimated at ₹123 billion. Children under 10 bear more than half of the burden. Out-of-pocket payments account for 91% of costs, and about 70,000 households faced catastrophic health expenditures. Five states—Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh (including Telangana), Tamil Nadu, and West Bengal—tunnel together to over half of national costs. Findings highlight the heavy financial hardship on families due to antimicrobial resistance in typhoid, based on The Lancet Regional Health Southeast Asia analysis of 2023 data; published 2026-03-25.

triage.headline_ja: 抗生物質耐性がインドのチフス経済負担の87%を占める：ランセット
