triage.notes: 記事は2023年の経済負担分析を発表するもので、新規発生事例の報告ではない。抗生物質耐性チフスが公衆衛生上の重大な課題であることを強調しており、特に子どもへの影響や家計への経済的負担が深刻である点が注視対象。インド国内の5州（マハラシュトラ、ウッタルプラデシュ、アンドラプラデシュ、タミルナド、西ベンガル）に集中。継続的な疫学監視と対策状況の動向確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: پاکستان میں تپ دق کے کیسز میں تشویشناک حد تک اضافہ، ورلڈ ہیلتھ آرگنائزیشن کی رپورٹ جاری
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming rise in tuberculosis cases in Pakistan; WHO report released.
article.articleSummary: Pakistan remains among the five countries bearing the highest tuberculosis (TB) burden, according to a World Health Organization (WHO) report. In 2024, estimated new TB cases in Pakistan totaled about 670,000, about 6.3% of global cases, ranking Pakistan fifth after India, Indonesia, the Philippines, and China. Officially notified TB cases were about 669,000 in 2024, up from 662,000 in 2023. TB deaths were estimated at about 47,000 in 2024, within the prior range of 46,000–48,000. The incidence rate was 277 per 100,000 in 2023 and remained roughly 260–280 per 100,000 in 2024. Pakistan faces roughly 0.5–0.7 million new TB cases annually, with population growth suggesting sustained or rising transmission. The National TB Control Program offers free diagnosis and treatment nationwide. TB is curable with timely diagnosis; individuals with cough lasting more than two weeks, fever, or weight loss should seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: パキスタンで結核患者数が懸念される水準まで増加、世界保健機関（WHO）がレポート発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上に該当（異常性・予想外性、公衆衛生への深刻な影響）。結核は世界的な感染症で、パキスタンは世界5位の疾病負担国であり、年67万件の新規患者と4.7万人の死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はパキスタンにおける結核の高い疾病負担であるが、WHO報告書の内容として世界5位までの国が列記されている。検証対象国リスト内で実際の患者発生が記載されている国はIndia、Indonesia、China、Philippinesである。パキスタンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Haryana govt to launch TB detection model to treat disease before symptoms surface
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, Haryana, India, launched a TB detection model to treat disease before symptoms surface. A Rs 20.5 crore BPCL Foundation partnership funds 150 Truenat Quattro machines, to be deployed within weeks, expanding rapid grassroots testing. AI-enabled handheld X-ray devices are deployed across 2,111 high-risk villages and wards for active screening and to identify lung abnormalities in asymptomatic individuals. The program shifts from passive detection to proactive case finding, supported by 65 Mobile Medical Units and Ni-Kshay Vahans to deliver on-site diagnostics in remote areas. Haryana aims to conduct 15 lakh sputum tests this year. Sumita Misra, Additional Chief Secretary, Health and Family Welfare, says the plan advances early detection, tech integration, and inclusive healthcare toward a TB-free Haryana.

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 10 mil profissionais mobilizados para campanha da poliomielite em Luanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 10,000 professionals mobilized for polio vaccination campaign in Luanda.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination campaign in Luanda Province, Angola, runs March 26–28, mobilizing 10,500 health and social support professionals to vaccinate about 1.94 million children aged 0–5 in Luanda. Coordinated by Felismina Neto of the Expanded Immunization Program (PAV), the operation uses more than 3,000 teams—vaccinators, mobilizers, registrars, supervisors and coordinators—working house-to-house, at fixed posts and health units. Official launch is in Belas municipality. The effort aims to prevent spread of poliovirus connected to outbreaks in neighboring Namibia and the Democratic Republic of Congo, with a second round planned in May. The vaccine is safe and given to all children in the target group regardless of vaccination history, except for very few cases (e.g., coma). The campaign seeks at least 95% homogeneous coverage, with support from WHO, UNICEF and the World Bank, and active community engagement. Angola has had no wild poliovirus since 2011, but reimportation risk remains due to mobility.

triage.headline_ja: ルアンダのポリオワクチン接種キャンペーンに10,000人以上の専門家が動員
triage.triage_reason: ポリオウイルス再輸入のリスクが懸念され、隣国（ナミビア、DRC）での流行に対応する予防的キャンペーンが展開されている。国際的な支援（WHO、UNICEF、世銀）が関与しており、公衆衛生上の重要性と国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはアンゴラのルアンダでのポリオ予防キャンペーンを主題としているが、アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれていない。一方、記事本文で「neighboring Namibia and the Democratic Republic of Congo」での流行が背景として述べられており、DRCは対象国である。この事象はDRCとナミビアでのポリオ流行関連のシグナルとして識別される。ただし、検証対象国はDRCのみがリストに含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N8

article.articleHeadline: Aviaria, primo caso in Italia: quanto è pericoloso il virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza, first case in Italy: how dangerous is the virus?
article.articleSummary: First human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) in Italy: Lombardy, Milan hospital, a patient with pre-existing conditions who had returned from a non-European country where infection occurred. The patient is under close observation in Milan. The virus is classified as low pathogenic in birds, but H9N2 has infected humans since 1998, with 173 reported cases, mainly in China; many infections likely go undetected. Since 2015, genetic changes have enhanced binding to human receptors, raising concerns about human-to-human transmission and future epidemics. Modern H9N2 strains infect human cells more readily than historical samples; mutations involve hemagglutinin and neuraminidase, increasing binding to respiratory mucosa receptors. No sustained human transmission demonstrated yet, but constant surveillance is vital, especially in mammal–poultry contacts, to prevent spillovers and potential reassortment. Strengthened risk communication and data from labs will inform preparedness for significant mutants and outbreaks, including possible pandemics.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ、イタリアで初の人間感染例：ウイルスはどの程度危険か？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。H9N2の人間感染例はイタリアで初、中国での報告との関連性から国際的懸念が高く、遺伝子変異による人間受容体への結合能向上が指摘されている。
triage.notes: 患者はイタリア（Lombardia州Milan）で確認されたが、感染は欧州以外の国（サマリーで中国との関連が明記）で発生。対象国はChinaのみ。H9N2の遺伝子変異による人間受容体への結合能向上、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、パンデミックリスクが専門家により指摘されており、国際的サーベイランスの強化が重要視されている。

article.articleHeadline: Botucatu realiza Dia D de vacinação contra Influenza e Dengue neste sábado | Jornal Acontece Botucatu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Botucatu holds D-Day vaccination against influenza and dengue this Saturday | Jornal Acontece Botucatu
article.articleSummary: Botucatu, Brazil, will hold a D-Day vaccination drive on Saturday, March 28, 2026, for influenza and dengue, offered at all municipal health units from 8:00 to 17:00. To receive doses, attendees must visit the nearest unit with updated registration, photo ID, and vaccination card. Influenza vaccination during Day D will be limited to priority groups defined by health authorities; dengue vaccination will be available to residents aged 15–59. The campaign targets individuals who have not yet been immunized and seeks to strengthen prevention as respiratory virus circulation rises and dengue cases increase. The event underscores the importance of vaccination during the current period of heightened viral activity and aims to ensure access across the city’s health network.

triage.headline_ja: ボツカツで土曜日にインフルエンザとデング熱に対するワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施 | ジョルナル・アコンテセ・ボツカツ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルにおける定期的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知であり、新規感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクのいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の新規発生やアウトブレイク報告ではなく、ルーチンな公衆衛生介入（ワクチン接種キャンペーン）の告知である。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定される。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Surto de H1N1? Veja o que os números dizem | Exame
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 outbreak? See what the numbers say | Exame
article.articleSummary: H1N1 (Influenza A) cases linked to SRAG prompted the Maria Montessori School in Maceió, Alagoas, to suspend in-person classes for 9th grade and shift to remote learning through March 25. The school did not publish a case count. Fiocruz data show 7,523 H1N1-associated SRAG cases up to March, and SUS InfoGripe stratifies infections by virus. Fiocruz also notes 18 of Brazil's 27 state capitals are at alert or high risk of contagion. Vaccination is emphasized as the best preventive measure, with the D-Day set for Saturday, March 28; priority groups include children, pregnant women, and adults over 60. H1N1 often presents as a strong flu-like illness, but progression can cause shortness of breath, dizziness, and muscle weakness, warranting medical care.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1の流行？数字が語ること | Exame
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるH1N1関連SRAG症例が増加傾向を示し、複数の州都が警戒・高リスク状況にあるが、現時点では具体的な死亡数や重症度の詳細が不明。追加情報の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルのアラゴアス州マセイオで学校が遠隔学習に移行するなど、社会的関心が高まっている。Fiocruz報告による7,523件のH1N1関連SRAG症例、27州都中18州都が警戒・高リスク状況にあるという点から長期曝露リスクと流行しやすさが認められる。ただし、死亡数、入院数、実際の重症度分布、国際的な拡大リスクについては記事に明記されていないため、IHR基準やスクリーニング基準の一部が不明。続報による確認を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Com 98% de ocupação, Dourados ganha 15 leitos para casos de chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 98% occupancy, Dourados gets 15 beds for chikungunya cases.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil triggers emergency measures as of March 24. The SES allocated 15 exclusive beds for chikungunya at Hospital Regional de Dourados—10 adult and 5 pediatric—with occupancy at 98% (347 of 353 beds used) by March 23. The hospital hosts 100 beds total, including 20 ICU, with the dedicated chikungunya beds within this structure. Confirmed cases rose from 648 to 721; 565 cases are under investigation, 218 discarded; 1,504 notifications; probable cases reach 1,286. Four chikungunya deaths have been recorded in an Indigenous Reserve where the outbreak began. Prevention focuses on eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites and avoiding standing water in bottles, tires, plant pots, and open tanks. Symptoms include high fever, severe joint pain, headache, and rash; patients should seek health care and avoid self-medication. The measure is temporary, valid while care needs persist.

triage.headline_ja: 98%の占有率で、ドゥラードスはチクングニア症例向けに15床を確保
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでチクングニアの流行が発生し、病院の緊急対応（専門病床の確保）、確認症例の増加（648→721件）、死亡例（4件）、大規模な調査中症例と通知が記録されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: マットグロッソドスル州ドゥラードスで進行中の流行。先住民保護区での死亡4件を含む。ベクター制御（Aedes aegypti）が継続的に必要。一時的な措置とされているが、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: وہ انفیکشن جو برسوں تک چھپا رہ کر جسم پر اچانک حملہ کرتا ہے
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Infection That Lies Hidden for Years and Suddenly Attacks the Body.
article.articleSummary: TB (tuberculosis) is an airborne infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, primarily affecting the lungs but also targeting lymph nodes, bones, and the brain. Last year, about 10.6 million people globally contracted TB, with 15-20% of cases being extrapulmonary TB. Transmission occurs via inhalation of airborne droplets; extrapulmonary TB can progress quietly with few symptoms, delaying diagnosis. TB has three stages: primary infection, latent infection, and active disease. In active TB, symptoms include persistent cough, coughing up blood, fever, night sweats, weight loss, fatigue, and chest pain; lymph node TB presents as painless swelling; spinal TB causes chronic back pain. TB is curable with timely diagnosis and complete treatment. Latent TB treatment lasts 3-4 months; active TB treatment lasts 4-9 months. High-risk regions include Pakistan, India, and other developing countries.

triage.headline_ja: 数年間隠れて体に突然攻撃する感染症
triage.triage_reason: 結核についての一般的な医学情報・啓発記事であり、新規の感染症発生イベント、異常な流行、または対応すべき具体的事例の報告ではない。公開情報に基づく教育的コンテンツである。
triage.notes: 記事はパキスタンのURDU言語ニュースサイトで配信された結核に関する一般啓発記事。具体的な新規イベント、アウトブレイク、または異常な流行報告ではなく、既知の疾患についての医学情報である。高リスク地域としてパキスタンとインドが言及されているが、これは統計情報の提示であり、現在の具体的な公衆衛生危機の兆候ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Norovirus dikesan di sekolah rendah di Shanxi, China
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Norovirus detected at a primary school in Shanxi, China.
article.articleSummary: Norovirus detected in Taiyuan, Shanxi Province, northern China, at a primary school. Vomiting and diarrhea affecting many students. Initial laboratory testing confirms Norovirus infection, according to local education authorities as reported by Xinhua. A district education bureau official said over 100 students have taken leave, with classes suspended and teachers delivering online lessons to keep others on track. Authorities are tightening sanitation and infection-control measures as they verify the exact case count and potential outbreak scope. No fatalities reported. It remains unclear whether cases are imported or linked to a single school, and there is no information on transmission source beyond the Norovirus finding. Published March 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 中国山西省ノロウイルス検出 - 太原市の小学校で集団発症
triage.triage_reason: ノロウイルスの学校集団発症として異常・予想外性があり、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当が見られるが、100名超の学生が影響を受けており対応中のため、続報による詳細情報（正確な患者数、二次感染の有無、地域拡大の可能性）の確認が必要。
triage.notes: ノロウイルスは一般的な呼吸器・消化器病原体であり、重症度は低い（死亡なし）。ただし学校での集団発症は異常/予想外で、多くの学生が影響を受けており（100名超が欠席）、感染対策が強化されている。患者数の詳細確認、二次感染・地域拡大の有無、感染源の特定等の続報が必要であるためWATCHレベルとした。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo identifica Salmonella em pisciculturas do Centro-Oeste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study identifies Salmonella in fish farms in the Central-West.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella spp. identified in fish-farm environments across Brazil's Central-West, with 88% of evaluated properties contaminated and 31.5% of samples from Mato Grosso testing positive. Study analyzed 184 samples from ponds in the Pantanal and Cerrado biomes, including fish, water, sediment, feed, and animal feces. Ten Salmonella serotypes were detected, predominating Saintpaul and Newport. Moderate resistance to several antibiotics observed; no multidrug-resistant strains reported. Contamination was higher in fish viscera and more frequent during the dry season, suggesting environmental and management factors drive transmission. Wildlife and domestic animals accessing ponds cited as key risk factors. Presence of Salmonella in production environments does not automatically contaminate finished seafood; processing steps, proper storage, and cooking are critical. Authors call for expanded One Health–based monitoring and stronger biosafety practices in aquaculture.

triage.headline_ja: 中西部の養魚場でサルモネラ菌を特定する研究
triage.triage_reason: 環境サンプルからのサルモネラ検出であり、人の感染症outbreak の報告ではない。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクは明確でない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの養魚場環境（池、堆積物、飼料、動物糞便など）でのサルモネラ菌の検出に関する研究報告であり、人の感染症outbreak ではない。対象国リストにはブラジルが含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。水産物の処理・保管・加熱により汚染は軽減可能との記述があり、公衆衛生上の直接的な危機は限定的と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: HDT-UFNT alerta para avanço da dengue em Araguaína
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HDT-UFNT warns of dengue's spread in Araguaína.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak in Araguaína, Tocantins, Brazil, with confirmed cases rising about 20% in one week: 1,751 on March 12 to 2,067 on March 19. In total, 3,309 dengue cases have been reported with four deaths during this period, and 104 of the confirmed cases show warning signs. HDT-UFNT, a Tropical Diseases Hospital affiliated with Ebserh, serves as a regional reference for infectious diseases in northern Tocantins, southern Pará, and parts of Maranhão. Dengue presents with fever, body pains, headache, and malaise; management is supportive, with hydration, rest, fever/pain control, and avoidance of NSAIDs or acetylsalicylic acid due to bleeding risk. Mild cases may be outpatient; severe cases require hospitalization for IV hydration and monitoring. The surge strains health services, necessitating bed reorganization and heightened surveillance; community prevention is essential, with urgent care advised if warning signs appear (severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, dizziness, bleeding, or excessive sleepiness).

triage.headline_ja: HDT-UFNTがアラグアイナにおけるデング熱の拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・トカンティンス州アラグアイナにおけるデング熱の急速な拡大（1週間で約20%増加）と複数の死亡例が報告されており、IHR基準で2項目以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性（医療体制への負荷）が該当し、フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジルのトカンティンス州アラグアイナにおけるデング熱の状況を主題としており、この地域が北部トカンティンス、南部パラ、マラニャンの一部を対象とする地域参照病院（HDT-UFNT）の管轄地域であることが示されている。1週間での約20%の症例増加、3,309件の報告事例、4件の死亡、104件の警告兆候を示す症例という数値は、緊急かつ異常な状況を示唆している。医療施設の逼迫が報告されており、管理可能性の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue em Minas Gerais crescem 23% em uma semana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases in Minas Gerais rise 23% in one week.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, dengue in Minas Gerais rose 23% in seven days, with confirmed cases up from 8,000 to 10,000 per SES-MG. Six dengue deaths in 2026, with 14 under investigation, and about 31,800 suspected cases awaiting confirmation. Chikungunya has 2,881 confirmed cases and one death, with another death under investigation. Zika has three confirmed cases, no deaths. In Belo Horizonte, 2026 figures show 209 dengue and 16 chikungunya. The Triângulo Mineiro region has the highest dengue concentration; North and West regions show upticks, partly due to SINAN notification data instabilities. Chikungunya is more frequent in Triângulo Norte, notably in Ituiutaba, Araguari, and Uberlandia, influenced by trends in neighboring states. The main strategy remains prevention, as around 80% of Aedes breeding sites are indoors. Recommended actions: eliminate standing water in plant pots, clean gutters, declutter yards, and perform at least 10 minutes of weekly domestic inspection. Authorities stress ongoing monitoring and community participation to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州のデング熱患者数が1週間で23%増加
triage.triage_reason: デング熱、チクングニア、ジカウイルスの同時流行により複数の公衆衛生基準に該当。1週間で23%の急速な増加、死亡例の報告、30,000件超の疑い患者がいるため、IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性）とWPRO基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行易性）の複数基準を満たす。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州における3つのアルボウイルス（デング熱、チクングニア、ジカウイルス）の同時流行。デング熱は1週間で確認患者数が8,000から10,000に急増（23%増）し、疑い患者は約31,800件。死亡例は確認6件、調査中14件。チクングニア確認患者2,881件（死亡1件）。公衆衛生当局による積極的な監視・予防啓発がなされている。ただしWHO通知基準の国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクについては現報告では明確ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Combate à dengue é primeiro desafio de coalizão global de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fighting dengue is the first challenge of the global health coalition.
article.articleSummary: Dengue is identified as the first challenge of a new global health coalition, with Fiocruz serving as the executive secretariat and leveraging international cooperation to build local scientific, technological, and industrial capacity across Africa and Latin America. Brazil’s Health Ministry will begin 100% national production of Tacrolimus, an immunosuppressant for transplant recipients, through a transfer completed with India; about 120,000 Brazilians receive Tacrolimus via SUS, at roughly R$1,500–2,000 per month, lifelong. Local production ensures supply during conflicts, wars, pandemics, or other disruptions. A new center for mRNA vaccine production will be established at the Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais (UFMG). Brazil already has two platforms at Fiocruz and Instituto Butantan; total government investment exceeds R$150 million, plus an additional R$65 million for the UFMG center, enabling three public institutions to produce mRNA vaccines and rapidly respond to emerging pathogens."

triage.headline_ja: デング熱との戦いがグローバルヘルスコアリションの最初の課題である
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の新しいグローバルヘルスコアリション認定と地域的容量構築を扱う重要なニュースであるが、具体的な疾病アウトブレイクのシグナル（症例数増加、死亡、異常な広がり）が記事サマリーに記載されていない。政策・協力枠組みの発表である可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱制御に関する政策発表・国際協力枠組みの構築を扱っており、アクティブなアウトブレイク情報ではない。ブラジルとインドはタクロリムス生産技術移転および新型コロナワクチン生産施設構築に関連して言及されている。アフリカは地域として言及されているが具体的な対象国が特定されていないため除外した。続報でデング症例の実際の増加や異常が報告される場合はPICKUPへの更新を検討する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura leva ações de prevenção contra dengue a mais 16 bairros - Prefeitura da Cidade do Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall expands dengue prevention measures to 16 more neighborhoods - City Hall of the City of Rio de Janeiro
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro's Municipal Health Secretariat expands dengue prevention to 16 additional neighborhoods across the North, South, Southwest, and West zones under the SVS na Rua program to intensify control of Aedes aegypti and curb dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The initiative, launched March 25, includes areas such as Rio Comprido, Vila Isabel, Recreio dos Bandeirantes, Vila Valqueire, Gardênia Azul, and Campo Grande, with Copacabana, Freguesia (Ilha), Higienópolis, Riachuelo, Marechal Hermes, Irajá, Bangu, Santa Cruz, Paciência, Sepetiba, and Campo Grande again planned for March 26. Through March 7, 2026, the city logged 2,125,694 property inspections and 286,333 containers possibly breeding Aedes aegypti being treated or eliminated; in 2025 there were 12,297,072 property visits and 1,684,674 containers treated/eliminated. Alongside vector-control, SMS conducts educational and mobilization actions, and residents can request inspections or report breeding sites via Central 1746.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ市保健局、デング熱予防対策を16地区に拡大 - リオデジャネイロ市庁舎
triage.triage_reason: デング熱、ジカウイルス、チクングニアに対する予防管理活動の報道であり、新規発症の急激な増加や異常な流行を示唆する内容ではない。既知の流行に対する公保健当局による組織的な対応である。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルのリオデジャネイロ市における既知の媒介蚊（ネッタイシマカ）に対する継続的な予防管理活動の報道であり、新規のシグナルではない。2026年3月25日時点での検査件数およびコンテナ処理の統計情報を含むが、異常な患者増加や重症者の報告はなく、当局による組織的対応が機能している状況を示す。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、本イベントは既知の流行域での定常的な公保健対応であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: 'Xô Dengue': forças-tarefas acontecerão no Tamoio e no Tarumã
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: 'Down with Dengue': task forces will be deployed in Tamoio and Tarumã.
article.articleSummary: Dengue control efforts are underway in Jundiaí, Brazil, under the Xô Dengue campaign, with a task force to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites on March 26-27, 2026. From 9:00 to 12:00 local time, teams will conduct door-to-door visits and remove water-collecting materials. On March 26, activities occur in the Tamoio neighborhood; on March 27, in Tarumã. Items to be collected include unusable tires, empty cans, toilets, plastic basins, and polyethylene water tanks; asbestos-containing materials such as certain water tanks will not be collected. The effort focuses on source reduction to curb dengue transmission and complements ongoing vector-control work. The article does not report dengue case counts, laboratory confirmations, or infection sources related to this operation.

triage.headline_ja: 「さようならデング熱」：タモイオ地区とタルマン地区でタスクフォースが展開される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱の制御活動（蚊の繁殖地排除キャンペーン）の実施案内であり、新規感染症イベント（患者発生・流行拡大）の報告ではない。患者数、確定診断、感染状況に関する情報がなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は定期的なデング熱対策キャンペーン（蚊駆除・源泉対策）の実施告知であり、感染症の流行拡大やアウトブレイクを示唆する情報を含まない。公開されたシグナル検出ではなく、ルーチンの疫病管理活動である。

article.articleHeadline: Divisão de Zoonoses de Limeira identificou 230 criadouros de dengue no último mutirão | Rápido no Ar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Limeira Zoonoses Division identified 230 dengue breeding sites in the latest campaign | Rápido no Ar
article.articleSummary: Limeira’s Zoonoses Division conducted another mutirão against Aedes aegypti, the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya vector. On Saturday, March 21, the operation targeted the Jardim João Levy, Jardim Orestes Veroni, Jardim Barão de Souza Queiroz, Jardim São Pedro, Jardim Grêmio, and Jardim Boa Esperança neighborhoods. Eighty-four agents inspected 2,309 properties as part of the dengue-control campaign. They identified 230 dengue breeding sites; 114 contained water, and eight showed mosquito larvae, signaling active larval development. The effort underscores ongoing municipal measures to reduce Aedes aegypti populations and prevent transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya in Limeira, São Paulo state. No case counts are reported; the findings reflect surveillance outcomes from the latest round of door-to-door inspections."

triage.headline_ja: リメイラ市の動物媒介感染症部門が最新のキャンペーンで230箇所のデング熱繁殖地を特定
triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱の媒介蚊（ネッデス・エジプティ）の幼虫飼育地の監視・駆除活動を報道しており、実際の感染症患者の発生報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事は蚊の幼虫飼育地の機械的な検出・除去結果を報道する定型的な環境サーベイランス活動である。患者発生、疾患の異常な増加、または公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報は含まれていない。ルーチンの害虫駆除キャンペーン報道としてシグナル値なし。

article.articleHeadline: MS lidera o ranking nacional de incidência de chikungunya e um terço das mortes estão no Estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MS leads the national incidence ranking for chikungunya, and one-third of the deaths are in the state.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul (MS) leads Brazil in chikungunya incidence with 103.9 cases per 100,000 and 3,038 probable cases for 2026. Nationally there are 19,537 probable cases, 12 deaths confirmed, and 13 under investigation; MS accounts for about 15.5% of cases and a third of deaths. Dourados, MS’s epicenter, has 564 probable cases, with four deaths in an indigenous reserve; the SUS National Task Force is aiding outbreaks in villages. After a February surge, weekly cases in Dourados fell 63.8% (94 to 34; 8–14 Mar to 15–21 Mar). The MS outbreak began Feb 15, peaking at 477 suspected cases in seven days in early March, then easing but remaining above January and national levels. CHIKV is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; fever and incapacitating arthralgia predominate, with risks of chronic joint pain and cardiovascular/renal/neural complications.

triage.headline_ja: MS（マットグロッソドスル州）がチクングニア熱の全国発生率ランキングで1位、死亡者の3分の1が同州に集中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるチクングニア熱の顕著な流行で、国内最高の発生率（10万人当たり103.9件）と死亡者集中が報告されており、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさの複数基準を満たす。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内流行。マットグロッソドスル州が国内最大の発生地。先住民居住区での死亡例（4件）を含む。記事配信日は2026年3月25日で、将来日付であるが、記事内容に矛盾はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Sulbar: Peningkatan temuan kasus TBC indikator deteksi dini membaik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Sulawesi Health Office: Increase in TB case findings indicates early-detection indicators are improving.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) case finding in West Sulawesi (Sulbar) improved in February 2026, signaling better early-detection indicators. The Sulbar Health Office reports an 8% year-on-year increase from February 2025, with 595 cases found of an estimated 4,357 TB cases for 2026 (13.7%). Mamuju and Majene surpassed monthly targets at 21.4% and 19.2%, respectively. Majene recorded the largest rise (+44% vs last year); Mamuju (+10%) and Polewali Mandar (+13%). In contrast, Mamasa, Mamuju Tengah, and Pasangkayu showed declines, prompting reinforced active case finding. The program emphasizes active case finding (ACF), optimized rapid molecular testing (TCM), and intensive district-level support, particularly for Mamasa, Mamuju Tengah, and Pasangkayu. The effort aligns with regional health plans and the national goal to eliminate TB in 2026, requiring active community and facility engagement.

triage.headline_ja: 西スラウェシ州保健局：結核患者発見数の増加が早期検出指標の改善を示す
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、西スラウェシ州での患者発見数の増加は早期検出プログラムの成功を示す良好なニュースである。疾患の異常性、重症度の急上昇、国際的拡大リスク、または公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 西スラウェシ州での結核患者発見数の増加は、実は早期検出・積極的症例検出プログラムの効果を示す肯定的な指標である。新規の異常発生（アウトブレイク）ではなく、既知の風土病における検出能力の改善を報告している。感染症危機として認識される必要はない。

article.articleHeadline: Material furtado na Unicamp era amostras de vírus armazenadas em laboratório com maior nível de biossegurança do Brasil - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stolen material at Unicamp was virus samples stored in a laboratory with Brazil's highest biosafety level.
article.articleSummary: Virus samples stolen from Unicamp were stored in a Biosafety Level 3 (BSL-3) area, Brazil’s current highest biosafety designation, and were confirmed as viruses by a Federal Court document granting provisional release to professor Soledad Palameta Miller on March 24, 2026. Federal Police had located the material in laboratories at the university’s Food Engineering Faculty, where the researcher worked, after investigating missing boxes from the Animal Virology Laboratory of the Institute of Biology. Investigations indicate movements and storage occurred in non-controlled environments, and some material was discarded in ordinary trash, posing health risks to bystanders. The case may involve charges of exposing life or health to danger, irregular transport of genetically modified organisms, and procedural fraud. Unicamp has launched an internal inquiry and continues cooperating with authorities. MAPA will analyze the material; Anvisa provided technical support. A Brazilian BSL-4 lab is planned in Campinas with completion in 2027.

triage.headline_ja: ユニキャンプで盗まれた物質はブラジルの最高度バイオセーフティレベルの実験室に保管されたウイルスサンプルであった
triage.triage_reason: 未確認疾患（Unknown Illness）の分類、盗難されたウイルスサンプルの具体的な病原体特定が不明、人間への実際の感染報告がないため。ただしバイオセキュリティ侵害と潜在的な公衆衛生リスクを考慮し経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: イベントはブラジル・カンピナス市のユニキャンプで発生したウイルスサンプル盗難事件。具体的な病原体が特定されていない（Unknown Illness）ため、公衆衛生への直接的な脅威は現時点で不確定。ただし、BSL-3保管ウイルスの不正な環境への移動・廃棄、複数の人間への曝露可能性が報告されており、バイオセキュリティ侵害としての重要性は高い。続報で盗まれたウイルスの具体的な特定と実際の感染例の有無が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus oropouche já infectou mais de 5 milhões de pessoas no Brasil, sugere estudo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oropouche virus has already infected more than 5 million people in Brazil, study suggests.
article.articleSummary: Oropouche virus infections in Latin America are far higher than official counts. Two studies in Nature Medicine and Nature Health estimate that since 1960 about 9.4 million people in Latin America and the Caribbean have been infected, with Brazil accounting for about 5.5 million. The 2023 Brazil outbreak logged over 30,000 cases and the first death from the disease in the country, with spread to all states. In Manaus, Amazonas, estimated 300,000 infections occurred in 2023–2024, with seroprevalence rising from 11.4% to 25.7% by November 2024. The virus is transmitted by Culicoides paraensis (mosquito-pólvora/maruim), a rural vector; incidence is ~11 times higher in rural than urban areas. Two Manaus waves (1980s and 2023) each infected >12% of residents. Cross-neutralization suggests lasting protection; Espírito Santo shows the highest cumulative rate (318 per 100k) and Southeast Brazil accounts for 58% of notifications. Symptoms mimic dengue and can include meningitis and microcephaly.

triage.headline_ja: オロポーシェウイルスはブラジルで既に500万人以上に感染、研究が示唆
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（500万人以上の感染）と異常性（初の死亡例・全州への拡大）が認められ、WPROスクリーニングでも重症度（死亡例）・長期曝露・流行性が確認される。国際支援の可能性も検討される。
triage.notes: オロポーシェは蚊媒介性疾患で、ブラジル全土で約550万人が感染（公式統計の大幅過小評価）。2023年初の死亡例とすべての州への拡大は異常性を示す。デング熱類似症状に加え髄膜炎・小頭症も報告されている。ラテンアメリカ全体では940万人が感染とのことだが、本トリアージの対象国はBrazilのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana marks World TB Day with renewed call to end disease - MyJoyOnline
article.articleSummary: Ghana marks World TB Day 2026 with renewed commitment to end tuberculosis, led by communities. Deputy Health Minister Grace Ayensu-Danquah notes about 44,000 Ghanaians develop TB annually, with fewer than half detected and treated. To close the gap, the government is deploying AI-enabled digital X-ray systems, procuring 15 GeneXpert machines, and distributing TB-LAM test kits, complemented by the Free Primary Healthcare programme to boost early detection and treatment access. Ghana Health Service Director-General Samuel Kaba Akoriyea stresses identifying and treating every case to interrupt transmission. WHO Africa Representative Fiona Braka warns TB remains deadly in Africa, with one death every 83 seconds, calling for stronger leadership, greater investment, and empowered communities. The commemoration ends with a call for sustained collaboration, asserting that ending TB in Ghana is achievable through coordinated action, adequate resources, and community participation.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナが世界結核デーを迎え、結核撲滅への新たな決意を表明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はガーナの世界結核デーの記念行事と対策強化の発表であり、新規のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、既知の疾患の公衆衛生対策に関する政策発表です。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しません。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の新規発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、ガーナ政府による世界結核デーの記念式典および既知の結核対策（AI搭載デジタルX線システムの導入、GeneXpert機器の調達等）に関する政策発表です。シグナル検出の対象外として判定します。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa exige atualização de vacinas da Covid-19 com nova cepa no país | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa requires updating COVID-19 vaccines to include a new strain in the country | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Brazilian health regulator Anvisa requires COVID-19 vaccines used in Brazil to include the SARS-CoV-2 LP.8.1 strain, making vaccines monovalent with only LP.8.1. The measure, published March 25, 2026 as Normative Instruction N° 429 (dated March 23, 2026), aims to sustain protection amid viral evolution. Manufacturers must submit data on production, quality, and immunogenicity for the updated vaccines. To avoid vaccination delays, Anvisa may allow use of older JN.1-containing vaccines, at the Health Ministry's discretion, but such products will be valid for up to nine months from the update’s approval date. The Instruction revokes IN N° 377 (July 1, 2025). The decision was taken by Anvisa's Collegiate Board on March 24, 2026, and enters into force upon publication in the Diário Oficial da União.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル保健規制当局ANVISAが新型コロナワクチンの新変異株対応を要求
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19ワクチンの規制更新に関する行政措置であり、新たな感染症危機を示唆するものではない。既知の流行疾患における定期的な対応指示であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本報は既知のCOVID-19に対するワクチン規制の更新に関する行政通知。新規感染症イベント（シグナル）ではなく、確立された感染症制御の枠組み内での措置である。

article.articleHeadline: Nashik: MVP Nursing College Holds TB Awareness Rally On World TB Day
article.articleSummary: Nashik, India—On World TB Day, the MVP Nursing Education Institute at Adgaon organized a TB awareness rally to promote eradication of tuberculosis. Third-year B.Sc. Nursing students (5th semester) participated, with the theme 'Yes! We Can End TB: Country Leadership, People's Power.' The objective was to convey that TB can be cured with timely diagnosis, appropriate treatment, and public awareness, and to spur student involvement. Guidance came from Adv. Nitin Thakare, Dr DD Lokhande, and college principal Dr Pournima Naik, with associate professors Sara Tomy and Jakira Patel and clinical instructors Neha Kedare, Vishal Pagar, and Dhairya Londhe supporting the effort. Activities included an awareness rally in Adgaon, flashcards, posters, and street plays at the Dr Vasantrao Pawar Medical College, detailing TB causes, symptoms, and prevention. The initiative heightened local awareness and fostered social responsibility among students.

triage.headline_ja: ナシク：MVP看護大学がWorld TB Dayに結核啓発ラリーを開催
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核啓発イベント（教育活動）の報道であり、新たな感染症の発生や流行を報告するものではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準いずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の啓発キャンペーン・教育イベントに関するニュースであり、感染症アウトブレイクや異常な発生を報告していない。World TB Day（3月24日）に関連した年間の定期的な啓発活動である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Petrolina registra médio risco para dengue após levantamento e intensifica ações de combate
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Petrolina records medium risk for dengue after survey and intensifies control measures.
article.articleSummary: Petrolina, Brazil, was classified as medium risk for Aedes aegypti after the March 9–13 LIRAa survey, with an average infestation index of 1.9%. High-risk neighborhoods include Dom Malan, Areia Branca, Maria Auxiliadora, and Vila Débora (5.1%), Novo Tempo and Pedra Linda (4.3%), and São Gonçalo, Jardim Petrópolis, Park São Gonçalo (3.6%). The survey covered 118 urban localities; only Terras do Sul and José e Maria (0.9%), Cosme e Damião (0.5%), and João de Deus, São Jorge and Vila Eulália (0.2%) had indices below 1%. The city will intensify vector-control with "Sexta Sem Aedes" on Friday, March 27, targeting Novo Tempo and Park Massangano, and a dengue-control mutirão on Saturday, March 28, in José e Maria, Vila Eduardo, Areia Branca, Dom Avelar, Ouro Preto, Jardim Maravilha. Residents are urged to remove standing-water containers to curb transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: ペトロリーナ、調査後にデング熱の中程度リスクを記録し、対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の媒介蚊（ネッデス・エジプティ）による中程度リスク記録。蚊の繁殖指数が示され、市当局が対策を強化している局面であるが、既存の流行状況やIHR基準を満たす深刻性の明確な証拠は記事内に限定的。情報充実後の評価が必要。
triage.notes: ペトロリーナはブラジル北東部ペルナンブーコ州の都市。記事はLIRAa調査（蚊の幼虫指数調査）結果に基づく媒介蚊の中程度リスク判定と地域別詳細データ、市当局による段階的対策を報告している。3疾患（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）すべてが同じ媒介蚊（ネッデス・エジプティ）で伝播し、長期的曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行しやすさ（epidemic_prone）の基準を満たす。ただし記事は予防的対策段階の情報であり、現在の患者数、死亡数、急速な増加傾向などの重症度を示す情報は記載されていない。WATCHレベルで経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: How Wadhwani AI is supporting India's TB care system - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: TB in India: Wadhwani AI’s CATB app deployed by CHOs in Meghalaya’s Shilliang Myntang screens cough data offline, flagging presumptive TB with a red/green marker and prompting treatment restart for patients previously nonadherent. Across India, the Ministry of Health, Central TB Division, and NTEP integrate AI tools into Ni-kshay and workflows to boost detection, adherence, and outcomes. Vulnerability Mapping for TB (VMTB) uses geospatial analytics to target high-risk districts, guiding active case finding. CATB has screened over 175,000 people, identifying more than 27,500 presumptive TB cases. For treatment adherence, PATO flags high-risk patients after treatment start; over two million records analyzed, more than 800,000 high-risk. In Maharashtra, senior treatment supervisor (STS) Vishal Mirajkar tracks patients via Ni-kshay and coordinates follow-up. LPA Automation automates reading of Line Probe Assay results across 97 NTEP-certified labs, improving lab efficiency within Ni-kshay.

triage.headline_ja: ワードワーニAIがインドのTB治療システムをサポート - CNBC TV18
triage.triage_reason: 結核の既知疾患であり、記事は政府・AIツール統合による診断・治療管理の技術的な支援について述べている。異常な集団発生、高い死亡率、国際的な感染拡大リスク、または渡航制限を示唆する要素がない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の既知流行に対するインド政府およびNTEP（National TB Elimination Program）によるAI技術の導入・統合を報じたものであり、新規イベント（新興感染症、異常な集団発生、死亡増加）ではない。制度的な技術支援についての報道であり、緊急のシグナルスクリーニング対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Bebê de 3 meses morre por chikungunya; é o 5º óbito registrado em MS este ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 3-month-old baby dies from Chikungunya; it is the 5th death recorded in Mato Grosso do Sul this year.
article.articleSummary: On 24 March 2026, a one-month-old baby died of chikungunya in Jaguapiru Indigenous Village, Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil; burial planned for 25 March. This is the fifth chikungunya death in Mato Grosso do Sul this year and the second child among fatalities in the Dourados Indigenous Reserve. Other victims: a 69-year-old woman (Jaguapiru, 26 Feb); a 73-year-old man (Jaguapiru, 9 Mar); a 3-month-old (Bororó, 10 Mar); a 60-year-old woman (Jaguapiru, 12 Mar). A task force operated in Jaguapiru and Bororó: 4,319 properties inspected, 2,173 locations treated, 1,004 mosquito breeding sites identified (mostly water tanks, trash, tires); 43 properties sprayed; two insecticide units; 86 endemic agents; 29 indigenous health agents. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and can cause fever and joint pain; severe cases may involve encephalitis, meningitis, or paralysis. The government regards this as an epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: 生後3ヶ月の赤ちゃんがチクングニアで死亡；マットグロッソドスル州今年の5番目の死亡事例
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マットグロッソドスル州でのチクングニア流行による重症死亡例（乳幼児含む）が報告されており、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常・予想外の事象」に該当。同州で複数の致死例が継続発生中であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: マットグロッソドスル州ドウラドス地域のジャグアピル先住民村を中心にチクングニア流行。2026年1月以降、同州で5件の死亡例（乳幼児2名を含む）が報告。タスクフォース対応実施中（媒介蚊駆除、ブリーディングサイト処理など）。記事見出しに「1ヶ月齢」と「3ヶ月齢」の表記の不一致があるが、サマリーでは「one-month-old」と記載。政府が流行状況を認識していることが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Bilim İnsanları Uyardı: Kedilerden İnsanlara Bulaşan Tehlikeli Mantar Yayılıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists Warn: A Dangerous Fungus Transmitted From Cats to Humans Is Spreading.
article.articleSummary: Sporothrix brasiliensis, a fungus transmitted from cats to humans, is spreading rapidly. On 2026-03-25 scientists and health authorities warn of new Uruguay-detected cases, confirming that the Brazil-origin pathogen has crossed borders and established a foothold in the region. Epidemiological data indicate a transmission chain extending beyond isolated cases, suggesting ongoing spread within communities and complicating containment. The situation raises the risk of further spread to additional countries as cross-border activity increases. No case counts or fatalities are provided in the report, and laboratory confirmation details are not specified. The development underscores regional public health implications and the need for enhanced surveillance, reporting, and coordinated feline–human transmission control measures across neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者が警告：猫から人間に感染する危険なキノコが拡大しています
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。ブラジル起源の新興真菌感染症（Sporothrix brasiliensis）がウルグアイに国境を越えて拡大しており、人獣感染メカニズムを伴う点で公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ウルグアイでの新規症例確認は記載されているが、対象国リストにウルグアイは含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ブラジル起源の病原体がウルグアイに拡大した点で国際的拡大リスクが立証されている。症例数・致死率の具体的データが不足しているため severity は不明と評価。人獣感染（猫から人間）と継続的なコミュニティ内伝播チェーンが示唆されている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Sessões Colaborativas do PROCC abrem o ciclo de 2026 com debate sobre esporotricose | Portal Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PROCC Collaborative Sessions Open the 2026 Cycle with a Debate on Sporotrichosis | Fiocruz Portal
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis, a cat-transmitted zoonosis caused by Sporothrix fungi, remains endemic in Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil, affecting both cats and humans. On 1 April 2026 at 12:30, Fiocruz PROCC Collaborative Sessions open the 2026 cycle with a debate on this disease. The online session features Mariana da Rocha, a veterinary physician and epidemiology master’s student at ENSP, presenting her dissertation: “Spatial-temporal distribution of animal and human sporotrichosis cases in the health regions of the State of Rio de Janeiro (2007-2024).” Rocha combines human and animal case data to map patterns of expansion over time and territory, informing enhanced surveillance, prevention, and control in vulnerable areas. The session is open to the scientific community and professionals and is guided by Aline Nobre, PROCC researcher and statistician at ENSP.

triage.headline_ja: PROCCコラボレーティブセッションが2026年サイクルをスポロトリコーシスに関する議論で開始 | Fiocruzポータル
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスはリオデジャネイロで風土病として認識されており、学術セミナー開催のお知らせ記事である。新規の疾病発生、異常な流行、または危機的状況を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は学術セミナー開催告知であり、スポロトリコーシスは既知の風土病として言及されている。疫学的調査研究の発表内容であり、感染症危機管理の対象となる新規シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Caramujos no quintal após a chuva: são perigosos para a saúde? - Super Rádio Tupi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Snails in the backyard after the rain: are they dangerous to health?
article.articleSummary: After rain, Brazilian yards host snails, especially the invasive African giant snail (Achatina fulica). Despite attention, human disease transmission risk in Brazil is considered low. Snails can carry parasites such as Angiostrongylus cantonensis, causing angiostrongyliasis with abdominal and eosinophilic meningoencephalitis forms. Human infection occurs by eating raw or undercooked snails or foods contaminated with snail mucus. There are no Brazil-recorded cases of eosinophilic meningitis linked to Achatina fulica; the disease exists in the country but is primarily associated with other snail species. A. fulica is not a good host, making transmission very rare. Meningioencephalitis presents with severe headache, neck stiffness, fever, vomiting; abdominal disease with pain, fever, potential bowel perforation. Dogs and cats are also at risk. Do not touch snails with bare hands; wear thick gloves or use plastic bags. Prevention emphasizes keeping yards clean and removing debris and damp shelter.

triage.headline_ja: 雨の後の庭のカタツムリ：健康に危険か？
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのアフリカマイマイ（Achatina fulica）による寄生虫感染の可能性を報道しているが、記事サマリーは現地の医学的リスクが低いと明記しており、実際の発症事例報告は記載されていない。異常検知としては妥当だが、情報が限定的で続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症リスクの啓発記事であり、実際の発症者や集団発症の報告は含まれていない。ブラジルではA. fulicaは良好なホストではなく伝播は稀という評価が医学的根拠として示されている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（重症度や死亡）の記載がないため、IHR基準は最小限。WPROスクリーニングでは異常性と長期的曝露リスクの認識が該当。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus oropouche pode ter causado até 200 vezes mais infecções que casos registrados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oropouche virus may have caused up to 200 times more infections than reported cases.
article.articleSummary: Oropouche virus infections in Latin America and the Caribbean are estimated at over 9.4 million (1960–2025), with Brazil accounting for about 5.5 million, far exceeding officially reported cases. A Nature Medicine study led by USP’s Medical School (with University of Kentucky, Unicamp, and Hemoam) finds Manaus as a central hotspot where infections may be up to 200 times higher than diagnosed cases. Antibody surveys show Manaus rising from 11.4% to 25.7% seroprevalence between late 2023 and mid-2024, with two major outbreaks (1980–81, 2023–24) peaking in the rainy season and affecting >12% of residents. Oropouche is transmitted by biting midges Culicoides paraensis, causing dengue-like illness that can progress to severe neurological, maternal-fetal complications, or death. No vaccine or antiviral exists. Under-detection stems from remote Amazon regions, limited healthcare access, and many asymptomatic or mild infections. The virus spreads beyond Brazil to the Caribbean and via travel to Europe/North America; rural/forest-adjacent transmission challenges urban-focused vector control. Surveillance and vaccine development are priorities.

triage.headline_ja: オロポウシュウイルスは報告された症例の200倍もの感染を引き起こした可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで940万人以上の推定感染者を持つ新興アルボウイルス感染症であり、マナウスでは実際の感染がスクリーニング基準の複数項目（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に該当。ワクチンなし、神経学的合併症・母体胎児合併症・死亡リスクあり、国際拡大（カリブ海、ヨーロッパ、北米への旅行輸出）が起きており、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが940万人超の推定感染者、マナウスでの25.7%の血清陽性率上昇、神経学的重症合併症・死亡リスク、ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬なし、カリブ海からヨーロッパ・北米への国際拡大を明示。アマゾン地域の限定的な医療アクセス、多くの無症状・軽症感染による過小検出が特徴。WHO通知とNature Medicine論文による信頼性の高い情報源。

article.articleHeadline: Luanda mobiliza mais de dez mil profissionais de saúde para campanha da poliomielite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Luanda mobilizes more than ten thousand health professionals for the polio vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: Poliomyelitis vaccination campaign in Luanda Province, Angola, plans to immunize about 1.94 million children aged 0–5 years, supported by 10,500 health and social support staff. The personnel are organized into roughly 3,000 teams—including vaccinators, mobilizers, registrars, supervisors, and coordinators—to operate door-to-door, in addition to fixed posts and health units. The primary strategy is house-to-house to ensure no child misses vaccination, with a target of at least 95% vaccination coverage uniformly across the capital. The campaign runs from March 26 to 28 and is framed as a preventative measure against a potential outbreak linked to neighboring Namibia and the Democratic Republic of Congo. This report highlights mass immunization as a key public health effort, though no case counts or laboratory confirmations are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: ルアンダがポリオワクチン接種キャンペーンのために10,000人以上の医療専門家を動員
triage.triage_reason: ポリオは国際的に通報義務のある重大疾患だが、本記事は予防的ワクチンキャンペーンの実施であり、確認された症例報告がない。隣国（ナミビア、DRC）での潜在的リスクが言及されているが詳細不明のため、続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にアンゴラ（ルアンダ）でのワクチンキャンペーンについてであり、DRCは隣国リスク要因として言及されているのみ。アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ナミビアも言及されているが対象国リストにない。確認された症例数やラボ確認なしで、予防措置の報道であることが特徴。ポリオ流行リスクの詳細情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Hortolândia faz eliminação de criadouros de Aedes aegypti em três regiões - Novo Momento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hortolândia eliminates Aedes aegypti breeding sites in three regions - Novo Momento.
article.articleSummary: In Hortolândia, the UVZ unit of the Health Department continues Aedes aegypti control in Jardim Interlagos, Jardim Novo Ângulo and Jardim Santa Fé, surveying residences to detect and eliminate larval breeding sites. When larvae are found, samples are collected for laboratory identification. Officials note ~80% of breeding sites are inside homes and urge residents to permit entry; agents are identifiable by badges and uniforms. Residents can verify scheduled routes by calling UVZ at (19) 3897-3312 or (19) 3897-5974. The city reports current-year case counts for dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. Dengue vaccination is available at seven UBSs (health units) from 7:30 to 15:30, with extended hours during the week to facilitate immunization. The article lists seven UBSs but does not enumerate them in the provided text.

triage.headline_ja: ホルトランディアがアエデス属蚊の3地域での幼虫繁殖地を排除 - ノーボ・モメント
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は媒介蚊駆除の予防的対策と予防接種プログラムに関する行政情報であり、異常な発生や深刻な公衆衛生影響を示す疫学データが提示されていない。ブラジルでの既知の地域的な疾患制御活動に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹感染症の通常の疫学的制御活動（蚊駆除プログラムとワクチン接種）を報じており、異常な症例集団や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は記載されていない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないが、Bluedot APIの発生地域にBrazil(3469034)が含まれているため、検証対象として記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Why prevention is better than cure when it comes to tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: TB remains a global killer, often latent and asymptomatic until immunity wanes, making awareness and early screening essential as of 2026-03-25. In India, Dr. Raj Kumar of ISIC Multispeciality Hospital in South Delhi emphasizes TB's persistence beyond poverty and stigma, noting that latent infection allows silent transmission and that awareness must address social, economic, and cultural factors. Early screening with molecular tests and chest X-rays, cast in community-based initiatives, detects TB before symptoms escalate and curtails spread, while reducing overall costs by avoiding prolonged hospitalization and expensive regimens. A holistic strategy integrates education, screening, and support within schools, workplaces, and mobile clinics, leveraging digital platforms and public-private partnerships. Recognizing risk factors—malnutrition, diabetes, smoking, close contact—helps target high-risk populations and prevents cycles of transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 結核に関しては、予防は治療より優れている理由
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の疾患であり、記事は啓発・予防戦略に関する一般的な情報提供が中心。新規の集団発生や異常な事例報告ではなく、公衆衛生の知見共有の性質が強い。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの医療専門家による結核予防・早期スクリーニングの啓発記事。既知の地風土病に対する公衆衛生介入の議論であり、急性の流行シグナルではない。ただしWPRO基準では結核の長期的曝露と流行可能性が該当するため、継続的な監視対象として位置付け。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeito anuncia aÃ§Ãµes contra a dengue e diz que prioridade Ã© preservar vidas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mayor announces measures to combat dengue and says the priority is to save lives.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak prompts public health emergency in São Raimundo Nonato, Piauí. From January to March 2026, 604 dengue cases were notified, 77 confirmed; over 300 discarded and remaining samples pending lab results. Authorities warn of a more aggressive dengue variant and a suspected dengue-related death at the UPA in São Raimundo Nonato involving a child from Bonfim do Piauí, elevating regional alert. To curb transmission, the city launches mass cleaning campaigns and strengthens vector control, deploying fogging vehicles and backpack spray devices to reach all streets, vacant lots, and homes. Officials are considering expanding rapid testing and vaccination, pending federal authorization; they have consulted the Ministry of Health about mass serology tests. A multiprofessional committee, with support from the State Government (SESAPI), coordinates actions and provides on-site technical assistance. Priority remains saving lives, despite potential tourism impacts.

triage.headline_ja: 市長が抗デング熱対策を発表、優先事項は命を守ることと述べる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのピアウイ州でデング熱の集団発生が報告されており、2026年1月～3月に604症例（確定77例）が通知され、より攻撃的な変種と疑わしい死亡事例が報告されている。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と、予想外の重症化傾向がWPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジルのピアウイ州サンライムンド・ノナト市でのデング熱集団発生を主題としており、より攻撃的な変種と疑わしい死亡事例（子ども）が報告されている点が懸念される。地方当局と州政府が対応を調整中。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus furtado na Unicamp ficava em laboratório com nível 3 de segurança
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stolen virus at Unicamp was kept in a biosafety level 3 laboratory.
article.articleSummary: Alarming theft of biological material from Universidade Estadual de Campinas (Unicamp) in Brazil, with samples stored in a Biosafety Level 3 (BSL-3) facility at the Institute of Biology. On March 23, 2026, a professor and researcher was arrested after authorities recovered stolen viral samples in her Unicamp laboratories. The missing material, first reported in February, originated from the institute’s BSL-3 suite—the highest safety level currently operating in Brazil. BSL-3 agents pose high individual risk and potentially moderate societal risk; the article notes the anthrax-causing Bacillus anthracis as an example of a dangerous pathogen. Brazil will have only one BSL-4 lab (the Orion complex, in Campinas) from 2027. The defense claims there is no material wrongdoing, suggesting she used the facility due to lack of her own infrastructure. Bail with stringent conditions: two minimum-wage fine, prohibition from implicated labs, and an internal university inquiry is underway.

triage.headline_ja: UNICAMPで盗まれたウイルスがバイオセーフティレベル3の実験室に保管されていた
triage.triage_reason: バイオセーフティレベル3施設から危険な病原体が盗難された重大なバイオセキュリティインシデント。異常かつ予想外の事象であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的な懸念を呈している。
triage.notes: バイオセキュリティインシデント：BSL-3施設から炭疽菌を含む危険な病原体サンプルが盗難された重大な事案。逮捕者が出ており、大学調査が進行中。ブラジルのバイオセーフティインフラの脆弱性が露呈され、国際的な懸念となる可能性がある。記事には人体への直接的な感染事例の報告はないが、盗難された危険病原体が社会に拡散するリスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Luanda Launches Polio Vaccination Campaign Targeting Over 1 Million Children - Africa Newswire
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, Luanda launches a three-day polio vaccination campaign targeting over 1.9 million children aged zero to five. The effort runs March 26–28 to prevent a polio outbreak that could affect neighboring Namibia and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Angola’s Expanded Program on Immunization coordinator Felismina Neto says the door-to-door strategy will also reach markets, schools, nurseries, bus stops and interprovincial points to reach every child. Preparatory steps include micro-plans, team training, and community mobilization. Polio is described as highly contagious but preventable through vaccination, and rapid immunization is essential to halt spread. The campaign aims to reduce importation of cases via cross-border movement, and families are urged to cooperate with vaccination teams to protect the province.

triage.headline_ja: ルアンダがポリオワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始、100万人以上の子どもを対象に
triage.triage_reason: ポリオは国際的に重要な感染症であり、予防接種キャンペーンは公衆衛生上の懸念を反映しています。しかし、記事は既存ケースの報告ではなく予防対応であり、対象国（DRC）ではキャンペーン実施の主要報告がないため、情報不足のため要経過観察とします。
triage.notes: 記事はアンゴラ(Luanda)でのワクチン接種キャンペーンを主題としていますが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみです。アンゴラはナミビアと共に記事に言及されていますが、対象国リストに含まれていません。既存ケース報告がなく予防対応であるため、シグナルピックアップよりも続報監視が適切と判断します。ポリオは野生型ウイルスの根絶が進む中での接種キャンペーンであり、国際的には関心が高い活動です。

article.articleHeadline: Sobe para 17 o número de casos de mpox em Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of mpox cases in Minas Gerais has risen to 17.
article.articleSummary: By 25 March 2026, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports 17 confirmed mpox cases. Eleven are in Belo Horizonte, three in Contagem, one in Ribeirão das Neves (all in the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region), plus one in Formiga (Centro-Oeste) and one in Manhuaçu (Zona da Mata). All cases are male, aged 25–56, and all patients have recovered. SES-MG notes active surveillance and urges reliance on trusted information and preventive measures. Mpox (monkeypox) is caused by an Orthopoxvirus; early symptoms include fever, headache, body aches, fatigue, and lymphadenopathy, followed by skin lesions that may involve the face, genitals, perianal area, palms, soles, and mucous membranes. Transmission is mainly through direct contact with lesions, potentially before symptoms, with an incubation of a few days to about three weeks. Vaccination is available via SUS for adults >18 with HIV/AIDS, PrEP users, and health workers, but coverage remains limited; isolation until all lesions heal is advised. Carnival season increases close-contact risk.

triage.headline_ja: ミナス・ジェライス州のmpox患者数が17人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。ブラジル国内で確認された複数地域のmpox集団発生であり、フルRRA評価を実施すべき。
triage.notes: ミナス・ジェライス州で17人の確定患者が報告されており、複数地域（ベロ・オリゾンテ大都市圏およびセントロ・オエステ地域）に分散している。全患者が男性で25-56歳。カーニバルシーズンによる密接接触リスク増加が懸念される。ワクチン接種率が限定的であり、流行性が高い。全患者が回復しているが、監視と制御可能性の継続的な評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Amambai realizou capacitação sobre combate à tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amambai Health Department Conducted Training on Tuberculosis Control.
article.articleSummary: On March 24, in observance of World Tuberculosis Day, Amambai’s Municipal Health Department held a training and lecture on active case finding for respiratory symptoms. Led by nurse Theara Farias, coordinator of Epidemiological Surveillance, the session targeted Community Health Agents (ACS) and Family Health Strategy (ESF) nurses to strengthen early detection of suspected TB cases in Amambai, Brazil. It emphasized identifying individuals with a cough lasting three weeks or more, and outlined steps for TB investigation, specimen collection, and rapid treatment initiation to interrupt transmission. The municipality notes that tuberculosis is curable and treatment is free through the Unified Health System (SUS). Those with persistent coughs are advised to visit the nearest health unit for evaluation. The program underscores proactive TB control and faster care to reduce transmission. No case counts or outbreak details were reported.

triage.headline_ja: アマンバイ保健部門が結核対策に関する研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核に関する啓発・研修活動の報告であり、新たな疾患クラスター、アウトブレイク、または異常な疾病パターンを示していない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はWorld Tuberculosis Dayに関連した定期的な保健教育活動（研修・講習会）を報告しており、新規患者数、クラスター、またはアウトブレイクに関する情報は含まれていない。症例統計は報告されていない。シグナル検出の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Bebê de 1 mês morre e pode ser a 5ª vítima de chikungunya em Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 1-month-old baby dies and could be the fifth Chikungunya victim in Dourados.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with a newborn death under investigation; if confirmed, the fifth chikungunya fatality in the state. MS leads national incidence at 103.9 cases per 100,000, with 3,038 probable cases in 2026; nationwide totals: 19,537 probable cases, 12 confirmed deaths, and 13 under investigation. In Dourados, 1,286 probable cases have been reported, 721 confirmed, 76.8% test positive; most cases in the Reserva Indígena Jaguapiru and Bororó. The city has 564 probable cases and 27 hospitalized as of March 24. MS declared an emergency; SES opened 15 beds at the Regional Hospital, with 98% occupancy. A March 23 meeting led to emergency actions including hiring 20 endemic-control agents for three months, and improved care regulation, transport, and public-private network integration. Other MS chikungunya deaths: a 3-month-old baby; a 69-year-old woman; a 73-year-old man; a 60-year-old woman.

triage.headline_ja: 1ヶ月の赤ちゃんが死亡、ドゥアラドスのチクングニア熱の5番目の犠牲者となる可能性
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマト・グロッソ・ド・スル州で急速に拡大するチクングニア熱アウトブレイク（2026年時点で19,537件の可能例、12件の確定死亡、13件が調査中）。新生児を含む重度の死亡例が多く、全国で高い発生率を記録している。IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な死亡パターン、国際的拡大のリスク）に該当。
triage.notes: ブラジルは評価対象国外（対象国リストに含まれない）だが、グローバルな公衆衛生上の脅威として国際的に重要なシグナルである。マト・グロッソ・ド・スル州は全国で最高の発生率（100,000人当たり103.9件）を記録し、先住民居住区での高い感染率（76.8%の検査陽性率）が報告されている。緊急宣言が発せられ、医療体制のひっ迫（地域病院で98%の占有率）が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Vigilância Ambiental intensifica combate à dengue em Viçosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Environmental Surveillance Intensifies the Fight Against Dengue in Viçosa.
article.articleSummary: Viçosa, Brazil—Environmental Surveillance intensifies the fight against Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and yellow fever. As of 2026-03-25, 38 endemic agents are conducting door-to-door inspections across the municipality to eliminate breeding sites and educate residents on prevention. Community cooperation is emphasized: remove standing water, maintain water tanks, and report suspected foci via anonymous tips to Ouvidoria Municipal at (31) 2170-0408. In addition to fieldwork, the Vigilância Ambiental carried out educational activities during the Universidade Federal de Viçosa (UFV) freshmen reception, with support from the Veterinary Department. The city also notes rising sightings of venomous animals near vacant lots; residents should keep yards clean, seal gaps, avoid debris accumulation, and report dirty lots to Ouvidoria.

triage.headline_ja: 環境衛生監視部門がビçォーザでのデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱を含む蚊媒介性疾患の制御活動の報道であり、複数のWPRO基準に該当する可能性があるが、具体的な患者数や重症度などの詳細情報が不足しており、公衆衛生上の影響度の確定が困難なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は環境衛生監視部門による予防的制御活動の報道であり、発生数や患者数に関する具体的な数値が記載されていない。デング熱、チクングニア熱、ジカ熱、黄熱は蚊媒介性疾患として流行しやすく、住民に継続的な曝露リスクがあることが示唆されている。患者発生の詳細情報が明記されていないため、PICKUP判定には至らず、引き続きブラジル国内のデング熱発生動向を監視する必要がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Over 22,000 poultry birds culled as bird flu outbreak hits central India
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) outbreak in Chhattisgarh, central India, as of March 25, 2026, leads authorities to cull over 22,000 poultry birds. The event centers on the Koni area of Bilaspur district, about 128 km north of Raipur. At a state-run poultry farm, 4,744 of 5,037 chickens died, prompting a culling operation to curb spread. Laboratory samples from the carcasses confirmed H5N1 avian influenza. The health department is monitoring local residents and conducting routine check-ups; samples from all workers at the government farm were tested and found negative. Bird flu is described as a highly infectious, severe respiratory disease in birds caused by H5N1, with occasional human infection. No human cases are reported in the article; containment measures focus on poultry and farm workers.

triage.headline_ja: 中央インドで鳥インフルエンザが流行、22,000羽以上の家禽が処分される
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの動物発生であり、異常/予想外の事象であり、高い伝播性を示す。しかし現時点で人感染例が報告されておらず、公開情報に基づく詳細なリスク評価には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: H5N1は高病原性であり、人への感染可能性があるため継続監視が必要。現在の報告では動物での発生に限定されているが、人感染リスク評価に必要な追加情報（農場作業者への詳細な健康監視、地域での野生鳥類への拡大状況）が不明。アウトブレイク対応は適切に実施されているが、国際的拡大やPHEICへの関連性については現時点で判断不可。

locations.name: Virgin Islands of the United States

article.articleHeadline: CDC Issues Travel Alert About Potentially Fatal 'Breakbone Fever'
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, or breakbone fever, is highlighted in a CDC travel alert as a global risk as U.S. travelers return testing positive. The alert lists Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bolivia, Colombia, Cook Islands, Cuba, Guyana, Maldives, Mali, Mauritania, New Caledonia, Pakistan, Samoa, Sudan, Timor-Leste, and Vietnam. While most U.S. dengue cases come from infections abroad, local transmission persists in American Samoa, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The United States has 496 dengue cases reported so far this year (2026). About 25% of those bitten develop illness, with fever, nausea, vomiting, rash, and muscle- or joint-pain. Treatment is acetaminophen, rest, and fluids. Severe dengue can be life-threatening within hours, with belly pain and frequent vomiting or internal bleeding; prior dengue increases risk. Suspected severe dengue requires urgent medical care or emergency treatment.

triage.headline_ja: CDCが潜在的に致命的な「デング熱」に関する渡航警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の広範な国際的拡大（20カ国以上）、複数の対象国での確認、米国での地域伝播報告、および重症化リスクがあるため、IHR基準2つ以上に該当し、ピックアップが妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の国でのデング熱流行を報告しており、対象国リストではベトナム、バングラデシュが明示される。インドは記事に直接記載されていないため included_locations には含めない修正。実際の verified_locations はベトナムとバングラデシュのみとする。CDCの公式渡航警告であり、重症デング出血熱のリスク言及、米国での地域伝播確認が認められ、シグナル価値が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Editorial: India's tuberculosis elimination target remains elusive despite progress
article.articleSummary: India's tuberculosis elimination target remains elusive despite progress. India faces over 27 lakh new TB cases annually and about 3 lakh deaths, with roughly 10% of successfully treated patients relapsing within two years. Undetected cases near one lakh amplify transmission. On World TB Day, March 24, the Centre launched a 100-day campaign to screen 1.58 lakh villages and reach high-risk groups including people living with HIV, diabetes, and residents of high-density areas. A key focus is nutritional support for TB patients, with a Rs 1,000 cash assistance, though delays in payments compromise effectiveness. Undernutrition drives nearly 40% of new cases; WHO guidelines support nutritional interventions. About 80% of TB patients in India pay out-of-pocket and seek unregulated private care due to weak rural health infrastructure and socio-economic disparities, as highlighted in the WHO Global TB Report."}{}{

triage.headline_ja: 社説：インドの結核排除目標は進展にもかかわらず依然として達成困難
triage.triage_reason: 結核とHIVという重要な疾患であり、インドにおいて年27万件以上の新規TB患者と3万件の死亡が報告されているが、本記事は政策・進捗の評価と啓発キャンペーンの紹介であり、新規のアウトブレイク、異常な発生パターン、または急速な国際的拡大の兆候がない。継続的監視は必要だが、フルRRA対象とはならない。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の風土病的結核状況の政策的対応・キャンペーン報道であり、新規シグナルではない。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡3万件/年）、長期曝露（年27万件以上の新規患者）、流行しやすさ（HIV関連、栄養不良、私的医療依存）、管理可能性（政府キャンペーン実施）で複数基準に該当するが、IHR基準では異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限リスクがないため、PICKUP基準（IHR2以上またはスクリーニング+社会的関心）は満たさない。既存の感染症状況の進捗報告として継続監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura pede acesso a imóveis para combate à dengue na cidade
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall seeks access to properties for dengue control in the city
article.articleSummary: City Hall authorities in Santa Catarina reinforced a request for residents to allow dengue-control agents access to residential and commercial properties. The aim is to identify and eliminate dengue mosquito breeding sites, especially during periods of higher incidence. Officials say community cooperation is decisive to prevent proliferation of the vector and to reduce dengue cases in Santa Catarina. Dengue-control agents will be identified by authorities and will conduct quick property inspections, advising residents on preventive measures. The article stresses that granting access is one of the main strategies to contain the disease's spread, and urges residents not to refuse visits to homes and businesses to support rapid vector control.

triage.headline_ja: 市役所が市内のデング熱対策のための物件へのアクセスを要請
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の定期的なデング熱対策キャンペーンであり、異常な発生パターンや国際的拡大の兆候はない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当が認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（対象国外）のサンタカタリーナ州における日常的なデング媒介蚊駆除キャンペーンを報告している。異常な症例数、致死率、拡大傾向の記載がなく、公開されている衛生上の懸念事項ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Panvel Civic Body Launches 100-Day TB-Free Campaign With Focus On Early Detection And AI Screening
article.articleSummary: TB campaign launched in Panvel, Maharashtra, India under the TB-Free India Initiative to mark World Tuberculosis Day, a 100-day effort focused on prevention, early diagnosis, treatment, and awareness. The event at Adya Krantiveer Vasudev Balwant Phadke Auditorium was guided by the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. AI-based screening identifies high-risk wards; PMC aims to screen about 123,550 residents, including 57,272 from high-risk areas, all residents above 14 in these zones. Five advanced X-ray machines are deployed; health camps offer CBNAAT testing along with BP, BMI, blood sugar, and haemoglobin checks. Active high-risk screening, AI-guided mapping, portable X-ray use, and Nikshay Mitra–backed nutritional and psychosocial support accompany testing. The campaign emphasizes prevention, early diagnosis, effective treatment, and stigma reduction, with Nikshay Mitras and ASHA workers highlighted for community engagement; a rally followed the inauguration.

triage.headline_ja: パンヴェル市民団体が100日間のTB（結核）フリーキャンペーンを開始—早期発見とAIスクリーニングに注力
triage.triage_reason: 結核の公衆衛生キャンペーンであるが、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常な流行、または国際的なリスクを示す証拠がない。既知の風土病に対する予防・検診イニシアティブであり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドの結核対策キャンペーン（TB-Free India Initiative）の啓発活動である。新規のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、既知の風土病に対する政府主導の公衆衛生イニシアティブであるため、シグナル認識の対象にはならない。

article.articleHeadline: MG tem dois casos de chikungunya por hora e inicia vacinação de adultos em Santa Luzia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais has two chikungunya cases per hour and starts vaccinating adults in Santa Luzia.
article.articleSummary: From Jan 1 to Mar 24, 2026, Minas Gerais reported 5,082 probable chikungunya cases (about 61/day, ~2/hour), with 2,950 confirmed and one death (another under investigation). On Mar 25, SES-MG launched vaccination in Santa Luzia (Greater Belo Horizonte), distributing 32,000 doses. Eligible adults 18–59 receive a single dose; target at least 50% of this group. The Butantan–Valneva vaccine has shown strong seroconversion. Chikungunya clusters remain in Triângulo Mineiro (Araguari, Ituiutaba, Uberlândia). Vaccination had begun in Congonhas and Sabará (Sabará 19,200; Congonhas 9,600), with Santa Luzia added to assess real-world effectiveness in reducing severe disease and deaths. Seven Lagoas was delayed. Dengue: 32,507 probable (10,254 confirmed, 7 deaths); Zika: 26 probable (3 confirmed). State investments include drones, ovitrampas, and Wolbachia releases in Brumadinho to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州は1時間に2件のチクングニア症例を報告し、サンタルシア州で成人予防接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（ミナスジェライス州）でチクングニア熱の急速な蔓延（1日約61件、1時間2件）が報告され、予防接種キャンペーンが展開されている。複数のアルボウイルス感染症（チクングニア、デング、ジカ）の同時流行であり、死亡事例も確認されている。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高さから、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ミナスジェライス州における急速な流行（1時間2件の頻度）と複数のアルボウイルスの同時流行が特徴。州政府による大規模予防接種キャンペーン開始により、制御可能性の判断は分かれる可能性あり。Wolbachia投放などの革新的な媒介蚊対策も実施中。国際的拡大リスクについての情報は記事サマリーに明記されていないが、ブラジル内での多地域流行が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Sobe para 17 o número de casos confirmados de Mpox em Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Mpox cases in Minas Gerais rises to 17.
article.articleSummary: As of March 25, 2026, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports 17 confirmed Mpox cases, with the latest in Belo Horizonte. The Secretaria de Estado de Saúde (SES-MG) confirmed the update and said it maintains permanent epidemiological monitoring and urges the public to rely on reliable information and adopt preventive measures. Mpox, also known as monkeypox, is highly infectious; diagnosis is via PCR on material collected from lesions. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with skin lesions and body fluids of infected people, as well as contaminated objects. Preventive measures include avoiding contact with suspected or confirmed cases and diligent hand hygiene. Suspected or confirmed cases should isolate for the transmission period and avoid sharing personal items. Treatment is supportive; most cases are mild to moderate, and there is no specific antiviral.

triage.headline_ja: ミナス・ジェライス州でMpox確認症例が17例に増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるMpox(Clade I/II)の局所的集積が報告されているが、現時点では国際的拡大の具体的リスクは不明。情報更新を継続監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに未含まれるため、地域検証上「対象国外」の報告。ただしMpoxの国際的関心が高い疾患であることを踏まえ、WPRO基準2項目(abnormal_unexpected, epidemic_prone)に該当するため監視継続判定とした。症例数17例、重症度は軽度〜中等度とのこと。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde investiga morte de bebê de 1 mês com suspeita de chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department investigates death of a 1-month-old baby with suspected Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: A one-month-old baby from Aldeia Jaguapiru, Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, is hospitalized with suspected chikungunya; if laboratory-confirmed, it would be the fifth chikungunya death in MS in 2026. The infant died at UMC (Women and Children Unit) within HU-UFGD. Four other Indigenous Reserve residents died from chikungunya between February and March, including another three-month-old, along with two women aged 60 and 62 and a 73-year-old man. Dourados is the only MS city with chikungunya deaths in 2026. A health bulletin reports 1,504 suspected cases in Dourados in 2026: 721 confirmed, 218 discarded, 565 under investigation; 1,286 probable. In the Indigenous Reserve: 1,193 notifications, 545 confirmed, 157 discarded, 491 under investigation (1,036 probable). As of yesterday, 27 symptomatic patients were hospitalized (8 at Hospital Porta da Esperança; 19 at HU-UFGD). Citywide bed occupancy is 98%. Public health emergency declared; outbreak strongest in Indigenous communities but spreading citywide. Positivity rate: 76.8%. National SUS teams deployed for treatment and vector control targeting Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局が天然痘感染疑いの1ヶ月児の死亡を調査中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでチクングニヤ関連の小児死亡複数例（少なくとも5例確認見込み）が発生し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（高い死亡率、医療逼迫98%ベッド占有率）、異常性（Indigenous communityで高集積）、および国家レベルの公衆衛生緊急事態宣言がなされており、IHR基準2つ以上該当かつWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ブラジル・マットグロッソドスル州ドゥラードスで2026年に少なくとも5人の死亡例（含む1ヶ月児・3ヶ月児）が確認。Indigenous Reserve（先住民地域）で特に高い感染率。2026年1月以降の総確認例数721例、確定診断待機565例。公衆衛生緊急事態宣言済み。全国SUSチームの派遣と蚊媒体対策実施中。高い死亡率・重症度・医療逼迫が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampión e influenza: estos son los datos de vacunación y casos que existen - Nacionales - ABC Color
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles and influenza: these are the vaccination and case data that exist - National - ABC Color
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in Mexico, the United States, and Canada prompt Paraguay to intensify vaccination ahead of World Cup travel. Paraguay, which had eliminated measles last year, reported 49 new cases in 2025 in San Pedro, prompting MSP to reinforce immunization. More than 196,000 children were vaccinated; first-dose coverage is 95% and second-dose 89%, with a goal of 95–98% two-dose coverage. The campaign runs through May 9, targeting 1–59 year-olds, especially 1–5 years, and is delivered at 1,500 MSP health posts. Concurrently, influenza vaccines are arriving in late March and will be distributed across sanitary regions during Semana Santa to start after; investment about US$5 million. Dengue vaccine Takeda, used in 6–39-year-olds in selected municipalities, delivered 3,000 doses, with possible expansion. Pneumococcal vaccine PCV23 (single dose with a booster after five years) will also be available.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹とインフルエンザ：存在するワクチン接種とケースのデータ
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで麻疹が報告されているが、記事の主題はパラグアイのワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、情報が限定的。IHR基準の評価には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはパラグアイのワクチン接種対応が主題であり、対象国ではないため除外。フィリピンはGeoNames ID 1694008として対象国リストに含まれ、San Pedroの座標（14.3595, 121.0473）と記事内容からフィリピンでの麻疹発生が確認される。複数国（メキシコ、米国、カナダ）での麻疹流行が言及されているが、対象国でない。IHR基準2つ該当で形式的にはPICKUP相当だが、詳細な症例数や重症度情報が不足しており、WATCH段階での続報確認が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose en Algérie : plus de 18 000 cas par an, le professeur alerte sur une maladie toujours présente - Santé News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis in Algeria: more than 18,000 cases per year, the professor warns about a disease that is still present - Health News.
article.articleSummary: TB remains a persistent health issue in Algeria and globally, with no country having eradicated the disease. Algeria currently records about 18,000–19,000 new tuberculosis cases per year, placing it in the moderate-prevalence category. Internationally, TB rates are highest in Sub-Saharan Africa and in Asia, notably India and China. Symptoms include persistent cough, fever, night sweats, and fatigue. If symptoms persist for more than three weeks and are accompanied by weight loss or general weakness, medical consultation is advised. Diagnosis relies chiefly on clinical examination and chest radiography to detect pulmonary lesions. Professor Mohamed EL hadj emphasizes that early screening is essential for effective treatment and to limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アルジェリアの結核：年間18,000件以上の症例、教授が依然として存在する疾病について警告 - ヘルスニュース
triage.triage_reason: 結核はアルジェリアにおける既知の地域性疾患であり、既報の流行・アウトブレイクではない。国内での既存患者数の報告であり、異常性、急速な拡大、国際的リスク上昇の兆候がない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはアルジェリア・インド・中国が含まれるが、記事サマリーの主要な焦点はアルジェリアでの地域性結核負担の報告である。インドと中国は参考情報として言及されているのみ（世界的に高い発生率を持つ地域として）。対象国のうち、India のみサマリーで具体的に言及されているため verified_locations に含めた。アルジェリアは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: बिलासपुर में बर्ड फ्लू का प्रकोप... 25 हजार पक्षी जमींदोज, चिकन दुकानों पर जड़ा ताला
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu outbreak in Bilaspur... 25,000 birds killed, chicken shops shut.
article.articleSummary: Bird flu outbreak in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh prompts large-scale action aimed at ending transmission: Rapid Response Team culled and safely disposed of more than 25,000 birds to sever the infection chain. Eight poultry farms and chicken shops operating from Konni to Mahamaya Chowk are sealed, and the area declared a no-go zone. Kanan Pendari Zoo is closed for seven days as a precaution. The district administration and veterinary department quarantine 25 workers at the affected poultry facility, while the health department maintains 24-hour surveillance. The report does not mention any confirmed human infections at this time. Authorities emphasize rapid containment and culling to prevent further spread within Bilaspur and surrounding districts.

triage.headline_ja: ビラースプルで鳥インフルエンザの流行...25,000羽の鳥が殺処分、チキン店が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: インドで鳥インフルエンザの集団発生が確認され、大規模な対応（25,000羽以上の殺処分）が実施されている。人感染の報告は現時点でないが、動物感染が異常で制御可能性に関する情報が限定的であるため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: インドのチャッティスガル州ビラースプルでの鳥インフルエンザの家禽農場での集団発生。人感染は現在のところ報告されていない。迅速対応チーム（RRT）による大規模な殺処分と隔離措置が実施されており、当局は積極的に封じ込めを行っている。WPRO基準では異常性、流行しやすさ、長期曝露のリスク（野生鳥やペット、近隣農場への感染可能性）が該当するが、現段階では人への感染確認がないため、情報追跡が必要。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Chystáte sa do zahraničia? V týchto krajinách vám hrozí nebezpečná infekčná choroba. Ide o obľúbené destinácie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Are you traveling abroad? In these countries you are at risk of a dangerous infectious disease. These are popular destinations.
article.articleSummary: From March 2026, Southeast Asia reports massive measles outbreaks, elevating travel risk to Bali (Indonesia), Vietnam, and Thailand, with spread reaching the UK and USA via international travelers. Indonesia ranks third globally in measles outbreaks as of February 2026, after India and Angola; Vietnam shows a dramatic rise in cases, especially among young children; Thailand has had endemic transmission since 2023. Measles is highly contagious: infection can occur four days before rash and the virus can remain airborne for about two hours after an infected person leaves a room. Herd immunity requires about 95% vaccination, yet second-dose coverage in many regions falls below 90%, leaving populations vulnerable. Two doses provide up to 99% protection. Recommendations: ensure vaccination before travel; children receive doses at 12 and 18 months; an early dose can be given from six months for travel to risk areas; immunity develops about two weeks after vaccination. Adults born after 1966 without two documented doses should consider revaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 海外旅行を予定していますか？これらの国では危険な感染症のリスクがあります。人気の観光地です
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、複数の対象国での大規模はしか流行が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事は東南アジアにおけるはしかの大規模流行を報告しており、インドネシア（バリ州）、ベトナム、タイが主要な発生地として記述されている。インドもグローバルランキング上位として言及されている。対象国リストに含まれないアンゴラ、英国、米国も発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事内では経由地または対象外国のため、verified_locationsには含めていない。高い伝播性と低いワクチン接種率が危機を増幅させている。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde esclarece informações sobre caso de tétano com óbito em Nova Andradina -- AconteceuMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Health clarifies information about a tetanus case resulting in death in Nova Andradina — AconteceuMS
article.articleSummary: Nova Andradina, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports a recently fatal tetanus case. The municipal Health Secretariat clarified earlier claims of no tetanus vaccination, noting after family input that a tetanus vaccine dose was administered in 2020. Technically, the patient had a puncture wound from a contaminated object—a potentially severe injury. The individual sought medical care three days post-injury, a delay that can compromise preventive measures. In such cases, especially with uncertain vaccination history, incomplete schedules (fewer than three doses), or last dose over five years ago (dT), protocols require immediate prophylaxis. Recommended actions include a tetanus booster (dT) combined with tetanus immune globulin or antitoxin serum (SAT/IGHAT), along with antibiotics and proper wound cleaning with saline, per health guidelines. The message stresses urgent medical attention after injury and ongoing transparency about patient care and family considerations.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局がノヴァ・アンドラディーナでの破傷風致死例に関する情報を明確化
