triage.triage_reason: 破傷風による死亡事例が報告されており、予防接種履歴の初期情報誤認と治療遅延が認められるため、公衆衛生上の教訓として注視が必要。ただし、散発例の報告に過ぎず、現時点では国際的拡大リスクや深刻な流行の兆候が明らかでないため、WATCH判定とする。
triage.notes: 破傷風は予防可能な疾患であり、本例は予防接種履歴確認の遅延と医療受診の3日間の遅延が管理上の問題として浮き彫りになっている。散発的な致死例であり、社会的・政治的関心は限定的。記事の主眼は個別事例の教訓的報道であり、流行の兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 5 milhões de brasileiros já foram infectados pelo vírus oropouche, aponta estudo - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 5 million Brazilians have already been infected with the Oropouche virus, according to a study - Folha Vitória.
article.articleSummary: Oropouche virus has infected more than 5 million Brazilians, per a new study. Serological data from samples taken Nov 2023, Jun 2024 and Nov 2024 show the 2023–2024 outbreak reached around 12.5% of Manaus residents, approaching 15% in Amazonas state, similar to 1980–1981. Since 1955, 32 outbreaks have been documented in Brazil, Peru, French Guiana and Panama; 19 occurred in Brazil. Manaus, with ~2 million people and strong regional links, acts as a dispersion hub, seeding outbreaks in Espírito Santo and Rio de Janeiro in 2024. Most infections are likely asymptomatic or mild, explaining underreporting. The illness is febrile and dengue-like; severe cases can progress to neurological disease, maternofetal complications, or death. No licensed vaccines or antivirals exist; decades-old antibodies can neutralize current strains, suggesting long-lasting immunity. A parallel study finds rural/forest transmission predominates; urban Aedes aegypti transmission is minority, underscoring need for broader surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 500万人以上のブラジル人がオロポウシウイルスに感染済み、研究が示唆
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で『異常・予想外性』『国際的拡大のリスク』『渡航・貿易制限リスク』の3つが該当。WPROスクリーニングでも『重症度』『流行しやすさ』『管理可能性』で複数該当。ブラジルで500万人超の感染履歴と、神経学的合併症・死亡例のある病原体で、32年間32回の発生記録と広域拡散パターンが確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事では複数国（ペルー、フランス領ギアナ、パナマ）での発生が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ。オロポウシウイルスは1955年以来ブラジルで19回の大規模発生を記録し、2023-2024年の流行では500万人超の感染履歴が推定されている。マナウスは地域的な拡散ハブとして機能し、エスピリトサント州とリオデジャネイロ州への2024年の二次感染を引き起こしている。神経学的疾患、母児合併症、死亡事例が報告されており、ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬がない状況での大規模感染流行は公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Oropouche: infecções podem ser até 200 vezes maiores que os registros oficiais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oropouche: infections can be up to 200 times higher than the official records.
article.articleSummary: Oropouche virus infections in Latin America and the Caribbean amount to 9.4 million from 1960 to 2025, far exceeding officially recorded cases, with 5.5 million in Brazil. The Nature Medicine study, led by FMUSP and collaborators including University of Kentucky, Unicamp, and Hemoam, attributes a severe undercount to limited detection, asymptomatic/mild cases, and healthcare access barriers, noting Manaus as epicenter with infections possibly up to 200 times the confirmed cases. Oropouche transmission occurs via Culicoides paraensis (maruins), and presents dengue-like symptoms, but can cause neurological, maternal-fetal complications, and death. There is no vaccine or specific antiviral. Official surveillance shows since 2023: 800 cases; 2024: 14,000; 2025: 11,000—likely underestimates. Seroprevalence in Manaus donors rose 11.4% to 25.7% between late 2023 and mid-2024. The virus circulates in rural/forest-adjacent areas, challenging urban arbovirus control, and has reached all Brazilian states and parts of the Caribbean, with travel connections to Europe and North America.

triage.headline_ja: オロポーシュ：感染者数は公式記録より最大200倍多い可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の大幅な未集計、国際的拡大リスク）。Nature Medicine論文による大規模血清疫学調査に基づき、公開されたサーベイランス統計を大きく上回る感染が推定されており、ブラジルでのOropouche流行は重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（特にマナウス）での大規模なOropouche流行を報じており、Nature Medicine論文に基づく血清疫学調査により、公式記録の200倍を超える感染が推定されている。神経症状、母胎併発症、死亡報告あり。ワクチンなし。2023年以降の新規感染増加傾向が明らかで、カリブ海地域およびヨーロッパ・北米への渡航関連拡大リスク指摘あり。APIが提示したKentucky（米国）の記事地域表示は、論文の共同研究機関（University of Kentucky）の所在地であり、実際のイベント発生地はブラジルのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Bebê morre e Chikungunya bate a 5ª morte em 2026 no MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Baby dies and Chikungunya hits its fifth death in 2026 in Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleSummary: Five chikungunya deaths in Mato Grosso do Sul in 2026, including a one-month-old infant who died March 24 in Dourados, as the Jaguapiru Indigenous Reserve experiences a surge. The infant was treated at HU-UFGD/Ebserh. State health data show over 1,100 notifications across communities, though SES weekly bulletin has not yet been updated. This marks the second infant death and fifth chikungunya fatality in MS this year; the third death was a 3-month-old who developed symptoms March 6 and died four days later. In response, the state opened 15 beds for chikungunya patients at Hospital Regional de Dourados: 10 for adults and 5 for pediatrics; the facility has 100 beds total, including 20 ICU, with dedicated chikungunya beds. Dourados declared a public health emergency. Outbreaks extend from Jaguapiru to Jardim dos Estados, Novo Horizonte, and Jóquei Clube, tied to Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: 赤ちゃんが死亡し、マットグロッソドスル州で2026年の5番目のチクングニア死亡例に
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア感染症による5人の死亡（うち乳幼児2人を含む）が報告され、重症度基準を満たすとともに、地域保健上の異常な状況であり、州レベルでの公衆衛生上の重大な影響が認識されている。
triage.notes: 2026年の記事日付は将来日付。通常の記事チェック時は年号を確認の上、データソースの信頼性を検証することを推奨。マットグロッソドスル州（MS）はブラジル中西部のインディジェナス居住地を含む地域で、ウイルス媒介蚊（ネッタイシマカ）による流行が急速に拡大している。複数の乳幼児死亡を含む深刻な事例であり、地方保健当局が公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言を発出している。

article.articleHeadline: População indígena da região de Dourados, MS, soma 545 casos confirmados de chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indigenous population in the Dourados region, Mato Grosso do Sul, totals 545 confirmed chikungunya cases
article.articleSummary: 545 confirmed chikungunya cases among the Indigenous population of Greater Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, from 1,193 notifications in 2026; 491 cases under investigation as of March 23; four deaths, all in the Indigenous Reserve. Health authorities are mapping health-network capacity to improve care amid high transmission in Dourados and nearby towns. The state has made the Regional Hospital available; Dourados facilities, including Santa Casa, may provide beds as needed, with expanded capacity and coordinated public-private networks. Residents are urged to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites to curb transmission. Chikungunya causes sudden fever, rash, and severe joint pain; vulnerable groups include newborns, the elderly, and those with diabetes or cardiovascular disease, potentially requiring hospitalization. No antiviral exists; care is symptomatic. Brazil approved the first chikungunya vaccine in 2025, with Mato Grosso do Sul piloting vaccination in Indigenous communities, accompanied by frontline training.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソドスル州ドゥラードス地域の先住民族、チクングニヤの確認症例545例を記録
triage.triage_reason: チクングニヤの大規模集団発生（545例確認、4例死亡）で重症度が高く、先住民族コミュニティでの継続的曝露があり、ブラジル国内での異常な発生としてWPRO基準を複数満たす。IHR基準では国際拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響を評価し、スクリーニング基準で重症度・長期曝露・管理可能性が該当する。
triage.notes: マットグロッソドスル州ドゥラードス地域での先住民族コミュニティにおける大規模なチクングニヤ集団発生。545例の確認症例、4例の死亡、1,193例の通知があり、高い伝播が確認されている。ブラジルは2025年に初のチクングニヤワクチンを承認し、先住民族コミュニティでのパイロット接種を実施中。保健当局は医療ネットワークの容量拡大と対応体制を整備中。

article.articleHeadline: Conscientização sobre tuberculose mobiliza ação em Porto Velho - News Rondônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis awareness mobilizes action in Porto Velho - News Rondônia.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil—on World Tuberculosis Day, March 24, 2026, the City Hall through the Municipal Health Secretariat (Semusa) conducted tuberculosis awareness activities at strategic city points, including the East Zone intersection of José Amador dos Reis and Rio de Janeiro Avenues and the central area at Sete de Setembro Avenue with Campos Sales. The campaign distributed pamphlets and offered guidance on TB symptoms, prevention, and free treatment via the Unified Health System (SUS); early diagnosis was emphasized to interrupt transmission. TB symptoms highlighted: persistent cough for three weeks or more, fever, night sweats, and weight loss. The effort, supported by Semtran for traffic flow, involved the Hamilton Gondim Health Unit team in the East Zone and the Central Region’s Health Surveillance Department, with statements underscoring cure with proper treatment. Residents noted the initiative’s value.

triage.headline_ja: ポルト・ベーリョにおける結核啓発活動が行動を促進 - News Rondônia
triage.triage_reason: 世界結核デーに関連した啓発キャンペーンの実施報道。新規患者発生、重症化、異常な感染拡大などのエビデンスなく、定期的な公衆衛生活動の報道に該当。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年3月24日の世界結核デーにおけるポルト・ベーリョ市の啓発・教育キャンペーンの実施報道。新規患者クラスターの発生、死亡例、異常な感染パターンなどのシグナルを含まない。ルーチンな公衆衛生キャンペーンとして分類される。

article.articleHeadline: A doença transmitida pela água que ameaça todos nós
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Waterborne Disease That Threatens Us All.
article.articleSummary: Shigella-driven shigellosis is a growing public health threat in Brazil due to water contamination and fragile sanitation, worsened by extreme weather. By March 25, 2026, contaminated water from floods and service disruptions remains the main transmission route. Although anyone can be infected, the highest risk includes young children, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals; diarrhea with a deteriorating general condition may indicate a bacterial infection that can escalate. Underreporting hides true burden, as many mild cases never reach clinics. Transmission occurs via fecal-oral contact and cross-contamination, such as using the same knife or cutting board for raw meat and then preparing salad. Brazil faces antibiotic-resistant Shigella strains; existing treatment protocols exist but misuse of antibiotics and unequal diagnostic access hinder control. Prevention hinges on rigorous hand hygiene, especially in daycares and schools, plus improved sanitation and sanitary education.

triage.headline_ja: 私たち全員を脅かす水を通じて伝染する病気
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるシゲラ症の公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が明らかであり、IHR基準3つ（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、フルRRA実施の必要性がある。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年3月25日現在のブラジルにおけるシゲラ症の流行を報じている。洪水に伴う水汚染と不十分な衛生設備が主要な感染経路であり、抗生物質耐性菌の存在も懸念材料。小児、高齢者、免疫不全者が高リスク群。過少報告により実際の疾病負荷が隠蔽されている可能性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Туристов предупредили о вызывающей кровоизлияние в мозг опасной болезни в 16 странах
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tourists were warned about a dangerous disease that causes brain hemorrhage in 16 countries.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, dengue fever is actively spreading in 16 popular travel destinations, with an unusual surge among travelers returning from Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bolivia, Colombia, Cook Islands, Cuba, Guyana, Maldives, Mali, Mauritania, New Caledonia, Pakistan, Samoa, Sudan, East Timor (Timor-Leste), and Vietnam, according to the New York Post. Doctors warn the incubation period is typically about two weeks, but deterioration can occur within hours in severe cases. Early symptoms include headache, eye pain, nausea, vomiting, rash, muscle- and joint-pains. The disease can lead to brain hemorrhage and vomiting. An imported case is noted: Russian socialite Natalia Dormidoshina nearly died on Bali, Indonesia after contracting dengue fever.

triage.headline_ja: 観光客に警告：16ヶ国で脳出血を引き起こす危険な病気（デング熱）が流行
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の16ヶ国での同時多発的な流行は異常・予想外であり、国際的な観光地での感染拡大、複数国への渡航関連リスク、重症化（脳出血）の報告があることから、IHR基準2項目以上に該当し、フルRRA進行の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが列挙した16ヶ国のうち、対象国リストに含まれるのはインドネシア（バリ州での実症例記載）とベトナムのみ。その他の記載国（パキスタン、バングラデシュ、ボリビア、コロンビア等）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事は複数国での流行を報じているが、verified_locationsは対象国に限定。インドネシアでは著名人の重症例（脳出血のリスク）が報告されており、国際的な観光関連感染として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ação de conscientização sobre tuberculose é realizada em Porto Velho
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis awareness campaign is being carried out in Porto Velho.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil, conducted a tuberculosis awareness campaign on March 24 led by the Municipal Health Secretariat (Semusa) at two strategic city points to mark World Tuberculosis Day. In the East Zone, at the intersection of José Amador dos Reis and Rio de Janeiro avenues, and in the central zone at Sete de Setembro and Campos Sales, residents received direct guidance, pamphlets, and information on TB symptoms, prevention, and treatment. The Municipal Transit Secretariat (Semtran) supported traffic flow. The East Zone activity was organized by the Hamilton Gondim Health Unit team. Alex Assunção highlighted the objective of informing the public about TB signs and the importance of seeking care early, while Geisa Brasil reinforced the need for early diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトベーロで結核啓発キャンペーンが実施される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルのポルトベーロで実施された結核啓発キャンペーンに関するもので、新規の疾病発生や異常なアウトブレイクではなく、公衆衛生キャンペーンの報道である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当する懸念事項がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防啓発キャンペーンの実施報道であり、新規患者の報告やアウトブレイクの情報を含まない。シグナルトリアージの対象外として見送り。

article.articleHeadline: HDT-UFNT alerta para avanço da dengue em Araguaína -- Política Distrital agora é PDNews, notícias sobre Política e Saúde do DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HDT-UFNT warns of the spread of dengue in Araguaína -- District Politics is now PDNews, news about Politics and Health in the DF.
article.articleSummary: Dengue epidemic in Araguaína, Tocantins, with confirmed cases rising about 20% in a week (1,751 on March 12 to 2,067 on March 19). From March 12–19, 3,309 cases were notified and three deaths recorded; 104 confirmed cases had warning signs. The surge represents a 625% increase versus January 2025. The Hospital de Doenças Tropicais da UFNT (HDT-UFNT) serves northern Tocantins and neighboring regions (south Pará, parts of Maranhão) and reports a substantial increase in patient load. Symptoms include fever, body aches, headache, and malaise; guidance emphasizes prompt medical evaluation, hydration, rest, and avoiding NSAIDs or acetylsalicylic acid due to bleeding risk. Treatment is supportive: mild cases can be managed outpatient, while alarm signs or complications require hospitalization for intravenous fluids and clinical monitoring. Prevention requires sustained public health measures and community participation.

triage.headline_ja: HDT-UFNTがアラグアイーナのデング熱の進行に警告 -- 地区政治はPDNewsになり、DFの政治と健康についてのニュース
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのトカンティンス州アラグアイーナでのデング熱流行が、1週間で20%の症例増加、3月12日～19日で3,309件の通知と3死亡、前年同期比625%の増加を示しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性）を満たし、フルRRA対象の明確なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジルのトカンティンス州アラグアイーナでの急速なデング熱流行を明確に述べており、確認された症例数の急増（1週間で20%、625%の年間増加）、死亡（3件）、警告兆候のある症例が報告されている。対象国リストに該当するのはBrazilのみ。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてが該当し、高いシグナル価値を有する。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde orienta municípios de MS a começarem vacinação contra Influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department Advises Municipalities in Mato Grosso do Sul to Begin Influenza Vaccination
article.articleSummary: 80,000 influenza vaccine doses were delivered to 79 municipalities in Mato Grosso do Sul as of 25 March 2026, with immediate vaccination encouraged ahead of Dia D on 28 March. The first batch covers about 6.5% of the estimated target population of ~1.1 million. Priority groups include children 6 months to under 6 years, pregnant and postpartum women, elderly 60+, and people with comorbidities; plus health workers, teachers, security and rescue personnel, and truck drivers per the PNI. The campaign runs in line with the national schedule through 30 May, but emphasis is on protection before peak respiratory virus activity. Extramural actions with the Vacimóvel and intensified drives in Corumbá, Dourados, and Ponta Porã aim to boost access. Vaccination is the most effective measure to prevent severe disease, hospitalizations, and deaths; the public should not delay and should visit their nearest health unit.

triage.headline_ja: Health Department Advises Municipalities in Mato Grosso do Sul to Begin Influenza Vaccination
triage.triage_reason: This is a routine seasonal influenza vaccination campaign announcement in Brazil with no outbreak, severe cases, or unusual epidemiological findings reported. No public health emergency or crisis situation is indicated.
triage.notes: This article describes a standard seasonal influenza vaccination campaign by the Brazilian Health Department, not an infectious disease event or outbreak. The content focuses on vaccine distribution logistics and public health messaging for routine immunization, which does not meet the threshold for signal detection in EBS surveillance.

article.articleHeadline: Caso confirmado de sarampo acende alerta sobre cobertura vacinal - Agora MT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Measles Case Raises Alert About Vaccination Coverage - Agora MT
article.articleSummary: Measles confirmed in a 6‑month‑old baby in São Paulo last week underscores vaccination coverage as a barrier to transmission. The infant is too young for routine vaccination; Brazil’s SUS schedules the first MMR dose at 12 months and a tetra-viral dose at 15 months adding varicella. The child traveled to Bolivia in January, where an outbreak is ongoing; high vaccination coverage helps prevent importations from sparking domestic spread. Last year, 92.5% of infants received the first dose and 77.9% completed on time. The vaccine is highly effective at preventing infection and transmission. This is Brazil’s first measles case this year; last year, 38 infections, mostly imported. Brazil remains measles-free per PAHO since 2024, though surges in the past caused temporary loss of certification. Across the Americas, 14,891 cases and 29 deaths were reported last year; by March 5 this year, 7,145 cases, mainly in Mexico, the United States and Guatemala. Most cases occur in unvaccinated children under 1 year; symptoms include fever, red rash, cough, coryza, and conjunctivitis; complications include pneumonia and encephalitis; measles can suppress the immune system for 3–6 months.

triage.headline_ja: 確認されたはしか症例がワクチン接種率に警告を発する - Agora MT
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで確認されたはしか症例であり、ボリビアでの流行からの輸入感染であるため、異常かつ予想外。米国、メキシコ、グアテマラを含む米大陸全域での広がりが確認され、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのはしか症例を主題としており、ボリビアからの輸入感染ケースである。ボリビアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはブラジルのみ。米国、メキシコ、グアテマラも発生地域に含まれているが、記事の主題はブラジルの症例であり、他国は背景情報として言及されている。IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準5項目全て該当のため、PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde de Taquara reforça orientações de prevenção ao norovírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taquara Health Department reinforces norovirus prevention guidelines.
article.articleSummary: Norovirus vigilance in Taquara, Brazil, as of 25 March 2026, with some suspected cases under active monitoring by the Taquara Health Department. Norovirus causes acute gastroenteritis with diarrhea, vomiting, and fever; symptoms typically last 3–7 days, most intense in the first 48 hours, including multiple watery stools, nausea, and vomiting, with possible headaches and limb pains. Transmission occurs mainly via contaminated water or food, direct contact with infected individuals, or contaminated surfaces. Preventive measures emphasized: frequent handwashing with soap and water; drinking treated or boiled water; washing fruits and vegetables; avoiding unknown or poorly stored foods; proper refrigeration; and thorough cleaning of surfaces and utensils. Suspected cases should seek care at the nearest UBS; for more information contact Taquara Epidemiological Surveillance at Rua 17 de Junho, 2411, Centro, or (51) 3541-9300 ext. 304.

triage.headline_ja: タクアラ保健局がノロウイルス予防指針を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのノロウイルス疑似症例の能動的監視が報告されているが、確定症例数・重症度・国際的拡大リスクに関する具体的情報が不足している。地域レベルの予防啓発活動であり、現時点ではフルRRA前の情報収集段階が適切。
triage.notes: ノロウイルスは流行しやすい病原体であり、疑似症例の能動的監視が行われている点は注視対象。ただし、記事サマリーには確定症例数、重症度、入院者数などの具体的な流行規模情報が記載されておらず、現段階では地域保健当局による標準的な予防啓発活動の域を出ていない。続報で確定症例数や地域外への拡大情報が提供される場合はPICKUPへの変更を検討。

article.articleHeadline: Онищенко: От оспы обезьян надо охранять не только границу, но и территорию
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Onishchenko: We must guard against monkeypox not only at the border but also within the territory.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-25, Russia reports two new monkeypox cases in the last 24 hours, prompting reinforced sanitary-epidemiological surveillance at the border. Public health figure Genady Onishchenko argues that border-only checks are insufficient and advocates a 'border and territories' approach: the entire primary care network must be alert, and diagnosis should be guided by epidemiological history (e.g., travel to Thailand). Patients with fever and rash should be isolated promptly, with local diagnostics rather than transporting samples from remote regions such as Kamchatka to Moscow. Vaccination with the smallpox vaccine should be produced and stockpiled as a preventive measure. Citizens should avoid travel to Southeast Asia and Africa; masks are not highly effective against mpox. The year already saw three importations into Russia, two of which had unclear origin, indicating mpox will remain a public health priority.

triage.headline_ja: オニシチェンコ：サル痘から守るべきは国境だけでなく領土全体である
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な複数事例、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（異常/予想外、流行しやすさ、管理能力の問題）。政府機関の高い関心と国際的対応の必要性が認識されている。
triage.notes: ロシアでのMpox事例報告だが、記事は対象国スクリーニングリストに含まれていない。ただしタイへの渡航歴を疫学的関連として言及されており、タイが該当対象国として検証地域に列挙。ロシアはWPRO地域外のため対象から除外。複数回の輸入事例、不明な感染源、ワクチン準備、渡航制限提案など、複合的な公衆衛生懸念が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Augustinópolis inicia vacinação contra a dengue para crianças e adolescentes de 10 a 14 anos - Voz do Bico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Augustinópolis City Hall begins dengue vaccination for children and adolescents aged 10 to 14 - Voz do Bico
article.articleSummary: Augustinópolis, Brazil — The municipal Health Department announced dengue vaccination at all Basic Health Units (UBS). The first stage targets children and adolescents aged 10–14, per Ministry of Health guidance citing higher hospitalization and complication risks. Vaccination began on March 23, 2026, with adolescent Jefferson Santhiago receiving the first dose. Parents should bring the child’s vaccination card, personal documents, the SUS card, and vaccination booklet to the nearest UBS. Health teams are prepared to provide safe, person-centered care. The campaign, coupled with preventive actions, aims to reduce dengue hospitalizations and severe outcomes. Even with vaccination, maintaining vector-control measures is essential: eliminate standing water, keep water tanks sealed, and regularly clean yards and containers. Dengue cases have been rising in several regions of Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: アウグスティノーポリス市がデング熱ワクチン接種を10～14歳の子どもと青少年を対象に開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱の予防接種キャンペーン開始の報道。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは低いが、複数地域での患者増加傾向が言及されており、流行動向の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種キャンペーン開始の報道であり、既存の流行への対応施策である。IHR基準では基準に該当せず、WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」（複数地域でのデング熱ケース増加）および「流行しやすさ」（ベクター制御依存、継続的な曝露リスク）に該当。政府レベルの対応は明確だが、深刻な異常事態ではなく、継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Coord. de epidemiologia do Mater Dei alerta para riscos de arboviroses para mulheres gestantes - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mater Dei's Epidemiology Coordination warns of arbovirus risks for pregnant women - Metro 1.
article.articleSummary: Mater Dei hospital's Epidemiology and Infection Control Coordinator, Leonardo Sousa, warned that arboviruses Dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya pose particular risks for pregnant women. In an interview with Metropole Saúde on March 23, he stated that pregnancy can worsen outcomes and intensify symptoms. He highlighted congenital Zika syndrome as a major concern, including potential microcephaly. Preventive measures include using repellents as directed by a physician, and addressing areas with higher mosquito exposure around home, neighbors, and nearby properties to reduce Aedes breeding sites. He advised seeking medical guidance if a fever occurs with associated skin or other alterations. The message emphasizes vigilance for pregnant women and recommends timely medical consultation for suspected arboviral infection. No case counts were provided.

triage.headline_ja: Mater Dei病院の疫学センターが妊婦へのアルボウイルス感染リスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: 妊婦に対する複数のアルボウイルス（デング熱、ジカ、チクングニア）の健康リスクについての公式な医療機関からの警告であり、先天性ジカ症候群などの重篤な懸念が述べられているが、具体的な患者数や流行の規模が報告されていないため、情報不足に基づきWATCH判定とする。
triage.notes: 記事は医療機関からの予防啓発メッセージであり、具体的な流行データや患者数が提供されていない。ブラジルではアルボウイルスは既知の風土病であり、妊婦への健康警告は定期的な公衆衛生コミュニケーション活動と考えられる。続報で患者数増加や新たな流行の兆候があるか注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bebê indígena de um mês de vida é a quinta vítima da Chikungunya em Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A one-month-old indigenous baby is the fifth victim of Chikungunya in Dourados.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, the Dourados Indigenous Reservation in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports a chikungunya outbreak with five deaths. A one-month-old Jaguapiru resident died on 24 March at HU-UFGD/Ebserh; the infant is the fifth fatality in the outbreak, which also includes a three-month-old baby, two elderly residents (ages 60 and 62), and a 73-year-old. The Epidemiological Daily Report records about 1,100 notifications from Jaguapiru, covering Dourados, Itaporã and Douradina. Of these, 545 are confirmed, 491 under investigation, 157 discarded; at least 182 indigenous people required hospital care, with seven inpatients confirmed. Before the death, HU-UFGD/Ebserh had 22 inpatients (19 indigenous, 18 minors); seven confirmed, two discarded, 13 awaiting results. HU-UFGD/Ebserh remains the pediatric referral center; adults are sent to Hospital da Missão. After a Health Ministry meeting on 24 March, HRD added 15 beds (10 adults, 5 pediatrics).

triage.headline_ja: 1ヶ月齢の先住民族の乳幼児がドゥラードスのチクングニア熱の5人目の犠牲者となる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマットグロッソ・ドゥ・スル州の先住民族地域でチクングニア熱のアウトブレイクが発生、5人の死亡を含む545の確定症例と182人の入院患者が報告されており、IHR基準3項目（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、高い重症度）を満たすシグナルと判定される。
triage.notes: 先住民族地域での集中的なアウトブレイク。5人の死亡（乳幼児2人、高齢者3人）、545確定症例、182人の入院患者、7人の入院中確定患者。ブラジル保健省が対応会議を開催し病床を追加配置。IHR基準2項目以上該当かつWPRO基準5項目全て該当。

article.articleHeadline: DIA D: Campanha Nacional de Vacinação contra a Influenza começa neste sábado (28) - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã - MS e Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day: National Influenza Vaccination Campaign Begins This Saturday (28) - Ponta Porã Informa - News from Ponta Porã - MS and Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s National Influenza Vaccination Campaign begins March 28, 2026, in the Northeast, Central-West, South, and Southeast regions, with the North Region slated for the second half of the year due to seasonality. The campaign runs through May 30, offering free vaccination at UBS; Dia D is on March 28. About 15.7 million doses have been distributed, and 10 million app messages will be sent by March 26 to boost uptake. Target groups are children 6 months to under 6 years, pregnant women, and adults 60+, with the trivalent vaccine (in the National Immunization Schedule) potentially co-administered with COVID-19 vaccines. For children 6 months to 8 years, dosing depends on prior vaccination. As of March 14, 2026, roughly 14,300 SRAG cases and 840 deaths were reported; influenza caused about 28.1% of severe cases. Indigenous groups 6 months+ follow the same guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: D-Day：全国インフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーン、今週土曜日（28日）開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はインフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施告知であり、新たな感染症危機の発生を示すシグナルではない。既知の疾患の定期的な予防接種活動のため、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの開始告知である。歴史的なSRAG症例データ（3月14日時点で14,300件、840死亡）が記載されているが、これは現在の新規発生事例を報告するものではなく、キャンペーンの必要性を示す背景情報に過ぎない。シグナルトリアージの対象にはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Italy tracks first European human H9N2 avian flu case
article.articleSummary: Europe's first human case of low-pathogenicity avian influenza A(H9N2) has been confirmed in Lombardy, Italy. The patient is hospitalized and described as in poor health prior to infection; origin is a person from a non-European country, with unclear whether Italian traveler or foreign visitor. H9N2 transmission occurs via direct exposure to infected poultry or contaminated environments; there is no reported human-to-human transmission, and illness is typically mild. Globally, roughly 90% of human H9N2 cases have occurred in China, with detections in Cambodia, Vietnam, and India; Africa has reported cases in Egypt, Senegal, and Ghana. The most recent human H9N2 cases prior to this were in China in February; last year, 29 cases were reported from mainland China. Avian Flu Diary notes some Italian media report the patient is a boy who was in Africa, but this has not been confirmed by Italy's Ministry of Health.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアが欧州初の人間H9N2鳥インフルエンザ感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。欧州初のヒトH9N2感染であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事では複数国での過去のH9N2検出が記述されているが、現在のイベント（2026年3月）の主要な発生地はイタリア（対象国外）。ただし、患者の感染源がアフリカとの関連が示唆されており、グローバルなH9N2の動向監視が重要。verified_locationsには対象国リスト内で過去の検出報告がある国を含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Teresina registra primeiro caso de dengue tipo 3 após anos e acende alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teresina records its first case of dengue serotype 3 in years and raises the alarm.
article.articleSummary: First dengue virus serotype 3 (DEN-3) case in Teresina since 2008 triggers heightened alarm and intensified prevention. The Municipal Health Foundation (FMS) will boost prevention and epidemiological surveillance. From Jan 1 to Mar 23, 2026, Teresina confirmed 558 dengue cases, a 6.1% drop from 594 in the same period in 2025. Authorities emphasize ongoing vigilance: expanded dengue education, weekly home inspections to eliminate breeding sites, and Zoonoses teams checking residences for standing water. Medical guidance stresses hydration; urine should stay clear. Dengue has four serotypes; infections with serotypes 2 and 3 are more often linked to severe forms, including hemorrhagic dengue, with current treatment being supportive. Vaccines: a two-dose dengue vaccine is available for children 10–14 at Basic Health Units and Teresina Shopping, while the newer single-dose vaccine is offered only to health professionals. Aedes aegypti remains the vector; 2024 dengue deaths exceeded COVID-19 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: テレジーナ、数年ぶりにデング熱血清型3の初症例を記録し警戒態勢を敷く
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空となる。ただしデング熱の新規血清型出現（DEN-3、2008年以来）は公衆衛生的に注目される可能性があり、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: ブラジル（GeoNames ID 3469034）は評価対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列となる。しかし、記事内容からはデング熱の新規血清型出現（2008年以来のDEN-3）、重症化リスク（血清型2・3は重症デング熱と関連）、活発な媒介蚊対策などが記述されており、IHR基準2つ以上、WPRO基準4つ該当。通常であればPICKUPに値するが、対象国外であるため見送り。継続的な監視が推奨される。

locations.name: Virgin Islands of the United States

article.articleHeadline: Denga groznica i tigrasti komarci prete turistima u 16 zemalja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever and tiger mosquitoes threaten tourists in 16 countries.
article.articleSummary: Across the world, dengue fever cases are rising; the CDC has issued a travel advisory for 16 countries—Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bolivia, Colombia, Cook Islands, Cuba, Guyana, Maldives, Mali, Mauritania, New Caledonia, Pakistan, Samoa, Sudan, East Timor, and Vietnam—due to risk from Aedes albopictus (tiger mosquitoes). Most dengue in the Americas is imported, though local transmission exists in American Samoa, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. In the United States this year, 496 dengue cases have been reported. Dengue typically presents with high fever, severe joint and muscle pain, and rash; about 25% progress to severe dengue, which can cause internal bleeding and be fatal within hours. Severe dengue requires urgent medical care. Travelers should use mosquito bite protection and seek immediate care if warning signs appear. Treatment is supportive: acetaminophen, rest, and fluids.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とトラ蚊が16ヶ国の観光客を脅かしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）。複数対象国での発生報告および社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが列挙した16ヶ国のうち、対象国リストに該当するのはAfghanistan、Bangladesh、Vietnamの3国。記事サマリーではCDCが16ヶ国に対し渡航勧告を発令した旨記載。グローバルなデング熱の上昇傾向が示唆されており、重症化率約25%で致死的リスクも存在。ベクター（ネッタイシマカ）による国際的拡散リスクが顕在化している。

article.articleHeadline: MS: Região indígena de Dourados registra 545 casos confirmados de chikungunya e quatro mortes em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MS: Dourados Indigenous Region records 545 confirmed chikungunya cases and four deaths in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in the Grande Dourados Indigenous Region, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reached 545 confirmed cases with 4 deaths in 2026; 1,193 notifications and 491 investigations as of 23 March 2026. The Ministry of Health deployed emergency measures, authorizing 20 endemic combat agents; total health workforce in the region is 21 professionals, with support from the National Health Force (FNS), the Special Indigenous District Health (DSEI-MS), and the Surveillance and Environment Health Secretariat (SVSA). Actions include mapping health network capacity, expanding hospital beds, improving care regulation, and coordinating transport; hospitals in Dourados (e.g., Santa Casa) available for bed contracting. Aedes aegypti control is emphasized. Symptoms include sudden fever, red rash, severe joint pain; high-risk groups are infants, elderly, and those with comorbidities. In 2025 Brazil approved a chikungunya vaccine; MS will pilot vaccination starting with Indigenous populations, with trained personnel.

triage.headline_ja: MS: ドゥラード先住民地域が2026年にチクングニア545確定症例と4人の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの先住民地域におけるチクングニア感染症の集団発生で、確定症例545例、死亡4例を報告。IHR基準で「公衆衛生への影響は深刻」「異常な発生」に該当し、先住民地域という脆弱集団への影響と政府の緊急対応体制確立が確認されたため。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リスト（WPRO/WPACリスト）に含まれないが、チクングニアは重要な感染症制御対象疾患であり、先住民地域での集団発生は地域保健上の重要なシグナル。死亡例の存在、Aedes aegypti媒介、ワクチン展開計画中など、公衆衛生対応が進行中。記事は信頼できる保健省情報源（Agência Brasil/Ministério da Saúde）からの配信。

article.articleHeadline: MutirÃ£o de limpeza em CurimatÃ¡ foca no combate Ã  dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cleanup drive in Curimatá focuses on dengue control
article.articleSummary: Curimatá, Brazil, will conduct a municipal urban cleanup on Thursday, March 26, 2026, in Vila Baio (Avenida Valdecir and adjacent streets) to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites and curb dengue and other arboviruses. Organized by the Municipal Health Secretariat, the operation collects waste capable of accumulating water, with residents instructed to place debris in front of their homes for pickup. This mutirão is part of a preventive public health calendar and will be replicated in additional neighborhoods across Curimatá. Authorities stress that community cooperation in proper disposal is crucial to strengthen vector control and maintain public hygiene, as environmental management remains central to reducing dengue transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: クリマタでの清掃運動がデング熱対策に焦点
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防的な環境対策（廃棄物清掃）についての記事であり、疾患の発生報告ではない。患者数、死亡、重症例などの疫学情報がなく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の活動的な発生（アウトブレイク）を報告するものではなく、自治体による予防的な衛生管理キャンペーンの実施を伝えるニュースである。蚊媒介ウイルス対策の通常業務として位置付けられるため、感染症イベントのシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta en Estados Unidos por la "fiebre rompehuesos": suben los casos en viajeros que regresan del exterior
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in the United States over "breakbone fever": cases among travelers returning from abroad are rising.
article.articleSummary: CDC issued a travel alert for dengue, or breakbone fever, published March 23, as cases among travelers returning to the United States from abroad rise. As of 2026-03-25, the United States has recorded 496 dengue cases this year, most of them acquired abroad; however, local transmission continues in Puerto Rico, American Samoa, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The alert highlights active circulation in travelers returning from Cuba, Colombia, Vietnam, and also Bolivia, Pakistan, and the Maldives. Dengue is a mosquito-borne virus that causes fever, nausea, vomiting, rash, and severe muscle and joint pain; a dangerous form can cause intense abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, or internal bleeding and can progress rapidly toward death. About 25% of people bitten by infected mosquitoes develop symptoms. Prior dengue infection increases risk of severe disease on reinfection. Prevention includes insect repellent, protective clothing, and seeking medical care if symptoms appear after travel.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がデング熱「骨折熱」について警告：海外から帰国する旅行者の症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の国際的拡大リスク、米国を含む複数国での確認、CDC公式警告の発出、および対象国（ベトナム）での活動循環が確認されている。IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の国際的拡大を示し、米国、キューバ、コロンビア、ボリビア、パキスタン、モルディブ、プエルトリコで活動循環が確認されている。対象国リストではベトナムのみ該当。CDCの公式旅行警告、2026年に既に496例の報告、重症化リスク（致死的進行の可能性）が記述されている。

article.articleHeadline: Saiba identificar os sintomas e como se prevenir da doença de Chagas no Amapá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Learn to identify the symptoms and how to prevent Chagas disease in Amapá.
article.articleSummary: Six cases of Chagas disease were confirmed in Macapá, Amapá, by the SVS, all linked to consumption of contaminated açaí. Two deaths have occurred and four cases remain under investigation. In the acute phase, symptoms include fever for more than seven days, intense malaise, swelling of the face and abdomen, extreme fatigue, and difficulty performing simple activities. Without treatment, the disease can progress to a chronic phase with no cure, causing serious heart, kidney, and digestive system complications. In the Amazon, transmission is typically oral, via açaí contaminated with the triatomine insect (barbeiro). Prevention focuses on consuming only from regulated outlets with proper hygiene and ensuring fruit handling from harvest to processing adheres to protocols. The health system must be prepared to rapidly identify cases and promote preventive screening. Carla Nobre, who contracted Chagas in 2008, underscores the need for vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: アマパ州のシャーガス病の症状を識別し予防する方法を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: シャーガス病の確認症例（死亡2件を含む）が報告されており、IHR基準で異常性・予想外性・重症度が該当。食品汚染経由の集団発生であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: アマゾン地域の特有な経路（アサイ果実の汚染）を介した集団発生。死亡例の報告と慢性化リスク、および継続的な曝露可能性（アサイ流通管理）が懸念される。SVS（国立衛生監視局）による公式確認済み。

article.articleHeadline: Agência Minas Gerais | Governo de Minas amplia vacinação contra chikungunya e inicia aplicação em Santa Luzia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais Agency | Government of Minas expands chikungunya vaccination and begins administering it in Santa Luzia.
article.articleSummary: Santa Luzia, in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan region, begins chikungunya vaccination for adults 18–59, with doses available at UBS and strategic vaccination points. The single-dose vaccine, developed by Instituto Butantan with Valneva, is part of a pilot coordinated by the Ministry of Health to assess effectiveness, safety, and potential incorporation into SUS. Santa Luzia received about 32,000 doses; Congonhas and Sabará received 9,600 and 19,200, respectively, aiming for at least 50% coverage. Sete Lagoas was selected but postponed; ten municipalities participate. As of 24 March, Minas Gerais reports 5,082 probable chikungunya cases and 2,950 confirmed; one death confirmed and another under investigation. The state allocates around R$210 million yearly to arboviruses; 2025 actions include drones, ovitrampas, and Wolbachia releases in Brumadinho to curb transmission, with a 92% dengue reduction vs 2024.

triage.headline_ja: ミナス・ジェライス州政府、サンタ・ルジアでチクングニア予防接種を拡大・開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのミナス・ジェライス州でチクングニア・デング熱が継続しており、州政府による予防接種キャンペーン展開は公衆衛生対応を示す。ただし、記事の主軸は予防接種プログラムの運用状況の報告であり、新規発生の警告信号ではなく、既知の流行への管理的対応の記事であるため、この段階ではWATCHが適切。
triage.notes: 記事はチクングニア流行への政府対応（予防接種プログラム）を報告している。ミナス・ジェライス州内での5,082例の推定患者数と2,950確定患者数、1例の確認死亡が報告されており、デング熱との同時流行も示唆されている。ただし、この記事自体は既知流行への管理的対応の進展報告であり、新規の異常事態の出現ではないため、フルRRAには進まず経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: SES-MS confirma morte de bebê de um mês por chikungunya e óbitos sobem para seis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SES-MS confirms death of a one-month-old baby due to chikungunya, and the death toll rises to six.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya deaths reach six in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, as SES-MS confirms the death of a one-month-old male infant in Dourados; case closed by laboratory criteria after Lacen-MS confirmation. This brings the 2026 chikungunya death toll in MS to six, with the sixth victim a resident of Bonito. Other fatalities include a three-month-old infant (died March 10), a 69-year-old woman (death Feb 13), a 73-year-old man (Mar 9) and a 60-year-old woman (Mar 12). Dourados reports 1,286 probable chikungunya cases, 721 confirmed, with a 76.8% test positivity. Most cases concentrated in the Indigenous Reserve, Jaguapiru and Bororó villages. As of March 24, 27 people were hospitalized with confirmed chikungunya. The municipality has declared a health emergency; the National Health System supports the response. Authorities emphasize Aedes aegypti control and removal of standing water; seek medical care for fever, severe joint pain, headache, or rashes.

triage.headline_ja: SES-MS、チクングニアによる生後1ヶ月の乳児の死亡を確認、死亡者数は6人に増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニアによる死亡事例が確認されており、特に乳幼児（生後1ヶ月）を含む複数の死亡、高い確定症例数（721例）、入院患者（27人）が報告されている。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生への影響と予想外の重症度に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、重症度、流行しやすさが明確である。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年のブラジル・マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州（特にドゥアラドス市）でのチクングニア発生を報告。生後1ヶ月の乳児を含む6人の死亡、721の確定症例、高い検査陽性率（76.8%）、複数の入院患者が記録されている。保健上の緊急事態が宣言されており、管理可能性の観点からも公的支援が動員されている。ただし、国際的な拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限のリスクに関しては現記事では言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ação contra dengue começa neste sábado (28) em 14 bairros de Boa Vista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue control action starts this Saturday (28) in 14 neighborhoods of Boa Vista.
article.articleSummary: Boa Vista, Brazil launches a new arbovirus-control operation starting Saturday, March 28, 2026, targeting dengue, Zika, and chikungunya by eliminating mosquito breeding sites in 14 neighborhoods: Alvorada, Asa Branca, Caranã, Cauamé, Cidade Satélite, Dr. Silvio Botelho, Dr. Silvio Leite, Equatorial, Jóquei Clube, Nova Cidade, Pintolândia, Raiar do Sol, Santa Tereza, and Senador Hélio Campos. The effort concentrates on residences that were closed during prior visits to broaden coverage in areas with high infestation indices. Additional visits are scheduled for April 11 and April 25, in morning and afternoon shifts. During visits, agents inspect yards and advise residents on prevention measures. Residents should allow entry; teams will be identifiable by uniforms and badges.

triage.headline_ja: ボア・ビスタの14地区でデング熱対策行動が今週土曜日（28日）に開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル北部でのデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱に対する公衆衛生対策記事。疾患の異常性や国際的な拡大リスクは明確でなく、情報が限定的であるため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の風土病（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）に対する日常的な蚊媒介感染症対策キャンペーンを報道している。新規の流行状況や異常な事象は記載されていない。WPRO基準では長期曝露と流行リスク（蚊媒介）で2つ該当するが、IHR基準該当なしであり、社会的関心は地域内政府レベルに限定されている。

article.articleHeadline: السفير المصرى لدى غانا يشهد تسلم "الصحة الغانية" معونات طبية مصرية لمعالجة فيروس "سى"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Egyptian ambassador to Ghana witnesses the handover of Egyptian medical aid to the Ghana Health Service to treat the Hepatitis C virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, the Egyptian ambassador to Ghana witnessed the handover of antiviral medications for hepatitis C to the Ghana Health Service to treat HCV. The ceremony was attended by Ghana’s Deputy Minister of Health, members of Parliament, and representatives from the WHO and local media. The Egyptian envoy highlighted President Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi’s initiative to combat hepatitis C and noted that Egypt has achieved World Health Organization certification for complete elimination of HCV, the first country worldwide to eliminate the virus. The handover underscores growing Egypt–Ghana cooperation and broader African-health assistance. Ghanaian officials welcomed the aid as the third consecutive medical shipment from Egypt, aimed at boosting national capacity to address the hepatitis C burden and strengthen regional public health collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: エジプト駐ガーナ大使がガーナ保健局へのC型肝炎治療用エジプト医療支援の引き渡しを目撃
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医療支援の儀式的な引き渡し式を報道するもので、新たな感染症の発生・流行を示す疫学的イベントではない。IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はエジプトからガーナへの医療支援物資（抗ウイルス薬）の引き渡し式であり、疾患の新規発生・流行検出を示すシグナルではない。エジプトがC型肝炎の排除を達成したという過去の成功事例の言及であって、現在の疫学的危機を示していない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Norovirus hits primary school in China's Shanxi - The Rahnuma Daily
article.articleSummary: Norovirus outbreak confirmed at Yucai Primary School in Xiaodian District, Taiyuan, Shanxi Province, China, after initial tests on Wednesday morning. Health authorities report over 100 students have taken leave; classes suspended; online instruction provided. Disinfection and epidemiological investigations are underway; cause under investigation. Norovirus—global common cause of acute gastroenteritis—causes sudden diarrhea and vomiting; not influenza. WHO data: approximately 685 million annual cases, including 200 million in children under 5, about 200,000 deaths per year (50,000 children). Economic cost around $60 billion. Most recover in 1–3 days, but contagious for a few days; dehydration risk heightened in young children.

triage.headline_ja: 中国陕西省でノロウイルスが小学校を襲う
triage.triage_reason: 学校での限定的な集団発生であり、IHR基準は2つ以上該当しない。ただしWPRO基準の「異常/予想外」「重症度」に該当し、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは100名以上の学生が欠席しているが、死亡例や重篤化の報告はない。限定的な学校内集団発生と判断される。ノロウイルスはWPRO基準「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、地理的に限定されており、現時点では国家対応レベルの危機とは判定されない。続報で患者数増加や地域拡大の報告があれば再評価が必要。

locations.name: Virgin Islands of the United States

article.articleHeadline: CDC warns of 'Breakbone Fever' surge across 17 countries
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever surge prompts a CDC travel alert after 496 U.S. cases this year, most acquired abroad. The alert covers 17 countries of concern: Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bolivia, Colombia, Cook Islands, Cuba, Guyana, Maldives, Mali, Mauritania, New Caledonia, Pakistan, Samoa, Sudan, Timor-Leste, Vietnam, and the U.S. territories of American Samoa, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands where local transmission is already common. Dengue is a mosquito-borne illness transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; symptoms include fever, nausea, vomiting, rash, and severe muscle and joint pains (breakbone fever). There is no antiviral treatment; management is supportive. Severe dengue, which can be life-threatening, is more likely during a second infection; warning signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, and bleeding, requiring emergency care. Travelers should use EPA-registered repellents, wear long sleeves, stay in screened or air-conditioned accommodations, and seek prompt testing if fever develops within two weeks of return.

triage.headline_ja: CDCが17カ国でのデングウイルス「骨折熱」の急増を警告
triage.triage_reason: デングウイルスが複数国で多国籍的に拡大しており、IHR基準で「異常/予想外（複数国での同時的な流行）」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。US領域での地域伝播が既に一般的であり、CDCが公式に17カ国に渡航警告を発令している点で社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事では17カ国が列挙されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはベトナムのみ。ただし、記事サマリー中で「496の米国輸入症例」「US領域での地域伝播」が言及されており、米国の関連領域での活動が確認されている。IHR基準とWPRO基準ともに複数該当し、かつ公式な渡航警告という政治的関心の高さから、フルRRA実施のためPICKUPとする。

article.articleHeadline: Poá intensifica ações de combate à tuberculose na próxima segunda-feira (30) na Vila São Francisco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Poá intensifies tuberculosis control actions next Monday (the 30th) in Vila São Francisco.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) control actions in Poá are being intensified throughout March, led by the Health Department's Surveillance in Health in partnership with the Specialized Assistance Service (SAE). The program targets people with symptoms such as persistent cough for 3 weeks or more, afternoon fever, night sweats, weight loss, fatigue, loss of appetite, and more severe cases with hemoptysis. It provides population education, active case finding among respiratory symptoms, and free specimen collection across different city regions to ease access and promote early diagnosis. The mobile outreach will take place next Monday, March 30, on Edwiges Andrade Pimenta Street in Vila São Francisco (Raspadão), from 8 a.m. to noon. Regular population care continues at the SAE, Centro de Especialidades Médicas in Jardim Medina, Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 4 p.m., offering follow-up, testing, and treatment. For more info call (11) 4636-3875 or (11) 4639-7204.

triage.headline_ja: ポア市が3月30日（月）ヴィラ・サン・フランシスコで結核対策活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核の公衆衛生キャンペーン・スクリーニング活動であり、異常な疾患発生や流行の報告ではない。既知疾患の定期的な管理・啓発活動であり、IHR基準やWPROスクリーニング基準に該当せず、国際的リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（Pará州のPoá市）における結核対策の定期的なスクリーニングキャンペーンについて述べており、新規の疾患発生や流行の報告ではない。対象国リストにはブラジルが含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。公衆衛生当局による予防啓発活動として位置づけられ、シグナル検知の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por "gripe rompehuesos" en viajeros que regresan a EUA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning about 'bone-breaking flu' among travelers returning to the U.S.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, nicknamed the 'bone-breaking flu', is prompting health alerts as travelers return to the United States with infections. The CDC reports hundreds of cases in the U.S. this year, mostly linked to international travel. Outbreaks occur across Asia, Latin America, Africa, and the Pacific, with destinations including Colombia, Cuba, Bolivia, Vietnam, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Sudan, among others. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and can cause high fever, severe muscle and joint pains, nausea, vomiting, and rash; some infections progress to severe disease requiring urgent care. About 25% of infections develop symptoms; prior dengue can increase risk of severe manifestations. Local transmission has occurred in Puerto Rico, American Samoa, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Prevention emphasizes mosquito bite avoidance (repellent and long sleeves) in tropical areas or where outbreaks are active. Travelers with fever or intense body pain after travel should seek prompt medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 米国に帰国する旅行者の間で「骨折する流感」による警告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の国際的な多地域での流行と米国への逆輸入ケースが報告されており、IHR基準3項目以上（異常性、国際的拡大、国境越え）およびWPRO基準複数項目に該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明示されている発生地域はコロンビア、キューバ、ボリビア、ベトナム、パキスタン、バングラデシュ、スーダン、プエルトリコ、アメリカンサモア、米領バージン諸島、アジア、ラテンアメリカ、アフリカ、太平洋地域。対象国リストに含まれるのはベトナムのみであるが、提供された情報ではインドが対象国として適切かどうか記事本文では明示されていない。ただし、デング熱の流行地域としてアジア全域が記述されており、インドはアジアのデング流行国として含める。記事の主題は米国への旅行者による逆輸入ケースのため、USは対象国外だが、WPRO域内の複数国での流行と国際的拡大リスクが明確なため、シグナルとして識別する価値が高い。

article.articleHeadline: MG chega a 17 casos de mpox confirmados em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais reaches 17 confirmed mpox cases in 2026
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) outbreaks in Minas Gerais, Brazil: as of March 25, 2026, 17 confirmed cases, all men aged 25–56. Distribution: Belo Horizonte 11, Contagem 3, Formiga 1, Ribeirão das Neves 1, Manhuaçu 1; all cases have recovered. Transmission via direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, and contaminated materials. Symptoms include skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, myalgias, chills, and weakness. No specific antiviral treatment; management is supportive. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with suspected/confirmed cases, isolation during transmissible period, avoiding sharing personal items, and hand hygiene. Vaccination targets high-risk groups: people living with HIV/AIDS with immunosuppression (CD4 <200 cells/µL in last six months), laboratory workers at biosafety level 2, and individuals with direct exposure to fluids/secreta of cases.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州が2026年にmpox確定症例17例に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（異常/予想外性、国際拡大リスク）。Mpox Clade I/IIの流行、複数地域での同時多発事例、HIV陽性者を含むハイリスク集団での発症が確認されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Mpox Clade I/II両方が同時流行中。HIV陽性者（CD4<200）がワクチンターゲット対象となっており、免疫低下者での感染が懸念される。複数の都市（ベロオリゾンテ、コンタージェン、フォルミガ等）での並行発生が確認され、さらなる拡大の可能性がある。現在までに報告された17例はすべて回復しているが、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cuiabá amplia equipes nas UPAs após aumento de casos de influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuiabá expands teams at UPAs after an increase in influenza cases.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A and B are surging in Cuiabá, Brazil, prompting expanded staffing at four UPAs (Verdão, Leblon, Morada do Ouro, Pascoal Ramos). From early 2026 to March, influenza A and B cases rose 824% versus the same period in 2025, with 231 residents confirmed and one death; total notifications reach 300 including non-residents. In the last weeks, 49 new cases were confirmed, though the week-over-week increase fell 54.2%, suggesting a temporary slowdown amid high transmission. SRAG accounts for about 35% of urgent-care visits; gastroenteritis 12%. Over 120 patients with respiratory symptoms sought care in the last 24 hours. To cope, each UPA now has eight doctors per shift (six general practitioners and two pediatricians), totaling 32 clinicians citywide. Officials urge prevention: hand hygiene, avoiding crowds, masking with symptoms, rest and hydration; mild cases should use USFs, severe cases UPAs.

triage.headline_ja: Cuiabá expands teams at UPAs after an increase in influenza cases.
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA型の明らかな流行が報告されており、患者数の急増（824%増加）と死亡例がある。ただし、記事がローカルな対応措置に焦点を当てており、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の言及がないため、IHR基準は明確には満たされない。続報を注視して判断する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが Philippines(1694008) も発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーはブラジルのCuiabáに限定されており、フィリピンでの感染症イベントは記述されていない。したがって verified_locations からは除外。IHR基準は2つ以上該当し、WPRO基準は5つ全て該当するが、記事がローカル対応に焦点化しており国際的拡大の明示的な懸念が述べられていないためWATCHと判定。高い流行性と死亡例があるため、続報監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí ultrapassa 2,5 mil casos de dengue em um mês e registra alta de quase 30%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí surpasses 2,500 dengue cases in one month and records a nearly 30% increase.
article.articleSummary: January dengue cases in Piauí reached 2,557, up 27.85% (557 more) per Sesapi. São Raimundo Nonato reports a suspected dengue death in a 5-year-old; the city has not yet notified Sesapi, with 313 suspected and 69 confirmed there. Teresina records 1,065 suspected cases, 676 confirmed. Officials warn the rainy season could boost transmission. On March 24, São Raimundo Nonato declared a public health emergency due to dengue, initiating intensified home visits, large-scale cleaning, breeding-site elimination, and school/community education with ongoing case monitoring. In February, Sesapi received 6,950 of 13,900 dengue vaccine doses for primary-care workers; the Instituto Butantan vaccine is single-dose, covers four serotypes, with 74.7% efficacy against symptomatic disease and 89% against severe dengue. In Teresina, a two-dose vaccine for ages 10–14 remains available per MoH guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州がデング熱で2,500例を超えており、わずか1ヶ月間で約30%の増加を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ピアウイ州でデング熱の急速な増加（月単位で27.85%増加、2,557例）が報告されており、小児死亡例の報告、公衆衛生上の重大な影響が示唆される。IHR基準（異常・予想外、深刻な影響）を満たし、WPRO基準（異常性、重症度、流行易易性）も複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブラジル（対象国）のピアウイ州で発生。1ヶ月間で2,557例の報告、27.85%の急速な増加、5歳小児の疑い死亡例、公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言（2026年3月24日）が報告されている。雨季の到来により感染が拡大する可能性を警告。ワクチン接種開始等の対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Morte por chikungunya avança no Estado e primeiro caso é registrado em Bonito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death from chikungunya advances in the state, and the first case is recorded in Bonito.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, continues with the first death recorded in Bonito, raising the state total to six fatalities. The Bonito death, a 72-year-old, was confirmed by Lacen-MS after laboratory testing; a 3‑month‑old infant in Dourados is the fifth death. In Dourados, the epidemiological bulletin reports 3,058 probable chikungunya cases, up from prior counts, with 1,452 confirmed; 27 people were hospitalized with confirmed disease as of March 24. Most cases are concentrated in the Indigenous reserves Jaguapiru and Bororó in Dourados, located about 225 km from Campo Grande. Other MS deaths include a 69-year-old woman (Feb 13), a 73-year-old man (Mar 9), and a 60-year-old woman (Mar 12). Transmission is driven by Aedes aegypti; authorities urge elimination of standing-water containers and prompt medical evaluation for fever, severe joint pain, headache, or rash.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの州でチクングニア熱による死亡が増加、ボニートで最初の症例が記録される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（Mato Grosso do Sul州）でチクングニア熱の流行が進行中で、6名の死亡が確認されており、IHR基準の重症度と異常性を満たす。また地域内での継続的な伝播と複数の重症死亡例がWPRO基準の複数項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないが、感染症危機管理上のグローバルシグナルとしての意義を考慮し、記事サマリーに基づき実際の発生地（ブラジルMato Grosso do Sul州）を verified_locations に記載。チクングニア熱は蚊媒介感染症で、Indigenous reserves での集中的な伝播が報告されており、継続的な公衆衛生上の脅威となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Early screening critical to curb risk of tuberculosis - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: TB in India remains a major public health burden, with nearly 28 lakh new cases annually, comprising more than a quarter of the global TB burden. TB primarily affects the lungs but can involve the spine, brain and kidneys, and transmits via airborne spread when an infected person coughs, sneezes or talks. Early symptoms—cough lasting over two weeks, low-grade evening fever, weight loss, night sweats, fatigue—are often overlooked; blood in sputum can occur. High-risk groups include individuals with diabetes or HIV, malnutrition, smoking, pre-existing lung disease, and those in overcrowded, poorly ventilated environments. Early diagnosis is essential; sputum tests and chest X-rays are available, with testing and treatment widely free of cost. Delays risk drug-resistant TB. Treatment requires at least six months of antibiotics; complete the full course. Prevention includes coughing etiquette, ventilation, proper nutrition, and seeking early screening.

triage.headline_ja: 結核のリスク抑制に早期スクリーニングが重要 - The Tribune
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける結核は重大な公衆衛生課題（年28万件の新規患者、世界負担の4分の1以上）として述べられており、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」と「長期曝露」に該当する可能性があるが、記事は啓発・予防メッセージが主体で新たなアウトブレイク情報や異常事象の報告ではないため、情報不足とみなし続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 記事はインド（アムリツァル州）における結核の公衆衛生負担と予防啓発に関する一般的な情報提供であり、新規アウトブレイク、突発的な事象、または異常な疫学パターンの報告ではない。HIV共感染も言及されているが、焦点は結核予防のための早期スクリーニン推奨にある。IHR基準は「重大な公衆衛生影響」のみ該当（基準数1）。WPROスクリーニング基準は「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、新たな異常事象ではないため判定を「WATCH」とした。

article.articleHeadline: Santos reforça ações para reduzir casos de tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santos steps up efforts to reduce tuberculosis cases
article.articleSummary: During a March 24, 2026 seminar in Santos, Brazil, World TB Day events highlighted intensified tuberculosis control. The Municipal Health Plan aims to raise pulmonary TB cure rate to 80% by 2029 and to widen testing among contacts of infected individuals. In 2025, Santos reported 402 TB cases, up from 338 in 2024, with authorities linking the rise to expanded testing and active case finding. The 2024 treatment abandonment rate was 30%. TB is airborne; main symptoms include a cough lasting three weeks or more, fever, night sweats, and weight loss. The World Health Organization views TB as a global challenge with targets to reduce cases and deaths by 2030. Testing and care are free at Santos health units, with no pre-scheduled appointment required.

triage.headline_ja: サントスが結核症例を削減するための取り組みを強化
triage.triage_reason: 結核の症例増加は報告されているが、これは検査拡大と積極的な症例発見の結果であり、新規の公衆衛生危機を示すものではない。地域の予防・治療プログラムの強化に関する施策記事であり、IHR基準やWPRO基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus H1N1 estava entre amostras furtadas de laboratório da Unicamp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The H1N1 virus was among samples stolen from Unicamp's laboratory.
article.articleSummary: H1N1 and H3N2 influenza A virus samples were among materials stolen from Unicamp’s Virology Laboratory in Campinas, Brazil. The items, from the Institute of Biology, disappeared on February 13, 2026 and were recovered by the Federal Police by March 24, 2026. Soledad Palameta Miller, a researcher from the Food Engineering Faculty, was arrested on March 23, 2026 and faces charges of theft, risking public health, and unauthorized transport of genetically modified material. The PF says the samples were moved without authorization to other university labs and remained within campus facilities; no external contamination has been confirmed. All samples were sent to the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock (MAPA), which keeps details about the viral types confidential. Unicamp’s Virology Lab operates at biosafety level 3; H1N1 and H3N2 are influenza A viruses, usually associated with seasonal flu.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1ウイルスはUnicampの研究室から盗まれたサンプルの中にありました
triage.triage_reason: バイオセキュリティインシデント（盗難）として異常・予想外の事象であり、公衆衛生リスク要因を含むが、現時点で実際の感染症の流行や患者発生は報告されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: このイベントは感染症の流行（アウトブレイク）ではなく、バイオセキュリティインシデント（実験室材料の盗難と回収）である。H1N1/H3N2サンプルは盗まれたが、その後キャンパス内で発見・回収されており、外部への流出やヒト感染例は報告されていない。ただし盗取行為の詳細や運搬経路の不規正性から公衆衛生リスクが潜在的に存在するため、捜査進展と検体の詳細な安全性確認について経過観察を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Teresina confirma primeiro caso de dengue tipo 3 após 11 anos sem registro - Portal O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teresina confirms first case of dengue serotype 3 after 11 years without a record - Portal O Dia
article.articleSummary: Teresina, Piauí, Brazil confirms first dengue serotype 3 (DENV-3) case since 2015 (11 years), amid rising dengue activity in the state. From Jan 1–Mar 23, 2026, Teresina recorded 558 dengue cases, down 6.1% from 594 in the same period in 2025; age and sex of the patient are not disclosed by the Fundação Municipal de Saúde. Authorities are intensifying vector control with weekly residential inspections to eliminate breeding sites and zoonoses teams surveying for standing water; public cooperation is urged. Dengue has four serotypes; infection with one type confers immunity only to that type; serotypes 2 and 3 are often associated with more severe disease after reinfection. Vaccination options: a two-dose dengue vaccine is available for children 10–14 at Basic Health Units and Teresina Shopping; a newer single-dose vaccine is offered only to health professionals. Emphasis remains on preventing mosquito proliferation.

triage.headline_ja: テレジーナ、11年ぶりにデング熱3型の最初の症例を確認 - ポータル・オ・ディア
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱3型（DENV-3）の11年ぶりの再出現は地域的に異常・予想外な事象であり、より重篤な再感染の可能性がある。ただし現時点では単一症例の確認であり、直ちにIHR基準2つ以上の満たす根拠に乏しいため、続報の経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは11年ぶりのDENV-3再出現（異常・予想外）、2026年1月1日～3月23日に558症例の発生継続中（曝露の継続）、ヒト-ベクター感染のリスク存在を示す。ただし現時点では単一症例確認のみで、国際的拡大や渡航制限まで至る根拠は未確認。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に入れた。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeito anuncia testagem em massa para a dengue em São Raimundo Nonato - São Raimundo Nonato
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mayor announces mass testing for dengue in São Raimundo Nonato - São Raimundo Nonato
article.articleSummary: São Raimundo Nonato, Piauí, Brazil, declared a health emergency over rising dengue cases. In an interview with Jornal do Piauí on March 25, 2026, Mayor Rogério Castro outlined measures: mass population testing, aggressive vector control, and expanded vaccination pending authorization. The city reported about 600 suspected dengue cases in 2026, with 67 laboratory-confirmed, 377 ruled out, and remaining cases under epidemiological analysis. Concerns center on severe dengue and the circulation of dengue serotype 3, which may cause complications. The plan includes a sanitation blitz and four fumigation vehicles and 15 backpack fogging pumps for targeted areas like schools and public buildings. A hydro jet will be hired to clean streets and catch basins to prevent water stagnation. The municipality has contacted the Ministério da Saúde seeking authorization to broaden vaccination beyond health professionals and at-risk groups, with intent to purchase vaccines for wider immunization if permitted.

triage.notes: ブラジル・ピアウイ州サン・ライムンド・ノナト市での局所的なデング熱集団発生。血清型3の循環と重症化の懸念が報告されているが、国際的拡大のリスクについては記事サマリーから明確な根拠がない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため検証された位置に含める。今後の感染動向と血清型情報の追跡が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: João Pessoa realiza capacitação para prevenção e controle de doenças transmissíveis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: João Pessoa conducts training for the prevention and control of communicable diseases.
article.articleSummary: João Pessoa's city government is strengthening epidemiological surveillance by training personnel in Hospital Epidemiological Surveillance Nuclei (NVEH) stationed in hospitals and UPAs (Urgent Care Units). The program aims to improve detection, notification, and investigation of notifiable diseases, boosting prevention, diagnosis, control, and rapid response. Vaccination training updates staff on immunization calendars, technical norms, and potential adverse reactions, with a focus on swift blocking measures when needed. Danielle Melo, manager of Epidemiological Surveillance, says continuous updates reinforce actions across municipal health services. NVEHs act as extensions of central surveillance within UPAs, hospitals and maternities, overseeing diseases of public health interest—especially immunization-preventable illnesses—and coordinating with environmental, sanitary, and worker health surveillance. For immunopreventable events, expedited contact tracing and assessment of vaccination blocks for patients and health workers are essential. Immediate response after suspected or confirmed transmissible diseases, such as measles or meningitis, aims to interrupt transmission and prevent outbreaks.

triage.notes: 記事は疾患サーベイランス能力構築に関する行政的ニュースであり、感染症イベント（患者発生、流行、異常検知）そのものではない。麻疹が言及されているが、これは訓練対象疾患の例示であり、実際の麻疹発生事例の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Semana Nacional de Luta contra a Tuberculose: FMS alerta sobre sintomas em Teresina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Week of the Fight Against Tuberculosis: FMS Warns About TB Symptoms in Teresina
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) is a priority in Teresina during the National Week of the Fight Against TB, with the Fundação Municipal de Saúde (FMS) promoting active case-finding, awareness, and treatment across UBS clinics. Symptoms include a persistent cough lasting more than three weeks, sometimes with fever, weight loss, night sweats, and sputum. TB is infectious and primarily affects the lungs, spreading via cough, speech, or sneeze. Diagnosis and treatment are provided free through the FMS network; after 15 days of regular therapy, patients are no longer contagious, but a full six-month course with monthly follow-up by the Family Health Team is essential. Prevention includes BCG vaccination for children aged 0–5 and treatment of latent infection for contacts without symptoms. Activities occur in Zona Leste (UBS Satélite, Coroatá, Piçarreira, Santa Bárbara, Taquari, Vila Bandeirante, Santa Luz, Cidade Jardim), Zona Sudeste (Parque Flamboyant, PQ Poty, Atalaia, Quadra 77, Todos os Santos), and Zona Sul (UBS Vermelha); World TB Day is observed on 24 March.

article.articleHeadline: JJ: HU registra aumento de 123% nos casos de Síndrome Respiratória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: HU reports a 123% increase in cases of Respiratory Syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Between January and March 2026, Hospital Universitário da Faculdade de Medicina de Jundiaí (HU-FMJ), in Jundiaí, Brazil, recorded 96 cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI), a 123% increase from 43 cases in the same period of 2025. The institution intensified monitoring of respiratory diseases in early 2026 and urged heightened awareness of symptoms and preventive measures among the population. No laboratory-confirmation details or etiological agents are provided in the report. The data underscore a rising burden of severe respiratory illness in the region, prompting ongoing surveillance by HU-FMJ; the piece does not specify whether the elevated cases reflect a single outbreak, concurrent infections, or seasonal trends. Public health messaging emphasizes symptom vigilance and general preventive practices to reduce transmission.

article.articleHeadline: 고병원성 AI에 백신 필요성 제기...'무증상 확산' 부작용 우려도
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Calls for a vaccine against highly pathogenic avian influenza... concerns about adverse effects of 'asymptomatic spread'.
article.articleSummary: 60 outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) on Korean poultry farms this winter, more than double the 32 outbreaks in 2022–2023, with culling of over 10 million laying hens—the largest in five years. The Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs weighs shifting from a culling-centric policy to vaccination-based control, with pilot vaccination planned in regions including the West Coast. Proponents argue vaccination could reduce transmission and be cost-effective relative to culling compensation, noting usage in China and Southeast Asia. Critics warn vaccination may cause asymptomatic infections, hindering early detection and risking widespread transmission, with concerns about vaccine effectiveness. The government plans domestic vaccine development by 2027, but actual adoption remains under review due to detection gaps and the zoonotic risk of avian influenza.

triage.headline_ja: 高病原性AIにワクチン必要性提起...'無症状拡散'の副作用懸念も
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザの大規模アウトブレイク（韓国で過去5年最大規模）であり、人獣共通感染症としてのリスク、ワクチン戦略の転換を巡る政策的議論、および国際的な関心の高さから、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国における高病原性鳥インフルエンザの大規模アウトブレイク（1000万羽以上の殺処分）をめぐる政策議論が主題であるが、Bluedot APIの発生地域には韓国が含まれていない。一方、サマリーではワクチン使用例としてChinaと東南アジアが言及されており、中国は対象国リストに含まれるため China (1814991) を verified_locations に含める。韓国（GeoNames ID 1835841）は評価対象国リストに含まれないため除外。IHR基準4項目全て該当（重度の経済的影響、予想外の規模、国際的な防疫上の関心、家禽貿易への影響）。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。

article.articleHeadline: Cum recunoști malaria la timp: de la cazul copiilor infectați recent la metodele de protecție recomandate de medici
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to recognize malaria early: from the case of recently infected children to the protective measures recommended by doctors.
article.articleSummary: Two of three children from Iași who recently returned from travel in Africa have laboratory-confirmed malaria and are hospitalized at Victor Babeș Infectious Diseases Hospital in Bucharest; they are 3 and 5 years old and in good condition after timely intervention. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by mosquitoes; after infection parasites multiply in the liver and then invade red blood cells, causing fever and chills, headache, muscle pain, malaise, and sometimes diarrhea. If untreated within the first five to six days, it can progress to severe complications or death. The disease is not human-to-human contagious and is vector-borne. Doctors advise anti-malarial prophylaxis before trips to endemic zones, tailored to age, though some travelers skip it due to information gaps or mistrust in medicine. Additional measures include bed nets, insect repellents, covering skin, and avoiding night exposure. Endemic countries include Nigeria, Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, Mozambique, Ghana, and Tanzania; risk is also present in other countries, especially rural forest-adjacent areas.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアを早期に認識する方法：最近感染した子どもの事例から医師が推奨する予防措置まで
triage.triage_reason: ルーマニアで帰国した子ども2人がアフリカ渡航後にマラリアと診断された局所的な事例。IHR基準は該当せず、スクリーニング基準では異常性と重症度に該当するが、確定患者数が限定的で国際拡大リスクは低い。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はルーマニアの帰国旅行者の事例だが、対象国リストに該当する検証済み地域はアフリカのエンデミック国（DRC、ガーナ）として言及されている。患者発症地はルーマニア（対象国外）であるため、影響を受ける対象国はアフリカのエンデミック国のみ。ルーマニアでのマラリア発生は局所的かつ限定的で、コミュニティでの流行の兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: MS tem 3.058 confirmações de chikungunya e Fátima do Sul passa Dourados em número de casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MS has 3,058 confirmed chikungunya cases, and Fátima do Sul surpasses Dourados in the number of cases
article.articleSummary: As of March 25, 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul's epidemiological bulletin reports 3,058 probable chikungunya cases and 1,452 confirmed cases. The outbreak appears to be expanding from the Dourados Indigenous Reserve to other municipalities. Fátima do Sul has moved ahead of Dourados with 477 confirmed cases versus 368. Other districts reporting cases include Jardim (209), Sete Quedas (85), Bonito (52, first death in this bulletin), Aquidauana (42), Vicentina (29), Guia Lopes da Laguna (24), Corumbá (14), Nioaque (12), Itaporã (9), and Maracaju and Três Lagoas (8 each). In Dourados, most infections remain in the Jaguapiru and Bororó Indigenous villages, with 27 people hospitalized on the bulletin date. The four additional deaths attributed to chikungunya are a 3‑month‑old baby (died Mar 10), a 69‑year‑old woman (died Feb 13), a 73‑year‑old man (died Mar 9), and a 60‑year‑old woman (died Mar 12).

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州が3,058件のチクングニア確定例を報告、ファティマ・ド・スルがドゥラドスを上回る

triage.notes: ブラジルのマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州で進行中のチクングニア熱流行。先住民地域（Jaguapiru・Bororó村）から複数の自治体への拡大が報告され、死亡者（含む乳幼児）も確認されている。流行の拡大傾向が明確で、対象国リストではBrazilが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Путешественников предупредили о риске заразиться лихорадкой денге в 16 странах
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Travelers have been warned about the risk of contracting dengue fever in 16 countries.
article.articleSummary: As of March 25, 2026, dengue fever is active in 16 tourist destinations, per the New York Post. Surge among travelers returning from Afghanistan, Colombia, Pakistan, and Vietnam; additional cases reported from Cuba, Maldives, Bolivia, New Caledonia, Bangladesh, Cook Islands, Guyana, Mauritania, Samoa, Sudan, and East Timor. Incubation is about two weeks; early symptoms include headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, nausea and vomiting. Severe dengue can cause bleeding, hypotension, and death. In 2025, two cases were confirmed in Moscow Oblast among travelers returning from Sri Lanka. Dengue is transmitted by mosquitoes. Earlier, Natalia Dormidoshina, a former Saint Petersburg gossip columnist, contracted dengue; and the wife of billionaire Yuri Dormidoshin fell ill in Bali and was hospitalized in serious condition.
