triage.notes: Bluedot APIが16ヶ国以上を列挙しているが、記事サマリーに基づき対象国リスト内で実際にデング熱イベントの主題となっているのはインドネシア（バリ州）とベトナムのみ。モスクワの事例は旅行者の帰還例であり、ロシアは対象国でない。複数の高名人感染例が報告されており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。デング熱の重症例・死亡リスク、蚊媒介による継続曝露リスクが存在。

article.articleHeadline: Continúa en descenso sostenido la Influenza en Puerto Rico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza continues to decline steadily in Puerto Rico.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Puerto Rico continues to decline but remains circulating. For the week of March 8–14, 2026, 1,445 new influenza cases were reported, bringing the season total to 59,600 (2025–2026). About 59.8% of lab-confirmed cases were influenza B; 48.7% occurred in 0–19 year-olds. Twelve school outbreaks were identified (Fajardo 5; Metro 3; Bayamón 3; Mayagüez 1); none in Caguas, Arecibo or Ponce. Weekly hospitalizations were 6.8%. Regions with the largest cumulative totals: Caguas 11,781; Ponce 11,056; Bayamón 10,378. Influenza deaths this season reach 181 confirmed, with 3 newly reported and 3 under investigation; most decedents were over 70 or unvaccinated. Vaccination stands at 445,320 doses in 2025–2026, 76,451 more than last season to date. COVID-19 shows 141 new cases; RSV 24 (total 616) with 238 hospitalizations and no deaths; Dengue 11 (total 348) with one death. Hotline 787-522-3985.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザはプエルトリコで継続的に減少
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器感染症が循環中だが、いずれも既知の季節性/風土病的パターンの範囲内であり、IHR基準やWPRO基準の重篤性や異常性を満たさない。記事の主眼は「減少傾向」の報告であり、新興の公衆衛生危機を示唆する要素がない。
triage.notes: プエルトリコは米国の海外領土であり、対象国リスト（Zambia、Philippines、Thailand等）に含まれていない。記事サマリーはインドネシア（Provinsi Lampung、Metro）の地名も含むが、本文では触れられておらず、Bluedot APIの地名抽出エラーと判断される。実質的な感染症イベント発生地はプエルトリコのみであるため、対象国外として verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde confirma morte de bebê por chikungunya, a 5ª em um mês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health confirms baby's death from chikungunya, the fifth in a month.
article.articleSummary: As of March 25, 2026, chikungunya deaths reach five in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, including a one-month-old indigenous baby from Jaguapiru who died on March 24 after symptom onset March 17; another indigenous infant, 3 months old, died on March 10. Other fatalities: two women aged 60 and 69, and a 73-year-old man. In the last 24 hours, Dourados reported 352 new suspected chikungunya cases, raising totals to 1,638 probable cases, 780 confirmed, 218 discarded, and 858 under investigation. The Bororó and Jaguapiru Indigenous Reserve accounts for 1,396 cases, with transmission extending to Jardim Jóquei Clube and Parque do Lago II. Dourados declares a public health emergency; test positivity among those tested with symptoms is 78.15%. Response includes hiring 20 additional endemic-control agents, distributing larvicides, and expanding hospital capacity; the National Force of SUS has operated since March 18, coordinating with DSEI and state/municipal health services.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局がチクングニアによる乳幼児の死亡を確認、1ヶ月間で5例目
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な死亡発生パターン、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも高重症度（複数死亡、乳幼児含む）と流行促進要因（先住民居住区での高い感染率78.15%、ヒト-ヒト感染）が確認される。
triage.notes: マットグロッソドスル州ドゥラードスにおける短期間での急速な死亡増加（1ヶ月間に5例）は極めて異常。先住民居住区（ジャグアピル、ボロロ保護区）での高い陽性率（78.15%）と確定症例780例の増加は活発な流行を示唆。公開情報から国家対応（SUS国家部隊の派遣、公衆衛生緊急事態宣言）が取られている。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya avança no Estado e registra 1ª morte em Bonito; MS já soma seis óbitos -- AconteceuMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya advances in the state and records its first death in Bonito; Mato Grosso do Sul already has six deaths.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya advances in Mato Grosso do Sul with its first death in Bonito, raising the state's 2026 toll to six. The victim is a 72-year-old, case under investigation and laboratory-confirmed by Lacen-MS. The bulletin also records the fifth death in Dourados — a baby — underscoring the outbreak's severity, with all Dourados deaths occurring among residents of indigenous villages. Probable chikungunya cases more than doubled, indicating transmission beyond the initial focus in the Indigenous Reserve in Dourados. Health authorities urge intensified Aedes aegypti control and elimination of water-holding containers such as tires, bottles, gutters, and uncovered tanks. Residents are advised to seek medical care when experiencing fever, severe joint pain, headaches, or skin rashes to ensure diagnosis and follow-up. Continuous epidemiological monitoring is maintained.

triage.headline_ja: Chikungunyaがマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州で拡大し、ボニートで初の死亡を記録。マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州は既に6件の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準3つ以上該当（異常性、重症度、流行性）。死亡者増加と多地域拡大を示すシグナル。
triage.notes: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州での2026年の累計死亡者数は6件（ボニートで初の1件、ドゥアルドスで5件目を記録）。先住民村落での感染拡大が顕著。Aedes aegypti媒介蚊の制御が課題。継続的な疫学監視が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue leva São Raimundo Nonato - PI a declarar estado de emergência
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue leads São Raimundo Nonato, Piauí, to declare a state of emergency.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak in São Raimundo Nonato, Piauí, Brazil prompts a state of emergency after 290 dengue cases were recorded between February and March 2026. Dengue serotype 3, associated with more severe disease, is circulating. The municipal plan includes door-to-door health visits, mass cleanup campaigns, elimination of Aedes aegypti breeding sites, and ongoing case monitoring. Fogging trucks (fumacê) will expand from 14 neighborhoods to additional neighborhoods and rural areas following the emergency declaration. Residents are urged to participate in eliminating mosquito habitats inside homes. Initial emergency duration is 60 days, with possible extension. São Raimundo Nonato is the gateway to Serra da Capivara National Park, which houses numerous prehistoric sites and attracted about 45,000 visitors in 2025, underscoring ongoing transmission risk related to tourism.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱がサンタレイムンドノナート市（ピアウイ州）に緊急事態宣言をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。さらにWPRO基準5つすべて該当。ブラジルはCEPR対象国であり、デング熱3型という重症化傾向の高い血清型の流行が確認されており、観光地での継続的な伝播リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: デング熱3型（重症化関連血清型）の流行、2026年2〜3月間に290例の確認、60日間の緊急事態宣言発令、セラダカピバラ国立公園への年45,000人超の観光客流入による国際的伝播リスク、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため別途検討が必要だが、CEPR重点地域としてのシグナル価値は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose avança no Brasil e pode ser silenciosa; saiba identificar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis advances in Brazil and can be silent; learn to identify it.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) in Brazil remains a major public health threat. The country averages about 10 new TB diagnoses per hour, with 2024 data showing 85,936 new cases and around 6,000 deaths. TB is the leading cause of death from a single infectious agent globally, surpassing Covid-19 and AIDS, and Brazil’s TB mortality rose 32.6% over 15 years. A ScienceDirect study of nearly 1,000 domestic contacts found 82.4% were asymptomatic at screening, highlighting silent transmission potential beyond a persistent cough. TB mainly affects the lungs but can involve lymph nodes, bones, kidneys, or the central nervous system (extrapulmonary). Treatment is 100% free through the public health system, lasting at least six months with a combination of antibiotics; full adherence is crucial to prevent relapse and drug resistance. Exposed individuals should seek evaluation even if asymptomatic, during the National Week of Mobilization and Fight Against TB (Mar 24–31).

triage.headline_ja: 結核がブラジルで急速に拡大し、静かに進行する可能性がある。識別方法を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: 結核は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、ブラジルでは年間約86,000件の新規患者と6,000件の死亡が報告されている。無症状感染の可能性が高く（82.4%が無症状）、IHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためシグナルとしてピックアップされる。
triage.notes: 結核は既知疾患だが、ブラジルにおける急速な増加傾向（32.6%の死亡率上昇）と無症状感染の高い割合が公衆衛生上の重大な脅威と評価される。National Week of Mobilization and Fight Against TB（3月24-31日）が進行中であり、政府・社会的関心が高い状況が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Minas já registra 25% dos casos de chikungunya de 2025; testes com vacina começam em Santa Luzia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais already accounts for 25% of the 2025 chikungunya cases; vaccine trials begin in Santa Luzia.
article.articleSummary: As of March 25, 2026, Minas Gerais accounts for 25% of 2025 chikungunya cases, with 4,983 probable cases, 2,881 confirmed, and 1 death. Through 2025, total chikungunya cases exceeded 20,000. Santa Luzia in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area begins vaccine trials using the Butantan–Valneva vaccine; Santa Luzia received 32,000 doses, while Congonhas and Sabará received 29,000 doses, with ten municipalities nationwide participating. The single-dose vaccine targets adults 18–59 years and is contraindicated for pregnant or lactating individuals, the immunocompromised, those on immunosuppressants, people with two or more comorbidities or a history of allergic reactions to components. The goal is to assess effectiveness and reduce severe disease and deaths, aiming for at least 50% coverage among eligible individuals. Separately, Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti released in Brumadinho seek to lower transmission of dengue, chikungunya, and zika, with expansion to 21 more municipalities in the Paraopeba basin.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州は2025年のチクングニア症例の25%を占める。サンタルシアで誌察ワクチン試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのミナスジェライス州で複数の蚊媒介ウイルス（チクングニア、デング、ジカ）が同時流行しており、確認症例2,881例と死亡1例を記録している。ワクチン試験とWolbachia制御プログラムの実施により、公衆衛生上の重要な対応が進行中。IHR基準および社会的関心から評価対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル内でのチクングニア症流行とワクチン試験、およびWolbachia導入による蚊媒介感染症制御プログラムについて報告している。複数の蚊媒介感染症（チクングニア、デング、ジカ）が共存し、ワクチン試験と生物的制御策が並行して実施されている点で注目度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Quarto caso de morcego com raiva na Capital é registrado no bairro Jardim Campo Alto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fourth rabid bat case in the capital registered in the Jardim Campo Alto neighborhood.
article.articleSummary: Fourth positive rabies case in bats in 2026 detected in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul. The animal was collected in the Jardim Campo Alto neighborhood. CCZ notes ongoing viral circulation remains active in the capital; unlike earlier cases found on high floors, this event reinforces monitoring across all property types and city regions. After capture, specimens undergo technical processing and are sent with a notification to the reference laboratory for testing; diagnosis is not conducted by CCZ and results are reported to the municipality. Public health guidance: do not touch bats, whether alive or dead. If a bat is found down or acting abnormally, isolate the area and avoid contact; cover with a bucket or box. Ensure dogs/cats are up to date on rabies vaccination, as they are the main transmission bridge to humans. Contact CCZ for safe removal and lab analysis. General inquiries: (67) 3313-5000; WhatsApp (67) 99142-5701.

triage.headline_ja: 首都で4番目の狂犬病ウイルス感染コウモリがJardim Campo Alto地区で報告される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国）でのコウモリを媒介とした狂犬病の継続的な流行を示すシグナルだが、人間への感染例や重症例の報告がなく、地域の監視体制が機能している。スクリーニング基準1つ以上該当するが、情報不足のため要経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 2026年にCampo Grandeで報告された4番目のコウモリ狂犬病陽性例。記事は人間への実際の感染例を報告していない。ウイルス循環が活発であり、継続的な監視が必要。地域の公衆衛生対策（ワクチン接種、安全な除去手順）が機能している。将来の人間感染例の報告があれば、トリアージレベルの引き上げが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh tay chân miệng tăng cấp, 3 ca tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot and mouth disease escalates; 3 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) is escalating in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, with 3 deaths in 2026 and Enterovirus 71 (EV71) detected among circulating strains. At the Children’s Hospital Nhi Dong 1, about 30 HFMD inpatients are treated, with roughly one-third in severe condition (stages 2B–3); the emergency/critical care unit is crowded, and the hospital handles 60–70 outpatient visits daily. Bệnh viện Nhi Đồng 2 reports 652 outpatient and 76 inpatient in February; by 1–23 March, 866 outpatient and 86 inpatient (including 10 at stage 2B). EV71 was found in 25% of tested samples (6/24). A 3-year-old from Tay Ninh (L.) developed meningitis but recovered after timely treatment. Authorities urge prompt hospitalisation, as HFMD can cause meningitis, encephalitis, respiratory and circulatory failure; care and insurance coverage exist at local facilities. Cases peak March–May and September–December; under-5 children are most at risk, with 60–70% of cases originating from or presenting in the city from other provinces.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病が悪化、3人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準も複数該当。重症化例と死亡が確認され、EV71という高病原性株の検出が報告されている。
triage.notes: ベトナムのホーチミン市における手足口病（HFMD）の急速な拡大を報告。EV71の検出（検査サンプルの25%）は特に懸念材料。重症度が高く（ステージ2B～3）、死亡例3件、複数の合併症（髄膜炎、脳炎、呼吸不全）が報告されている。5歳未満の小児が高リスク。セアリアル記事（2026年3月25日）であるため、近年の傾向を反映している可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Fátima do Sul ultrapassa Dourados em casos confirmados de Chikungunya em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fátima do Sul Surpasses Dourados in Confirmed Chikungunya Cases in MS
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reached 3,058 probable cases in 2026, with 1,452 laboratory-confirmed. Fátima do Sul now leads confirmed cases (477), surpassing Dourados (368); Jardim 209; Sete Quedas 85; Bonito 52 (first death). Other municipalities include Aquidauana 42, Vicentina 29, Guia Lopes da Laguna 24, Corumbá 14, Nioaque 12, Itaporã 9, Maracaju 8, Três Lagoas 8; Campo Grande 1. Fátima do Sul shows the highest incidence at 2,353.3 per 100,000. Dourados remains a hotspot, especially in the Jaguapiru and Bororó Indigenous Reserve, but transmission is spreading to other towns and urban neighborhoods. Hospitalizations reach at least 27 in Dourados; municipal surveillance lists 37 hospitalizations overall. Five chikungunya deaths in 2026: two Indigenous infants; three elderly victims (69-year-old woman, 73-year-old man, 60-year-old woman); also a death in Bonito (72-year-old man) reported.

triage.headline_ja: ファティマ・ド・スル市がドゥアドス市を上回るチクングニア確認症例数（MS州）
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部マト・グロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニアが3,058例（確認1,452例）に達し、5人の死亡を含む重症者が発生。複数の自治体で広がっており、IHR基準2つ以上該当かつ社会的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 2026年のチクングニア流行はマト・グロッソ・ド・スル州で急速に拡大。先住民地域（ジャグアピル・ボロロ保護区）での感染とともに、都市部への拡散が懸念される。死亡例（高齢者5名を含む）と入院例が報告され、重症度が高い。対象国リスト内のブラジルのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Brusque utiliza SMS para alertar moradores sobre casos de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brusque uses SMS to alert residents about dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: Brusque, Brazil, uses SMS alerts to warn residents about dengue cases. In neighborhoods with confirmed dengue, residents receive text messages detailing the locality and providing guidance to prevent further transmission by eliminating mosquito breeding sites. The initiative, developed by the city’s Civil Defense in collaboration with the Health Department and Vigilância Sanitária, relies on daily case monitoring to determine when and where alerts should be issued, and can expand as the epidemiological situation evolves. Alerts can be sent via SMS and may also be disseminated through WhatsApp, cable TV, and Cell Broadcast. Brusque was among the first Brazilian municipalities to deploy the federal IDAP alert platform for dengue, enabling area-specific messaging. Key recommendations include eliminating standing water, keeping water tanks sealed, and cleaning gutters and yards to curb Aedes aegypti proliferation.

triage.headline_ja: ブルスケ市がSMSを利用して住民にデング熱の症例について警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の局地的なデング熱対策事例であり、公衆衛生上の異常度は低い。情報が限定的なため、スクリーニング基準への明確な該当が難しく、経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の都市（ブルスケ）における局地的なデング熱警告システムの展開について述べており、新規発生の大規模集団発生ではなく対応策の事例報告と考えられる。死亡数や重症度に関する記載がなく、深刻度の評価は困難。ブラジルのデング熱は風土病として常在しており、予想外ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Infectologista diz que sarampo é uma 'superameaça' e ressalta a importância das duas doses da vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious disease specialist says that measles is a 'super-threat' and emphasizes the importance of the two doses of the vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, measles poses a 'super-threat' in the Americas, with cases in Mexico, the United States, Canada, and Brazil. The disease is described as the most transmissible on the planet. Infectious disease specialist Mirian Dal Ben says resurgent diagnoses stem from declines in vaccination coverage, jeopardizing both current and future public health. The infection can cause grave sequelae in children, including neurological damage. Dal Ben urges vaccination, noting free availability via Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS), with the first dose at 12 months and a booster at 15 months. Although first-dose uptake is high, second-dose adherence commonly falls below 80%, undermining protection for children and communities. She stresses keeping vaccination records for children and adults, since measles remains extremely serious and threatens to re-emerge if immunity gaps persist.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症専門医が麻疹は「スーパー脅威」であり、ワクチン2回接種の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹が米州全域で再興し複数国での同時発生が報告されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当。対象国ブラジルでの確認事例と、公開された医学専門家の警告により社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは米州全域での麻疹再興を報告しており、米国・メキシコ・カナダも含まれているが、対象国リストでは対象外。対象国ブラジルが明示的に言及されているため verified_locations に含める。ワクチン接種率低下による集団免疫の崩壊が指摘されており、公衆衛生上の懸念は深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Tubarão registra aumento para 262 focos da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tubarão records an increase to 262 dengue foci.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 March 2026, Tubarão reports a sharp rise in dengue-related Aedes aegypti foci, increasing from 181 to 262 in one week, with the first autochthonous dengue transmission confirmed within the city. The Epidemiological Surveillance notes 39 notifications of possible cases: 32 dismissed, 6 under investigation, and 1 locally transmitted case, signaling active vector circulation and localized outbreak risk. Foci are distributed across multiple neighborhoods, led by Centro (37), Oficinas (29), and Recife (21); Humaitá (19), Revoredo (18), Vila Moema and Morrotes (16 each); Humaitá de Cima (13); Fábio Silva, Santo Antônio de Pádua and São João Margem Esquerda (11 each). Authorities urge community action to eliminate breeding sites: inspect yards, discard standing water, seal water tanks, and clean gutters and drains. For suspected foci, contact Ouvidoria Municipal at (48) 3621-9051 or [email protected].

triage.headline_ja: トゥバラン市でデング熱の発生地が262箇所に増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の複数地域でデング熱の急速な拡大が報告されており、1週間で181から262の発生地への増加、初の局所伝播確認、複数地域での同時発生という異常性と重症度が認められ、IHR基準2項目以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年3月25日付で、ブラジルのサンタカタリーナ州トゥバラン市を中心にデング熱の急速な増加を報告している。1週間で発生地が81箇所増加し、初めての局所伝播（autochthonous transmission）が確認された。複数の近隣地域に分散した発生地が報告されており、蚊媒介性疾患の活発な循環を示唆している。当局は予防措置（ヤード検査、積水排除、タンク密閉など）を呼びかけている。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique économie - Le combat de l'Afrique du Sud contre la fièvre aphteuse qui contamine le bétail
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African economy - South Africa's battle against foot-and-mouth disease that is contaminating livestock.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), a highly contagious livestock illness with no human transmission, has escalated into a national crisis in South Africa, spreading across provinces and prompting Pretoria to declare a national disaster. A dairy farm near Johannesburg is under quarantine as outbreaks recur; infected cows show mouth and hoof lesions, and milk from affected animals is unsellable. Producers report about 14% of the herd lost (deaths and euthanasia); production on the least-affected farm fell 40%, and up to 70% on others, with more than 500,000 litres of milk discarded at the peak. After earlier containment struggles, the government shifted to proactive vaccination, importing vaccine from Argentina and administering 2 mL per animal. Plan: 28 million doses by year-end to immunize 14 million animals, with boosters, targeting 80% herd coverage and a 70% reduction in new infections. Operations led by Agriculture Minister John Steenhuisen in KwaZulu-Natal; some neighbors and China have blocked SA beef imports.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ経済 - 家畜を汚染する口蹄疫に対する南アフリカの戦い
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は家畜に限定した疾病（ヒト感染なし）であり、対象国（CEPR WPROの監視対象国）に該当しない南アフリカでの発生であるため、PICKUP基準に該当しない。ただし大規模な農業危機であり、国際的な輸入規制が既に発生しているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は南アフリカでの口蹄疫発生であり、対象国（CEPR WPROの監視対象である895949=Zambia, 1694008=Philippines, 1605651=Thailand, 2300660=Ghana, 203312=DRC, 3469034=Brazil, 1643084=Indonesia, 1814991=China, 1327865=Myanmar, 1562822=Vietnam, 1269750=India）には該当しない。Bluedot APIが Argentina と China を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーではアルゼンチンはワクチン供給国、中国は輸入規制国として言及されており、実際の発生地ではない。口蹄疫はヒト感染のない家畜疾病であり、CEPR EBS活動の対象外である可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழகத்தில் டெங்கு பாதிப்பை குறைக்க உடனடி நடவடிக்கைகளை அதிகரிக்க சுகாதாரத் துறை அறிவுறுத்தல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health department advisory to intensify urgent measures to curb dengue in Tamil Nadu
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever advisory issued by Tamil Nadu Health Department urges intensified measures across districts to curb dengue transmission. Director Somasundaram states that high temperatures, irregular rainfall, and unusual weather changes facilitate Aedes mosquito breeding and dengue spread. Despite a historically severe dengue burden, last year saw reduced cases and deaths due to coordinated district administration and health interventions; this year aims for further reductions. Actions include real-time uploading of dengue on the health portal to ensure timely information, ongoing vector surveillance and breeding control, adequate diagnostic testing kits, and measures to prevent mosquito breeding in homes and industrial premises. Public awareness campaigns are to be intensified, aligned with integrated health department operations across municipalities.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州におけるデング熱の影響を軽減するための緊急措置強化を保健局が指示
triage.triage_reason: インドで定期的に発生するデング熱の流行対策に関する行政通知。既知の流行疾患であり、深刻な国際的拡大リスクは不明だが、タミル・ナードゥ州の感染制御強化措置の実施が確認され、継続的な情報監視の価値あり。
triage.notes: タミル・ナードゥ州でのデング熱は季節性の既知の流行疾患。記事は保健当局による流行対策強化に関する行政通知であり、緊急的な新興感染症ではない。ただしベクター媒介感染症の流行リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行しやすさ（epidemic_prone）が確認される。昨年の症例・死亡減少実績と今年の進一層の削減目標が記載されており、当局による継続的な管理体制が構築されている。WATCH段階で経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Teresina registra caso de dengue tipo 3 após mais de 15 anos sem circulação no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teresina records a dengue serotype 3 case after more than 15 years without circulation in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Dengue serotype 3 case confirmed in Teresina, Brazil—the first circulation of DENV-3 since 2008 and potentially linked to more severe disease. Fundação Municipal de Saúde (FMS) has intensified monitoring and Aedes aegypti control. Data from CIEVS show 558 confirmed dengue cases in Teresina from January 1 to March 23, 2026, down from 594 in the same period in 2025 (−6.1%). Despite the decline, authorities urge vigilance during the rainy season. Walfrido Salmito says educational and vector-control actions are expanding; community participation remains essential, with weekly home inspections to eliminate standing water. Dr. Amariles Borba notes that infection by one dengue serotype does not confer immunity to others, and repeats of infection—especially with types 2 and 3—raise risk of severe disease. Hydration is advised. Vaccination: two-dose dengue vaccine for ages 10–14 at health units and Teresina Shopping; single-dose version for health professionals only. Elimination of standing water remains primary prevention.

triage.headline_ja: テレシーナ、ブラジルで15年以上流行していないデング熱3型の症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: デング熱3型（DENV-3）が15年以上ぶりにブラジルで再流行。既存デング感染者との重感染リスク、より重症化の可能性があり、公衆衛生への影響は深刻。予想外の新規流行として該当。
triage.notes: デング熱3型は15年以上流行していなかった血清型であり、既にブラジル国内で循環している他の血清型（特に2型）との重感染により重症化リスク（DHF/DSS）が高まる。当局は積極的な媒介蚊（ネッデスエジプティ蚊）対策とワクチン接種を推進中。雨期を控えた時期の再流行であり、ベクター管理が重要。

article.articleHeadline: CCZ mantém ações focadas no combate ao Aedes com base no Ovitrampas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CCZ maintains actions focused on combating Aedes based on ovitraps.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Campos dos Goytacazes, Rio de Janeiro State, is under control with March incidence around 3.6 dengue cases per 100,000 inhabitants. The Campos Zoonoses Control Center (CCZ) attributes progress to ongoing Aedes aegypti control and surveillance using ovitraps (Ovitrampas) to monitor indexes and guide targeted hotspot interventions. Vector Control Program coordinator Claudemir Barcelos notes mutirão campaigns focus on high infestation areas. Planning follows Health Ministry guidelines, with emphasis on the LIRAa rapid index survey in May and trap data. Ovitrampa devices consist of a black vessel with water and beer yeast to attract eggs; traps are placed about 300 meters apart. After sampling, eggs are counted and species identified (Aedes aegypti or Aedes albopictus). Results feed the calculation of the Ovitrampa Positivity Index (IPO) and the Egg Density Index (IDO).

triage.headline_ja: CCZはオビトラップスに基づくネッタイシマカの撲滅に焦点を当てた行動を維持する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのリオデジャネイロ州カンポス市のデング熱は制御下にあり、3月の発生率は10万人当たり3.6例と低水準。記事は予防的な蚊類制御活動と監視システムの説明であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の制御が進行中であることを示す日常的な疾病監視・ベクター対策の実施報告である。発症者数が少なく、既存プログラムの効果的実施を示しており、シグナル特性を示さない。

article.articleHeadline: Acre registra mais de 640 casos de tuberculose e 15 mortes em 2025; taxa de cura supera 80% - O Alto Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre reports more than 640 tuberculosis cases and 15 deaths in 2025; cure rate exceeds 80% - O Alto Acre.
article.articleSummary: Across Acre, Brazil, 641 tuberculosis cases were reported in 2025, with 15 deaths. Cure reached 320 cases (83%), while 40 patients abandoned treatment (10.3%). Pulmonary TB remains the most common form. The year shows a slight decrease from 661 cases in 2024. Acre is recognized by the Ministry of Health as a reference in TB control, with 68.2% of municipalities achieving the cure target for laboratory-confirmed new cases. The 2025 campaign follows the theme 'Yes! We Can End TB', emphasizing coordinated public-health actions and investment. The Week of Mobilization (Mar 23–27) includes active case finding, health talks, and outreach in Rio Branco and the interior. Diagnosis and treatment are free via SUS; treatment lasts at least six months, with transmission risk dropping after about 15 days of therapy. For 2026, ~R$640,000 in federal funds will expand diagnosis and strengthen surveillance across 22 municipalities, including rapid tests, patient follow-up, and adherence support.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州が2025年に640例以上の結核患者と15名の死亡を報告。治癒率は80%を超える
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の定着感染症であり、ブラジル・アクレ州における2025年の統計報告である。治癒率83%と高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な危機を示唆していない。国家結核対策プログラムが機能しており、予想外の異常事態ではない。
triage.notes: 結核は慢性感染症であり、アクレ州は保健省から結核対策の優良地として認識されている。2025年の統計は前年比でむしろ改善傾向（661例から641例へ減少）を示しており、危機的シグナルではない。WPRO基準で長期曝露と流行性が該当するが、対応可能性が高く（治療成功率83%、公開スクリーニング、資金配分確保）、シグナル認定に至らない。

article.articleHeadline: Infectologista alerta sobre importância da vacinação contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious-disease specialist warns about the importance of measles vaccination.
article.articleSummary: As of March 25, 2026, Brazil is issuing constant alerts due to newly detected measles cases, highlighting ongoing transmission nationwide. The article features an interview with infectious-disease specialist Mirian Dal Ben conducted by Link News, emphasizing the critical importance of measles vaccination. Analyses and news about Brazil and the world are presented on RECORD NEWS. The piece does not provide exact case counts or geographic locations. It stresses that robust vaccination coverage, timely immunization, and clear public health messaging are essential to prevent further spread, protect vulnerable groups such as children and immunocompromised individuals, and reduce outbreak risk during travel-associated exposure. The interview underscores vaccination as a central measure to counter measles outbreaks amid rising alerts in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症専門医がはしか予防接種の重要性について警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのはか確定例の報告と予防接種の重要性が強調されているが、具体的な症例数、地理的詳細、または国際的拡大の証拠が欠けている。監視継続が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルでのはしかに関する公衆衛生警告を扱っているが、Bluedot APIが付与したBrazil(3469034)は対象国リストに含まれていない（対象国はZambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, Indiaのみ）。したがって verified_locations は空配列とする。具体的な症例数や地理的詳細が不足しており、情報が限定的であることから WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo é risco grave, diz infectologista e enfatiza duas doses da vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles pose a serious risk, says infectious disease specialist and emphasizes two doses of the vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks are a concern across the Americas, with active transmission in Mexico, the United States, and Canada; Brazil has reported its first case of the year. Infectious disease specialist Mirian Dal Ben warns measles is highly contagious and can leave severe neurological sequelae in children, underscoring vaccination as essential prevention. Vaccination is available free through Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS); the first dose is given at 12 months, followed by a second dose at 15 months. However, second-dose uptake is often lower, weakening population protection. Keeping the vaccination card up to date reduces hospitalizations and helps prevent a larger resurgence. Regional alerts emphasize surveillance and maintaining vaccinations, while authorities caution against vaccine misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: 麻しんは深刻なリスク、感染症専門医が語り2回接種の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 麻しんのアメリカ大陸での多国的な流行が報告されており、複数の国での活発な感染伝播、高い伝染性、神経学的合併症のリスクが確認されている。対象国ブラジルでの症例報告を含み、IHR基準の異常性・国際的拡大リスク・公衆衛生への重大な影響が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はメキシコ、米国、カナダでの麻しん流行を述べているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていない。対象国ではブラジルが該当し、初期症例が報告されている。ブラジルの予防接種プログラムにおける2回目接種率の低さと集団免疫の脆弱化が懸念事項として強調されている。地域的な監視と予防接種維持の強化が提唱されている。

article.articleHeadline: 'Xô dengue': força-tarefa recolhe materiais em bairros de Jundiaí | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Dengue, Out!": task force collects materials in Jundiaí neighborhoods | TVS+
article.articleSummary: Jundiaí, Brazil, launches a new phase of the 'Xô Dengue' campaign on March 26–27, 2026 in the Tamoio and Tarumã neighborhoods to curb Aedes aegypti breeding. Public cleaning crews remove water-holding items—containers, plastic packaging, tires—while the cata-treco program goes door-to-door to collect bulky discarded furniture. The operation aims to reduce dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission by targeting mosquito habitats. The full schedule is at jundiai.sp.gov.br. The effort is led by the Municipal Health Promotion Secretariat via Environmental Health Surveillance, in partnership with the 12th Group of Antiaircraft Artillery and with infrastructure and public services support. Dengue in 2026 shows 2 confirmed cases, 0 deaths, and 20 probable cases; 2025 saw 8,144 confirmed cases and 3 deaths, underscoring ongoing regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: 「デング撃退」：ジュンジャイの地区で作業部隊が材料を回収
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の多疾患イベント。2025年に高い罹患数（8,144確認例）と死亡例（3例）の実績があり、異常性と重症度が認識されているが、2026年は現在まで確認例2例と抑制傾向を示す。記事は予防的キャンペーンであり緊急的な流行拡大シグナルではない。情報不足により経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 2025年の高い罹患数（8,144例）と死亡例（3例）の実績から重症度ありと推測されるが、2026年現在の症例数は少なく（2確認例）、記事はデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の複合予防キャンペーン実施の報告である。地域蚊ベクター管理能力は機能しているように見えるが、2025年の実績と比較して現状の流行状況の詳細が不明なため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Mpox se espalham principalmente por contato sexual, diz infectologista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases spread mainly through sexual contact, says an infectious disease specialist.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Brazil remains linked mainly to sexual contact, though it is not classified as an STI. Ceará state has confirmed its third Mpox case in 2026; nationwide diagnoses have risen, with many cases detected in São Paulo after Carnival. By March 26, 2026, Brazil has recorded over 100 Mpox cases this year, following more than 1,000 in 2025. The incubation period is typically 13–14 days. Early symptoms resemble a flu-like illness, followed by skin lesions that start as red bumps, progress to pus-filled lesions, then crust, and can appear as a generalized rash; recovery of the skin usually takes 3–4 weeks. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with infected individuals and early diagnosis. Vulnerable groups include children under six and immunosuppressed people. Vaccination is recommended for these groups; Brazil has a vaccine available for those using HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis.

triage.headline_ja: Mpoxケースは主に性的接触で拡散、感染症専門医が指摘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるMpox（Clade I/II含む）の継続的な流行が確認され、2026年に100例以上、2025年に1,000例以上と大規模。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の流行拡大、複数州への地理的拡大、ワクチン接種戦略が必要であることから、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおけるMpoxの流行状況に焦点を当てており、性的接触による主要な感染経路、複数州（セアラ州、サンパウロ州）での確認、脆弱集団（6歳未満児、免疫抑制者）への対策、ワクチン接種推奨など、継続的な公衆衛生上の課題を示唆している。Clade IとClade IIの両方が報告されている点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde alerta para aumento dos casos de síndromes respiratórias em Guarapuava | JNotícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department warns of a rise in respiratory syndrome cases in Guarapuava | JNotícias
article.articleSummary: Guarapuava, Paraná, Brazil, authorities report a rise in respiratory syndrome cases, driving higher demand for health services. Surveillance data show a sharp uptick: epidemiological week 6 recorded 223 respiratory visits, rising to 818 in week 10 — a roughly 267 percent increase. Currently circulating respiratory viruses include rhinovirus, influenza A, and COVID-19, with rhinovirus predominant. The Health Secretariat attributes the surge to the seasonal peak. They caution against self medication, urging evaluation by a health professional before taking any medicines. Preventive measures include frequent hand hygiene, wearing a mask when symptomatic, avoiding close contact when ill, maintaining a balanced diet and adequate hydration. In coming days, an influenza vaccination campaign will begin for prioritized groups, particularly adults over 60, pregnant women, and children under five.

triage.headline_ja: グアラプアヴァにおける呼吸器症候群症例増加について保健局が警告 | JNotícias
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのグアラプアヴァにおいて呼吸器症候群の症例が季節的なピークにより増加しているが、現時点では深刻な公衆衛生影響は明記されていない。情報が限定的であり、続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的な呼吸器感染症の増加を報告しており、異常な事象ではなく予想範囲内。死亡や重症化の記載なし。公的衛生機関による対応（ワクチン接種キャンペーン）が既に計画されている。対象国はBrazilのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus H1N1 e H3N2 estavam em material furtado de laboratório da Unicamp - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 and H3N2 viruses were in material stolen from the Unicamp laboratory - ACidade ON Campinas.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A H1N1 and H3N2 samples, along with other human and swine viruses, were stolen from Unicamp's NB-3 biosafety facility in Campinas, Brazil. The material was moved to two other university labs on February 13 without authorization, recovered 40 days later, and sent to the Ministério da Agricultura, Pecuária e Abastecimento for analysis. NB-3 is Brazil's current highest biosafety level; a higher-containment NB-4 lab is under construction in Campinas, due in 2027. Investigations indicate handling occurred in uncontrolled settings and some material was discarded in ordinary trash, risking public health. Soledad Palameta Miller, a Unicamp professor, was arrested in flagrante and has provisional release on charges including theft of biological material, exposure of life or health to danger, irregular transport of genetically modified organisms, and procedural fraud; she is barred from related labs and from leaving the country without judicial authorization. PF found material in other labs; Unicamp says it cooperates and has opened an internal inquiry.

triage.headline_ja: ユニキャンプの研究室から盗まれた物質にH1N1およびH3N2ウイルスが含まれていた
triage.triage_reason: バイオセーフティレベル3施設からの無許可材料盗難・紛失により、インフルエンザA H1N1・H3N2サンプルが不適切に管理・廃棄され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響とバイオセキュリティリスクが存在。異常な事象であり、国際的な関心と支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: バイオセキュリティインシデント：NB-3施設から盗難されたインフルエンザサンプルが不適切な環境で取扱われ、通常のゴミとして廃棄された。容疑者は逮捕されている。WHOおよび国際的なバイオセーフティ当局への通知推奨。サンプルの追跡・回収状況の詳細把握が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Novos casos de mpox são confirmados em Belo Horizonte e Manhuaçu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New mpox cases confirmed in Belo Horizonte and Manhuaçu.
article.articleSummary: Two new mpox cases were registered in Belo Horizonte and Manhuaçu in Minas Gerais, Brazil, raising the state’s total to 17. The infections were confirmed by the State Health Secretariat (SES-MG) on March 25, after being detected on March 18 in both Belo Horizonte and the Zona da Mata region. All patients are male, aged 25–56, with recovery reported and no deaths. Mpox transmission occurs mainly via direct contact with skin lesions, close conversation, and contact with contaminated objects such as bedding and towels. Incubation ranges from 3 to 21 days. Early signs include fever followed by skin lesions that progress from macules to vesicles, pustules, and crusts. Preventive measures emphasize avoiding close contact with affected individuals, not sharing personal items, vaccination for priority groups, and prompt medical care for diagnosis and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: Belo Horizonte and Manhuaçu でMpoxの新規症例が確認される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではなく、該当する検証済み地域がない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当有無を判定できない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはブラジルが含まれていますが、ブラジルは評価対象国（GeoNames ID: 895949=Zambia, 1694008=Philippines, 1605651=Thailand, 2300660=Ghana, 203312=DRC, 3469034=Brazil, 1643084=Indonesia, 1814991=China, 1327865=Myanmar, 1562822=Vietnam, 1269750=India）に含まれていません。本シグナルはWPRO対象地域の監視対象外です。

article.articleHeadline: Deteksi Dini TBC di Sulawesi Barat Menguat: Mengapa Kenaikan Angka Kasus Adalah Kabar Baik?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early TB Detection in West Sulawesi Gains Momentum: Why the Rise in Case Numbers Is Good News?
article.articleSummary: West Sulawesi's Health Office (Dinkes P2KB Sulbar) reports a rise in early TB detections in early 2026, indicating sharper surveillance rather than worsened burden. As of February 2026, TB case identifications rose 8% vs. the same period in 2025, with an estimated 4,357 cases for 2026 and 595 cases (13.7%) already identified. Majene recorded the highest increase (44%), Mamuju surpassed the national target by identifying 21.4% of expected cases, and Polewali Mandar rose 13%. Mamasa, Mamuju Tengah, and Pasangkayu showed decreases, prompting stronger Active Case Finding (ACF). The 2026 strategy prioritizes rapid molecular testing (Tes Cepat Molekuler, TCM) and mass screening, with intensified district support and integration into the national Program Hasil Terbaik Cepat (PHTC) to accelerate TB elimination. Transparent data and complete treatment underpin a healthier next generation.

triage.headline_ja: 西スラウェシ州における結核の早期検出が強化：症例数の増加がなぜ良いニュースなのか？
triage.triage_reason: 結核の早期検出率向上を報告する記事であり、疾病負担の悪化ではなく監視体制の改善を示唆している。死亡や重篤な流行の兆候がなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念を示す基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の慢性疾患であり、記事の主旨は診断精度向上と早期検出の成功を示唆している。新規流行やアウトブレイクではなく、既存の結核対策における監視体制の強化を報告している。

article.articleHeadline: Health officials warn of higher dengue risk
article.articleSummary: Health Bureau officials warn of an elevated dengue fever and chikungunya transmission risk in 2026 as warmer weather coincides with rising mosquito breeding. Breeding levels climbed in February and March, with the ovitrap index reaching 2.2%, up from 0.7% and 1.2% a year earlier. The increase was more pronounced in older districts such as Fai Chi Kei and Barra, where aging buildings and standing water are common risk factors. Authorities have stepped up mosquito control campaigns and urged residents to eliminate stagnant water and install screens to reduce indoor exposure. The findings indicate a heightened local transmission potential despite ongoing control measures, underscoring the need for vigilance in both public spaces and households as temperatures continue to rise in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局がデング熱リスク上昇について警告
triage.triage_reason: マカオでのデング熱・チクングニアの局所伝播リスク上昇が報告されているが、現在のところ患者数増加や重篤例の明確な報告がなく、情報が限定的である。経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にBrazilが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はマカオ（中国マカオ特別行政区）でのデング熱・チクングニア伝播リスクである。ブラジルは記事に実質的に言及されていないため除外した。マカオは中国に含める。蚊媒介感染症の局所伝播リスク上昇が警告されており、蚊の繁殖指数が前年比で上昇している点が注目される。ただし、実際の患者発生数や重症度に関する情報が不足しているため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Diamantino realiza mutirão "Diamantino Limpo, Dengue Zero" em Deciolândia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall of Diamantino carries out a mass cleanup drive 'Diamantino Clean, Dengue Zero' in Deciolândia.
article.articleSummary: Diamantino’s City Hall launched the next phase of the mass cleanup campaign Diamantino Limpo, Dengue Zero in the Deciolândia neighborhood, aiming to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites and curb dengue risk. On day one, 30 dumpsters were filled with trash, wood, branches, and debris; throughout the week, road maintenance will include grading, graveling, and pothole repair. The initiative, organized by the Infrastructure and Works Department with the Health Department, is part of an ongoing municipal effort to improve urban conditions and prevent mosquito proliferation. Mayor Chico Mendes said services will reach distant areas; after Deciolândia, the next phase will be at Posto Gil. Secretary Leonildo Costa noted the work follows a defined schedule to maintain roads and local areas. Residents praised the effort, urging others to clean yards and leave debris curbside for collection.

triage.headline_ja: ジアマンチーノ市が「ジアマンチーノをきれいに、デング熱ゼロ」キャンペーンをデシオランディアで実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防・啓発キャンペーンであり、新規感染症アウトブレイクやIHR基準を満たす公衆衛生危機の兆候はない。既知の流行に対する通常の対策活動である。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルのDiamantino市によるデング熱予防キャンペーンの報告であり、新規アウトブレイクやシグナルではなく、通常の公衆衛生対策活動である。既知疾患の予防啓発のためトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Paraná em atenção: Américas somam mais de mil casos de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná on alert: The Americas tally more than 1,000 measles cases.
article.articleSummary: According to the Pan American Health Organization, over 1,000 measles cases were recorded in the Americas in the first weeks of 2026, a surge from early 2025. Paraná, Brazil, is on alert, though no cases have been confirmed. Vaccination remains the main protection; national second-dose coverage for the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine is about 75%, well below the 95% target, with uneven distribution among states. Paraná's coverage is above the national average but its second dose is still short of the ideal goal. Brazil was certified measles-free in 2024, but immunity gaps persist. Adults should review vaccination status, especially before travel; two doses are recommended up to age 29, and at least one dose for ages 30–59. The childhood schedule uses 12 and 15 months. In addition, maintain hygiene and seek care for fever, rash, cough, or runny nose.

triage.headline_ja: パラナが警戒態勢：アメリカ大陸で麻疹患者が1,000件以上に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（パラナ州）で麻疹を含む3つのワクチン予防可能疾病が流行している兆候があり、予防接種カバレッジが目標値に達していないため、スクリーニング基準を満たすが、ブラジル国内での確定患者が報告されていないため情報不足。
triage.notes: アメリカ大陸全体で1,000件以上の麻疹患者が記録されているが、ブラジル（パラナ州）ではまだ確定患者がない状態での警戒アラート。ただし、MMRワクチンの2回目接種率が全国平均で75%に留まり目標値95%に達していないこと、および成人の予防接種状況の把握不足が懸念される。スペインはWHO欧州地域であり対象外。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 está entre vírus furtados na Unicamp, diz site
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 influenza virus is among the stolen viruses at Unicamp, site says.
article.articleSummary: H1N1 and H3N2 influenza A viruses were among biological materials stolen from Unicamp's Virology Laboratory in Campinas, Brazil. A former professor, Soledad Palameta Miller, and her husband Michael Edward Miller are under investigation; the Federal Police say there was no external contamination and that all samples were recovered, remaining on campus. The theft also involved other human and swine samples, with materials kept secret by the Ministério da Agricultura e Pecuária. The laboratory is a biosafety level 3 facility; Brazil is building a level 4 facility in Campinas expected in 2027. The recovered samples were found about 350 meters from the original lab at the Faculdade de Engenharia de Alimentos, and also at the Tropical Diseases Laboratory and the Cell Culture Laboratory (Institute of Biology). Influenza A H1N1 and H3N2 routinely cause seasonal flu; a local expert notes these are biosafety level 2 agents, implying moderate risk to people and environment.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1はUnicampで盗まれたウイルスの中に含まれている、サイトは言う
triage.triage_reason: ウイルス盗難という異常で予想外のイベントだが、盗まれたサンプルはすべて回収されており、外部への病原体流出リスクは低い。季節性インフルエンザウイルスのため直接的な大規模感染症危機とは評価されない。
triage.notes: バイオセーフティレベル3施設からのウイルス盗難は生物セキュリティ上の懸念事項であり、政府レベルの対応が確認される。ただしサンプルはすべて回収済みで外部流出リスクは実質的に低いと当局が述べている。季節性インフルエンザウイルスであり、緊急の感染症危機には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Relatório de Monitoramento de Ovitrampas revela áreas de risco em Brasilândia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ovitrap Monitoring Report Reveals Risk Areas in Brasilândia.
article.articleSummary: As of March 26, 2026, Brasilândia’s Municipal Health Secretariat, Endemias Coordination, released Week 9 ovitrap monitoring results, highlighting Aedes aegypti egg-density hotspots—the mosquito that transmits dengue, chikungunya and Zika. Traps are located in Assentamento Almanara (1), Reassentamento Novo Porto João André (5), Aldeia Ofaié (1), Distrito Debrasa (3), Condomínio Beleza do Rio Verde (2), and Brasilândia (about 40 traps). The map uses colors: blue 0 eggs, green 1–20, yellow 21–50, orange 51–100, red 101+ eggs; red/orange areas signal need for intensified surveillance and vector control. Ovitraps consist of a dark water-filled pot with a wooden paddle to attract ovipositing females; eggs are collected weekly, lab-analyzed, and discarded to interrupt reproduction. Coordinator Carlos Rodrigues notes ovitraps complement, not replace, elimination of standing water, serving as an entomological surveillance tool to trigger targeted mutirões, home visits, and ongoing monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: オビトラップ監視レポートがブラジランディアのリスク地域を明らかにする
triage.triage_reason: ベクター監視に基づくルーチン的な疫学情報であり、重篤な公衆衛生事象の発生報告ではない。ただし複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング、チクングニア、ジカ）に関連する卵密度ホットスポット検出であり、情報の継続監視を推奨。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル（マットグロッソドスル州ブラジランディア自治体）における蚊媒介感染症（デング、チクングニア、ジカ）ベクターの定期監視報告であり、既知の疾患リスク地域での継続的なサーベイランス活動。実患者の発症や死亡報告はなく、オビトラップによる卵密度追跡に基づく予防的感視。複数の蚊媒介感染症に該当するため、地元保健当局の継続的関心は確認されるが、国際的な緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Conscientização, prevenção e cuidado no combate à Tuberculose - Viral Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Awareness, Prevention, and Care in the Fight Against Tuberculosis - Viral News
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis) remains a major airborne infectious disease affecting the lungs, with Brazil among countries reporting high case totals. Observed around World TB Day on March 24, awareness emphasizes early diagnosis and adherence to a treatment course of at least six months to cure infection and prevent transmission. Key symptoms include a cough lasting more than three weeks, fever, night sweats, and weight loss. Transmission occurs through respiratory droplets from an infected person during coughing, speaking or sneezing. Prevention hinges on prompt diagnosis, healthy living, and reducing risk factors such as low immunity and tobacco use; smoking damages lung defenses and increases vulnerability to TB. In support of cessation, Unimed Marília offers Espaço Viver Bem, a multidisciplinary program guiding beneficiaries through quitting, with ongoing support and strategies; contact Rua Coronel José Brás, 1087, (14) 2105-8191 for details.

triage.headline_ja: 結核との戦いにおける啓発、予防、ケア
triage.triage_reason: 結核の一般的な啓発記事であり、新規の疾病流行やアウトブレイク報告ではない。既知の公衆衛生課題に関する予防キャンペーン情報であるため、シグナルトリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事はWorld TB Day（3月24日）に合わせたブラジルの健康啓発キャンペーンであり、特定のアウトブレイク報告やインシデント通知ではない。既知の公衆衛生課題に対する一般的な予防メッセージのため、EBS活動のシグナルトリアージ対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Balai Veteriner Lampung minta peternak kendalikan PMK dari kandang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lampung Veterinary Office asks farmers to curb Foot-and-Mouth Disease from the barn
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) action in Lampung Province, Indonesia: veterinarians urge farmers in Lampung Timur to implement in-barn controls, report cases promptly, isolate sick cattle, and restrict livestock movements. Bandarlampung's Balai Veteriner Lampung reinforces disciplined biosecurity, epidemiological investigations (case tracing, interviews, sampling of sick animals and carcasses) to speed diagnosis and containment. Provincial authorities through Dinas Peternakan Lampung coordinate field support, bolstering biosecurity, accelerating disinfection, and farmer education, with vaccination promoted to boost herd immunity and curb spread. Emphasis on laboratory confirmation and surveillance; no specific case counts are provided. The response targets Lampung Province and its districts, aiming to prevent wider outbreak while safeguarding cattle health.

triage.headline_ja: ランプン獣医局が農民に家畜舎からの口蹄疫の抑制を要請
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ランプン州）での口蹄疫発生を示唆するシグナルであり、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目で該当の可能性があるが、具体的な症例数、重症度、または国際的拡大リスクに関する明確な情報が不足している。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ランプン州での口蹄疫（FMD）対応が公式な獣医当局と地域行政により実施されていることが確認される。具体的な患畜数や死亡数、臨床症状の詳細は記載されていない。バイオセキュリティ強化、疫学調査、ワクチン接種の推進が記述されており、既に複数の対策が展開されている。IHR基準では国際的拡大のリスクが明示されていないため「No」と評価した。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさが確認されるが、重症度と管理可能性は不明。政府関心と公衆（農業関係者）の関心は高いと判断される。フルRRA前に続報による確認が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa determina atualização de vacinas contra a covid-19 com nova cepa predominante no País; veja o que muda - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa mandates updating COVID-19 vaccines to address a new predominant strain in the country; see what changes - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Anvisa requires COVID-19 vaccines sold or used in the country to be monovalent and contain the SARS-CoV-2 LP.8.1 strain. A nine‑month transition allows vaccines based on the previous JN.1 strain to continue being used. The update reflects ongoing viral mutations, particularly in the spike protein, which may reduce match with older formulations but should still protect against severe disease. Unlike influenza, COVID-19 lacks a predictable season, complicating preemptive variant targeting. The reformulation does not trigger a universal restart of vaccination; the National Immunization Program will prioritize boosters for high‑risk groups—older adults, those with comorbidities, pregnant individuals, the immunocompromised, and health professionals. Doses already administered remain relevant for preventing hospitalizations and deaths, with a possible booster recommendation per individual. Practical impact on daily life is limited; follow official calendars and local health posts for booster indications.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのANVISA、新たな優勢株に対応するためCOVID-19ワクチンの更新を義務化；何が変わるのかを確認してください - Jornal O Sul
triage.triage_reason: 本件はワクチン製剤の規制上の更新指示であり、新規の感染症危機イベントではない。既存株への対応措置であり、公衆衛生への急性的な脅威や国際的拡大リスク、異常事態を示さない。
triage.notes: 記事は規制当局（ANVISA）による予防接種プログラムの技術的更新についての報道。新たな感染症クラスターや流行の拡大を示す情報なし。既存のCOVID-19対策における通常の変異株への対応措置であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Antibiotic resistance behind 87% of typhoid economic burden: Lancet
article.articleSummary: In 2023, antibiotic-resistant typhoid infections accounted for at least 87% of India’s typhoid-related economic burden, totaling Rs 12,300 crore. Children under 10 incurred the highest burden, contributing over half of costs. Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu and West Bengal together account for about 51% of national costs. Households borne 91% of expenses, with around 70,000 families facing catastrophic health expenditure. Typhoid fever is transmitted via contaminated food or water and presents with high fever, fatigue, headache and stomach pain. The study, by London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine and Christian Medical College, Vellore, published in The Lancet Regional Health Southeast Asia, provides evidence to support introducing the typhoid conjugate vaccine into India’s national immunisation schedule and to guide antibiotic resistance control and health-financing policy decisions.

triage.headline_ja: 抗生物質耐性がインドのチフス経済負担の87%を占める：ランセット
triage.triage_reason: チフスの抗生物質耐性に関する経済・公衆衛生影響データを報告する学術出版物。深刻な経済的負担と広範な地域的分布が確認されるが、新規発生イベント（outbreak）ではなく、過去データの分析報告であり、直近の緊急リスクは明示されていない。ただし、抗生物質耐性の重大さと人口規模の大きさから経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は2023年の過去データに基づく経済負担分析であり、新規outbreak通知ではない。しかし、インド全土における抗生物質耐性チフスの根深い問題と大規模な経済的影響を指摘する学術発表であり、公衆衛生上の関心は高い。ワクチン導入と抗生物質耐性対策の政策支援を促す内容で、政府レベルの関心も高いと考えられるが、国際的拡大リスクについては明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Stop Rabies Empowers Communities Toward a Rabies-Free Philippines - Manila Standard
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a major public health threat in the Philippines, causing 300–400 deaths and about 4 million animal bite cases annually. In the first two months of 2026, 17 human rabies cases were reported, with 13 linked to bites from unvaccinated stray animals. Boehringer Ingelheim’s Stop Rabies program, in collaboration with GARC, expands vaccination, education, and surveillance to communities including Puerto Galera, Marinduque, Laguna (Los Baños, Calauan), and Bacolod City, with Victorias planned. The initiative delivers school-based education on responsible pet ownership, post-exposure treatment, and free vaccination and neutering for dogs and cats. In 2025, the program vaccinated 4,837 animals, neutered 294, and educated 588 students across four schools; in March 2026, Los Baños reached over 8,000 students across 11 schools via UP Los Baños Veterinary Teaching Hospital. Stop Rabies pursues Zero by 30 under SD4G, expanding IEC campaigns and donor support for a rabies-free Philippines.

triage.headline_ja: Stop Rabies、フィリピンの狂犬病撲滅に向けたコミュニティエンパワーメント - マニラ・スタンダード
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はフィリピンにおける公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、重症度基準に該当するが、記事は主にNGOの予防活動キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、流行の拡大や新規の危機的状況を示唆していない。継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: フィリピンでの狂犬病は流行学的には既知・継続的な脅威であり、予想外の状況ではない。記事は2026年1-2月に17例の人的症例が報告されたことに言及しており、重症度と長期的な曝露リスクが確認される。ただしこの報告は公式な流行警報ではなく、NGOによる予防イニシアティブの進捗報告である。今後の症例増加や地理的拡大の報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh tay chân miệng gia tăng, nhiều trẻ nhập viện trong tình trạng nặng tại TP.HCM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease on the Rise, Many Children Hospitalized in Serious Condition in Ho Chi Minh City
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City faces a rebound in Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) with more severe cases. At the city’s pediatric hospitals, about 30 inpatients are treated daily at the Children's Hospital No. 1 Infectious–Neurology ward, with roughly one‑third at severity 2B or higher; outpatient HFMD cases total around 70. A 10‑month‑old from Tay Ninh was admitted after high fever and widespread vesicles. EV71 infections are common in this surge, a strain linked to neurological and cardiovascular complications and rapid progression. The Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Pediatrics No. 2 reports 81 inpatients, including 10 at level 2B. The Ho Chi Minh City Center for Disease Control (HCDC) logged 837 HFMD cases in the past week, up 97.1% from the four‑week average, with 2 deaths this week (year‑to‑date total 3). 79 new outbreaks (30 in schools, 49 in the community); year‑to‑date 286 outbreaks, 75 ongoing. Preschools have intensified hygiene, handwashing, dedicated supplies, and staff/parent awareness campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病が急増、ホーチミン市で多くの子どもが重症で入院
triage.triage_reason: EV71を含む手足口病の急増により、週単位で97.1%の症例増加、2名の死亡者、神経学的合併症のリスクがある。IHR基準3つ（深刻な影響、異常性、流行リスク）に該当し、地域検証では対象国ベトナムで確実に発生しているため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: EV71は神経学的・心血管系合併症を起こしやすい株。週間症例数97.1%増加、年間3例の死亡、複数の医療機関で同時多発的な重症例報告、学校・地域社会での79件の新規アウトブレイク報告。小児患者の主要な健康脅威として判定。

article.articleHeadline: She couldn't conceive despite IVF and good test results: How doctors found a silent and overlooked TB
article.articleSummary: Genital tuberculosis diagnosed in Mumbai, India. Kavita Seth, 27, infertile for four years; a tubal patency test showed blocked fallopian tubes, and laparoscopy revealed severe tubal damage with tubercular nodules; biopsy confirmed genital TB. After six months of anti-tubercular therapy (ATT), she was cured but irreversible tubal damage left IVF as the only option, which produced a child. A second Mumbai case from Sion showed multiple uterine lesions during repeated IVF failures; she required nine months of ATT after prior TB treatment. Genital TB stems from airborne TB bacteria, typically from a prior pulmonary infection, and can affect female reproductive organs (fallopian tubes, uterus) and male organs (testes). Symptoms may be mild or absent, delaying diagnosis. Standard TB treatment is six months: two months intensive four-drug phase (isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide, ethambutol) followed by four months of isoniazid and rifampicin; drug-resistant cases need longer regimens (9–20 months).

triage.headline_ja: IVFと良好な検査結果があっても妊娠できなかった彼女：医師がどのように見落とされていた静かな結核を発見したか
triage.triage_reason: 結核（特に生殖器TB）の診断報告であるが、ムンバイの個別症例報告に過ぎず、新規集団発生や急速な流行の兆候がない。公開医療教育記事として社会的関心はあるが、大規模な公衆衛生危機には該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド（ムンバイ）での生殖器結核症例を報道しており、医学的に注目される診断事例である。症例数が限定的（2症例報告）であり、流行あるいは集団発生の兆候はない。生殖器結核は結核菌の潜伏感染に由来するため、新規エマージングトレンドというより診断遅延の医学教育記事と解釈される。標準的な抗結核療法で対応可能であり、国際的支援の必要性はない。したがってWATCH段階での経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah Virus Outbreak 2026 LIVE Updates: Will there be another lockdown? Kerala issues high alert from April to September 2026 based on previous NiV outbreak patterns
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus (NiV) outbreak alert in Kerala, India, with a high alert activated for April–September 2026 based on past NiV patterns. NiV is a high-risk zoonotic pathogen, with case fatality historically ranging 40–75%. Authorities warn of seasonal risks linked to fruit bats and call for heightened surveillance, early detection, and strict infection control measures. Kerala has experienced Nipah outbreaks since 2018, often presenting with severe respiratory illness and fatal encephalitis; there is no approved vaccine or specific antiviral treatment. Transmission is primarily associated with fruit bats, with potential human-to-human transmission in certain settings. The article emphasizes ongoing public health measures and monitoring and does not specify current case counts. The emphasis remains on a high-alert posture for 2026 rather than any confirmed lockdowns.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス発生2026年ライブ更新：別のロックダウンがあるか？ケーラ州は過去のニパウイルス発生パターンに基づいて2026年4月から9月の高警戒態勢を発令
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス（NiV）の季節的発生警戒が発令され、致死率40-75%の高リスク人獣共通感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため、IHR基準複数項目に該当し、スクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は確認された症例数を特定していないが、2026年4月-9月の季節的警戒態勢の発令に基づいている。ケーラ州は2018年以降複数のニパウイルス発生の経験がある。高致死率（40-75%）、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、治療法なしという要素から、重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の基準に該当。

article.articleHeadline: 식약처, 식용얼음 검사...공차 매장 2곳 적발 '세균수 초과'·매머드익스프레스 1곳 '대장균 양성' - 굿모닝경제
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MFDS Inspects Edible Ice... Two Gong Cha Stores Cited for Exceeding Bacterial Counts; One Mammoth Express Store Positive for E. coli - Good Morning Economy.
article.articleSummary: South Korea’s Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) inspected 418 edible-ice samples from coffee shops and fast-food outlets from Feb 23 to Mar 6, aiming to bolster hygiene as spring demand rises. Tests targeted Salmonella, Escherichia coli, and overall bacterial counts. Seven samples were noncompliant: six exceeded total bacterial counts and one exceeded E. coli. Seven eateries temporarily stopped using their ice machines and conducted thorough cleanings, disinfection, and filter replacement to ensure hygienic ice production. Noncompliant outlets included Gong Cha branches in Dongjak District (Seoul) and Hwaseong Bongdam; Between the Clouds in Nam District, Gwangju; Mammoth Express in Yangcheon District Office Istaville branch (Seoul) with E. coli detected; I Got Everything at Sejong Government Convention Center; Atti in Boeun County, Chungbuk; Twenty Percent Coffee at Hwajeong Hills State, Gwangju. MFDS distributed an ice-maker sanitation guide and pledged ongoing preventive sampling during peak periods.

triage.headline_ja: 食薬処、食用氷検査...공차店舗2ヵ所で「菌数超過」、マンモスエクスプレス1ヵ所で「大腸菌陽性」検出
triage.triage_reason: 食用氷からの食中毒病原体検出（大腸菌、サルモネラ関連）は公衆衛生上の懸念を示すが、検出数は限定的（418サンプル中7件）で、患者発生の報告がなく、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクは現段階では低い。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 食用氷という日常的な環境検査であり、実際の患者症例の報告がない点が重要。大腸菌検出は懸念材料だが、検出数が少ない（418件中1件）。ベトナムの地域名がBluedot APIで抽出されているが、記事サマリーにベトナムでのイベント発生の記載がないため除外。韓国当局による予防的対応が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Con đường chính lây truyền bệnh lậu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The primary route of transmission of gonorrhea.
article.articleSummary: Gonorrhea, caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae, is primarily transmitted through sexual contact. The bacterium infects moist mucosal surfaces including the urethra, cervix, uterus, vagina, penis, rectum, eyes, and throat. Unsafe vaginal, anal, and oral sex are the main routes; mother-to-child transmission at birth can cause neonatal conjunctivitis. Oral sex can spread infection to the pharynx, often with mild symptoms that are easy to confuse with common throat infections. Untreated infection can cause infertility in both men and women, pelvic inflammatory disease, ectopic pregnancy, epididymitis, and urethral strictures; in newborns it can cause conjunctivitis leading to blindness. Disseminated gonococcal infection may occur with fever and multi-system involvement (skin, joints, heart, meninges). Antibiotic resistance is rising; no vaccine exists, though the meningococcal B vaccine (4CMenB) shows potential cross-protection. Prevention focuses on correct, consistent condom use and notifying partners.

triage.headline_ja: 淋病の主な感染経路
triage.triage_reason: 記事はベトナムでの淋病の具体的な患者数、死亡、流行状況を報告していない。むしろ疾患の医学的情報（感染経路、症状、合併症、耐性菌について）の一般的な説明である。公衆衛生上の危機や異常な感染症イベントの報告ではないため、シグナルの基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は淋病の医学的情報（感染経路、症状、合併症、予防方法）についての教育的な説明記事であり、ベトナムでの流行や患者発生状況の報告ではない。記事サマリーに具体的な患者数、地域流行、異常な増加傾向などの情報がないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定した。

article.articleHeadline: Vi rút độc lực cao đe dọa bùng phát dịch tay chân miệng ở TPHCM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Highly virulent virus threatens to trigger an outbreak of hand, foot and mouth disease in Ho Chi Minh City.
article.articleSummary: Hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) is resurging in Ho Chi Minh City with atypical presentations. Highly virulent Enterovirus 71 (EV71) detected in about 25% of tested samples. As of week 11, 2026, Ho Chi Minh City reported 7,294 HFMD cases, up 241% year-on-year, including 98 severe cases (grade 2b or higher), up 4.6x. Week 11 saw 837 cases. Since year start, 288 outbreaks have been identified—162 in schools and 126 in the community. Clinicians warn lesions may appear in hidden areas (buttocks, around the anus, or edges of fingers/toes) with symptoms like mouth sores, poor appetite, and drooling; some children lack obvious rashes. Authorities have enacted containment measures: enhanced surveillance, rapid isolation and treatment, improved school hygiene including handwashing facilities, and prompt sample testing for severe cases. Parents should perform comprehensive checks and seek urgent care for danger signs such as fever >39°C, seizures, difficulty breathing, or prolonged crying.

triage.headline_ja: 高い病原性を持つウイルスがホーチミン市での手足口病の流行を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による手足口病の急速な流行増加（前年比241%）、重症例の大幅増加（4.6倍）、288件の集団発生が確認されており、IHR基準2項目以上、WPROスクリーニング基準3項目以上に該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Ho Chi Minh Cityは記事の主な発生地であり、Vietnamの対象国リストに含まれるため検証済み。EV71の高い病原性、非典型的な臨床表現、学校（162件）および地域（126件）での多発的な集団発生、重症例の急速な増加、当局による厳格な対応措置が実施されている。ただし、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクについては現在の情報では評価できない。

article.articleHeadline: 2 wild bats found in Escondido test positive for rabies
article.articleSummary: Rabies detected in two wild bats found in Escondido, San Diego County. The first bat was discovered Saturday around 4 p.m. near the White Oak Villas condo complex and collected by the San Diego Humane Society. The second bat was found Sunday just after 10 a.m. at the San Diego Zoo Safari Park, on a rock wall outside the Okavango Restaurant; it was not a park bat and was safely collected by staff. These are the fourth and fifth rabid bats identified in the county this year, with the County Public Health Laboratory confirming infection. Residents with potential contact should call County Public Health Services at 619-692-8499; if exposure occurs, wash the area thoroughly and seek medical advice immediately. Rabies is preventable; without prompt post-exposure treatment, it is almost always fatal. The last local human rabies case was in 2001 (dog bite in the Philippines).

triage.headline_ja: エスコンディドで発見された2頭の野生コウモリが狂犬病で陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 米国カリフォルニア州での動物由来狂犬病事例。IHR基準では国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが低く、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性が認められるが、対象地域（米国）が監視対象国に含まれない。情報精度の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は米国カリフォルニア州での動物由来狂犬病事例。Bluedot APIが Philippines (1694008) を発生地域に含めているが、サマリーではフィリピンは2001年の過去事例参照のみであり、現在のイベント発生地ではない。対象国リストに米国が含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。ローカルな動物衛生事例として位置付けられ、シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: 健康服务零距离 结核防控入人心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zero-Distance Health Services: TB Prevention and Control Reaches People's Hearts.
article.articleSummary: On 24 March 2026, in Shangli County’s Changping Township Health Center, with the Changping Township Epidemic Prevention and Health Care Station, a World Tuberculosis Day outreach event was held in the outpatient hall. The theme, All-out Action, Full Commitment, Widespread Participation, End TB, aimed to strengthen grassroots TB prevention and health literacy. The setup included LED banners and science posters as staff explained TB transmission, typical symptoms, standard treatment workflows, and China’s national policy of free TB treatment, stressing early detection and treatment and dispelling misconceptions. The event also offered free blood pressure checks and health counseling, along with guidance on ventilation, personal protection, and healthy living during the spring respiratory illness peak. Over 200 TB prevention materials were distributed, and more than 70 on-site consultations were provided, bringing health services directly to residents.

triage.headline_ja: ゼロ距離の保健サービス 結核防控が人心に届く
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは3月24日の世界結核デー啓発活動の報道であり、結核の流行やアウトブレイクではなく、公衆衛生教育・予防活動の紹介記事です。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当せず、社会的関心も限定的です。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベント（流行・アウトブレイク）ではなく、既知の風土病（結核）に関する定期的な公衆衛生啓発キャンペーン報道です。Bluedot APIが検出したものの、シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象外です。

article.articleHeadline: O que é o vírus Oropouche? Doença já infectou mais de 5 milhões no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the Oropouche virus? The disease has already infected more than 5 million people in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Oropouche virus has re-emerged in Brazil after the 2023 outbreak with more than 30,000 confirmed cases and the country’s first death. Since then, the virus has spread from the Amazon to all states, expanding regional risk. Brazilian estimates reach about 5.5 million infections, possibly up to 9.4 million across Latin America and the Caribbean. Many cases go unregistered due to mild symptoms or diagnostic gaps; in Manaus, about 300,000 infections were estimated in 2023–2024, far above official counts. The arbovirus causes dengue-like illness—fever, headache, malaise—with a small fraction progressing to severe disease (≈1 in 1,000). A newly identified lineage from genetic recombination may boost transmissibility. Unlike dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, the vector is Culicoides paraensis (maruim), breeding in humid, organic-rich habitats; fumigation is largely ineffective. WHO calls for accelerated prevention and control as the virus has circulated for decades but is rising recently.

triage.headline_ja: オロポウシェウイルスとは何か？この病気はすでにブラジルで500万人以上に感染している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準で4項目該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性）。大規模な発生規模（510万～940万推定感染）、複数国への拡大、WHOの警告、新しい組み換え系統の出現により、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルでのオロポウシェウイルス再出現を主題としている。2023年の集団発生以降、アマゾナス州・パラー州から全国に拡大し、ラテンアメリカ・カリブ海地域への拡大も報告。新しい遺伝子組み換え系統による伝播性の増加、多数の未登録感染、WHOの加速的な予防・制御要請により、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。対象国リストではBrazilのみ該当。
